101.name: Character EXP
101.desc: Character EXP, used to level up characters.

102.name: Adventure EXP
102.desc: Adventure EXP. Used to improve Adventure Rank.

103.name: Stardust
103.desc: Small talent points (Including the main character)

104.name: Starglitter
104.desc: Large talent points (Including the main character)

105.name: Companionship EXP
105.desc: Companionship EXP. Used to increase Friendship levels.

106.name: Original Resin
106.desc: Used to vitalize Petrified Trees and Ley Line Blossoms, allowing access to the treasures they hold. Energy regenerates over time.\nIt is said that the roots of all the Irminsul trees and blossoms in the world are intertwined at the deepest, most hidden place in the earth, and that the pattern the root system makes defines the Ley Lines of the world.

107.name: Story Key
107.desc: A key used to unlock Story Quests.\nObtained by completing the required number of Daily Commissions.

109.name: Fading Star's Might
109.desc: A collection of celestial energy.\nCan be exchanged for treasure during the "Unreconciled Stars" event.

110.name: Fading Star's Essence
110.desc: Distilled celestial energy.\nCan be exchanged for valuable treasure during the "Unreconciled Stars" event.\nThe essence of a faraway star. The power emanating from within is warm to the touch.

111.name: Glimmering Essence
111.desc: A collection of vital energy that exudes a faint glimmer of light.\nCan be exchanged for treasure during the event "The Chalk Prince and the Dragon."

112.name: Warm Essence
112.desc: A collection of vital energy that exudes a gentle warmth.\nCan be exchanged for precious treasure during the event "The Chalk Prince and the Dragon."

113.name: Miraculous Essence
113.desc: A wondrous energy capable of reviving and mutating a withered Cryo Regisvine.\nCan be exchanged for invaluable treasure during the event "The Chalk Prince and the Dragon."

114.name: Iron Coin
114.desc: An ancient type of coinage that Ulman is collecting. Perhaps he may offer you something in exchange for Iron Coins.\nLong ago, there was once an organization that attempted to found their own nation. These coins were the nation's minted currency at the time.

115.name: Peace Talisman
115.desc: Jade talismans that can be obtained during Lantern Rite. The people of Liyue believe that these talismans can bring and defend peace. You might be able to exchange these for some things during Lantern Rite...
source_list: Obtained by completing the Theater Mechanicus challenge quest

116.name: Festive Fever
116.desc: The festive mood during Lantern Rite. Perhaps the atmosphere on the day of the Rite will be better the higher the Festive Fever is...
source_list: Obtained by completing Lantern Rite Tales

117.name: Veneficus Sigil
117.desc: A resource used to build all manner of mechanisms in the Theater Mechanicus. Still, the word "veneficus" itself seems to come from some old book...
source_list: Obtained by completing the Theater Mechanicus challenge

118.name: Festive Tour Ticket
118.desc: Take part in the celebratory activities of the Windblume Festival to obtain these tickets and exchange them in the event shop for rewards.\nThe people of Mondstadt are fun-loving by nature, and they have a celebration for the seasons, the harvests of different crops, and the anniversaries of events of historic significance. Perhaps there might be a festival to commemorate the outlander who repelled Stormterror someday...?
source_list: Obtained by completing the Bullseye Balloons challenge
Obtained by completing the Floral Freefall challenge
Obtained by completing the Ballads of Breeze challenge

119.name: Peculiar Collab Coupon
119.desc: Take part in the Windblume Festival event Domain to obtain these coupons and exchange them in the event shop for rewards.\nThis Domain of exceeding peculiarity is also part of the Windblume Festival celebrations, and it displays the fun-loving nature of Mondstadt's people.
source_list: Obtained by completing the Peculiar Wonderland challenge

120.name: Heart of the Spring
120.desc: The true heart of an Oceanid. This item is truly hard to find, for one must become one with the waters to truly perceive the heart of the springs.

121.name: Trust
121.desc: Accumulate this to increase your Trust Rank.

122.name: Fractured Fruit Data
122.desc: Irminsul Fruit fragment data that you have obtained via calculations and analysis performed by the Energy Amplifier. It contains a vast bounty of knowledge that may yet lead to surprising gains if you use it well.

123.name: Windtrace Coins
123.desc: The currency that is awarded for participating in Windtrace.\nThe "background settings" of this same game will change in different areas. Though it is still a game of chase-and-catch, the fleeing party are named the "Rebels" in Mondstadt, while their pursuer is the "Hunter," symbols both of the ancient resistance and oppression.\nOf course, the children of Mondstadt know well that this is just a game, and no true sense of enmity emerges as they play.

124.name: Shiny Flotsam
124.desc: Shells brought in by the tide that shine gorgeously, filled with the breath of the sea.\nCan be exchanged for precious treasures during the "Midsummer Island Adventure" event.
source_list: Obtained by completing the "Main Cannon, Make Ready... Fire!" challenge

125.name: Mini "Harpastum"
125.desc: These crystal-clear marbles have a bright feather sealed within them, making them miniature harpasta that are easy to collect.\nCan be exchanged for precious treasures during the "Midsummer Island Adventure" event.
source_list: Obtained by completing the "Harpastum Bombs Loaded... Blow 'Em Away!" challenge

126.name: Enigma Gear
126.desc: Intricately crafted parts from Dodofortresses that look rather valuable. Can be exchanged for rewards.
source_list: Obtained by completing the Kaboomball Kombat challenge

127.name: Thunder Pellet
127.desc: A shard of concentrated violet lightning, fizzing with strange Electro energy. Can be exchanged for precious treasures during the "Thunder Sojourn" event.
source_list: Obtained by completing the Bolt Blitz challenge
Obtained by completing the Lightning Round challenge
Obtained by completing the Weaving Lightning challenge

128.name: Thunder Crystal
128.desc: A crystal formed from concentrated violet lightning, fizzing with strange Electro energy. Can be exchanged for valuable treasure during the event "Thunder Sojourn" event.
source_list: Obtained by completing the Automaton Front challenge

129.name: Mechanicus Mastery EXP
129.desc: Accumulate this to raise your Mastery Level. Raise your Mastery Level to obtain new Mechanici and Wondrous Sticks.
source_list: Obtained by completing the Theater Mechanicus: Stage of Wonders challenge

130.name: Wondrous Talisman
130.desc: A mysterious talisman obtained by playing Theater Mechanicus: Stage of Wonders. Exchange them with Komakata for some precious items.
source_list: Obtained by completing the Theater Mechanicus: Stage of Wonders challenge

132.name: Battered Shikifuda
132.desc: Shikifuda that have become terribly tattered. The intricate, esoteric charms have long ago become blurred and cannot be used in combat. However, the energy within these shikifuda is still sufficient to activate Charm Emplacements.\nUse these items in the Labyrinth Warriors event to re-draw Charms.
source_list: Obtained by completing the Labyrinth Warriors event

133.name: Damaged Replica
133.desc: Shikigami replicas whose charm magic has long since faded. They cannot reawaken Shiki Taishou's memories, but if gathered together, they can still help him reclaim his past power.\nUse these items in the Labyrinth Warriors event to enhance Shiki Taishou's abilities.
source_list: Obtained by completing the Labyrinth Warriors event

134.name: Aged Token
134.desc: Leftover wooden military ID tokens that record the names of the warriors who once fought within the Mystic Onmyou Chamber.\nExchange these items in the Labyrinth Warriors event for valuable treasure.
source_list: Obtained by completing the Labyrinth Warriors event

135.name: Snowstrider Seal
135.desc: An insignia given to those who complete the special training conducted by the Adventurers' Guild. It can be considered a symbol of one's strength.
source_list: Complete Dragonspine Special Training to obtain

136.name: Vanquisher's Emblem
136.desc: A precious insignia obtained from conquering a great trial. These emblems won't morph into anything else... Right?
source_list: Complete Rise of the Fell Flower to obtain

137.name: Affluence Talisman
137.desc: A wondrous talisman said to be able to connect people to "fortune." In Liyue Harbor, many children are asked by their parents to carry this sort of talisman with them all the time.
source_list: Obtained by completing "Fleeting Colors in Flight"

138.name: Immaculate Talisman
138.desc: An exquisite talisman that seems quite valuable. You should be able to exchange this for certain items...
source_list: Obtained by completing "Fleeting Colors in Flight"

139.name: Conquest Talisman
139.desc: A strange talisman that appeared out of nowhere on your person. You can still feel powerful emotions emanating vaguely from this talisman when you hold it tight...
source_list: Obtained by completing "Fleeting Colors in Flight"

140.name: Moonlit Cragstone
140.desc: A stone that gives off a strange radiance. It can only be found in a separate part of The Chasm, and its origins and composition are both unknown. However, it has strange and unique properties: When it falls, it maintains a regular shape and its cross-section still keeps its mirrored sheen. Those of these rocks that are older may have witnessed that ancient battle.\nThese stones can be exchanged for treasures during "Perilous Trail."

141.name: Iridescent Flotsam
141.desc: The shell of some sea creature, hard in texture and scattered in the Golden Apple Archipelago. As if affected by a certain power, its surface loses all its natural patterns and becomes iridescent instead.\nCan be exchanged for treasure during "Summertime Odyssey."
source_list: Obtained from completing Phantom Realm challenges

142.name: Stratagem Shard
142.desc: A crystal that contains a deep and subtle power. Much like Cor Lapis, it has a pure Geo-gold hue. Its power can be activated to some extent within this space under The Chasm, thus helping to defeat monsters.\nThis can be used in the "Realms of Guile and War" of "Perilous Trails" to draw Stratagems or allow characters who have fallen to take to the field once again.

143.name: Creative Note
143.desc: After much discussion with your companions during the adventure, you summed up some thoughtful suggestions on how Aranara Carvings can become more popular. Can be exchanged for precious treasures during the "Graven Innocence" event.
source_list: Complete the "Metamorphosis of Wood" challenge to obtain

144.name: Whimsical Draft
144.desc: A quick sketch of inspirations for "Aranara Carvings" made during the adventure. Can be exchanged for precious treasures during the "Graven Innocence" event.

145.name: Ancient Iron Coin
145.desc: Ancient iron currency which, according to Ulman, is worth an awful lot of money. However, it doesn't feel like anything special to the touch...

146.name: Player EXP
146.desc: Obtained by winning Genius Invokation TCG matches. Every duel you won builds upon the paths to victory, such is the act of earning experience itself. To know how to overcome and subdue the adversary in any situation is the greatest strength that a player can possess.

147.name: Festive Fever
source_list: Obtained from the Of Ballads and Brews event

148.name: Business Earnings
148.desc: A sizable amount of Fairbrew Jelly, representing the sum total of your earnings in this charity event. As the Weinlesefest draws to a close, Bernhard will exchange these for Mora to give to old folks and children who need it.

149.name: Usable Funds
149.desc: A sizable amount of Fairbrew Jelly, representing the base capital used in setting up your shop.\nAttracting customers and increasing earnings — these two are the key goals of all shopkeepers. As such, you must plan out your spending and increase the attractiveness of your shop.

150.name: Strategic Inspiration
150.desc: Materials that contain various theories and case studies related to mercantile practice. To those with the appropriate experience, every page and every word is filled with possible inspiration for ways to improve.

151.name: Mushroom Currency
151.desc: A finely-crafted memorial coin, and the reward given to outstanding participants in the Fungus Capture and Coruscating Potential stages of the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament.\nNo matter the results of the competition, these coins are proof of the friendly associations between the participants and the tame Fungi.\nThese coins can be used to exchange for precious items during the "Fabulous Fungus Frenzy" event.
source_list: Obtained from Fungus Capture and Coruscating Potential

152.name: Fungus Medal
152.desc: A medal made from unique materials, and the reward given to outstanding participants in the Special Training stage of the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament.\nWorking together to defeat powerful enemies in the Special Training grounds is one of the key aspects to nurturing the bond between you and your Fungi friends and growing stronger together.\nThese coins can be used to exchange for precious items during the "Fabulous Fungus Frenzy" event.

153.name: Shattered Phenocryst
153.desc: A mysterious crystalline substance that you obtained after defeating the mighty Hypostases within a heretofore undiscovered Domain. Its lovely colors are like the remnant light of the elements as they are scattered.\nCan be used to exchange for valuable resources in the event "Hypostatic Symphony: Dissonant Verse"
source_list: Obtained from the "Hypostatic Symphony: Dissonant Verse" event

155.name: Courage Test Ticket
155.desc: Ticket earned from a participant's display of courage and insight by completing special challenges in the "Test of Courage" event hosted by the Yashiro Commission.\nYou can exchange these tickets for rewards during the "Akitsu Kimodameshi" event.

156.name: Festive Fever
source_list: Obtained from The Exquisite Night Chimes

157.name: Floral Coupon
157.desc: You can obtain these reward coupons by playing games of Floral Chess during the Windblume Festival. During the event, you can exchange them for rewards.

158.name: Gala Excitement
source_list: Take part in the A Parade of Providence event to obtain

159.name: Festive Ticket
159.desc: You can obtain these reward tickets by taking part in the various festivities during the Windblume Festival. During the event, you can exchange them for rewards.

160.name: Invokation Coupons
160.desc: You can obtain these coupons after participating in various events at the King of Invokations Grand Prix. During the event, you can exchange them for rewards.
source_list: Claim from the "Duel! The Summoners' Summit!" event

161.name: Joyeux Voucher
161.desc: Vouchers found inside Voucher Boxes throughout the Veluriyam Mirage. They are exquisitely made and come in vivid colors. Just gripping them in your hand seems to impart the joy of winning a reward.\nCan be used to unlock valuable rewards during the "Secret Summer Paradise" event.
source_list: Obtain from the "Secret Summer Paradise" event

162.name: Fascinating Phenocryst
162.desc: A crystal that radiates a magnificent luster. Looking upon it for a time will bring back fun memories of taking part in various games. With so many interesting sights to be seen within the Veluriyam Mirage, is it strange that such vast quantities of joy would crystallize into a pure gemstone?\nCan be used to unlock valuable rewards during the "Secret Summer Paradise" event.
source_list: Obtain from the "Secret Summer Paradise" event

163.name: Enigmatic Copper Mainspring
163.desc: A mainspring with an enigmatic metal luster. Its surface is said to have been processed with a secret technique that grants desirable properties to the inexpensive base metal. The method ensures the mainspring's good performance at a low price when utilized in core meka.\nIt can be used to exchange for supplies and unlock rewards in "Mega Meka Melee."

166.name: Thelxie's Badge
166.desc: A golden penguin badge that shines with a metallic glow. It seems to give the bearer a staunch resolve to move forward...\nA precious reward that can be unlocked in the "Thelxie's Fantastic Adventures" event.
source_list: Obtained from the "Thelxie's Fantastic Adventures" Event

167.name: Theater Tickets
167.desc: Exquisitely-made souvenir tickets meant to memorialize participation in the various events related to the Fontinalia Film Festival. These tickets are said to be made to have a similar texture to film slides. Crystal-clear when reflecting light, they resemble nothing so much as thin gem fragments...\nUse these to unlock various rewards during the "Roses and Muskets" event.
source_list: Obtained from the "Roses and Muskets" event

168.name: Ancient Iron Coin
168.desc: Ancient iron currency which, according to Ulman, is worth an awful lot of Mora. However, it doesn't feel like anything special to the touch...

169.name: Festive Fever
source_list: Obtained from the "Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze" event

170.name: Film for Fun
170.desc: Souvenir coins shaped like film slides. These are mementos that can be accumulated and won through participation in the Fontinalia Film Festival. These cannot be placed within specialized devices to play exciting films, sure, but their unique designs are sure to lift peoples' spirits with reminders of what they saw during that festival...\nThese can be exchanged for valuable rewards during the "Roses and Muskets" event.
source_list: Obtained from the "Roses and Muskets" event

171.name: Funds
171.desc: Funds obtained from running the alchemy shop, which can be reinvested into various matters surrounding said shop. Cultivating more ingredients, producing potions, and the scale of your operations...\nA good shopkeeper always keeps an eye on their shop funds and has a considerable sum at hand. That way, you will be able to maintain a profitable, expanding business...

172.name: Iridescence Tour Tickets
172.desc: A mysterious ticket that symbolizes the spirit of rock 'n' roll. It appears able to grant its holder hot-blooded passion...\nYou can exchange this for valuable rewards during the "Iridescent Arataki Rockin' for Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness," and send an invitation to an important companion...
source_list: Obtained from the "Iridescent Arataki Rockin' for Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness"

173.name: Analysis Progress
173.desc: By initiating wargames and collecting the combat data therein, we can provide useful points of reference for the various commanders and analyze the abilities of various monsters, as well as how to effectively defeat them...
source_list: Obtained from the "Mutual Security Enhancing Simulation" event

174.name: Excerpts of Bliss
174.desc: Pages found while exploring Simulanka. They contain text fragments that describe the daily lives of the realm's inhabitants. Filled as they are with leisure and joy, they set outsiders at ease, that they too may enjoy unforgettable and happy times with their companions in this marvelous wonderland.

176.name: Starsail Coin
176.desc: A custom coin with a starry emblem carved into it. Exquisitely crafted, it seems to carry the blessings of the one who made it. And who knows? Perhaps good things will come when you use it!\nYou can use it to obtain fairytale figurines from Fantastical Fabricators in the "Summertide Scales and Tales" event.

177.name: Colorful Contemplation
177.desc: Inspiration for graffiti that, following Dopey Dazzler's suggestion, you've gathered from various sightseeing spots across Natlan. When you calm your mind and focus on the act of observing things, you find that you are able to glean a more thorough understanding of their shapes and colors, which proves greatly beneficial when creating graffiti...\nCan be used to unlock all sorts of material rewards during the "Traces of Artistry" event.
source_list: Obtained from the "Traces of Artistry" event

178.name: Festive Fervor
178.desc: The festive fervor of the Sabzeruz Festival can be continually accumulated by participating in festival events and be used to unlock various rewards.
source_list: Obtained from the "Chromatic Ode of Candies and Roses" event

179.name: Incense Ashcrystals
179.desc: When a person burns incense to enter a state of clairvoyance, the ash leftover from the consumed incense condenses into these crystals. The sides reflect the time that was spent Spiritseeking.
source_list: Obtained from the "Iktomi Spiritseeking Scrolls" event

181.name: Festival Stamp
181.desc: A stamp gained from playing games at the Mikawa Flower Festival. It represents both the festival-goer's appreciation and the creator's passion...
source_list: Obtained from the "Enchanted Tales of the Mikawa Festival" event

182.name: Smiley Snacks
182.desc: A tasty treat combining a variety of aromatic ingredients with a soft and crumbly base. Ingredients are carefully selected, and the finished result is safe for 99% of Teyvat's animals to eat. This sumptuous snack is a delicious invitation for animal friends from far and wide to visit the Mellow Manor...

183.name: Funds
183.desc: The total funding pool reserved for operating the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland. It is the source of investment for all of the park's amusements, and the destination for all of their income. Only by ensuring that every last Mora is invested correctly can profits be maximized...

184.name: Action Points
184.desc: Equivalent to the "time slots" that Navia told you about. These are the units of time in which all work at the park is allocated, based on the principles of time management. Using words that even Paimon can understand, they are "points required to perform actions."\nAs management skills and working efficiency improve, more work can be completed in the same amount of time, allowing for the day to be subdivided into a larger number of time slots, thereby increasing the amount of work completed...

185.name: Speculative Records
185.desc: Records collected through careful observations of the Companion Caper Chronicles' tabletop adventure game and fruit-feeding trials. Fadaweh uses these records to calculate and extrapolate various scenarios and data for the Companion Caper Chronicles. Though initially a game made for children, she will not tolerate even the slightest inaccuracy in the data.
source_list: Obtained from the "Battle of Imagined Arrays" event

186.name: Sunspray Spirit
186.desc: A small pattern in the shape of an Asha that exudes the mesmerizing colors of summer. Increase your summer heat and enjoy everything this precious holiday has to offer!
source_list: Obtained from the "Sunspray Summer Resort" event

187.name: Legion Morale
187.desc: The Clink Clank Legion's morale affects Aino's efficiency and is crucial to the investigation!
source_list: Obtained from the "Clink Clank Clash" event

188.name: Prep Progress
188.desc: Preparation work progress made on behalf of the Fieldwise Center. Once adequate preparation work has been completed, the Fieldwise Center should be able to operate on its own...
source_list: Obtained from the "Ruins Exploration: Fieldwise Center" event

189.name: Blazing Spirit
189.desc: Proof of participation in the "Soulblazers' Snowbound Journey." A warrior fueled by faith, courage, and passion will ultimately reap brilliant victories.
source_list: Obtained from the "Soulblazers' Snowbound Journey" event

190.name: Fortune Coin
190.desc: A special coin prepared by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. It can be exchanged for various rewards during the Lantern Rite.
source_list: Obtained from the "A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon" event

191.name: Windscape Splendor
191.desc: Inspiration gained by exploring Mondstadt from a different perspective during the welcome ceremony. It can be used to unlock valuable rewards.
source_list: Obtained from the "Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind" event

193.name: Treasured Insights
193.desc: Insights gained from appreciating all manner of splendid attire. Once enough have been accumulated, they may one day be exchanged for precious rewards...

194.name: Joint Exhibition Popularity
194.desc: A commemorative medal awarded for helping organize the "Nod-Krai Trade Expo." It can be exchanged for valuable rewards.

195.name: Pals Synergy
195.desc: The bond established while playing with your imaginary friends. Can be exchanged for rewards in the "Phantasmal Pals" event.

196.name: Venue Popularity
196.desc: During the "Sunny Summer Fontinalia" event, complete various aquarium tasks to raise your Venue Popularity. This score can be used to unlock valuable supply rewards.
source_list: Obtained from the Sunny Summer Fontinalia event

197.name: Tournament Points
197.desc: Points awarded based on performance in each challenge during the first "Adventurers' Tournament." At the end of the tournament, the adventurer who has accumulated the most Competition Points will be crowned the champion...\nIn the Great Expeditionist Challenge, these points can also be used to unlock a variety of rewards...

198.name: Fervor Coupon
198.desc: A type of coupon widely circulated among both the adventurers and the Mutual Aid Advancement Network. They can be exchanged to draw for limited-edition "Lady Katheryne" statue parts. Come to think of it... is Katheryne's popularity among adventurers and civilians actually completely off the charts?
source_list: Obtained from "Aid from the Sprout: Into the Snowland"

199.name: Prime Ice Count
199.desc: Stored within the internal reservoir of the Eye of Graeae, it can be utilized to build the various mechanisms and constructs detailed in the blueprints.

201.name: Primogem
201.desc: A primordial crystalline gem that's beyond the mundane world. Shines with the condensed hopes and dreams of universes that once were.

202.name: Mora
202.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

203.name: Genesis Crystal
203.desc: An energy crystal from the very origin of the universe. Formed from within nothingness out of pure potential and hope, it contains enough energy to create a newborn star.

204.name: Realm Currency
204.desc: Currency of the realm. Used within the Serenitea Pot to exchange for various items.

206.name: Toy Medal
206.desc: A shiny medal. It is a toy, yes, but it nonetheless represents the acknowledgment of the audience.\nUse it in the "Imaginarium Theater" to obtain "Thespian Tricks" from Wolfy.

207.name: Repertoire Coins
207.desc: Currency gained from completing "Repertoire of Myriad Melodies" performances. Proof that you've been acknowledged as one who loves music and rhythm. Can be exchanged at the "Treasure of Myriad Melodies" for unique rewards.

210.name: Original Essence (Invalidated)
210.desc: A crystal that temporarily revitalizes Irminsul to grant you ancient treasures. The energy within regenerates over time.

211.name: Original Resin (Invalidated)
211.desc: A crystal that temporarily revitalizes Irminsul to grant you great treasures. The energy within regenerates over time.

221.name: Masterless Starglitter
221.desc: Currency used to purchase rare resources from the Shop.\nSurplus Starglitter of destiny. Perhaps it can light up other corners of the universe.

222.name: Masterless Stardust
222.desc: Currency used to purchase rare resources from the Shop.\nSurplus Stardust of destiny. Perhaps it can create new destinies when in large enough quantities.

223.name: Intertwined Fate
223.desc: A fateful stone that connects dreams.\nIts glimmers can entwine fates and connect dreams, just as how its glimmers link stars into the shapes of a heart's desires.

224.name: Acquaint Fate
224.desc: A seed that lights up the night.\nNo matter the distance apart, guided by the stone's glimmer, the fated will meet under the stars.

231.name: Chronal Nexus
231.desc: A crystal containing phenomenological concepts formed from the coalescence of precious memories and obsessions within ever-shifting realms.

232.name: Arcane Keystone
232.desc: A curious keystone that serves as a repository of brilliant hues.\nIn a wondrous domain filled with beauty and mystery, myriad stories from a witch's long sojourns in foreign lands are sealed. By harnessing the power of this wondrous item, you can reveal these brilliant treasures to the world once more...

233.name: Geode of Replication
233.desc: A crystal geode that serves as a template to reproduce splendor.\nIn a mystical realm where anything can take shape, it is imbued with a witch's insights into the true essence of clothing. By harnessing the power of this wondrous item, you can re-create many a marvelous cosmetic...

234.name: Engraved Shard
234.desc: Currency used to purchase precious items from the Shop.\nThe materialized form of surplus phenomena. Perhaps it can recreate splendorous treasures when in large enough quantities.

235.name: Festive Key
235.desc: A wondrous key that allows you to open a lobby. Absolutely essential for anyone seeking to host a lively gathering.\nA new Festive Key takes shape every 12 hours.

236.name: Luminous Keystone
236.desc: A bright, translucent keystone that can be used to perform Event Odes.\nIn a wondrous domain replete with luminous splendor, every corner is filled with exquisite forms arranged by a witch. By harnessing the power of this wondrous item, you can re-create many a marvelous cosmetic...

238.name: Wonderland EXP
238.desc: When exploring the "Miliastra Wonderland," the enthusiasm, encounters, and knowledge gained serve as a particularly precious form of "experience."

239.name: Chronicle EXP
239.desc: A witch's boundless collection, sealed within a Wonderland. Each treasure is a spark of inspiration leading toward a brand-new creation.

240.name: Chronicles of the Realms
240.desc: Use this item to unlock Chronicles of the Realms for a single period.

241.name: Prismatic Crystal
241.desc: A precious item in "Miliastra Wonderland." This crystal shimmers with a mysterious light and can be exchanged for various gift boxes in the Wonderlands.

242.name: Prismatic Crystal
242.desc: A precious item in "Miliastra Wonderland." This crystal shimmers with a mysterious light and can be exchanged for various gift boxes in the Wonderlands. It has a <color=#FF5E41>time limit</color>. Once this period ends, it will vanish and lose all its effects...

243.name: Prismatic Crystal
243.desc: A precious item in "Miliastra Wonderland." This crystal shimmers with a mysterious light and can be exchanged for various gift boxes in the Wonderlands.

301.name: Pyro Sigil
301.desc: A sigil representing the acknowledgment of Natlan's flames.\nCan be offered to the Tablet of Tona at the Temple of Pax to obtain the blessings of the Sacred Flame.

302.name: Hydro Sigil
302.desc: A sigil that serves as a sign of recognition from the waters in Fontaine.\nOffer it to the Fountain of Lucine to receive the rewards from the springs.

303.name: Dendro Sigil
303.desc: A sigil that serves as a sign of recognition from the trees, grass, and flowers in Sumeru.\nOffer it to the Tree of Dreams deep in the woods to receive the rewards from the forest.

304.name: Electro Sigil
304.desc: A sigil that serves as a sign of the acknowledgment given by the thundering islands of Inazuma.\nOffer them to the Sacred Sakura of the Grand Narukami Shrine to raise your Sacred Sakura's Favor level.

305.name: Anemo Sigil
305.desc: An insignia that shows the recognition of the winds of Mondstadt.\nCan be exchanged for special items in Mondstadt.

306.name: Cryo Sigil
306.desc: A sigil that serves as a sign of recognition from the frost and snow of Snezhnaya.\nOffer it to the Meeting Point to receive the rewards from the ice.

307.name: Geo Sigil
307.desc: An insignia that shows the recognition of the cliffs of Liyue.\nCan be exchanged for special items in Liyue.

308.name: Luna Sigil
308.desc: A sigil that serves as a sign of recognition from the flowing moonlight of the borderlands.\nOffer it to the Meeting Point to receive the rewards from moonlight.

319.name: "Scions of the Canopy" Reputation EXP
319.desc: Increases your Tribe Reputation Lv. (Scions of the Canopy)

320.name: "People of the Springs" Reputation EXP
320.desc: Increases your Tribe Reputation Lv. (People of the Springs)

321.name: "Children of Echoes" Reputation EXP
321.desc: Increases your Tribe Reputation Lv. (Children of Echoes)

322.name: "Flower-Feather Clan" Reputation EXP
322.desc: Increases your Tribe Reputation Lv. (Flower-Feather Clan)

323.name: "Masters of the Night-Wind" Reputation EXP
323.desc: Increases your Tribe Reputation Lv. (Masters of the Night-Wind)

324.name: "Collective of Plenty" Reputation EXP
324.desc: Increases your Tribe Reputation Lv. (Collective of Plenty)

403.name: Expedition Insights
403.desc: Insights gained from exploring featured Wonderland stages. Collect enough of them, and it seems they can unlock gifts bestowed in response by the Wonderland itself...

911.name: Memory of Eternal Flames
911.desc: The missing star from the Talents of a Pyro-aligned Traveler.

912.name: Memory of Running Stream
912.desc: The missing star from the Talents of a Hydro-aligned Traveler.
source_list: Obtained by making offerings to Statues of The Seven in Fontaine

913.name: Memory of Flourishing Green
913.desc: The missing star from the Talents of a Dendro-aligned Traveler.
source_list: Obtained by making offerings to Statues of The Seven in Sumeru

914.name: Memory of Violet Flash
914.desc: The missing star from the Talents of an Electro-aligned Traveler.
source_list: Obtained by making offerings to Statues of The Seven in Inazuma

915.name: Memory of Roving Gales
915.desc: The missing star from the Talents of an Anemo-aligned Traveler.

916.name: Memory of Piercing Frost
916.desc: The missing star from the Talents of a Cryo-aligned Traveler.

917.name: Memory of Immovable Crystals
917.desc: The missing star from the Talents of a Geo-aligned Traveler.

918.name: Blazing Flint Ore
918.desc: Flint Ore gets its name from the radiant glow it harbors.\nWhen grasped in one's hand, one can feel the fiery pulse thrumming within the stone. Perhaps one day, held high against the starry sky, it might emit a gentle gleam that illuminates the night.

1002.name: Kamisato Ayaka
1002.desc: Daughter of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Dignified and elegant, as well as wise and strong.

1003.name: Jean
1003.desc: The righteous and rigorous Dandelion Knight, and Acting Grand Master of Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius.

1005.name: Male Character
1005.desc: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

1006.name: Lisa
1006.desc: The languid but knowledgeable Librarian of the Knights of Favonius, deemed by Sumeru Akademiya to be their most distinguished graduate in the past two centuries.

1007.name: Female Lead
1007.desc: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

1014.name: Barbara
1014.desc: Every citizen of Mondstadt adores Barbara. She learned the word "idol" from a magazine.

1015.name: Kaeya
1015.desc: An accomplished swordsman and a strategic thinker in the Knights of Favonius, rumored to hail from beyond Mondstadt.

1016.name: Diluc
1016.desc: The tycoon of a winery empire in Mondstadt, unmatched in every possible way.

1020.name: Razor
1020.desc: A boy who lives among the wolves in Wolvendom of Mondstadt, away from human civilization. As agile as lightning.

1021.name: Amber
1021.desc: Always energetic and full of life, Amber's the best — albeit only — Outrider of the Knights of Favonius.

1022.name: Venti
1022.desc: One of the many bards of Mondstadt, who freely wanders the city's streets and alleys.

1023.name: Xiangling
1023.desc: A renowned chef from Liyue. She's extremely passionate about cooking and excels at making her signature hot and spicy dishes.

1024.name: Beidou
1024.desc: Captain of her crew, The Crux. She's quite an unbound and forthright woman.

1025.name: Xingqiu
1025.desc: A young man carrying a longsword who is frequently seen at book booths. He has a chivalrous heart and yearns for justice and fairness for all.

1026.name: Xiao
1026.desc: A yaksha adeptus who defends Liyue. Also heralded as the "Conqueror of Demons" and "Vigilant Yaksha."

1027.name: Ningguang
1027.desc: The Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing. Her wealth is unsurpassed in all of Teyvat.

1029.name: Klee
1029.desc: An explosives expert and a regular at the Knights of Favonius' confinement room. Also known as Fleeing Sunlight.

1030.name: Zhongli
1030.desc: A mysterious expert contracted by the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Extremely knowledgeable in all things.

1031.name: Fischl
1031.desc: A mysterious girl who calls herself "Prinzessin der Verurteilung" and travels with a night raven named Oz.

1032.name: Bennett
1032.desc: A good-natured adventurer from Mondstadt who's unfortunately extremely unlucky.

1033.name: Tartaglia
1033.desc: No. 11 of The Harbingers, also known as "Childe." His name is highly feared on the battlefield.

1034.name: Noelle
1034.desc: A maid who faithfully serves the Knights of Favonius. She dreams of joining their ranks someday.

1035.name: Qiqi
1035.desc: An apprentice and herb gatherer at Bubu Pharmacy. An undead with a bone-white complexion, she seldom has much in the way of words or emotion.

1036.name: Chongyun
1036.desc: A young exorcist from a family of exorcists. He does everything he can to suppress his abundance of yang energy.

1037.name: Ganyu
1037.desc: The secretary at Yuehai Pavilion. The blood of the qilin, an illuminated beast, flows within her veins.

1038.name: Albedo
1038.desc: A genius known as the Kreideprinz, he is the Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius.

1039.name: Diona
1039.desc: A young lady who has inherited trace amounts of non-human blood. She is the incredibly popular bartender of the Cat's Tail tavern.

1041.name: Mona
1041.desc: A mysterious young astrologer who proclaims herself to be "Astrologist Mona Megistus," and who possesses abilities to match the title. Erudite, but prideful.

1042.name: Keqing
1042.desc: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. Keqing has much to say about Rex Lapis' unilateral approach to policymaking in Liyue — but in truth, gods admire skeptics such as her quite a lot.

1043.name: Sucrose
1043.desc: An alchemist filled with curiosity about all things. She researches bio-alchemy.

1044.name: Xinyan
1044.desc: Liyue's sole rock 'n' roll musician. She rebels against ossified prejudices using her music and passionate singing.

1045.name: Rosaria
1045.desc: A sister of the church, though you wouldn't know it if it weren't for her attire. Known for her sharp, cold words and manner, she often works alone.

1046.name: Hu Tao
1046.desc: The 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. She took over the business at a rather young age.

1047.name: Kaedehara Kazuha
1047.desc: A wandering samurai from Inazuma who is currently with Liyue's Crux Fleet. A gentle and carefree soul whose heart hides a great many burdens from the past.

1048.name: Yanfei
1048.desc: A well-known legal adviser active in Liyue Harbor. A brilliant young lady in whose veins runs the blood of an illuminated beast.

1049.name: Yoimiya
1049.desc: Owner of Naganohara Fireworks. Known as the "Queen of the Summer Festival," she excels in her craft of creating fireworks that symbolize people's hopes and dreams.

1050.name: Thoma
1050.desc: The Kamisato Clan's housekeeper. A well-known "fixer" in Inazuma.

1051.name: Eula
1051.desc: The Spindrift Knight, a scion of the old aristocracy, and the Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company. The reason for which a descendant of the ancient nobles might join the Knights remains a great mystery in Mondstadt to this very day.

1052.name: Raiden Shogun
1052.desc: Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, who promised the people of Inazuma an unchanging Eternity.

1053.name: Sayu
1053.desc: A pint-sized ninja attached to the Shuumatsuban, who always seems sleep-deprived.

1054.name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
1054.desc: The Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island. All of the island's affairs are at this young lady's fingertips.

1055.name: Gorou
1055.desc: The great general of Watatsumi Island's forces. He is deeply trusted by his subordinates.

1056.name: Kujou Sara
1056.desc: A general of the Tenryou Commission. Bold, decisive, and skilled in battle.

1057.name: Arataki Itto
1057.desc: The first and greatest head of the Arataki Gang, famed throughout Inazuma City's Hanamizaka... Wait, what? You've never heard of them? Are you trying to be funny here?

1058.name: Yae Miko
1058.desc: Lady Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine. Also serves as the editor-in-chief of Yae Publishing House. Unimaginable intelligence and cunning are hidden under her beautiful appearance.

1059.name: Shikanoin Heizou
1059.desc: A young prodigy detective from the Tenryou Commission. His senses are sharp and his thoughts are clear.

1060.name: Yelan
1060.desc: A mysterious person who claims to work for the Ministry of Civil Affairs, but is a "non-entity" on the Ministry of Civil Affairs' list.

1061.name: Kirara
1061.desc: A courier for Komaniya Express, a delivery company in Inazuma. A nekomata who loves her job and human society.

1062.name: Aloy
1062.desc: Formerly an outcast, now a hunter of unparalleled skill. Ready to do the right thing at any time.

1063.name: Shenhe
1063.desc: An adepti disciple with a most unusual air about her. Having spent much time cultivating in isolation in Liyue's mountains, she has become every bit as cool and distant as the adepti themselves.

1064.name: Yun Jin
1064.desc: A renowned Liyue opera singer who is skilled in both playwriting and singing. Her style is one-of-a-kind, exquisite and delicate, much like the person herself.

1065.name: Kuki Shinobu
1065.desc: The capable and reliable Arataki Gang deputy leader - Please note: capable and reliable are not appellations for the "Arataki Gang," but for their deputy leader in specific.

1066.name: Kamisato Ayato
1066.desc: The young but highly accomplished head of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Cultured and polite, he is a man of many ways and means.

1067.name: Collei
1067.desc: A trainee ranger active in Avidya Forest. Behind her enthusiastic words and actions hides a slightly introverted personality.

1068.name: Dori
1068.desc: An elusive merchant who has a fondness for glittering Mora.

1069.name: Tighnari
1069.desc: A young researcher well-versed in botany who currently serves as a Forest Watcher in Avidya Forest. He is a straight shooter with a warm heart — and a dab hand at guiding even the dullest of pupils.

1070.name: Nilou
1070.desc: The star of the Zubayr Theater. She is full of warmth and innocence, and her dances are lively and elegant.

1071.name: Cyno
1071.desc: The General Mahamatra in charge of supervising the researchers of the Akademiya. It is said that when he gets down to work, the General Mahamatra is even more efficient than the "Great Vayuvyastra" made by the Kshahrewar.

1072.name: Candace
1072.desc: A descendant of King Deshret with an amber left eye. The defender of Aaru Village.

1073.name: Nahida
1073.desc: A caged bird secluded within the confines of the Sanctuary of Surasthana who can only see the world in her dreams.

1074.name: Layla
1074.desc: A Rtawahist student who specializes in Theoretical Astrology. Heavily prone to somnambulism and locked in a grinding war with sleep deprivation, the problem of restful slumber is a most troubling one to her.

1075.name: Wanderer
1075.desc: A wayfaring figure whose identity is a mystery. He dresses like a mountain ascetic, but he certainly does not act the part.

1076.name: Faruzan
1076.desc: A researcher from "one hundred years ago." She enjoys self-identifying as everyone's senior, and has significant knowledge of ancient scripts and machines of all kinds.

1077.name: Yaoyao
1077.desc: Streetward Rambler's youngest disciple. A gentle and caring "little adult."

1078.name: Alhaitham
1078.desc: The current scribe of the Sumeru Akademiya, a man endowed with extraordinary intelligence and talent. He lives free — free from the searching eyes of ordinary people, anyway.

1079.name: Dehya
1079.desc: A member of the Eremites, a mercenary organization that roams the sands of Sumeru. Valiant and powerful, she enjoys great fame amongst her fellow Eremites.

1080.name: Mika
1080.desc: A young knight born to an ordinary family. He serves as a Front-Line Surveyor in his Company. He is a low-key and cautious character.

1081.name: Kaveh
1081.desc: A renowned architect from Sumeru who perhaps cares a bit too much about too many things. He is an aesthete troubled by reality.

1082.name: Baizhu
1082.desc: The owner of Bubu Pharmacy, who is rarely seen without the white snake named Changsheng. His medicinal knowledge is encyclopedic, and his personal intrigues subtle.

1083.name: Lynette
1083.desc: A magic assistant of few words, her emotions are as inscrutable as any cat's.

1084.name: Lyney
1084.desc: A famed Fontainian magician who possesses great stage presence as well as gift of the gab. Audiences are enthralled by his exquisite skills, and they hang on to his every clever word.

1085.name: Freminet
1085.desc: A reserved young man who is well-versed in diving. Beneath his distant, icy demeanor lies a pure heart bereft of all flaws.

1086.name: Wriothesley
1086.desc: Duke of the Fortress of Meropide, Lord Incognito of the murky depths.

1087.name: Neuvillette
1087.desc: The Chief Justice of Fontaine, known as the Iudex, is renowned for his unassailable impartiality.

1088.name: Charlotte
1088.desc: Indefatigable reporter of The Steambird, constantly on the hunt for the "truth."

1089.name: Furina
1089.desc: The absolute focus of the stage of judgment, until the final applause sounds.

1090.name: Chevreuse
1090.desc: The captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, who wears justice as an ever-present seal upon her heart. Her musket shall only ever point at the guilty.

1091.name: Navia
1091.desc: The current President of Spina di Rosula, who is lovely, dutiful, and a great boss.

1092.name: Gaming
1092.desc: Guard of the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency, and the head of the "Mighty Mythical Beasts" Wushou troupe.

1093.name: Xianyun
1093.desc: One of the Mighty and Illuminated Adepti of Jueyun, known as "Cloud Retainer." Expert in all kinds of mechanical contraptions, her heart now turns towards the affairs of the mortal world, through which she walks under the name "Xianyun."

1094.name: Chiori
1094.desc: The owner of Chioriya Boutique. A tailor renowned throughout Fontaine.

1095.name: Sigewinne
1095.desc: A Melusine and the Fortress of Meropide's head nurse. She cares equally for every convict locked in the undersea prison.

1096.name: Arlecchino
1096.desc: "The Knave," Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers. A poised, ruthless diplomat. To the children in the House of the Hearth, she is their feared yet dependable "Father."

1097.name: Sethos
1097.desc: The Temple of Silence's heir. Burdened with secrets, he comes from the sands.

1098.name: Clorinde
1098.desc: An undefeated Champion Duelist. Sword in hand, she defends justice in the Court of Fontaine.

1099.name: Emilie
1099.desc: A Fontainian perfumer, one who bottles secrets.

1201.name: Gnostic Hymn - Old Notes
1201.desc: An early draft of a traveler's tale, recording the many things they saw on their journey across the lands. But why does it exist? It is almost as if you have been here before...\n\nUse this item to unlock Gnostic Hymn for a single period.

1202.name: Blessing of the Welkin Moon - New Moon
1202.desc: A ritual prayer, recited on the rising of the first new moon, to ask for the moon's blessing in the form of wealth and good fortune. For your purposes, the new moon you shall pray to is the first-ever new moon in Teyvat, since it's the first one you've seen here.\n\nUse this item to receive 30 days of Blessing of the Welkin Moon rewards.

1301.name: An Appellative Stroke
1301.desc: The brush with which you may bestow a new name upon a certain person.\nOnce the new name has been given, it cannot be changed.

1302.name: Reaffirmed Accord of Appellation
1302.desc: Just like when you first met and tied a scarf around his tail, now give him a new "name."\nAfter giving him a new name, it cannot be changed again.

1303.name: Overwrite Key: Left
1303.desc: A secret key given to you and Paimon, along with the Miliastra Wonderland. Use it to rename the Manekin.\nOnce the new name has been given, it cannot be changed.

1304.name: Overwrite Key: Right
1304.desc: A secret key given to you and Paimon, along with the Miliastra Wonderland. Use it to rename the Manekina.\nOnce the new name has been given, it cannot be changed.

2025.name: Quest Use - Overpowered Atomic Energy Orb (All)

2026.name: Time Shard (Minigame item)
2026.desc: Mysterious time shards that increase the time you can stay in the Fog Maze.

2027.name: Time Shard (Minigame item)
2027.desc: Mysterious time shards that increase the time you can stay in the Fog Maze.
