3009.name: Kamisato Ayaka Test Package
3009.desc: Obtained Kamisato Ayaka, 3-Star Hard Steel Sword, Kamisato Ayaka Stardust x16

3010.name: Xiangling Test Package
3010.desc: Obtained Xiangling, 3-Star White Tassel Lance, Xiangling Stardust x16

3011.name: Jean Test Package
3011.desc: Obtained Jean, 3-Star Hard Steel Sword, Jean Stardust x16

3012.name: Diluc Test Package
3012.desc: Obtained Diluc, 3-Star White Iron Greatsword, Diluc Stardust x16

3013.name: Venti Test Package
3013.desc: Obtained Venti, 3-Star Raven Bow, Venti Stardust x16

3020.name: Razor Test Package
3020.desc: Obtained Razor, 3-Star Ferrous Shadow, Razor Stardust x16

3021.name: Kaeya
3021.desc: An accomplished swordsman and a strategic thinker in the Knights of Favonius, rumored to hail from beyond Mondstadt.

3022.name: Lisa
3022.desc: The languid but knowledgeable Librarian of the Knights of Favonius, deemed by Sumeru Akademiya to be their most distinguished graduate in the past two centuries.

4100.name: Kachina
4100.desc: A young warrior of the Nanatzcayan, given the Ancient Name of "Uthabiti." Kind-hearted and insatiably persistent, she grows stronger and more capable with each setback she faces.

4101.name: Kinich
4101.desc: A Huitztlan Saurian Hunter skilled at counting costs.

4102.name: Mualani
4102.desc: A well-known guide in Natlan who owns a watersports shop, and expert in all forms of wave-chasing.

4103.name: Xilonen
4103.desc: A Name Engraver of the Nanatzcayan, she is especially skilled at finding a good balance between the heavy responsibilities of her job and living well.

4104.name: Chasca
4104.desc: The Peacemaker of the Tlalocan, the ender of all disputes.

4105.name: Ororon
4105.desc: A young man from the Masters of the Night-Wind who instead lives in the wild alongside all manner of life.

4106.name: Mavuika
4106.desc: The leader of Natlan who inherited the Ancient Name of "Kiongozi." She made a vow to illuminate the future of the nation of war with the Sacred Flame.

4107.name: Citlali
4107.desc: The great shaman from the Masters of the Night-Wind, the universally-revered Granny Itztli.

4108.name: Lan Yan
4108.desc: A rattan weaver from Chenyu Vale. Clear-minded and well-tempered, she is as lively as a mountain spring.

4109.name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
4109.desc: A shareholder of Aisa Bathhouse, a baku, and a clinical psychologist. Dedicated to the dispersal of nightmares, and to bringing people peace of mind.

4110.name: Iansan
4110.desc: Head coach of the fitness club at the Collective of Plenty, and a renowned Natlanese nutritionist.

4111.name: Varesa
4111.desc: A laid-back orchard manager and warrior of the Collective of Plenty. An aspiring hero who hungers for justice... and lots and lots of food!

4112.name: Escoffier
4112.desc: The ex-head chef of Hotel Debord, renowned throughout Fontaine as the Patissiere Supreme and vanguard of precision gastronomy. Has incomparably strict standards when it comes to cooking.

4113.name: Ifa
4113.desc: A vet from the Flower-Feather Clan who cherishes the life he leads alongside all manner of living things — people, animals, you name it.

4114.name: Skirk
4114.desc: A visitor who once appeared in an Abyssal rift and the Primordial Sea, this solitary warrior mentored Tartaglia in the martial arts.

4115.name: Dahlia
4115.desc: Deacon of the Church of Favonius and the Anemo Archon's representative in the church.

4116.name: Ineffa
4116.desc: A multifunctional robot containing integrated mechanical components from various nations. The Source Core in her chest has endured the passage of countless years.

4119.name: Lauma
4119.desc: A Maiden blessed by moonlight and the grove alike, hope born to the Frostmoon Scions.

4120.name: Flins
4120.desc: A Lightkeeper of Nod-Krai, guardian of a lighthouse and graveyard on a northern isle. An enigmatic gentleman, cultured and courtly.

4121.name: Aino
4121.desc: A genius mechanic and inventor from Nod-Krai who loves interesting machines and sweet treats.

4122.name: Nefer
4122.desc: The remarkably resourceful owner of the Curatorium of Secrets.

4123.name: Durin
4123.desc: A dragon born from M's pen, who came to alight in the human world. His "story" continues to unfold.

4124.name: Jahoda
4124.desc: The Curatorium of Secrets' extremely reliable, do-it-all super employee (or so she claims).

4125.name: Columbina
4125.desc: The Moon Maiden born in Nod-Krai, and also the welkin moon returning home.

4126.name: Zibai
4126.desc: The White Horse Adeptus from Liyue's legends, known as Zibai. The most mysterious figure in Liyue's myths.

4127.name: Illuga
4127.desc: Member of the investigation squad, the Nightmare Orioles. The youngest squad leader among the Lightkeepers.

4128.name: Varka
4128.desc: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. Knight of Boreas, protector of Mondstadt.

4129.name: Lohen
4129.desc: Vice Captain of the Knights of Favonius Ranged Company, a knight known for his unorthodox approach and fondness for unconventional tactics.

4130.name: Linnea
4130.desc: Naturalist and Advisor to the Nod-Krai Branch of the Adventurers' Guild.

4132.name: Prune
4132.desc: A diminutive Witch Hunter who has journeyed all the way from Nod-Krai with the singular purpose of rooting out a witch who, to hear her tell it, has committed every sin imaginable — including bullying little kids!

4133.name: Sandrone
4133.desc: The Seventh of the Fatui Harbingers, "Marionette." Interprets all phenomena through the prism of mathematics, and is an elegant lady who is never absent from a tea party.

4148.name: Alyosha
4148.desc: A "professional hunter" and master of the Snezhnayan snowfields. A fierce, distinct "idealism" burns beneath his calm demeanor.

4150.name: Odette
4150.desc: A famed Snezhnayan ballerina who blossoms against the frozen landscape with a beauty as sharp as frost.

100001.name: Apple
100001.desc: Crisp and fragrant. Delicious raw or made into wine.
100001.effect: Restores 300 HP for the selected character.

100002.name: Sunsettia
100002.desc: A plump fruit, beautiful like the sunset, that is abundant across all of Teyvat. It has a curious, sweet aroma and is able to energize an individual.
100002.effect: Restores 300 HP for the selected character.

100003.name: A Piece of Paper
100003.desc: You have no idea who slipped it to you.

100004.name: Stolen Items
100004.desc: Items belonging to the people of Mondstadt that were previously stolen by hilichurls in Drunkard Gorge.

100006.name: Hilichurl Antidote
100006.desc: Made by hilichurl witch doctors. Cures hilichurl poison.

100007.name: Climbing Finish Line Garland
100007.desc: Marker indicating the finish line of the Climbing Competition.

100008.name: Gliding Finish Line Garland
100008.desc: Marker indicating the finish line of the Gliding Competition.

100009.name: Gliding Finish Line Garland
100009.desc: Marker indicating the finish line of the Gliding Competition finals.

100010.name: Gliding Champion Cup
100010.desc: Awarded to the Mondstadt Gliding Competition Champion.

100011.name: Mushroom
100011.desc: Hardy common fungi. Can grow anywhere with the right amount of shade and moisture.

100012.name: Sweet Flower
100012.desc: Particularly fragrant flowers. They can be found easily, even in the dark. Just follow the scent.

100013.name: Carrot
100013.desc: A healthy and nutritious vegetable that is crunchy and sweet to the taste. Easy to grow and harvest.

100014.name: Radish
100014.desc: Rich in fiber and nutrients. Easy to grow and harvest.

100015.name: Snapdragon
100015.desc: Can be eaten once cooked. As a spice, it can bring wonderful flavor to dishes.
source_list: Found near lakes and river banks

100016.name: Mint
100016.desc: A refreshingly cool ingredient. The cool, fresh flavor can cut through the heat of many dishes.

100017.name: Wheat
100017.desc: Golden, sun-kissed tassels. Needs to be ground down to flour for further use.

100018.name: Cabbage
100018.desc: A layered, leafy vegetable. Said to have originally been an ornamental plant, it certainly looks great in the pot.

100019.name: Silver Lotus
100019.desc: A rare plant that grows on steep cliffs with nobility. Shines magnificently in the night.

100020.name: Pinecone
100020.desc: Filled with oil-rich seeds. Certainly won't be growing into a tree from inside a squirrel's stomach.

100021.name: Wolfhook
100021.desc: A berry with thorns that often gets attached to a wolf's pelt. When you look at it, you can almost hear the echoing cries of the wolves in the woods.

100022.name: Valberry
100022.desc: A plump and translucent berry that has a fragrant smell and a sweet, refreshing taste. In the past, the storm watchers' only solace was the sweetness of this fruit and hope for the city's peace.

100023.name: Cecilia
100023.desc: A beautiful flower with a name that suits its appearance. It only grows where harsh winds blow, and is just as intangible as the true heart of an unbound soul.

100024.name: Windwheel Aster
100024.desc: A plant that adores the wind. To the proud children of the wind, or the citizens of Mondstadt, the Windwheel Asters are "the visible winds."
source_list: Found near the Statue of The Seven at Windrise

100025.name: Philanemo Mushroom
100025.desc: A fungus that grows in the warm caress of the wind. It is as everlasting as the wind, nourishing life.
source_list: Found under the eaves of houses

100026.name: Lotus Head
100026.desc: An aquatic plant native to Liyue that grows and blooms in pairs. One is fragrant, and the other bitter. It's said to make a good herbal medicine.
source_list: Found near lakes and river banks

100027.name: Jueyun Chili
100027.desc: A spicy plant native to Liyue. Merely smelling it makes one hot and thirsty.

100028.name: Noctilucous Jade
100028.desc: A rare mineral that glimmers in the dark. It's said to be a mutated gemstone condensed from the flourishing elements of the world.

100029.name: Silk Flower
100029.desc: A crimson flower that blooms like the rainbow clouds in Liyue. It can be made into silky-smooth fabric.
source_list: Found near Yujing Terrace, Liyue Harbor

100030.name: Glaze Lily
100030.desc: An extremely ancient flower that was said to be commonly seen in Liyue. It transforms the memories of the land into its fragrance during florescence.
source_list: Recommendation: Found in Yujing Terrace, Liyue Harbor

100031.name: Qingxin
100031.desc: A translucent white flower that only grows on the highest stone peaks. It eschews the warmth and moisture of the plains to gaze out afar from the solitary mountaintops.
source_list: Recommendation: Found in Guyun Stone Forest

100032.name: Horsetail
100032.desc: A purple plant that sometimes grows amidst Silvergrass but grows taller, straighter, and plumper — like an aristocrat among the paupers.
source_list: Found in patches of Silvergrass and wetlands

100033.name: Starconch
100033.desc: Empty seashells brought ashore by the tides. Hold one close to your ear, and hear the longing calls of the sea.
source_list: Found on the beaches of Liyue

100034.name: Violetgrass
100034.desc: A small flower with strong vitality. It is said that its downward-blooming flower keeps its fragrance from dissipating.

100051.name: Berry
100051.desc: Small, brightly-colored fruit. They can be found everywhere, and the taste of them wipes the fatigue of a long journey away.

100052.name: Mist Flower Corolla
100052.desc: A flower bud encased in solid ice. Even after being picked, the flower continues to emit cold.

100053.name: Flaming Flower Stamen
100053.desc: The stamen of a fiercely burning flower. Even after being extinguished, it still emits heat.
source_list: Recommendation: Found at the Thousand Winds Temple

100054.name: Electro Crystal
100054.desc: A power-rich crystal that draws electricity from the air around it. Holding it makes your hand a little numb.

100055.name: Small Lamp Grass
100055.desc: A wild grass that emits light at night. Used in cooking to enhance other flavors.
source_list: Recommendation: Found in the Whispering Woods

100056.name: Calla Lily
100056.desc: A flower that grows near water sources. When cooked, the petals have a chunky texture, yet are sweet and a little bitter.

100057.name: Dandelion Seed
100057.desc: A tiny seed that rides on the wind. Even without its feathered wings, it still holds the hope from afar within.

100058.name: Cor Lapis
100058.desc: A precious crystal of condensed pure Geo element that usually grows along with other minerals. It's also commonly called "Cor Petrae."

100061.name: Raw Meat
100061.desc: A fresh chunk of meat. Handled properly, it can be used to make delicious food.

100062.name: Bird Egg
100062.desc: An incredibly versatile ingredient that can supply all of your daily protein needs.

100063.name: Matsutake
100063.desc: A rare fungus that generally grows on or near pine trees. Its delicate aroma gives away its location.

100064.name: Fowl
100064.desc: A fresh chunk of fowl. Handled properly, it can make a hearty meal.

100072.name: Butterfly Wings
100072.desc: Brightly colored wings. The powder that falls from them shimmers a little. Perhaps this is what allows them to fly?

100073.name: Crab
100073.desc: A shelled creature that lives near the ocean. Its flaky, delicious meat can easily be made into tasty dishes.
source_list: Found near lakes, river banks, and beaches

100074.name: Crab Roe
100074.desc: A delicacy specific to female crabs. A rare and prized ingredient that isn't quite to everyone's taste.

100075.name: Salt
100075.desc: A savory seasoning. A precise but adequate amount will elevate the quality of the cuisine.

100076.name: Onion
100076.desc: A spherical vegetable. As vengeance for cutting it, it will make you cry, no matter how brave you are.

100077.name: Pepper
100077.desc: Peppery. Cuts through oily flavors and excites the taste buds. Goes best on meat.

100078.name: Milk
100078.desc: Sweet and fragrant cow's milk. Don't waste a single drop, not even that one rolling down your chin.

100079.name: Tomato
100079.desc: A bright red ingredient that gives a tangy kick. Yes, the "fruit or vegetable" debate is still going...

100080.name: Potato
100080.desc: A chunky vegetable. A gift from the earth that you never tire of with its multitude of cooking methods.

100081.name: Frog
100081.desc: Common frog found in moist environments. Full of energy, they secrete a substance that will keep you full of vitality.
source_list: Found near bodies of fresh water

100082.name: Luminescent Spine
100082.desc: The light-emitting part of a firefly. Used for courtship, and in medicine to help recover strength.

100083.name: Lizard Tail
100083.desc: A lizard tail that curled up after losing its owner. Very bitter, but has skin hardening properties.

100084.name: Fish
100084.desc: A fresh fillet of fish. Handled properly, it can make a rich dish.

100085.name: Crystal Core
100085.desc: The core of a crystal butterfly. It absorbs elemental energy that has escaped into the atmosphere.

100086.name: Raw Meat (S)
100086.desc: A fresh chunk of meat. Handled properly, it can be used to make delicious food.

100087.name: Fowl (S)
100087.desc: A fresh chunk of fowl. Handled properly, it can make a hearty meal.

100088.name: Tofu
100088.desc: Freshly made bean product that has a silky-smooth tender texture.
source_list: Sold at general goods shops in Liyue
Sold at general goods shops in Inazuma
Sold at general goods shops in Sumeru

100089.name: Almond
100089.desc: A seed with a peculiar fragrance that gives food a refreshing taste.
source_list: Sold at general goods shops in Liyue
Sold at general goods shops in Fontaine

100090.name: Loach Pearl
100090.desc: A shiny pearl spat out by a loach that has mystical medicinal properties.\nMinerals and elemental particles ingested by the loach condense into these mildly magical beads. When threatened, the loach spits them out to confuse predators and escape with its life.

100091.name: Bamboo Shoot
100091.desc: A fresh young bamboo shoot, straight out of the ground. It is a delicious cooking ingredient with an exotic aroma, found exclusively in bamboo-growing regions.
source_list: Recommendation: Found in the bamboo forest near Qingce Village

100092.name: Rice
100092.desc: A grain crop commonly found in Teyvat. People of all walks of life enjoy its distinct grainy texture. As the saying goes, "The same kind of rice can feed one hundred kinds of people."
source_list: Sold at general goods shops in Liyue
Sold at general goods shops in Inazuma
Sold at general goods shops in Sumeru

100093.name: Shrimp Meat
100093.desc: A whole piece of deep sea shrimp meat, full of nutrients and bursting with delicious flavor.
source_list: Sold at general goods shops in Liyue
Sold at general goods shops in Inazuma
Sold at general goods shops in Sumeru

100094.name: Chilled Meat
100094.desc: Rare, fresh meat.\nThis species of boar is recorded to have gone extinct several hundred years ago and has been preserved by the extreme temperatures on Dragonspine. For the gourmets of Teyvat, this is an ingredient of unspeakable sacrosanctness.

100095.name: Eel Meat
100095.desc: The fresh meat of an Unagi/Eel. If handled properly, it can be used to make fresh, lovely food.

100096.name: Glabrous Beans
100096.desc: A common legume in Teyvat with a light aroma. It can be prepared in a variety of ways, and is thus widely accepted by people all over the world.
source_list: Sold at general goods shops in Fontaine
Sold at general goods shops in Natlan

100097.name: Mysterious Meat
100097.desc: A fresh chunk of meat that seems to be radiating an enigmatic aura. Wonder what it'll taste like?

100098.name: Coffee Beans
100098.desc: A common fruit in Teyvat with a special aroma. It can be used to make beverages after being ground.

100099.name: Fermented Juice
100099.desc: A fermented juice with a unique fruity scent. It is often used as a marinade.
source_list: Sold at general goods shops in Fontaine

100100.name: Rye
100100.desc: The gray-brown ears are a gift from the earth. Their richness can only be brought out by grounding and roasting.
source_list: Sold at general goods shops in Nod-Krai

100101.name: Jean's Document Package
100101.desc: A few normal documents and a copy of Vera's Troubles.

100102.name: Extreme Escape
100102.desc: Musk's Travel Journal. In the notes regarding Musk Reef is a line that reads: "Only on a morning sea breeze can one glide here from Lover's Cape..."

100103.name: Incomplete Score (Part 1)
100103.desc: The first half of the sheet music for "Yellow." "S to J" is written in the bottom right corner.

100104.name: Incomplete Score (Part 2)
100104.desc: The second half of the sheet music for "Yellow."

100105.name: Private Letter from Lisa to Jean
100105.desc: Lisa has asked you to give this to Jean to deliver the news that Vera's Secret is receiving a sequel soon.

100106.name: Autumn Night
100106.desc: Tells a story in which a court mage and her King get married in the end.

100107.name: Tasty-Looking Potion
100107.desc: Looks tasty, but is actually a weakening potion.

100108.name: Potion
100108.desc: Lisa has asked you to give this to Barbara.

100109.name: Barbara's Treatment
100109.desc: Lisa has asked you to give this to Barbara.

100110.name: Incomplete Poem (Part 1)
100110.desc: The poem Venti asked you to look for, though only the first part of it.
100110.title: Inscription Rubbing

100111.name: Incomplete Poem (Part 2)
100111.desc: The poem Venti asked you to look for, though it would seem there is more.
100111.title: Inscription Rubbing

100112.name: Incomplete Poem (Part 3)
100112.desc: The poem Venti asked you to look for, piece the three pages together to reveal a love verselet.
100112.title: Inscription Rubbing

100113.name: Inscription Rubbing
100113.desc: Ancient text engraved on the building.

100114.name: Form Restoration Potion
100114.desc: Can restore those that have been transformed into hilichurls by Abyss Mages back to their human form.

100115.name: Holy Lyre der Himmel
100115.desc: Can be used for taking down Stormterror.

100120.name: Cricket Hair
100120.desc: You didn't catch a cricket, just a hair off its leg.
100120.title: Catch

100121.name: Cricket (White)
100121.desc: Common cricket. Can be seen everywhere, nothing rare about it at all.
100121.title: Catch

100122.name: Cricket (Blue)
100122.desc: A big blue cricket. Seems to have a powerful bite force. Should be good at battle.
100122.title: Catch

100123.name: Cricket (Purple)
100123.desc: A rare cricket with seven different red and purple layers to its wings.
100123.title: Catch

100124.name: Cricket (Gold)
100124.desc: Oh, wow! The Legendary Golden Cricket!
100124.title: Catch

100125.name: Hydro Amber
100125.desc: Hydro Amber given to you by Venti. Can be smashed to create rainfall. (Test)

100126.name: Anemo Amber
100126.desc: Anemo Amber given to you by Venti. Can be smashed to create air currents. (Test)

100131.name: Random Loot (A)
100131.desc: Items worth little value stolen from some random passer-by. Better return them quickly.

100132.name: Random Loot (B)
100132.desc: Items worth little value stolen from some random passer-by. Better return them quickly.

100133.name: Random Loot (A)
100133.desc: Items worth little value stolen from some random passer-by. Better return them quickly.

100134.name: Random Loot (B)
100134.desc: Items worth little value stolen from some random passer-by. Better return them quickly.

100135.name: Crimson Crystal
100135.desc: A teardrop crystal in which gloomy red gleams flow. Seems to have been left by the dragon. Perhaps the person that was talking with the dragon knows more about it, but where did he go?

100148.name: Investigate the Seal of Stormterror's Lair
100148.title: Observe the Strange Light

100149.name: Break the seal of Stormterror's Lair
100149.title: Open the seal

100151.name: Fragmented Memory (Wind)
100151.desc: Bring it close to your ear and it seems you can hear faint whispers, but can't make out what's being said. (Not available)

100158.name: Teardrop Crystal
100158.desc: A curious teardrop left in the ancient arena that attracted hordes of monsters to fight for it.

100159.name: Teardrop Crystal
100159.desc: A teardrop looted and treasured by some members of the Eclipse hilichurl tribe. Had some trouble "convincing" them to part with it.

100160.name: Teardrop Crystal
100160.desc: A tear hidden in the forest ruins. Thankfully it hadn't been eaten by the insects.

100161.name: Holy Lyre der Himmel
100161.desc: A treasure that once belonged to Barbatos, the Anemo Archon, but its Anemo power has all dried up.

100162.name: Partially Repaired Holy Lyre der Himmel
100162.desc: A treasure that once belonged to Barbatos, the Anemo Archon, with some power restored by a Teardrop Crystal.

100163.name: Completely Repaired Holy Lyre der Himmel
100163.desc: A treasure that once belonged to Barbatos, the Anemo Archon, that has been restored to full power. Even Dvalin may heed its call.

100164.name: Clear Dvalin Tear
100164.desc: A teardrop left behind by Dvalin. The pure power of Anemo resonates within it.

100165.name: Damaged Holy Lyre der Himmel
100165.desc: A prized treasure of Barbatos, the Anemo Archon. Its clear sound that once echoed through the heavens and was beloved by the unruly Dvalin has now been reduced to naught but dull, ear-piercing noise.

100171.name: Treasure Clue (I)
100171.desc: A piece of paper with clues to a treasure. On it, is an unclear map with an unclear message.
100171.title: Investigate

100172.name: Treasure Clue (II)
100172.desc: A piece of paper with clues to a treasure. On it, is an unclear map with an unclear message.
100172.title: Investigate

100173.name: Treasure Map
100173.desc: A scribbled map with a simple marking in a particular area.
100173.title: Investigate

100175.name: Hidden Key
100175.desc: A key that once belonged to the Fatui. Just like all other keys, each respond to a door.

100178.name: Vera's Melancholy (I)
100178.desc: I don't ever think the world is monotonous. It's just that interesting things happen in far away galaxies.\nThe great adventure of Vera, an ordinary girl always fascinated by distant lands, secretly begins.

100179.name: Vera's Melancholy (II)
100179.desc: Everything's just boring. Everything, all the time. It's not depression. It's just reaching the age of 14.\nSo begins Vera's adventure.

100180.name: Vera's Melancholy (III)
100180.desc: The Andromeda Empire stretches across half the galaxy group. Every planet within the Empire has its own demons and deities, dragons and monsters.\n"I've come up with a story for every star from your home." "That's not possible. Looking from here, the Andromeda Galaxy is only one fifth the size of your moon."\nSo continues Vera's adventure.

100181.name: Along with Divinity: Prologue
100181.desc: "Have you ever thought about what our lives would've been like without the archons?"\nCome and join the author in an exploration of "divinity" with humor and logic.

100182.name: The Legend of Vennessa (I)
100182.desc: A popular song since the reconstruction of Mondstadt. It tells the story of Vennessa, the founder of the Knights of Favonius, in her early years as a slave in Mondstadt.

100183.name: The Legend of Vennessa (II)
100183.desc: A popular song since the reconstruction of Mondstadt. It tells the story of Vennessa, the founder of the Knights of Favonius, in her early years when she met Barbatos, the Anemo Archon, as well as how she defeated the drake and overthrew the Aristocrats.

100188.name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (I)
100188.desc: "Dandelion, Dandelion, ride the wind to a faraway land," the Fox chants.\nAn unforgettable Mondstadt fairytale about a hunter and a fox. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, an 11-part story, begins here.

100189.name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (II)
100189.desc: "Be good and stay put." Trapped by a Mist Flower, what does fate have in store by the fox who met a hunter?\nThe story of the Hunter and the Fox continues in Part 2.

100190.name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (III)
100190.desc: The Hunter of fruitless hunts was awoken by a commotion outside. Who is at his door?\nThe story of the Hunter and the Fox continues. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, Part 3.

100191.name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (V)
100191.desc: Upon accepting the Fox's conditions, he came to the place where all the prey who disappeared had eventually gone to — an endless field of dandelions.\nThe story of the Hunter and the Fox in the sea of dandelions. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, Part 5.

100192.name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (VI)
100192.desc: "Why do you want to learn the language of human?" "So I can befriend humans when I become one."\nThe child-like voice says, in the sea of dandelions. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, Part 6.

100193.name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (VII)
100193.desc: "Dandelion, Dandelion, ride the wind to a faraway land," the Fox chants.\nCan the Hunter also learn magic to make his wish come true? The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, Part 7.

100194.name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (X)
100194.desc: The somber parting has finally arrived... The Fox bids farewell to its mother, teacher, and the dandelion sea.\nIt's time to live up to the promise. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, Part 10.

100195.name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (XI)
100195.desc: "Dandelion, Dandelion, ride the wind to a faraway land," the Fox chants.\nAn unforgettable Mondstadt fairytale about a hunter and a fox. The Fox in the Dandelion Sea, the final installment.

100196.name: Hilichurl Ballad Selection (I)
100196.desc: The masterpiece of the Poet Laureate of Hilichurlian! Scholar Jacob Musk will show you the mysterious spiritual world of the hilichurls through this poetry collection!

100197.name: Hilichurl Ballad Selection (II)
100197.desc: Are wine and poetry a part of the hilichurl lifestyle? Do they have pure and devout desires? Expert on the hilichurls, Jacob Musk, is here to answer!

100198.name: Vera's Melancholy (V)
100198.desc: You can't have picnics on the sides of a galactic highway! Even the deities will be held fully responsible for road accidents that might occur!\nThe doorway to a study in a simple village connects to anywhere in space and time! Having tea with the deities, playing hide-and-seek across time... Vera's great adventure continues!

100199.name: Vera's Melancholy (IX)
100199.desc: "Vera's so beautiful, like a shining star in the universe, but I..." "Boys at this age are always more petite than girls of a similar age."\nChildhood must be let go of to welcome the coming of the adolescent years. It's not too late to think about it now... Real melancholy finally hits Vera.

100200.name: Vera's Melancholy (X)
100200.desc: "It's enough. Let's go home... The furthest place I've dreamt of, is the Delphi where you are."\nThough the explanation is delayed, you should know that Delphi is the center of Greek mythology. Vera's Melancholy - the perfect ending... or is it?

100201.name: Breeze Amidst the Forest - Ballad Selection Excerpt
100201.desc: A collection of Mondstadt ballads, recorded, compiled and arranged by scholars centuries ago.

100202.name: The Boar Princess (I)
100202.desc: A long, long time ago, in the forest kingdom... What legends occurred there?\nThe Boar Princess, Part 1. A story about friendship, love, and death.

100203.name: The Boar Princess (II)
100203.desc: A lifeless ice field, a land even the gentle Anemo Archon has never visited. How is it that it still has its lonely inhabitants?\nThe Boar Princess, Part 2. The story continues on the glacier.

100204.name: The Boar Princess (III)
100204.desc: "Now and evermore shall you be bereft of hope." What fate awaits the wolf pup who bears such a cruel curse?\nThe Boar Princess, Part 3.

100205.name: The Boar Princess (IV)
100205.desc: The wolf pup grew up in the cold loneliness. The secret past of the lone wolf is now revealed.\nThe Boar Princess, Part 4.

100206.name: The Boar Princess (V)
100206.desc: "No one deserves this fate." The good princess sheds a tear of compassion. For those who persevere as true companions, even the ice shall melt before their determination.\nThe Boar Princess, Part 5.

100207.name: The Boar Princess (VII)
100207.desc: All the sacrifices made out in the frozen plains were not in vain. The perfect ending of friendship, love, life and death!\nThis is the end to the famous and touching story, The Boar Princess.

100208.name: The Mondstadt Tower (I)
100208.desc: In the age of depression and tyranny, the outlander girl met the ominous orphan. Does this fateful encounter foretell a tragic ending?\nThe historic romance novel, The Mondstadt Tower, begins!

100211.name: Broken-off Branch
100211.desc: Seems it's been rotten for a long time.
100211.title: Investigate the broken-off branch

100213.name: Breeze Amidst the Forest Supplement: The Dragon Tome
100213.desc: A supplement to the "Breeze Amidst the Forest" ballad selection with excerpts from various sources.\nIt tells the story of the Dragon of Mondstadt.

100214.name: Letter from the Abyss Order
100214.desc: Seems to be a declaration of war from the Abyss Order to the "Darknight Hero." Many key phrases have been redacted.

100215.name: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (I)
100215.desc: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. This is part one, which tells the story of the Land of Night and the Moonlight Forest.

100216.name: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (II)
100216.desc: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. This installment tells of the meeting of the Pale Princess and the Light Prince.

100217.name: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (III)
100217.desc: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. This installment tells of the Pale Princess and the Light Prince's decision to save the Moonlight Forest.

100218.name: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (IV)
100218.desc: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. Installment four describes the meeting between the Pale Princess, the Light Prince, and the Six Pygmies.

100219.name: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (V)
100219.desc: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. In this installment, the Six Pygmies' sinister scheme starts to unfold.

100220.name: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (VI)
100220.desc: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. This installment tells of how the Six Pygmies managed to implement their nefarious plot.

100221.name: The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies (VII)
100221.desc: A fairytale story that has been told throughout Teyvat for ages. The final installment brings everything to a conclusion, and includes the Night Mother's prophecy.

100222.name: 1000 Years of Loneliness
100222.desc: The beginning of the Springvale Hunter's tragic fantasy journey. Where did misfortune first befall him? What marks the start and finish of the 1000-year journey of loneliness? Let this first volume of 1000 Years of Loneliness be your guide through the fantastical fog that is the life of Gothson.

100223.name: Teyvat Travel Guide - Mondstadt
100223.desc: A magazine by the Adventurers' Guild. Each issue introduces great sceneries across Teyvat. This issue includes a short traveling diary of Alice the Traveler on her experiences in Mondstadt.

100224.name: Wind, Courage, and Wings
100224.desc: A book mistakenly taken by Amber... about fables?

100225.name: Hunting Trap
100225.desc: Used to trap beasts of a certain size. If you pay attention in the wilds to collect them, you can make one like this. Set one down, and then conceal it carefully.

100226.name: Diary of Roald the Adventurer: Qingce Village
100226.desc: A diary left behind by the famed adventurer, Roald, at a makeshift camp. It stills looks new, and smells like the fragrant herbs of Mt. Qingce.

100227.name: Diary of Roald the Adventurer: Luhua Pool
100227.desc: A diary left behind by the famed adventurer, Roald, at a makeshift camp. It seems to have been dipped in water, with the watermark of a fox's footprint.

100228.name: Diary of Roald the Adventurer: Yaoguang Shoal
100228.desc: A diary left behind by the famed adventurer, Roald. The pages smell like the sea breeze.

100229.name: Letter for Dongdong
100229.desc: A letter treasured by Dongdong from Qingce Village. It seems to be a letter from his father.

100230.name: Someone's Diary I: Yaoguang Shoal
100230.desc: A diary left behind by someone in the wilderness that tells of the owner's unfortunate encounters at Yaoguang Shoal.

100233.name: Hearty Mushrooms
100233.desc: Hardy common fungi. Can grow anywhere with the right amount of shade and moisture.

100234.name: Crunchy Carrots
100234.desc: A healthy and nutritious vegetable that is crunchy and sweet to the taste. Easy to grow and harvest.

100235.name: A Plump Cabbage
100235.desc: A layered, leafy vegetable. Said to have originally been an ornamental plant, it certainly looks great in the pot.

100236.name: Gliding Instruction Manual
100236.desc: A guidebook for the ones new to using wind gliders. It also serves as a mandatory reading material to get a gliding license in Mondstadt. It contains all the necessary info any user must know.

100237.name: Azurite
100237.desc: A piece of plaustrite dug up from the roots of a Bloatty Floatty. It has a rather unique color and is, perhaps, the Azurite that Wang'ya spoke of...

100238.name: Vermillionite
100238.desc: A piece of plaustrite plucked from a Ruin Hunter. It has a rather unique color and is, perchance, the Vermillionite that Wang'ya mentioned...

100239.name: Someone's Diary II: Guili Plains
100239.desc: A diary left behind by someone in the wilderness that tells of the owner's unfortunate encounters at Guili Plains.

100240.name: Someone's Diary III: Jueyun Karst
100240.desc: A diary left behind by someone in the wilderness that tells of the owner's adventures at Jueyun Karst.

100241.name: Someone's Diary IV: Liyue Harbor
100241.desc: A diary left behind by someone in Liyue that tells of the owner's adventures there.

100242.name: Letter to the Treasure Hoarders
100242.desc: A letter written by someone to the Treasure Hoarders about some plans for the Lantern Rite...

100243.name: Nephrite Ring
100243.desc: A Nephrite Ring obtained from a slime. Gorgeous color and clearly a top-quality item. This must be Mr. Zhu's lost property.

100244.name: Delicious Golden Crab
100244.desc: Crab meat that's been rolled in flour, deep fried, and then pan fried together with ginger and garlic. When you finally plate up, the crab appears to be lying on gold.

100245.name: "Of Mountains and Seas"
100245.desc: Notes penned by Leonard, an adventurer from the distant past. Clearly an ancient text, it has suffered much wear and tear. Most of the content has been lost to the ravages of time, with just a few fragments remaining.

100246.name: Draft Manuscript of "Hyakunin Ikki: The Greatest Battle"

100247.name: Fischl Dictionary: Die Neuauflage der Prinzessin

100301.name: Wyatt's Red Key
100301.desc: A key to the warehouse's gates kept by Wyatt. The likeliness of him losing it is next to him losing his slim wallet.

100302.name: Wyatt's Black Key
100302.desc: A key to the warehouse's gates kept by Wyatt. The likeliness of him losing it is next to him losing his slim wallet.

100303.name: Coin Pouch
100303.desc: A small coin pouch of Mora that doesn't weigh much; you'd sometimes forget it's even there.

100304.name: Meal Fee Pouch
100304.desc: A small coin pouch of Mora that contains payment for a meal ordered at the Good Hunter. Do not take your cut out of this bag.

100305.name: Delicious Sticky Honey Roast
100305.desc: A meat dish in a sweet honey sauce. The warm honey draws out the flavor of the meat, creating a flavor explosion akin to bathing in the warm summer sun.
100305.effect: Decreases all party members' climbing and sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

100306.name: Sturdy Plank
100306.desc: A sturdy plank. It feels heavy and reliable, and easy to apply to all sorts of scenarios.

100307.name: Fragile Wooden Plank
100307.desc: A fragile wooden plank that is easily breakable. It doesn't serve much of a purpose aside from pretending that you're strong.

100308.name: A Bundle of Ropes
100308.desc: A bundle of sturdy ropes long enough to temporarily hold certain things together for a time, however short it may be.

100309.name: Meal Fee Pouch
100309.desc: A small coin pouch of Mora that contains payment for a meal ordered at the Good Hunter. Do not take your cut out of this bag.

100311.name: Meal Fee Pouch

100312.name: Delicious Fried Radish Balls
100312.desc: Fried Radish Balls. It's insane that something so delicious comes from plain old radishes! All who eat them will truly understand Liyue's culinary reputation.
100312.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 95 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

100313.name: Delicious Calla Lily Seafood Soup
100313.desc: A balanced combination of seafood. The crab, mint, and Calla Lily come together perfectly to dance on your tongue. It reminds you of playing barefoot by the lake in summer.
100313.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 235 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

100314.name: Bag of Goods
100314.desc: A bag that is quite heavy. Once picked up, you can't help but think of asking someone else for a hand.

100316.name: "Mondstadt Sunset"
100316.desc: A pretty and sweet cocktail. The juice slowly sinks in the clear liquor like the sunset. A favorite among couples.

100317.name: "Margaret"
100317.desc: Margaret's refreshing signature cocktail, popular among those who only want one drink. It also uses dandelions, but the greatest difference between this and dandelion wine is the price.

100318.name: "Charged Attack"
100318.desc: A straight liquor shot, giving you the original taste of the distilled liquor itself. One shot is enough to make your body burn.

100319.name: "Pearl"
100319.desc: A mellow beer with thick layer of foam on top. The flying bubbles from making toasts gave it its name.

100320.name: Messy "Mondstadt Sunset"
100320.desc: Though the taste is acceptable, but it has lost its aesthetic value due to a mistake in the making.

100321.name: Unusual "Margaret"
100321.desc: It looks alright, but a mistake in the making cost it its refreshing taste.

100322.name: Bizarre "Charged Attack"
100322.desc: A shot without the taste of the distilled liquor and pretty much anything else... Something must have gone wrong.

100323.name: Unusual "Pearl"
100323.desc: Though the taste is acceptable, but a mistake in the making cost it its texture.

100324.name: Odd Cocktail

100325.name: Messy Cocktail

100328.name: Barely Drinkable Cocktail

100348.desc: A love letter from Godwin to Glory detailing their love and the intimate things they did, which would make any reader blush. However, only the last part is somewhat memorable.

100349.desc: A hefty bottle that came drifting with the waves, carrying tokens of an old friendship and the hopes of being reunited.

100351.name: Tunner's Cough Syrup
100351.desc: Cough Syrup made from Sweet Flower that can moderately suppress cough. Due to its sweet and refreshing taste, the syrup is very popular among kids in Mondstadt. Some kids even wish they had a cough so they can get the syrup.

100352.desc: A letter from Draff to Sister Grace. It was tightly sealed, but it wasn't enough to withstand the brute force of the hilichurls.

100353.desc: All sorts of materials. These should be just enough to make a training dummy.

100354.desc: A thick-set letter sent back from Liyue Harbor to Sara. Several feathers are still stuck in the envelope, signifying the effort that carrier pigeon put in and the sort of treatment it received.

100355.name: Clean Radish
100355.desc: Rich in fiber and nutrients. Easy to grow and harvest.

100356.name: Guy's Letter
100356.desc: A letter from Guy to his father sealed as per regulation of the Knights of Favonius. It is tightly sealed to deter influence of rain and perplexity.

100361.name: Teyvat Travel Guide - Liyue
100361.desc: A magazine by the Adventurers' Guild. Each issue introduces great sceneries across Teyvat. This issue includes a short traveling diary of Alice the Traveler in Liyue.

100362.name: Letter
100362.desc: A letter written by Xingqiu to the Feiyun Commerce Guild. The handwriting is so messy it's barely recognizable.

100363.name: A Huge Bag of Mora
100363.desc: A heavy bag full of Mora provided by the Feiyun Commerce Guild. Enough to purchase every Cor Lapis available in Liyue.

100364.name: Legend of the Shattered Halberd (VI)
100364.desc:
Mir once again chanted the forgotten spell. The maiden was reunited with him again. "So, this is what you truly look like."
"The world is beyond repair. It shall be born anew from the ashes of the last." The mad Celestial Emperor sentenced all living things of the world to a harsh punishment.
"But you, you would understand me, wouldn't you?" The nameless thief who stole the national treasure said to his lord.
"No. No apologies necessary, for you are benevolent."

100365.name: Intact Training Dummy
100365.desc: An intact training dummy. Very sturdy, perfect for training.

100390.desc: A diary left behind by the famed adventurer, Roald. The pages have the scent of flowers that grow on cliffs.

100391.desc: A diary of the famed adventurer, Roald, left by the lake. It tells of his plans after his adventures on Mt. Aocang.

100395.desc: A box that's carelessly sealed. The content doesn't seem important.

100396.name: Tightly-Sealed Box
100396.desc: A box that's tightly sealed. The content must be important...

100398.name: Katheryne's Letter
100398.desc: A tightly-sealed letter packed with other supporting documents that prove the bearer of the letter to be a reliable and experienced adventurer.

100399.name: Records of Jueyun: Stone Beasts
100399.desc: A collection of folk stories, myths, and legends from Liyue. It's quite a page-turner. This segment is on the legends of stone beasts.

100400.name: Records of Jueyun: Palace Beneath the Sea
100400.desc: A collection of folk stories, myths, and legends from Liyue. It's quite a page-turner. This segment is on ancient fictional stories.

100401.name: Verses of Equilibrium
100401.desc: Legend has that it contains ancient incantations used to pay respects to Rex Lapis and the yaksha adepti. It also serves as a historical record of the ancient belief in the Geo Archon.

100402.name: Records of the Gallant: The Hermit
100402.desc: A compilation of stories and legends of various knights-errant in Liyue. Some of them have been told for a long time but are still popular among the people.

100403.name: Customs of Liyue: Flower Ball
100403.desc: A book on the cultures and customs of Liyue originally compiled by Fadhlan, a scholar from Sumeru residing in Liyue. It was then edited by many local scholars and published. It is one of the bestsellers in Liyue.

100404.name: Stone Tablet Compilations: Vol. I
100404.desc: A history book compiled and translated from ancient stone tablets of Liyue by the historian Zichang. It contains various fragmented historical events.

100405.name: Humor From Tianheng
100405.desc: A poetry collection by Pingshan, The Mystic. The quality of the poems is all over the place, but it has long been a reference book for young poets or poet-wannabes in Liyue.

100406.name: Hilichurl Cultural Customs (I)
100406.desc: It contains the investigations and observations into the cultural customs of the hilichurls by the "Poet Laureate of Hilichurlian," Jacob Musk, a Mondstadt ecologist. This volume features the social structure and characteristics of the hilichurls.

100407.name: Hilichurl Cultural Customs (II)
100407.desc: It contains the investigations and observations into the cultural customs of the hilichurls by the "Poet Laureate of Hilichurlian," Jacob Musk, a Mondstadt ecologist. This volume features the beliefs and spiritual world of the hilichurls.

100408.name: Hilichurl Cultural Customs (IV)
100408.desc: It contains the investigations and observations into the cultural customs of the hilichurls by the "Poet Laureate of Hilichurlian," Jacob Musk, a Mondstadt ecologist. This volume explores the diverse cultural customs of the hilichurls in relation to Mondstadt's.

100409.name: History of Kings and Clans: Prologue
100409.desc: A comprehensive history of Mondstadt edited and compiled by the Northland History Society.

100410.name: Biography of Gunnhildr
100410.desc: A history book on the life of the apical ancestor of the Gunnhildr Clan compiled by Eckhart Gunnhildr, a modern historian of Mondstadt. It consists of fragmented stories and legends from the aristocratic period.

100411.name: Ballads of the Squire (I)
100411.desc: Ballads that have been passed down since the aristocratic period and are said to come from Ragnvindr the Dawn Knight himself. They tell of Ragnvindr's days as a knight's squire.

100412.name: Ballads of the Squire (II)
100412.desc: Ballads that have been passed down since the aristocratic period and are said to come from Ragnvindr the Dawn Knight himself. They tell of Ragnvindr's friendship with a sword-dancer.

100413.name: Teyvat Wilderness Survivalist's Recipes
100413.desc: Field-cooking skills are paramount to surviving in the wilderness. Lynn, a 10-year Adventurers' Guild veteran, teaches you how to cook delicious and fulfilling food in times of emergency in the wilderness!

100414.desc: A treasure map obtained from Bolai of a hidden treasure somewhere out there...
