100426.name: Yakshas: The Guardian Adepti
100426.desc: A volume out of the "Wonders and Folklore of Liyue" collection, which serves as Liyue's own version of "Tour of the Land of Liyue," an encyclopedia of folk beliefs and customs by Masudi, a scholar from Sumeru. Due to the archaic nature of the author's writing style, it was largely dismissed by the public and publishers alike. "Yakshas: The Guardian Adepti" introduces the readers to the various yakshas who fought side-by-side with the Geo Archon.

100428.name: Special Almond Tofu
100428.desc: The signature dish of Smiley Yanxiao, the chef of Wangshu Inn. It has a sweet taste but also retains the bitterness of the almonds. Its refreshing taste and mild fragrance shall impress even the adepti.

100429.name: Dropped Package
100429.desc: A package that has been left on the ground. It's not very heavy; the sound of something clattering inside can be heard when picking it up. It must contain many small objects.

100430.name: Sigil of Permission
100430.desc: A token lent out from "Childe" of the Fatui. Normally, the people of Liyue only hold rituals to worship the adepti in the peripheral areas of Jueyun Karst; however, he who holds this token may safely enter the residence of the adepti.

100432.name: Legend of the Shattered Halberd (I)
100432.desc: In ancient times when Axis Mundi was unobstructed, there were nine realms, each a world of its own. The realm of humans was known as the Zhongzhou, while the gods reside in Shenxiao.\nAt the end of the last calamity, a war between the gods broke out. The God King fell, setting the nine realms ablaze, obliterating all living things. The realms have now been born anew, life again thrives, but the passageway between the nine realms by Axis Mundi has been sealed off.\nAn all-new graphic novel on the epic journey in search of the God-King's Halberd begins!

100433.name: Legend of the Shattered Halberd (II)
100433.desc: Mir, having stumbled onto the journey to retrieve the swords by accident, encountered a huge crisis before the journey had even begun. Imperial Guard and Imperial Escort elites were slain by enemies holding the Ominous Swords. Amidst grave danger, Mir recalled a spell taught by his father. Legend has that, the Celestial Emperor has a young daughter whose name was not known to the world; she now possessed Weiyang's body and revealed herself. Who would prevail? The wielders of the Ominous Swords who had turned into ferocious demons? Or Mir who could somewhat hold his own in a fight?

100434.name: Legend of the Shattered Halberd (III)
100434.desc: "Just stay with the name 'Weiyang' for convenience's sake on the road. With the official documents from the government in hand, you should be free to go as you wish throughout the kingdom." Still worried about Weiyang, Mir decided to accompany her on her journey and kill any demons they may encounter.\nThough they had already collected five Ominous Swords and all seemed to be well, they knew in their hearts that the way forward would only get more treacherous and perilous.

100435.name: Legend of the Shattered Halberd (IV)
100435.desc:
"Calm down, my son. Listen, Mir. I am not your real father..."
"Noooooo!"
The once Minister of Imperial Banquets was, in truth, Khan the Asura from Jotunheim. Leaving the capital was but an act in collaboration with the Minister of Ceremonies and the Grand Secretary to protect the daughter of the Celestial Emperor.
"The late Celestial Emperor Shenxiao, the now Contra Mundi, was once a dear friend of mine. But now, knowing that you have successfully summoned her, all my wishes have been fulfilled."

100436.name: Legend of the Shattered Halberd (V)
100436.desc:
"There are many among the military officials who wish to unseal Axis Mundi since the world in chaos would greatly elevate the position and importance of the Martial Artists."
"They want to wage another War of the Asuras?"
"He does."
The tug-of-war between the civil and military officials and the schemes of the past gods once again threatens all of the nine realms!

100437.name: Heart's Desire: Moonlight
100437.desc: A collection of fantasy stories centered around a mysterious antique shop. It's widely popular around Teyvat.

100438.name: Heart's Desire: Crystal Glaze
100438.desc: A collection of fantasy stories centered around a mysterious antique shop. It's widely popular around Teyvat.

100439.name: Heart's Desire: Sapphire
100439.desc: A collection of fantasy stories centered around a mysterious antique shop. It's widely popular around Teyvat.

100440.name: Heart's Desire: Stone Heart
100440.desc: A collection of fantasy stories centered around a mysterious antique shop. It's widely popular around Teyvat.

100441.name: Diary of Roald the Adventurer: Qingxu Pool
100441.desc: Diary of a renowned adventurer, Roald. Spots of shiny green moss can be seen among the pages.

100442.name: Traveler's Notes
100442.desc: A clue found in the northern Guili Plains ruins: "To unite in ambition is to be steadfast and immovable for all time."

100443.name: Traveler's Notes
100443.desc: A clue found in the eastern Guili Plains ruins: "Wisdom is like water, it nourishes all those who receive it and in it is a reflection of the truth."

100444.name: Traveler's Notes
100444.desc: A clue found in the southern Guili Plains ruins: "Fortify the bones, that movement be supple when the time comes."

100445.name: Traveler's Notes
100445.desc: A clue found in the western Guili Plains ruins: "Virtue grows tall like a tree, though there be shade it will flourish forever."

100450.name: Censer
100450.desc: A censer used for burning incense.

100453.name: Special Mondstadt Hash Brown
100453.desc: A Mondstadt Hash Brown stuffed with chopped Philanemo Mushrooms. It's much tastier and more nutritious than the average hash brown.\nThey say a father who truly loved Mondstadt Hash Browns prepared these for his unborn son.

100454.name: Dendro-Processed Berry
100454.desc: It's a berry that's been digested by a Dendro Slime. From the outside, it appears the same as any other ordinary berry. Will using it for herbal medicine really have any effect?

100455.name: Thick Hydro Slime Condensate
100455.desc: A thick blob of Hydro Slime Condensate. You can't help but get a strange sense of satisfaction while sloshing it in your hands. As for its taste...

100456.name: Wind-Caressed Aster
100456.desc: A Windwheel Aster that's been through the gentle caress of an Anemo Slime. Although its appearance hasn't changed, faint puffs of air seem to escape between your fingers as you hold it in your hand.

100457.name: Collected Fragment
100457.desc: A delicate fragment of carved stone. It seems to have something inscribed on it, perhaps only locals could decipher its exact meaning...

100458.name: Collected Fragment
100458.desc: A delicate fragment of carved stone. It seems to have something inscribed on it, perhaps only locals could decipher its exact meaning...

100459.name: Collected Fragment
100459.desc: A delicate fragment of carved stone. It seems to have something inscribed on it, perhaps only locals could decipher its exact meaning...

100460.name: Transcription from a stone tablet
100460.desc: "...In the beginning, when the people assembled to farm the land..."\nThe transcript seems to be a record of some event...

100461.name: Transcription from a stone tablet
100461.desc: "...A god named Guizhong descended, whose dominion was over Dust, and whose reach shrouded the skies for thousands of miles around..."\nThe transcript seems to be a record of some event...

100462.name: Transcription from a stone tablet
100462.desc: "...The god laid down four commandments for the people..."\nThe transcript seems to be a record of some event...

100463.name: Transcription from a stone tablet
100463.desc: "...Then another god descended, whose dominion was over Geo, and who brought the people of Liyue to this place. Jointly they shepherded the people for their protection..."\nThe transcript seems to be a record of some event...

100464.name: Transcription from a stone tablet
100464.desc: "...And the assembly was named Guili after the names of the two gods..."\nThe transcript seems to be a record of some event...

100465.name: Transcription from a ruin
100465.desc: "...and there they fought upon the Guili Plains, where black dust choked the heavens and a thousand rocks splintered..."\nThe transcript seems to be a record of a terrible war...

100466.name: Transcription from a ruin
100466.desc: Guizhong's Four Commandments are: "Teach with wisdom, be bound by virtue, fortify the bones, unite in ambition — the convergence of these four shall be known as the 'Guili Assembly.'"\n"...One can bear not to leave one's native land. A treasure lies in Guili, and Guizhong's Four Commandments shall guide those in generations to come who aspire to find it, if they would test themselves against the Four."\nThis transcript seems to be a letter that was left behind by someone...

100467.name: Hidden Treasure of Qingce
100467.desc: The hidden treasure of Mt. Qingce contains enormous Energy.

100468.name: (test)盗宝团情报笔记
100468.desc: A report regarding the hidden treasure of Mt. Qingce.

100469.name: Draft Lines of Hilichurlian Poetry
100469.desc: A list of lines from Ella Musk. On the front are many terms in Hilichurlian, and the back has some simple footnotes regarding the content...

100472.name: A Letter by Timmie
100472.desc: An envelope that has been tightly sealed. Inside is a letter, inked characters, a Dandelion, love, and a wisp of hope. All these will be safely preserved inside until the seal is opened.

100473.name: Marjorie's Recommended Gift
100473.desc: A gift that was recommended by Marjorie. It isn't very heavy; what kind of souvenirs could be packed inside?

100474.name: A Gift from Quinn
100474.desc: A gift from Quinn. He mentioned that Beatrice helped him prepare it.

100475.name: Sara's Special Dish
100475.desc: A special dish that Sara had specially made for Jilliana. What dish could it be? And what could be so special about it?

100476.name: Traveling Merchant's Package
100476.desc: A package given from a traveling merchant to Huai'an, boss of the Wangshu Inn. There seems to be some gifts inside. It's heavy enough to pique your interest, but not so heavy as to make you worry.

100477.name: Box of Goods Invoices
100477.desc: A box containing invoices of goods. Common sense says that to avoid raising any suspicion, it's usually best to not open the box and take a peek.

100478.name: Box of Goods Invoices
100478.desc: Although it only contains papers, it's still pretty heavy. You can't help but to start sympathizing the merchants that deal with them daily.

100479.name: Box of Goods Invoices
100479.desc: A box containing various invoices. It appears to have been opened once before and then tightly sealed back up. What nature of business could make even one who stumbles upon the box feel at nerve's end?

100480.name: Heart of Clear Springs (I)
100480.desc: A legendary tale passed down by Springvale hunters that portrays an encounter between an unknown young boy and a spring fairy.

100481.name: Heart of Clear Springs (II)
100481.desc: A legendary tale passed down by Springvale hunters that recounts the acquaintance of a spring fairy and a young boy.

100482.name: Heart of Clear Springs (III)
100482.desc: A legendary tale passed down by Springvale hunters that recounts a promise made between a spring fairy and a young boy.

100483.name: Heart of Clear Springs (IV)
100483.desc: A legendary tale passed down by Springvale hunters that recounts a bitter ending finally faced by a boy who was no longer young and a spring fairy who had not grown old.

100484.name: Linling's Anthology of Selected Poetry
100484.desc: A collection of poetry that Linling published at her own expense. It is her first publication, and she is very proud of it.

100485.name: Goods Invoice
100485.desc: An invoice with information of goods recorded on it. With only a few simple goods listed on it, someone must have selected these items.

100486.name: Invoice of Goods Quantities
100486.desc: Some manifests of goods that has only had their numbers checked out. This may seem like a very simple job, but one must still focus in order to ensure that no mistakes are made.

100487.name: Golden House Maiden
100487.desc: Silk Flowers from which perfume used in the Rite of Parting is made.\nThis species originally grew under complex hydrological conditions. Its foliage is abundant, its leaves are evergreen, and its stamen is as fair as a Golden House Maiden.

100488.name: Valley Weaver
100488.desc: Silk Flowers from which perfume used in the Rite of Parting is made.\nThis variety originally grew in dark, damp locations. It is known for its profusion of petals, densely packed stamens, and powerful scent.

100489.name: Fate's Yearning
100489.desc: Silk Flowers from which perfume used in the Rite of Parting is made.\nIn the past, this strain would grow among cloud-ringed peaks. It is a reclusive species, and has a subtle yet enduring scent.

100490.name: Golden House Maiden Essential Oil
100490.desc: The essence of decocted Silk Flowers. It can be further refined into perfume. Gives off a sweet scent.

100491.name: Valley Weaver Essential Oil
100491.desc: The essence of decocted Silk Flowers. It can be further refined into perfume. Gives off an intense scent.

100492.name: Fate's Yearning Essential Oil
100492.desc: The essence of decocted Silk Flowers. It can be further refined into perfume. Gives off an elegant scent.

100493.name: Bao'er's Empty Box
100493.desc: A light and empty box. It doesn't seem as though this fragile container has much protective ability...

100494.name: Heavy Box
100494.desc: A box containing cultural relics. Its ponderous weight makes one feel like it could break at any time...

100495.name: Sopping Wet Page
100495.desc: A page of a book that has been soaked through in water. It must have been in there for a long time, as the words have become so smudged as to be illegible.

100496.name: A Huge Bag of Mora
100496.desc: Funds provided by Childe. The sense of stability one gets from its weight also makes one unwilling to part with the money...\nThe face value of each of these gold coins is very large, but they can be redeemed for smaller change at the Northland Bank.

100497.name: Golden House Maiden Perfume
100497.desc: A perfume decocted from a special breed of Silk Flower.\nIt releases a scent that reminds one of sweet dreams. Perhaps it is the best fit for innocent young ladies.

100498.name: Valley Weaver Perfume
100498.desc: A perfume decocted from a special breed of Silk Flower.\nIt releases a thick, oppressive aroma. They say that it is very popular among the daughters of wealthy families.

100499.name: Fate's Yearning Perfume
100499.desc: A perfume decocted from a special breed of Silk Flower.\nIt releases a fragrance as elegant as the elusive, smoky mountain mist. One hears that it is a favorite of mature women.

100500.name: A Box of Gadgets
100500.desc: A box that contains the gadgets Soraya gave to you. You can feel its weight in your hand. It should be able to satisfy the greed of certain people.

100501.name: Cleansing Bell
100501.desc: It is said that this magic bell was prepared specifically for adepti. Its sound rings through the air and does not fade quickly, and can be used to purify the mortal realm.\nIt seems to have a life of its own, even as you hold it in your hand...

100502.name: Guizhong Ballista Maintenance Material
100502.desc: Spare parts for the Guizhong Ballista that have been stored away since antiquity.\nWhile they may seem like ordinary components, they have been made with special construction techniques, and to special design specifications.

100503.name: A Record of Qiming and Zhihua's Conversation
100503.desc: A record of Qiming and Zhihua's conversation. It seems like banal passing of the buck, but it feels like there is some tacit understanding hidden within...

100504.name: A Record of Sisi and Chaoxi's Conversation
100504.desc: A record of Sisi and Chaoxi's conversation. At first glance, the impression it makes is one of endless evasion, and of avoiding the brunt of work...

100505.name: A Record of Little Meng, Little Fei, and Little Lulu's Conversation
100505.desc: A record of Little Meng, Little Fei and Little Lulu's conversation. It appears to only be the straightforward conversation of children. But one can dimly sense some unnameable emotion sprouting in the hearts of the children. Perhaps this sprout will continue to gradually grow until its branches stretch out across the skies, no longer able to be ignored by anyone...

100506.name: Norma's Order
100506.desc: Norma's food order. You can feel its warmth in your hand.

100507.name: Hilichurl Ballad: Recital Draft
100507.desc: A Hilichurlian poem created by Ella Musk. According to her, this Recital of Friendship is the work of many hands. Still, you can't help but feel that something sounds a bit off when you read it...

100508.name: Hilichurl Ballad: Narrative Draft
100508.desc: A Hilichurlian poem created by Ella Musk. According to her, this Stirring Narrative is the work of many hands. Still, you can't help but feel that something sounds a bit off when you read it...

100509.name: Hilichurl Ballad: Lyrical Draft
100509.desc: A Hilichurlian poem created by Ella Musk. According to her, this Elegant Lyric Poem is the work of many hands. Still, you can't help but feel that something sounds a bit off when you read it...

100510.name: Vile's Gift
100510.desc: A gift acquired from Vile. Given how heavy it is to hold, there must be quite a lot of items inside.

100511.name: Stolen Relic
100511.desc: Cultural relics dug up by the Treasure Hoarders, and packed willy-nilly into a box. When you lift the box, it feels like it could collapse at any moment.

100512.name: Madame Ping's Box
100512.desc: A seemingly ordinary container that had been trapped in amber. Its weight, once held, is astounding, and no matter what you do, you can't seem to open it...

100513.name: A Torn Out Page
100513.desc: A page that seems to have been forcibly torn out of a book. It has been soaked in water, and the words on it have become illegible.

100514.name: Page of Scribbled Writing
100514.desc: A page with very messy handwriting. The words have been struck out with crude brushstrokes, and it has also been soaked in water to the point where nothing can be made out.

100515.name: Noctilucous Jade Sample
100515.desc: A small sample that has been sliced off in order to help you select the Noctilucous Jade you will be using to make implements for the Rite of Parting.\nAn ancient Liyue proverb goes: "Noctilucous Jade shines brightest in the flames," meaning that high-quality Noctilucous Jade will shine with a bright and pure azure light when exposed to high temperatures. It has also come to symbolize heroes showing their true mettle in times of crisis.

100516.name: A Bag of Mora
100516.desc: Funds provided by Childe. The clinking of the coins within lifts a person's spirits.

100517.name: Mitachurl Loot
100517.desc: A trophy taken from a Mitachurl. It seems to be capable of producing a very loud sound, but that probably won't be enough to shake a certain group of people free of their arrogance.

100518.name: Treasure Hoarder Loot
100518.desc: A trophy taken from the Treasure Hoarders. This box is very small and isn't very heavy, and will not be able to contain the arrogance of certain people. But it should be more than enough to keep a lid on their tricks.

100519.name: Ruin Guard Loot
100519.desc: A trophy seized from a Ruin Guard. It does not appear to have much value as a collector's item. But it is heavy enough that it would cause a great deal of pain, were it to be dropped onto a certain arrogant someone's foot.

100520.name: Noctilucous Jade Sample
100520.desc: A small sample that has been sliced off in order to help you select the Noctilucous Jade you will be using to make implements for the Rite of Parting.\nAn ancient Liyue proverb goes: "Noctilucous Jade shines brightest in the flames," meaning that high-quality Noctilucous Jade will shine with a bright and pure azure light when exposed to high temperatures. It has also come to symbolize heroes showing their true mettle in times of crisis.

100521.name: Noctilucous Jade Sample
100521.desc: A small sample that has been sliced off in order to help you select the Noctilucous Jade you will be using to make implements for the Rite of Parting.\nAn ancient Liyue proverb goes: "Noctilucous Jade shines brightest in the flames," meaning that high-quality Noctilucous Jade will shine with a bright and pure azure light when exposed to high temperatures. It has also come to symbolize heroes showing their true mettle in times of crisis.

100522.name: Everlasting Incense
100522.desc: A traditional incense fit for the Rite of Parting, worth 2,990,000 Mora.\nThere are some things in this world whose value can only be appreciated by those who understand them. Perhaps Everlasting Incense is one such thing...?

100523.name: Guizhong Ballista Maintenance Material
100523.desc: Spare parts for the Guizhong Ballista that have been stored away since antiquity.\nWhile they may seem like ordinary components, they have been made with special construction techniques, and to special design specifications.

100524.name: Sturdy Wooden Plank
100524.desc: A wooden plank well-suited to repair work. When people need repairs done, these things always come to mind.

100525.name: Box of Leaves
100525.desc: A box with some leaves inside. Something feels unusual about it when you hold it in your hand, and you can't help but feel a little uneasy... can this box really contain these leaves?

100528.name: Treasure Hoarder's Key
100528.desc: A key carried by a Treasure Hoarder.

100529.name: Alrani's Note
100529.desc: The treasure is buried beneath the <color=#00E1FFFF>giant golden tree</color> in the middle of Lingju Pass.

100530.name: Nameless Treasure
100530.desc: Anonymous treasure acquired at Qingxu Pool. There is a pattern of unknown significance on the outside. Perhaps you could get someone in Liyue Harbor with an interest in antiques to take a look at it.

100531.name: Nameless Treasure
100531.desc: Anonymous treasure acquired at Lingju Pass. There is a pattern of unknown significance on the outside. Perhaps you could get someone in Liyue Harbor with an interest in antiques to take a look at it.

100532.name: Nameless Treasure
100532.desc: Anonymous treasure acquired at Dunyu Ruins. There is a pattern of unknown significance on the outside. Perhaps you could get someone in Liyue Harbor with an interest in antiques to take a look at it.

100533.name: Stone of Remembrance
100533.desc: An unusual gemstone capable of removing a seal somewhere.\nYou can feel the turbulent thoughts racing relentlessly within when you hold it in your hand. Somewhere in this world are buried the memories of an ancient war.\n"For a future without the pain of savage slaughter, for a future without lives lived in vain, for a future where every day is filled with peace..."
source_list: Obtained by making offerings to Statues of The Seven in Liyue

100534.name: Dull Ring
100534.desc: A ring that seems to have existed for a long time. Though it has become dull due to erosion over time, it is not dirty because it has been stored inside a box.\nThere are words engraved on the inside of the ring, still clearly legible:\n"All beings suffer in war."

100535.name: Vermeer's Paintbrushes
100535.desc: Around five paintbrushes of different lengths and widths, wrapped in a cloth and stored in a box. The artist clearly takes excellent care of them.

100536.name: Vermeer's Paints
100536.desc: Half a box of paints of different colors. The bottle of white paint seems bigger than the others.

100537.name: Black and White Sketch
100537.desc: An unfinished painting by Vermeer the artist. For some reason, black and white are the only colors that he used. Vermeer says that his lost paints and brushes are at the <color=#00E1FFFF>viewing spot</color> where he painted this work.

100538.name: Color Sketch
100538.desc: An unfinished painting by Vermeer the artist. He says that his lost paints and brushes are at the <color=#00E1FFFF>viewing spot</color> where he painted this work.

100539.name: Nameless Sketch
100539.desc: A painting that Vermeer completed with the Traveler's help. He says that it is his finest work to date, but still far from perfect. He is determined to keep painting.

100540.name: Strange Stone
100540.desc: A circular stone with some text engraved on the side: "The house of stone envelops the timber hut." It seems like it should be fitted inside something...

100541.name: Fresh Qingxin
100541.desc: The freshest Qingxin you ever saw. Just bursting with scent when you picked it. It probably needs some further processing before it's ready to brew, though.

100542.name: Good Hunter's Specialty Dish
100542.desc: An extra-special item from the Good Hunter menu. A durable and travel-ready reinvention of their Satisfying Salad, intended as a gift product. Despite this, the original flavor and texture apparently doesn't quite survive long journeys.

100543.name: Flora's Bookmark
100543.desc: A bookmark given to you by Flora. Made from a dried-out Windwheel Aster, even in its box you barely notice the weight of it.

100544.name: Special Beverage from Angel's Share
100544.desc: An extra-special beverage obtained from the Angel's Share. Claimed to be the most cool and refreshing beverage ever, one can certainly feel the wind at the back of the throat more keenly after consuming it.

100545.name: Special Perfume
100545.desc: A mint-scented perfume specially prepared for Little Lulu by Ying'er. It's the perfect scent for Lulu, Ying'er says.

100546.name: Mint Essential Oil
100546.desc: Essential oil extracted from the Mint plant. Used for making perfume.

100547.name: Tasty Slime Condensate
100547.desc: Crystal-clear, thick and gooey, like gelatine... Could this be the stuff of haute-cuisine dreams?\nApparently, very few people are actually willing to try eating slime, so derivative products are typically passed off as agar-based delicacies. Only die-hard food fanatics can taste the subtle difference between the two.

100548.name: Extra-Sweet Sweet Flower
100548.desc: A plant with a rich, sweet fragrance that makes an excellent sweetener.\nSome say plants have feelings too — show them enough care and attention, and they will strive to bloom all the more fragrantly. Sometimes, though, this will then make them the target of people who don't know how to mind their own business.

100549.name: Fresh Sweet Flower
100549.desc: A Sweet Flower picked in the Whispering Woods. A decidedly healthy-looking specimen with a delightfully sweet aroma if you get close enough.

100550.name: Fresh Cecilia
100550.desc: A Cecilia picked on Starsnatch Cliff. The whole plant still conveys a quiet sense of gentleness even outside of its natural habitat.

100551.name: Fresh Windwheel Aster
100551.desc: A Windwheel Aster picked at Windrise. The petals are still spinning merrily around. It seems the wind has imbued this plant with a healthy dose of vitality.

100552.name: Fresh Small Lamp Grass
100552.desc: A small lamp grass obtained from the Whispering Woods. It has been unearthed with the utmost care, and neither its stem nor leaf has been bruised.

100553.name: Strange Cocktail Ingredient
100553.desc: A cocktail ingredient salvaged from a cart. When you hold it in your hand, you can't help but feel that there's something unusual about it.

100554.name: Teucer's Mora Pouch
100554.desc: A very hefty bag of cash that Teucer was all too eager to offload onto you... One wonders what sort of family this Snezhnayan kid comes from.\nThe face value of each of these gold coins is very large, but they can be redeemed for smaller change at the Northland Bank.

100555.name: Childe and Teucer's Mora Pouch
100555.desc: Funds for Teucer's entertainment, provided by Childe, now mixed in with the stash you received from Teucer earlier...\nThe face value of each of these gold coins is very large, but they can be redeemed for smaller change at the Northland Bank.

100556.name: Plump Sunsettia
100556.desc: A Sunsettia, slightly plumper than most, possibly due to unique cultivation conditions. That aside, there doesn't seem to be anything particularly special about it.

100557.name: Merchant Poster
100557.desc: "The Adventurers' Guild is now recruiting new members! To sign up, speak to Branch Master Cyrus in Mondstadt today."

100558.name: Merchant Poster
100558.desc: "New drinks at the Cat's Tail. Your bartender today is: Diona."

100559.name: Merchant Poster
100559.desc: "Try the all-new Good Hunter meal deal! Get 10% off when you purchase a Satisfying Salad and a Sticky Honey Roast in a single order."

100560.name: Jiayi's Gifts
100560.desc: A huge, heavy bag of gifts bought by Jiayi for his daughter, Little Liu. Perhaps Jiayi would prefer to give it to his daughter himself?

100561.name: Treasure Hoarder's Map
100561.desc: A map of Mondstadt carried by a Treasure Hoarder. Someone with terrible handwriting has made some notes on a location not too far away.

100562.name: Ragged Notebook
100562.desc: Anonymously authored notes. They describe a place seemingly not far from here.

100563.name: Strange Stone
100563.desc: A circular stone with some text engraved on the side: "To enter, first dot the eyes." It seems like it should be fitted inside something...

100564.name: Knights of Favonius Handbook - 5th Edition
100564.desc: A code of conduct covering language usage and behavioral norms for Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius, personally edited by Acting Grand Master Jean. All knights are expected to strictly abide by these rules and regulate their words and deeds accordingly.

100565.name: Tales From the Waves: Rising Tide
100565.desc: The legendary tale of an anonymous seafarer set in a time when Liyue was plagued by sea monsters.

100566.name: Tales From the Waves: Wild Storm
100566.desc: To the never-ending tune of the ocean, the seafarer fought against the phenomenal foe of fate, fighting to the bitter end...

100567.name: Tales From the Waves: Receding Torrent
100567.desc: Finally, when the tempest eased and the ocean surface was tranquil once more, the soft wind played a poignant homecoming tune...

100568.name: Hex & Hound (I)
100568.desc: Sometimes, feelings are like the summer rain, coming out of nowhere and catching you unprepared. A nostalgic summer story set in the age of aristocrats begins right here.

100569.name: Hex & Hound (II)
100569.desc: Money doesn't solve all your problems, but it can certainly solve a lot of them! A young woman's summer vacation in Mondstadt opens to the melodic tune of a symphonic sum of Mora.

100570.name: Hex & Hound (III)
100570.desc: Even when you live in a safe city, you should watch out for the wolves that lurk in the night... Something more impossible to master than mass hypnosis is revealed within these pages.

100571.name: Hex & Hound (IV)
100571.desc: Even a dog can learn basic things like upper-class etiquette — or so insists a certain non-nonsense teacher from afar.

100572.name: Hex & Hound (V)
100572.desc: "Be a good dog! Yes, there's no reward for getting it right, but there's still a punishment for getting it wrong!" The witch in black makeup smirked.

100573.name: Moonlit Bamboo Forest (I)
100573.desc: When a small-town boy looking to leave his sleepy hometown behind gets lost in a bamboo forest at sundown, what long-forgotten dreams will he encounter?

100574.name: Moonlit Bamboo Forest (II)
100574.desc: As the moon slowly rises in the night sky, small-town boy meets bamboo-forest girl — but is he voyaging into the realm of the adepti, or setting foot in some monstrous trap?

100575.name: Moonlit Bamboo Forest (III)
100575.desc: Deep in the bamboo forest, reality has coincided with a story from the distant past. But the crossover ends as the bright moon reaches its peak in the night sky, and small-town boy disappears into an indescribable dream.

100576.name: Moonlit Bamboo Forest (IV)
100576.desc: As dawn gently approaches, the fate of the two youngsters diverges, and they go their separate ways. But the echoes of that ancient story still resound within the forest, waiting for the day that they may welcome small-town boy back into their midst once more.

100577.name: A Drunkard's Tale (I)
100577.desc: One of many popular tales told of Mondstadt's drinkers. This one is the story of a drunkard who stumbled into wolven territory and the lone, starving wolf he encountered there.

100578.name: A Drunkard's Tale (II)
100578.desc: One of many Mondstadt tales told of popular drinkers. This story is the one of the time a lone, starving wolf met a drunken Mondstadt man.

100579.name: A Drunkard's Tale (III)
100579.desc: One of the popular, many tales told by the drinkers of Mondstadt. This drunkard is the one who told the lone wolf of an ancient story.

100580.name: A Drunkard's Tale (IV)
100580.desc: One of many drinking tales popularly told in Mondstadt. This wolf told a tale of wine and wolf to a drunken man of Mondstadt.

100583.name: "Dwelling in the Clouds" Blueprints
100583.desc: The designs for the Dwelling in the Clouds, built long ago by Cloud Retainer.

100584.name: Tainted Blood
100584.desc:
Substance acquired from defeating Dvalin.
A crystal imbued with the winds of antiquity as well as another occult power from within the great dragon's body.

The mighty dragon was once a captive of a cage of toxicity, woven of three poisons:
The foul blood he once ingested, the lies whispered from the Abyss, and the anguish of abandonment.
Through tears shed and songs sung, the unholy spikes that had grown on Dvalin's body were smashed to pieces, and the web that had ensnared him was torn away...
Perhaps these feats were achievable only by a free-spirited traveler from a far-away land.

100585.name: Monolith Fragment
100585.desc:
Some kind of fragment recovered after defeating the Overlord of the Vortex in battle.
In the ancient past, it was used to pin the great beast down.

There once was a time when the inhabitants of this land were terrorized by waves as tall as mountains, torn from their dreams in the dead of night by the deafening roar of tidal waves that would shake the world to its core. Fear of such horrors gradually subsided over the years as peace became the norm.
But no matter: though That Which Lies In The Deep awakens once more, it is powerless to prevent the dawning of a new era.
Perhaps this is just what the one who suppressed the Overlord of the Vortex has been hoping to witness in the millennia since.

100586.name: Rex Incognito (I)
100586.desc: A Liyue fantasy novel that tells the tales of Rex Lapis' incognito excursions in the mortal realm. Set in an age when the treasures of the world flocked forth, fact merges with fiction and both blend with old dreams in this charming tale set in the commercial port of Liyue.

100587.name: Rex Incognito (II)
100587.desc: A Liyue fantasy novel that tells the tales of Rex Lapis' incognito excursions in the mortal realm. Between lofty mountain peaks where bounteous jade lies beneath, substantial ideas and empty lies are suddenly shown up side by side.

100588.name: Rex Incognito (III)
100588.desc: A Liyue fantasy novel that tells the tales of Rex Lapis' incognito excursions in the mortal realm. Iron-clad concepts of rules or equity fade into nothingness in this fantastical tale.

100589.name: Rex Incognito (IV)
100589.desc: A Liyue fantasy novel that tells the tales of Rex Lapis' incognito excursions in the mortal realm. In an age when scrutiny was laid upon the treasures of the world, one humble witticism was all it took to expose all lies.

100590.name: Legend of the Lone Sword (I)
100590.desc: A popular martial arts novel in Liyue Harbor. In a world without elemental energy or alchemy, a tale unfolds of love and hate between friends and foes. This volume tells of the origins of Jin the Seventy-Second's revenge.

100591.name: Legend of the Lone Sword (II)
100591.desc: A popular martial arts novel in Liyue Harbor. In a world without elemental energy or alchemy, a tale unfolds of love and hate between friends and foes. This volume tells of Jin the Seventy-Second's arrival in Tupi Village.

100592.name: Legend of the Lone Sword (III)
100592.desc: A popular martial arts novel in Liyue Harbor. In a world without elemental energy or alchemy, a tale unfolds of love and hate between friends and foes. This volume tells of Jin the Seventy-Second's duel with the chief of Tupi Village.

100593.name: Legend of the Lone Sword (IV)
100593.desc: A popular martial arts novel in Liyue Harbor. In a world without elemental energy or alchemy, a tale unfolds of love and hate between friends and foes. This volume tells of Jin the Seventy-Second's treacherous trek into the mountains.

100594.name: Little Liu's Gifts
100594.desc: A little bag of gifts collected by Little Liu for her father, Jiayi. Perhaps Little Liu would prefer to give it to her father herself?

100595.name: Chaoxi's Reply to Cui'er
100595.desc: A reply from Chaoxi to Cui'er. Judging from the sender's attitude, it's unlikely to be a particularly heartfelt letter.

100596.name: Little Yue's Gift
100596.desc: A toy made from Starconches by Little Yue. It might not capture the sound of the sea, but it certainly captures the amount of thought he put into it.

100597.name: Yinxing's Letter to Bolai
100597.desc: A letter from Yinxing to Bolai. Short, but tightly sealed.

100598.name: Clerk Zhao's Invoice for Jiangzhou
100598.desc: An invoice from Clerk Zhao to Jiangzhou. There are several sheets, each with reams of text on. It seems that Jiangzhou has been putting off the planning for Lantern Rite for a very long time...

100599.name: Clerk Zhao's Invoice for Nervous An
100599.desc: An invoice from Clerk Zhao to Nervous An. There are several sheets, each with reams of text on. It seems that Nervous An has been putting off collating the statistics on the ships in the harbor for a very long time...

100600.name: Cui'er's Letter to Chaoxi
100600.desc: A letter from Cui'er to her lover, Chaoxi. It's a rather long letter — presumably packed with page upon page of poignant prose about how much she longs to see him again.

100601.name: Thick Notebook
100601.desc: Notes written by Henry Morton. They describe a place seemingly not far from here.

100602.name: Jack's Map
100602.desc: Jack's map. Huge when unfolded, but currently neatly packed into a box.

100603.name: Jack's Adventurer Handbook
100603.desc: Jack's Adventurer Handbook. Issued by the Guild to every newly recruited adventurer, Jack has carefully wrapped his in a cloth and packed it into a box.

100604.name: Cage Key
100604.desc: A key used to open a wooden cage.\nOf course, considering what the cage is meant to do, perhaps one should call it a "key meant to lock a wooden cage" instead?

100605.name: Sugar-Frosted Slime
100605.desc: A truly exquisite sweet treat that came to a certain someone in a dream. This dream was made a reality through someone else's hard work and, of course, a healthy dose of boom shaka-laka.\nSurely this is a gift fit for someone who belongs to the upper echelons of society.

100606.name: Wild Glaze Lily
100606.desc: Wild Glaze Lilies used in the Rite of Parting.\nDue to geological changes, Glaze Lilies have lost their natural habitat. They say that these plants understand human hearts, and will grow to be especially beautiful if serenaded with deep and meaningful songs.

100607.name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (IV)
100607.desc: After a few days apart, a long-awaited reunion takes place on a midsummer's night amidst a veritable blizzard of dandelion seeds.\nAt the direction of the fox, an ocean of dandelions opens up before the hunter's very eyes...

100608.name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (VIII)
100608.desc: "When he has mastered human language..." The fox's voice is gently carried away by the midnight breeze, drifting further and further away together with the dandelion seeds...\nAfter all, the fox is a different kind of creature from the human, and the two do not share all the same sense of mirth and misery...

100609.name: The Fox in the Dandelion Sea (IX)
100609.desc: When I have taught all that there is to teach, will it be possible to see this sea of dandelions again...?\nIn the dandelion sea, the hunter starts to contemplate leaving.

100610.name: The Boar Princess (VI)
100610.desc: The Boar Princess and her two wise companions brave an icy wasteland and scale a snowy mountain, where they discover a very mysterious inhabitant indeed...\nSee how this high-altitude, low-temperature adventure unfolds in volume six of The Boar Princess.\nThere is some childish handwriting on the title page, which reads: "Daddy, when you get home, you have to read me the one about the snowy mountain too!"

100611.name: Vera's Melancholy (IV)
100611.desc: There is a saying that goes as follows: Not all that glitters is gold, sometimes it is the outpouring of a broken heart.\nEither way, the stars in the sky certainly aren't made of gold, and most people's hearts aren't made of glass.\nIn any case — here is the next chapter of Vera's adventure!

100612.name: Vera's Melancholy (VI)
100612.desc: There was once a great scholar who wished to write a book about all the festive days of the empire.\nAfter looking into it more closely, he discovered that every single day had some sort of a festival associated with it... He persevered with this monumental writing task for six months before giving up on it.\nBut don't worry — as far as this book is concerned, I am the author, and I won't let my readers down!

100613.name: Vera's Melancholy (VII)
100613.desc: In the star clusters at the outer reaches of the universe, habitable planets are few and far between. For this reason, the region is the playground of space captains and pirates alone.\nWith this being the universe, though, there is no port and starboard in the traditional sense — out here, "starboard" means whichever side of your spacecraft is oriented towards the star you are using for navigation...\nLose yourself, and especially your sense of direction, in this next chapter of Vera's starbound voyage!

100614.name: Vera's Melancholy (VIII)
100614.desc: Of course boys aren't invited to the girl's slumber party! Girls are sacrosanct, like the gods of the golden age.\nVera, the Princess, Saint King Lebannin, and Ur, alpha female of the Galactic Swarm, shall talk deep into the night!

100615.name: Hilichurl Cultural Customs (III)
100615.desc: It contains the investigations and observations into the cultural customs of the hilichurls by the "Poet Laureate of Hilichurlian," Jacob Musk, a Mondstadt ecologist. This volume features mysterious hilichurls who live apart from the others.

100617.name: "Of Mountains and Seas"
100617.desc: Notes penned by Leonard, an adventurer from antiquity. Most ancient indeed. Mona has used her astrology to interpret its tattered contents and restore them.

100618.name: Strange Tooth
100618.desc: A Dragontooth you picked up in Dragonspine. Perhaps someone would know something more about it...

100619.name: Empowered Dragontooth
100619.desc: A Dragontooth infused with power. Its luster and texture appear to have been somewhat transformed...

100620.name: Princess' Box
100620.desc:
A treasure box with a decorative pattern at the bottom. The ornamentation seems to be a part of a three-piece motif. Once the pattern is completed, a certain door may open.
"I'm afraid I can't finish the fresco."
"It's been a while since I last saw the blue sky and green grass. I don't know which hues to use to capture the landscape of thawing ice and snow that my father so longs for."
"By the time he comes back, everything will be back to how it was. But I can't take this cold anymore."
"Forgive me, Father. Ukko, I'm sorry you had to see us like this."
"Imunlaukr, I wish I could see you again..."

100621.name: Priest's Box
100621.desc:
A treasure box with a decorative pattern at the bottom. The ornamentation seems to be a part of a three-piece motif. Once the pattern is completed, a certain door may open.
"I thought that the young will grow strong and vital like cypresses."
"But these cypresses are about to wither. Their voices won't be carried by the wind anymore. My expectations towards them, as well as the faith they have in me, will all fall through."
"Once again I'll climb this peak looking for guidance. By the time I'm back down, my daughter will have finished the second painting."
"As long as the third one will be of thawing snow and ice, everything will be fine."

100622.name: Scribe's Box
100622.desc:
A treasure box with a decorative pattern at the bottom. The ornamentation seems to be a part of a three-piece motif. Once the pattern is completed, a certain door may open.
"I yearn for those frosty skies to stand in flames and burn till there's no living soul in the world."
"I yearn for us to turn to dust carried by the wind so that we can find that outsider who abandoned the princess."
"I yearn for the black dragon from the princess' dreams to engulf the land in a cloud of scarlet poison."
"For I am the last one. There's no need to keep watch any longer."
"I've heard of people who are building a new nation without gods. Perhaps they'll have the power to stand against this world."

100623.name: Very Ordinary-Looking Sweet Flower
100623.desc: A Sweet Flower gathered from beside a meteorite. It doesn't look, feel or smell like anything special. Perhaps only Ivanovich knows its true worth...

100624.name: Customs of Liyue: Receiving God
100624.desc: A book on the cultures and customs of Liyue originally compiled by Fadhlan, a scholar from Sumeru residing in Liyue. It was then edited by many local scholars and published. It is one of the bestsellers in Liyue.

100625.name: Mr. Cyclops Action Figure
100625.desc: A "Mr. Cyclops" toy that Childe had specially-made for Teucer. It even has the lad's name on it.

100626.name: Little Liu's Letter
100626.desc: A letter that Little Liu wrote to Jiayi. The seal isn't all that tight. Best not to open it...

100627.name: Used Training Dummy
100627.desc: A wooden stake of very common design. It doesn't seem special in any way, other than its slightly smaller bulk. It bears some signs of use, and might have been moved here from elsewhere.

100628.name: Crude Sack
100628.desc: A cloth bag made of commonly-found materials. It contains some slightly damp objects. It might have fallen from a merchant vessel.

100629.name: Mysterious Stone Tablet
100629.desc: A stone tablet with mysterious markings on it. Its origin cannot be determined, but there is value in analyzing it.

100630.name: Treasure Hoarder Scouting Report
100630.desc: A letter obtained from Vile. It has the special mark of the Treasure Hoarders on it.

100631.name: Viktor's Lost Box
100631.desc: The box that Viktor lost. The wrapping is all crumpled up... but it doesn't look damaged. What important things could it contain?

100632.name: Notice Paper
100632.desc: A note written in haste. It lists a number of documents required when applying for a new business license.

100633.name: Old Business Permit
100633.desc: An old business license. The thick stack has an unnatural weight to it...

100634.name: Business Premises and Safety Certificates
100634.desc: Proof of one's business premises and the safety of said premises. The thick bundle has an unnatural weight to it...

100635.name: Approved Exit Permit
100635.desc: Approval documentation for going out to sea. Best you don't lose this thin sheet of paper...

100636.name: Great Snowboar King Meat
100636.desc: Exquisite flavor, rich in fat. This cut of meat is exceptionally delicious, regardless of preferred cooking technique.\nOnly the most ancient of creatures, the sturdiest of the boars deserves to be called a king.

100637.name: Records of Jueyun: Wuwang
100637.desc: A collection of folk stories, myths, and legends from Liyue. It's quite a page-turner. This segment is on the origin of Wuwang Hill.

100638.name: Records of Jueyun: Mountain Spirits
100638.desc: A collection of folk stories, myths, and legends from Liyue. It's quite a page-turner. This segment features the stories of Seelie living in the mountains.

100639.name: Meadow of Gems
100639.desc: This scroll, which seems to be a part of a larger series, belongs to the Jade Chamber's invaluable collection of written works. This volume is a dissertation on Liyue Harbor's economic policy.

100640.name: Customs of Liyue: Silk Flowers
100640.desc: A book on the cultures and customs of Liyue originally compiled by Fadhlan, a scholar from Sumeru residing in Liyue. It was then edited by many local scholars and published. It is one of the bestsellers in Liyue.

100641.name: Customs of Liyue: Glaze Lilies
100641.desc: A book on the cultures and customs of Liyue originally compiled by Fadhlan, a scholar from Sumeru residing in Liyue. It was then edited by many local scholars and published. It is one of the bestsellers in Liyue.

100642.name: String of Pearls (I)
100642.desc: Zixin is a poor fisherwoman whose family struggles to make ends meet. One day, she is selling fish on the street when she carelessly loses the string of pearls she usually wears. Though what she does not know is that this lost string of pearls will change her fate for good...

100643.name: String of Pearls (II)
100643.desc: The young man who had returned Zixin's string of pearls left without revealing his name. Grandma Zhang comes up with a plan that will allow Zixin to find him...

100644.name: String of Pearls (III)
100644.desc: Our heroine meets the young man again. They fall in love and are ready to live together happily ever after. But a despot who covets Zixin's beauty and virtue is putting the skids under their plans...

100645.name: Ancient Investigation Journal: Part I
100645.desc: An investigation journal found in front of the ruins with a circular entrance.\nIts author seems to have been a member of the aristocracy that once ruled Mondstadt.

100646.name: Special Mondstadt Hash Brown
100646.desc: A Hash Brown made specifically for Silio. Fresh out of the oven and still warm.

100647.name: Special Almond Tofu
100647.desc: A newly-made serving of Almond Tofu. It looks very delicious indeed.

100648.name: Special Jewelry Soup
100648.desc: Warm Jewelry Soup. It's practically spilling out of the bowl.

100649.name: Special Sweet Madame
100649.desc: A custom-made Sweet Madame. Such a fragile yet tempting dish is not often seen.

100650.name: Special Matsutake Meat Rolls
100650.desc: Freshly-made Matsutake Meat Rolls. The person who ordered this is in for a real treat.

100651.name: Special Jade Parcels
100651.desc: A newly-completed set of Jade Parcels. It exudes a transient, fantastical aroma. If you don't send this out soon...

100652.name: Special Flaming Red Bolognese
100652.desc: A freshly-served plate of Flaming Red Bolognese. It is a thing of fragile beauty.

100653.name: Special Black-Back Perch Stew
100653.desc: Black-Back Perch Stew, fresh from the oven. It won't maintain its freshness for long.

100654.name: Special Mora Meat
100654.desc: A serving of Mora Meat. Neither Mora nor Meat will be left if it gets cold.

100655.name: Special Tea Break Pancake
100655.desc: Tea Break Pancake that has just had syrup drizzled over it. Time to serve it to the customers, and fast.

100656.name: Special Come and Get It
100656.desc: A Come And Get It that looks delicious. Specially-made or not, Come And Get It always tastes terrible cold.

100657.name: Special Jueyun Chili Chicken
100657.desc: Especially tender Jueyun Chili Chicken. Eating it cold has some merit, but it's best to serve it hot.

100658.name: Special Mondstadt Hash Brown
100658.desc: A Hash Brown made specifically for Silio. Fresh out of the oven and still warm.

100659.name: Special Black-Back Perch Stew
100659.desc: Fresh Black-Back Perch Stew. It will probably be inedible once it gets cold.

100660.name: Special Come and Get It
100660.desc: A Come And Get It that looks delicious. Specially-made or not, Come And Get It always tastes terrible cold.

100661.name: Special Mondstadt Grilled Fish
100661.desc: Mondstadt Grilled Fish with crispy skin and tender meat. It'll taste terrible if left out for too long.

100662.name: Special Stir-Fried Filet
100662.desc: Stir-Fried Filet prepared for Ling'guan. If it was fated to be left to cool, why stir-fry it in the first place?

100663.name: Special Lotus Seed and Bird Egg Soup
100663.desc: Lotus on the one hand, and eggs on the other. It feels like you'd be insulting the adepti if you sent this over to Jueyun Karst.

100664.name: Special Fisherman's Toast
100664.desc: This should be finger food, but it also needs to be sent by speed courier. How odd.

100665.name: Special Almond Tofu
100665.desc: A newly-made serving of Almond Tofu. It looks very delicious indeed.

100666.name: Special Jewelry Soup
100666.desc: Warm Jewelry Soup. It's practically spilling out of the bowl.

100667.name: Orders
100667.desc: Orders written by Huffman. It's sealed up very tight. Best not to open it yourself...

100681.name: Jiayi's Letter
100681.desc: A letter that Jiayi wrote to Little Liu. It is sealed very tightly. Don't open it, now...

100682.name: Nostalgic Jueyun Chili Chicken
100682.desc: Jueyun Chili Chicken made personally by Little Wu. According to him, it captures the taste of his youth perfectly, and though Big G will not be able to enjoy it, he may yet remember some of the happiness of his youth.

100683.name: Luxurious Toybox
100683.desc: A luxurious toybox from Mumu. This was once something they all desired in their childhood. May all wishes come true in the future.

100684.name: Congzi's Plaustrite Shards
100684.desc: Plaustrite Shards of fine quality. A Xiao Lantern made from such material is sure to carry happy hopes high into the sky.

100685.name: Custom-Made Xiao Lantern
100685.desc: Xiao Lantern obtained from Congzi, and it has the names of the five childhood playmates inscribed upon it. May the fire pass on, and may friendship never die.

100686.name: Glory's Dandelion Seeds
100686.desc: Dandelion Seeds that contain Glory's thoughts. The wind can probably carry these far, far away.

100687.name: Letter to Cyrus
100687.desc: A letter to Cyrus. The handwriting on the envelope looks hasty and careless, reflecting the sender's state of mind.

100688.name: Qingzhou's Signature
100688.desc: A signature personally penned by the Liyue poet, Qingzhou. He mentioned that you can exchange this signature for a copy of his new anthology at Wanwen Bookhouse. Well, no one knows when he will finish writing that anthology, but at least it makes for a nice memento.

100689.name: Package of Fresh Flowers
100689.desc: The package contains some flowers trimmed by Flora herself. One can almost smell their fragrance through the packaging.

100690.name: Package of Fresh Flowers
100690.desc: The package contains some flowers trimmed by Flora herself. One can almost smell their fragrance through the packaging.

100691.name: Rex Incognito (IV)
100691.desc: A Liyue fantasy novel that tells the tales of Rex Lapis' incognito excursions in the mortal realm. In an age when scrutiny was laid upon the treasures of the world, one humble witticism was all it took to expose all lies.

100692.name: Ancient Investigation Journal: Part II
100692.desc: An investigation journal found in the basement of the ice-covered ruins.\nIts author seems to have been a member of the aristocracy that once ruled Mondstadt.

100693.name: Ancient Investigation Journal: Part III
100693.desc: An investigation journal found in the camp on the sunny side of Dragonspine.\nIts author seems to have been a member of the aristocracy that once ruled Mondstadt.

100699.name: Invoice From Second Life
100699.desc: The invoice for the furniture that Second Life purchased from Fanmu Carpenter's. It features detailed information regarding that transaction.

100700.name: Package of Fresh Flowers
100700.desc: The package contains some flowers trimmed by Flora herself. One can almost smell their fragrance through the packaging.

100701.name: Package of Fresh Flowers
100701.desc: The package contains some flowers trimmed by Flora herself. One can almost smell their fragrance through the packaging.

100702.name: Package of Fresh Flowers
100702.desc: The package contains some flowers trimmed by Flora herself. One can almost smell their fragrance through the packaging.

100703.name: Thank-You Letter
100703.desc: A crumpled note featuring hastily written characters. One can imagine the state its author was in when they wrote it.

100704.name: Experimental Potion
100704.desc: A potion that Albedo made using alchemy. Despite its unusual color, Albedo insists that the potion will work just as expected. Drinking it should not cause any adverse side effects.

100705.name: Chilled Meat
100705.desc: Rare, fresh meat.\nThis species of boar is recorded to have gone extinct several hundred years ago and has been preserved by the extreme temperatures on Dragonspine. For the gourmets of Teyvat, this is an ingredient of unspeakable sacrosanctness.

100706.name: Diary of Roald the Adventurer: Dragonspine
100706.desc: A journal left behind by a renowned adventurer Roald. Some of its pages are damaged and crumpled, and a few shimmering ice crystals are attached to them.

100707.name: Kamera Picture
100707.desc: A picture printed out by the Kamera. It's very clear.

100708.name: Kamera Picture
100708.desc: A picture printed out by the Kamera. It's very clear.

100709.name: Sigil of Permission
100709.desc: Normally, the people of Liyue only hold rituals to worship the adepti in the peripheral areas of Jueyun Karst; however, he who holds this token may safely enter the residence of the adepti.

100710.name: Harris' Special Cream Stew
100710.desc: A dish of delicate texture stewed in fresh cream. So warm and comforting that it makes one feel at home.

100711.name: Treasure Map
100711.desc: A map that records the location of treasure.
100711.title: Investigate

100712.name: Strange Note
100712.desc: A strange note that seems to contain some sort of message...
100712.title: Investigate

100713.name: A Bag of Mora
100713.desc: A bag of Mora. Not the heaviest, but one would not mind finding it on the street.

100714.name: Water-Logged Box
100714.desc: A water-logged box. It is packed very tightly — its contents seem to be of much importance...

100715.name: Meadow of Gems
100715.desc: This scroll, which seems to be a part of a larger series, belongs to the Jade Chamber's invaluable collection of written works. This volume is a dissertation on Liyue Harbor's economic policy.

100716.name: Starsilver Catalyst
100716.desc: Starsilver ore collected along the way. It looks similar to regular Starsilver, but upon closer inspection by Albedo, it can be used as an alchemical catalyst.

100717.name: Starsilver Catalyst
100717.desc: Starsilver ore collected along the way. It looks similar to regular Starsilver, but upon closer inspection by Albedo, it can be used as an alchemical catalyst.

100718.name: Starsilver Catalyst
100718.desc: Starsilver ore collected along the way. It looks similar to regular Starsilver, but upon closer inspection by Albedo, it can be used as an alchemical catalyst.

100719.name: Starsilver Catalyst
100719.desc: Starsilver ore collected along the way. It looks similar to regular Starsilver, but upon closer inspection by Albedo, it can be used as an alchemical catalyst.

100720.name: Starsilver Catalyst
100720.desc: Starsilver ore collected along the way. It looks similar to regular Starsilver, but upon closer inspection by Albedo, it can be used as an alchemical catalyst.

100721.name: （test）灯纸纤维待重命名
100721.desc: Dropped by <color=#FF5E41FF>the Fatui, hilichurls</color>, and <color=#FF5E41FF>Abyss Mages</color>. Can also be harvested from plants.\nCommon fibrous material that can be processed into lantern wrappings so that the lanterns can float away with their beautiful wishes.\nFound in Liyue.

100722.name: （test）灯芯绒材待重命名
100722.desc: Dropped by <color=#FF5E41FF>fluffy enemies</color> and <color=#FF5E41FF>small animals</color>. Can also be harvested from plants.\nCommon velvety material that can be processed into lantern wicks so that the lanterns can float away with their beautiful wishes.\nFound in Liyue.

100723.name: Dummy's Xiao Lantern
100723.desc: A Xiao Lantern made by Dummy. It looks surprisingly intricate...

100726.name: Herbalist Gui's Medicine
100726.desc: Medicine from Herbalist Gui. Best to send it to the one who ordered it.

100727.name: Starsilver Catalyst
100727.desc: Starsilver ore collected along the way. It looks similar to regular Starsilver, but upon closer inspection by Albedo, it can be used as an alchemical catalyst.

100728.name: Dandelion Seed
100728.desc: Dandelion Seeds that contain the wishes of the siblings Freki and Geri. May it go with the wind back to Mondstadt...

100729.name: Siyu's Xiao Lantern
100729.desc: A Xiao Lantern given to Wrench Wang by Siyu as a gift.

100730.name: Records of Jueyun: Qilin
100730.desc: A collection of folk stories, myths, and legends from Liyue. It's quite a page-turner. This segment is on the shared history of qilins and humans.

100731.name: Records of Jueyun: Hidden Jade
100731.desc: A collection of folk stories, myths, and legends from Liyue. It's quite a page-turner. This segment is on the Dunyu Ruins.

100732.name: Records of the Gallant: Black Raccoons
100732.desc: A compilation of stories and legends of various knights-errant in Liyue. Some of them have been told for a long time but are still popular among the people.

100733.name: Records of the Gallant: Dust
100733.desc: A compilation of stories and legends of various knights-errant in Liyue. Some of them have been told for a long time but are still popular among the people.

100734.name: Hex & Hound (VI)
100734.desc: "Message From the Editor: Thank you for your support, everyone! We've managed to snag our erstwhile author from the bowels of The Cat's Tail! Although they look drunker than a sodden dandelion, continued serialization should pose no problem! We hope for your continued support from here on out as well!"

100735.name: Hex & Hound (VII)
100735.desc: "A good person, one who smiles as she gives out dog biscuits..." What is the true identity of the strange young woman in the familiar forest?

100736.name: Hex & Hound (VIII)
100736.desc: "Heavens, I spoke ill of a witch to her face!" "Oh, what a bad boy. Still, discipline is a master's duty, so there's nothing for it~" The curtains rise on the witch's cruel secret—

100737.name: Aunt Qiao's Almond Tofu
100737.desc: This box contains Almond Tofu made at Wangshu Inn. It is well-packaged, and one can feel the care that the chef took in putting this together.

100738.name: Zhuyu's Golden Shrimp Balls
100738.desc: This box contains Golden Shrimp Balls made at Wangshu Inn. It is well-packaged, and one can feel the care that the chef took in putting this together.

100739.name: Ominous Dish
100739.desc: This is supposed to be Bennett's specialty dish, but you can sense that this dish emanates a strange feeling of... misfortune?

100740.name: Lost Adventure Notebook
100740.desc: A set of adventurer's notes that you picked up in the ruins. It seems to contain a clue to unlocking these mechanisms.

100741.name: Broken Xiao Lantern Lampshade
100741.desc: This was once a Xiao Lantern that carried someone's wishes. No one can say where it has flown since, but now there is naught left but its lampshade...

100742.name: Hard Iron Chunk
100742.desc: Iron ore. Looks like it could take quite a strong blow to break it apart.

100743.name: Hard Crystal Chunk
100743.desc: An uncut crystal. Most people could throw everything they have at it and still barely leave a scratch.

100744.name: Red Wolfhook
100744.desc: A red Wolfhook berry. One wonders if it might have some unique medicinal properties...

100745.name: Fresh Jueyun Chili
100745.desc: A very fresh Jueyun Chili. It seems to be of very high-quality...

100746.name: Handpicked Gift
100746.desc: A gift you chose together with Noelle. Hopefully, it will help bring Bea and Quinn together...

100747.name: Lantern Rite Gift
100747.desc: Lantern Rite Gifts from Wang'ya. Best to pass them on to the Millelith as soon as possible...

100748.name: Pyro Whopperflower Nectar
100748.desc: You can still feel its heat as you hold it in your hand. Can this really be used to make paint?

100749.name: Wanmin Restaurant Take-Away
100749.desc: A meal that Chef Mao has made for Atsuko. It looks like it is freshly made — you can feel its warmth even through the tight wrapping.

100750.name: Strange Box
100750.desc: A box with something in it. One wonders who might have buried it here...

100751.name: Inscribed Xiao Lantern
100751.desc: At first glance, this looks no different from your average Xiao Lantern. However, closer observation reveals that this lantern has inscriptions upon it. The penmanship is most austere, and seems to have been written in Mr. Bohuan's hand.

100752.name: Soil Sample
100752.desc: A soil sample from Mt. Tianheng. Who knows what discoveries Soraya's analysis will yield...

100753.name: Fresh Qingxin
100753.desc: A translucent white flower that only grows on the highest stone peaks. It eschews the warmth and moisture of the plains to gaze out afar from the solitary mountaintops.

100754.name: Slime-Swallowed Calla Lily
100754.desc: A Calla Lily that has been swallowed by a Slime. One hopes that this Calla Lily can still be used in making medicine...

100755.name: Fresh Lotus Head
100755.desc: An aquatic plant native to Liyue that grows and blooms in pairs. One is fragrant, and the other bitter. It's said to make a good herbal medicine.

100756.name: Plank
100756.desc: An ordinary wooden plank. It has a great many uses.

100757.name: Fresh Raw Meat
100757.desc: Fresh meat rendered from a fresh hunt. It is both firm and tender.

100758.name: High-Quality Chilled Meat
100758.desc: High-quality Chilled Meat from Dragonspine. It has a unique flavor.

100759.name: Picture of Windblume Festival
100759.desc: A picture recording the scene in Mondstadt during Windblume Festival. With fresh flowers, the Statue of The Seven, and the free people of Mondstadt, "Windblume" could be deemed synonymous with "romantic."

100760.name: Picture of Windblume Festival
100760.desc: A picture recording the scene in Mondstadt during Windblume Festival. With fresh flowers, the Statue of The Seven, and the free people of Mondstadt, this festival could indeed be deemed synonymous with "romance."

100761.name: Picture of Windblume Festival
100761.desc: A picture recording the scene in Mondstadt during Windblume Festival. With fresh flowers, the Statue of The Seven, and the free people of Mondstadt, "Windblume" could be deemed synonymous with "romantic."

100762.name: Wondrous Lovely Flower
100762.desc: A wondrous flower created using alchemy, with Starsilver as its main component. Its petals are large but soft, and it glimmers with a silver light.

100763.name: Watch Out!
100763.desc: A threatening letter of unknown origin. You can barely make heads or tails out of it, but yet it seems to also conceal some deeper meaning...

100764.name: Fresh Valberry
100764.desc: A freshly picked Valberry. It would make a fine dye once mashed.

100765.name: Pyro Slime Condensate
100765.desc: The condensate of a Pyro Slime. It bears slight traces of Pyro energy.

100766.name: Special Bottle
100766.desc: A bottle you received from Connor. It contains the key to resolving this incident.

100767.name: Notes of Some Kind
100767.desc: A note filled from margin to margin with text. It seems to have come from a student of the love poem crash course. If you read it carefully, you may yet grasp the gist of how to write a love poem.

100768.name: Ward
100768.desc: A mysterious object retrieved from within a fox-shaped statue.

100769.name: Ward
100769.desc: A ward retrieved from within the kitsune-shaped sculpture within the abandoned shrine north of Konda Village.\nAccording to Hanachirusato, these wards are required to conduct rites of purification.

100770.name: Ioroi's Ward
100770.desc: A ward given to you by the bake-danuki Ioroi as a sign of thanks. It is shaped like a lovely comb.\nIoroi once stole this comb to lure "that sneaky kitsune" out. As punishment, Ioroi and his companions were sealed into graven stone by "that dratted fellow."\nAccording to Hanachirusato, these wards are needed to conduct the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual.

100771.name: Scroll-Shaped Ward
100771.desc: An ancient and mysterious item shaped like a tightly-sealed scroll. No matter what you do, it won't open at all.\nAccording to Hanachirusato, these wards are needed to conduct the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual.

100772.name: Key-Shaped Ward
100772.desc: An ancient and mysterious item shaped like an ancient key. Where there's a key, there's a lock — but this key's lock is about to be breached by the defilement absorbed by the tree's roots.\nAccording to Hanachirusato, these wards are needed to conduct the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual.

100774.name: Old Key
100774.desc: According to Konda Densuke, this is the key to the well's lid.

100775.name: Old Stone Slate
100775.desc: The lines carved into this old stone slate speak silently of the secret of the legendary treasure...

100776.name: Old Stone Slate
100776.desc: The lines carved into this old stone slate speak silently of the secret of the legendary treasure...

100777.name: Old Stone Slate
100777.desc: The lines carved into this old stone slate speak silently of the secret of the legendary treasure...

100778.name: Old Stone Slate
100778.desc: The lines carved into this old stone slate speak silently of the secret of the legendary treasure...

100779.name: Rather Fine Dandelion Seeds
100779.desc: Seeds of a Dandelion plucked from Starsnatch Cliff. Said to be of rather fine quality.

100780.name: Rather Fine Windwheel Aster
100780.desc: A Windwheel Aster that grows near Windrise. Said to be of fine quality.

100781.name: Special Beverage
100781.desc: A special beverage that has just been brewed. Who knows how it will taste...

100782.name: Special Beverage
100782.desc: A special beverage that has just been brewed. Who knows how it will taste...

100783.name: Hex & Hound (IX)
100783.desc: "What does the death of a warm spring day feel like?" So the young maiden said one morning, in defiance of all common logic. "I suppose it must feel... furry?"

100784.name: Hex & Hound (X)
100784.desc: After all, none can live and still obtain release.

100785.name: Hex & Hound (XI)
100785.desc: "I should just stuff that noisy puppy yapper of yours..." "Woof, woof!" That day, the young maiden gave her loyal dog something precious...

100786.name: String of Pearls (IV)
100786.desc: To rescue the one he loves, the young man charges heedlessly into danger, entering the lair of the enemy with his sword drawn: and on the other side, his beloved hangs on desperately...

100787.name: String of Pearls (V)
100787.desc: The bandit lair in the dead of night is pitch-dark. The tyrant, the youth, and the lady grope in the dark in search of one another, and there, a perilous misunderstanding is about to play out...

100788.name: Handy Handbook of Hilichurlian
100788.desc: A handbook of Hilichurlian written by the folklorist Ella Musk, though its practical use has yet to be tested in the field.

100789.name: Bamboo Slip
100789.desc: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

100790.name: Bamboo Slip
100790.desc: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

100796.desc: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

100798.name: Fortune Slip
100798.desc:
A special slip of paper that can illuminate one's fortune. Also known to a certain someone as "strips of paper."
You can only get one of these per day, which will cause the previous day's fortune slip to lose meaning and disappear.
They say that slips that portend ill luck such as "Misfortune" and "Great Misfortune" can be tied to the Fortune Slip Hanger as a prayer for a turnaround.
Regardless, "fate" and "destiny" are things best grasped and forged in one's own hands.
