100807.name: Strange Fortune Slip
100807.desc: A special slip that can only be obtained if you use a certain secret code while exchanging for a Fortune Slip. Indicates a target and the location where they will emerge.

100808.name: Strange Fortune Slip
100808.desc: A special slip that can only be obtained if you use a certain secret code while exchanging for a Fortune Slip. Indicates a target and the location where they will emerge.

100809.name: Strange Fortune Slip
100809.desc: A special slip that can only be obtained if you use a certain secret code while exchanging for a Fortune Slip. Indicates a target and the location where they will emerge.

100810.name: Strange Fortune Slip
100810.desc: A special slip that can only be obtained if you use a certain secret code while exchanging for a Fortune Slip. Indicates a target and the location where they will emerge.

100811.name: Picture of Cape Oath
100811.desc: A picture taken for Bea. It shows a scenic view of the beach at Cape Oath.

100812.name: Picture of Starsnatch Cliff
100812.desc: A picture taken for Bea. It shows the night sky above Starsnatch Cliff.

100813.name: Picture of Windrise
100813.desc: A picture taken for Bea. It shows the picturesque landscape of trees and water at Windrise.

100814.name: Cyrus' Letter to Iris
100814.desc: This long letter makes one curious as to what Cyrus has written in it... But it's not very appropriate to peek at the private letters between a brother and sister, now is it?

100815.name: Picture of Dragonspine
100815.desc: A picture taken for Iris. It depicts the snowy scenery of Dragonspine.

100816.name: The Crux Clash Champion Medal
100816.desc: A medal awarded by the organizers of The Crux Clash. It is proof that you are the undisputed champion of this tournament. But it is not so much the duels you experienced that you will look back on — rather, it is the story of a Vision and the pursuit of ideals.

100817.name: Well-Packaged Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut
100817.desc: A serving of Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut that has already been packed. A curious smell wafts from within.\nYou've heard that this is a hidden menu item that only long-time patrons know of and that the hoi polloi cannot appreciate its flavor — fair enough, you think...

100818.name: Tea Break Pancake Cooked by Lily
100818.desc: The inner layers have not quite been pressed together to perfection, and it does taste a little burnt, but these are the best pancakes that Lily can make.

100819.name: Mysterious Mechanical Part
100819.desc: A rarely seen device that seems to have some special purpose. Try fitting it into a suitable environment.

100820.name: Pale Yellow Crystal
100820.desc: A crystal chunk that is pale yellow all over, beauteous as the swaying leaves of fall.

100821.name: Pale Red Crystal
100821.desc: A crystal chunk that is pale red all over, lovely as spring blossoms.

100822.name: Pale Blue Crystal
100822.desc: A crystal chunk that is pale blue all over, fair as the purest winter snow.

100823.name: Pale Yellow Scale
100823.desc: A pale yellow scale obtained from a fish in the sea. Gazing upon it for a long time, you are reminded of autumn.

100824.name: Pale Blue Scale
100824.desc: A pale blue scale obtained from a fish in the sea. Gazing upon it for a long time, you are reminded of winter.

100825.name: Pale Red Scale
100825.desc: A pale red scale obtained from a fish in the sea. Gazing upon it for a long time, you are reminded of springtime.

100826.name: Cat Food
100826.desc: Cat food obtained from Sara. You wonder what it might taste like...

100827.name: Cat Toy
100827.desc: A cat toy obtained from Marjorie. Hopefully, the kittens will enjoy it.

100828.name: Fresh Fish Scales
100828.desc: The fresh scales of a fish. One wonders what Diona might do with it...

100829.name: Some Strange... Drink?
100829.desc: A newly mixed drink. It seems a little... odd?

100830.name: Purse by the Dried-Up Well
100830.desc: A purse that you found beside the dry well in Konda Village.\nIt seems to have been left behind in a hurry, and has a special symbol printed on it.

100831.name: Archaic Stone
100831.desc:
A rare ore mined from a deserted spot deep in the mountains.
This sort of ore can only be found in veins in the oldest mountains. Perhaps it is due to its extreme rarity, but many merchants haven't even so much as heard of this rock.
The ore itself has incredible clarity and its colors are dazzling, almost seeming to glow with an inner light that brings out its blue-violet beauty, which is like the distant and lovely sunset sky.
The few scholars who understand its value gave it a most straightforward name — "Archaic Stone."
If you intend to give it as a gift, it would be best to give it to one who recognizes what they're receiving.

100832.name: Slightly Damaged Wooden Plank
100832.desc: A wooden plank that has taken some damage. Some words seem to be carved on it...

100833.name: Somewhat Rotten Wooden Plank
100833.desc: A wooden plank that has partially rotted away. There seem to be some words carved on it...

100835.name: Smaragdus Jadeite
100835.desc: A stone known as Smaragdus Jadeite. What will Madame Ping use it for?

100836.name: Smaragdus Nephrite Fragment
100836.desc: A stone that Yanfei and Zhiqiao have adjudged to be Smaragdus Nephrite.

100837.name: The Jade Mystery's Affidavit
100837.desc: A written affidavit from The Jade Mystery.

100838.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs' Affidavit
100838.desc: The Ministry of Civil Affairs' filing documents, obtained from Mingxing Jewelry.

100839.name: Bubu Pharmacy's Affidavit
100839.desc: A pharmacological certification from Bubu Pharmacy.

100840.name: Fresh Slime Condensate
100840.desc: Slime condensate that you just obtained. Who knows what Diona might do with it...

100841.name: Minacious Isle Mural
100841.desc: A mural that you found on a stone wall on Minacious Isle. It seems to depict a shipwreck...

100842.name: Broken Isle Mural
100842.desc: A mural that you found on a stone wall on Broken Isle. It depicts five strange objects...

100843.name: Nameless Island Mural
100843.desc: A mural that you found on a stone wall on the Nameless Island. It seems to depict a rescue...

100844.name: Twinning Isle Mural
100844.desc: A mural that you found on a stone wall on Twinning Isle. The mountain in the mural bears a special mark...

100846.name: Fresh Fish
100846.desc: Fresh fish. What will Diona use it for, you wonder...

100849.name: Ragged List of Goods
100849.desc: A list of goods found on a destroyed transport cart.\nBoth sun and rain have beaten down upon it such that most of its contents are impossible to discern. One thing alone remains clear — that this was once a Shogunate receipt for goods and the payments thereof.

100850.name: Cargo Bag Fished Out From Water
100850.desc: A bag of cargo you discovered in the water while following the gully.\nIt seems to have been washed away.

100851.name: Nameless Islet Mural
100851.desc: A mural that you found on a stone wall on the Nameless Islet. It seems to depict a group of people preparing to board a ship...

100852.name: Clear Image
100852.desc: An image showing the state of the storage devices within the Mikage Furnace. Who knows what Xavier can glean from it...

100853.name: Somewhat Clear Image
100853.desc: An image showing the lowest level of the Mikage Furnace. Who knows what Xavier can glean from it...

100854.name: Rather Foggy Image
100854.desc: An image showing the area around the Mikage Furnace. Who knows what Xavier can glean from it...

100855.name: A Discarded Blade
100855.desc: An old blade that has lost its luster due to a long-term lack of maintenance.

100856.name: A Jug of Wine
100856.desc: An old jug containing wine. A rich scent emanates from it.

100857.name: A Masterless Blade
100857.desc: A familiar old blade, stabbed into the battlefield in a skewed fashion.

100858.name: Bag of Flower Seeds
100858.desc: A bag full of flower seeds. Question is, where to plant them?

100859.name: Mysterious Conch
100859.desc: A conch, but there's something strange about it. What could it be for?

100861.name: The Sage Aetolia Will Die Tomorrow
100861.desc: A fantasy novel. From the packaging, it seems that this book has used various setting intricacies to attract many readers...

100862.name: The Honest Cat's Little Lie
100862.desc: A suspense novel. The packaging suggests that many readers were attracted by the unexpected twists and turns of the plot.

100863.name: Literature Club
100863.desc: A traditional novel. The packaging states that this novel has a "rigorous plot and setting"...

100864.name: Rust-Worn Key
100864.desc: An old key found at the bottom of the Konda Village well.\nIt is said that "where there's a key, there's a lock." Who knows where the lock for this key is...

100865.name: 附有记忆的面具（废弃）
100865.desc: Hanachirusato the shrine maiden used to wear this mask. It is deeply stained on the inside.\nSome memories are contained inside, through which one may learn the art of creating the Catalyst known as "Hakushin Ring."\nNow that Hanachirusato has been separated from this mask, Paimon doesn't get to call her the "Masked Maiden" anymore, right?

100866.name: The Violet Oni's Blade
100866.desc: The favored sword of Yanagiha Arashi, an expelled member of the Iwakura School.\nIt is a leftover copy of a certain famous sword, and has been reforged after being broken. It and the weapon of Okazaki Toraemon are a pair.

100867.name: The Crimson Oni's Blade
100867.desc: The favored sword of Okazaki Toraemon, an expelled member of the Iwakura School.\nIt is a leftover copy of a certain famous sword, and has been reforged after being broken. It and the weapon of Yanagiha Arashi are a pair.

100875.name: Chang the Ninth's Gift
100875.desc: A gift from the Yae Publishing House to Chang the Ninth. There's even a letter on the inside.

100876.name: Zhenyu's Gift
100876.desc: A gift from the Yae Publishing House to "Zhenyu." There's even a letter on the inside.

100880.name: Cage Key
100880.desc: Seems to be the key to some prison cage. Some reckless person seems to have thrown it out here.

100881.name: Metal Key
100881.desc: A metal key that one can find just about anywhere, and that can unlock a majority of ordinary doors... Well, probably, anyway.

100882.name: Atsuko's Letter
100882.desc: A letter that Atsuko penned herself. It is filled with her yearning to see her parents again — with any luck, this long letter will bring her parents some peace of mind.

100883.name: Illegible Fortune Slip
100883.desc: A fortune slip on which the wording has become all but illegible. But considering that it was chucked up to such a high spot, it can't have boded particularly well...

100884.name: Damaged Note
100884.desc: A paper note that has been crumpled into a ball. A wish has been scribbled on it, but the only legible word now is "peace."

100885.name: Luxurious Silk Cloth
100885.desc: A bolt of lovely silk. This is normally used to make high-end clothing.

100886.name: Special Recipe: Mushroom Pizza
100886.desc: A handwritten Mushroom Pizza recipe. Perhaps food prepared using various different methods might result in a unique flavor.

100889.name: Chef Mao's Special Jueyun Chili Chicken
100889.desc: Jueyun Chili Chicken specially made by Chef Mao. Seagrass and Sea Cucumber were added in the process, and one wonders how the result might taste...

100890.name: Xiangling's Handwritten Notes
100890.desc: Xiangling's handwritten notes. It records some of her... novel ideas regarding cooking.

100891.name: Yellowed Letter
100891.desc: A letter unearthed from beneath a tree in Konda Village. It seems to convey a certain person's hopes.

100892.name: Vahid's Kneaded Onigiri
100892.desc: Onigiri made from rice cultivated personally by Vahid. It tastes as good as it looks.

100893.name: Naganohara Fireworks Note
100893.desc: A note that Yoimiya gave you to record firework formulae with. If you give this note to Yoimiya, she will be able to make fireworks just as you remember them.\nNo matter how time passes, or people and things change, so long as you take care of this note, you will stand guard over a door to the past. Perhaps you too will find happiness that belongs only to you under a firework-filled sky.

100894.name: Spirit Pearl
100894.desc: An ancient, vibrant pearl, within which lies the secret of the ocean depths.

100895.name: Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep
100895.desc: A strange treasure with an awkward name. It is said to have been forged from the blood of Watatsumi Omikami.

100896.name: Strange Bottle
100896.desc: A vessel with an odd appearance. It seems fragile, but is actually quite sturdy.

100897.name: Water Welling With "Wishes"
100897.desc: This water is filled with hopes and dreams. Please send them to the place where they belong.

100898.name: Spiritherb Water
100898.desc: Crystal-clear water, the ideal source of hydration for the Spiritherb.

100899.name: Rinzou's Letter
100899.desc: A letter written by the legendary pirate Rinzou. The paper is all crumpled up. It must have been wet at some point.

100900.name: Rinzou's Signet
100900.desc: A signet left behind by the great pirate Rinzou as proof of a glorious life of adventure.

100901.name: Hidden Ledger
100901.desc: A ledger that seems to contain the recent taxation situations of Ritou's merchants. Its owner is Keijirou.

100902.name: Komore Teahouse Invitation Letter
100902.desc: Whomsoever has this invitation letter may enter Komore Teahouse. It has the seal of the Yashiro Commission on it.

100903.name: A Love Letter(?)
100903.desc: A letter that Hiiragi Chisato has written for Kujou Kamaji. She would be mad if you opened it up without her permission...

100904.name: Cooked Meat
100904.desc: Meat that has just been cooked. Maybe it can be used in a dish...

100905.name: "The Seventh Samurai" Script
100905.desc: A "film script" you obtained from Xavier.

100907.name: A Note Left by Someone
100907.desc: A special fortune slip that a certain person left behind. A certain location is recorded within. This may have something to do with Gendou Ringo's disappearance.

100908.name: Bamboo Slip
100908.desc: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

100909.name: Bamboo Slip
100909.desc: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

100910.name: Bamboo Slip
100910.desc: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

100911.name: Bamboo Slip
100911.desc: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

100912.name: Bamboo Slip
100912.desc: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

100913.name: Bamboo Slip
100913.desc: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

100914.name: Bamboo Slip
100914.desc: A bamboo slip that was used as a marking in some unremarkable spot. Can be exchanged with Gendou Ringo of the Grand Narukami Shrine for fortune-telling Fortune Slips.

100916.name: Lightly-Perfumed Letter
100916.desc: You obtained this from an infantryman at the Kanjou Commission. They say that this was written personally by the young lady of the Hiiragi Clan.

100917.name: Travel Permit
100917.desc: A special Travel Permit that allows travel throughout Inazuma. With this in hand, you can now freely enter and leave Ritou...

100918.name: Kujou Kamaji's Letter
100918.desc: Kujou Kamaji asked you to carry this letter that he personally penned to Hiiragi Chisato. According to him, this one was the best-worded of the lot.

100919.name: Snack Box
100919.desc: A box of snacks that Kujou Kamaji request you bring to Hiiragi Chisato. It seems very full indeed...

100920.name: Dull Golden Bridle
100920.desc: The hereditary national treasure of Byakuyakoku, but it has lost all of its own power. This was done to prevent thieves who have entered through alternative means from seeing its value.

100921.name: Golden Bridle
100921.desc: The hereditary national treasure of Byakuyakoku. It represents the highest authority in the land and confers the power to control Evernight and Whitenight upon its wielder.

100922.name: Reins of Revival Fragment (The Narrows)
100922.desc: A fragment of the Reins of Revival. It is made from a special material.

100923.name: Reins of Revival Fragment (Temple)
100923.desc: A fragment of the Reins of Revival. It has some special power.

100924.name: Reins of Revival Fragment (Serpent's Heart)
100924.desc: A fragment of the Reins of Revival. The three fragments, too, follow "The Rule of Three."

100925.name: Reins of Revival
100925.desc: The hereditary national treasure of Byakuyakoku. Apart from representing the highest authority in the land, it also confers the ability to control souls and this realm.

100926.name: Offerings of The Narrows
100926.desc: Offerings from The Narrows that contain a fraction of Aberaku's remnant thoughts.

100927.name: Offerings of the Temple
100927.desc: Offerings from the Evernight Temple that contain a fraction of Aberaku's remnant thoughts.

100928.name: Offerings of the Serpent's Heart
100928.desc: Offerings from the Serpent's Heart that contain a fraction of Aberaku's remnant thoughts.

100929.name: The Serpent and Drakes of Tokoyokoku
100929.desc: A novel based on Watatsumi Island's folktales. The original edition of this text was transcribed on Watatsumi Island and brought back to Narukami Island by a merchant while the former's serpent god yet lived. No one reads this ancient tome nowadays, its role supplanted by all the light novels on the market. This book describes the unique cosmological outlook of the Watatsumi people before they came to adopt aspects of Narukami culture, and a recent resurgence in traditional novel publishing has allowed it to see the light of day once more.

100930.name: Bathysmal Vishap Experimental Records
100930.desc: Experimental Records of the Bathysmal Vishaps. No vishaps were killed in the writing of these records.

100931.name: Before Sun and Moon
100931.desc: A chronicle that ordinary folk have been forbidden to read. The writing is a mix of fables and histories from the beginning of the world to the creation of the Dainichi Mikoshi.

100932.name: Hydrological Studies in Byakuyakoku
100932.desc: This text records the geography and hydrology of Byakuyakoku. With the sealing of the depths and the emigration of the people of Watatsumi, as well as the passing of long years, this book is now useless.

100933.name: In the Light, Beneath the Shadow
100933.desc: A puzzle book for children of ages nine to twelve. As a book from a transitory period, it uses Narukami-style names with Byakuyakoku subscripts.

100934.name: Key Sigil
100934.desc: A sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. Such pictures are used in unlocking, and are thus named "Key Sigils."

100935.name: Key Sigil
100935.desc: A Key Sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. It was made by disassembling the emblems of the once-upon-a-time people of Byakuyakoku.

100936.name: Key Sigil
100936.desc: A sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. Each of the five Key Sigils is unique in its structure.

100937.name: Key Sigil
100937.desc: A Key Sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. When people left the ocean depths, they combined various Key Sigils to create the Sangonomiya house emblem.

100938.name: Key Sigil
100938.desc: A sigil passed down through Watatsumi Island and Enkanomiya. It conceals some secret.

100939.name: Bloodbranch Coral
100939.desc: A coral in which the life force of Watatsumi Omikami dwells. It is a vital part of the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri.

100940.name: Divine Bridle
100940.desc: A symbol of the Sunchild's authority, made in the shape of a bridle. It does not possess any special power by itself.

100941.name: Date's Medal of Recognition
100941.desc: A medal that represents Date's recognition. It is very well-made.

100942.name: Date's Medal of Recognition
100942.desc: A medal representing Date's recognition. It is very well-made. If you look at it long enough, the labyrinth-wanderlust might actually overtake you!

100943.name: Secret Room Key
100943.desc: A key that opens the door to a certain secret room in The Narrows. This might be one of the abandoned safehouses that Adonis and his compatriots once used.

100944.name: Waters of Lethe
100944.desc: Water from a river that flows near the Evernight Temple. It shines with a faint light in the darkness. Directly ingesting this liquid will not cause you to forget anything, but the Dragonbone Orb created through its auspices has this effect.

100945.name: Dragonbone Orb
100945.desc: The fruit of the Dragonbone Flower, created via the use of the Waters of Lethe. It is said to sweep one's worries away and bring peace. Giving up your objectives, forsaking desire, and becoming content and satisfied... Is that not happiness?

100946.name: Key to Some Place
100946.desc: A key found in Tatarasuna.\nWhere there's a key, there's got to be a lock to match.

100947.name: Key to Some Place
100947.desc: A key found in Tatarasuna.\nWhere there's a key, there's got to be a lock to match.

100948.name: Key to Some Place
100948.desc: A key found in Tatarasuna.\nWhere there's a key, there's got to be a lock to match.

100949.name: Sun-Dried Sweet Flower
100949.desc: A dried flower from Hanayama Kaoru. It was the first flower to grow in that brand-new floral sea.

100950.name: Peculiar Pinion
100950.desc: A strange feather you discovered after defeating the monster on the summit of Amakumo Peak.

100951.name: Maushiro
100951.desc: An item that Sumida tasked you to find.\nYou found this Maushiro on Tsurumi Island, and it seems to be a traditional instrument around these parts.\nThat said, it should have been at least a few thousand years since Tsurumi Island last played host to any civilization at all.

100952.name: Maushiro
100952.desc: The item that Sumida sent you to find.\nThis Maushiro appears to have been left behind by someone before they left Tsurumi Island.\nAccording to what Ruu tells you, the Maushiro are not musical instruments. Instead, they were used by the locals as a means of locating one another amidst the fog that shrouded their home.

100955.name: An Onikabuto Affected by Tatarigami
100955.desc: An onikabuto that has fallen under the influence of Tatarigami. Who knows what sort of tests Xavier wants to put it through...

100956.name: Missing Component(s)
100956.desc: A component that fell from the Purification Device.

100957.name: Funerary Mask
100957.desc:
A trophy obtained from defeating Signora, Eighth of the Fatui Harbingers.
The Fatui often face the world from behind their masks, and it is said that this is because all they once were will mean nothing once they become Fatui, and thus must they forsake their true names and faces alike.

—Yet the act of giving up all that makes up an "I" — one's past and the bonds that come with it — is no mean feat.
Perhaps it is fair to say that only those who possess an obsession close to or even exceeding the level of delusion might be willing to join this group that so rebels against the Heavenly Principles, binding their remaining days to their Delusions and burning as brightly as stars.
...Of course, many within the Fatui are simply consumed by power and are simple sadists — nor are these states necessarily in conflict.

The woman whose real name was Rosalyne-Kruzchka Lohefalter may have once led a more innocent, naive existence.
But that was before her eyes were filled with a raging fire, and her innocent days were burned away. Before the icy Delusion extinguished the flaming tongues that ever gnawed her. Before the frozen might that protected her was shattered by the eternal outlander, unbound yet no less determined than she was, causing the flames to burst forth once more...

100958.name: Musoujin Gorge: Rock Pillar Pearl
100958.desc: A precious pearl that emits Electro energy and a strangely-colored light. It seems to have some connection with the rock pillars on the island.

100959.name: Musoujin Gorge: Rock Pillar Warding Stone
100959.desc: A gem that has an electric scent and that is quite shocking to the touch. It has some unknown connection to the rock pillars on the island.

100960.name: Serpent's Head: Rock Pillar Pearl
100960.desc: A precious pearl that emits Electro energy and a strangely-colored light. It seems to have some connection with the rock pillars on the island.

100961.name: Serpent's Head: Rock Pillar Warding Stone
100961.desc: A gem that has an electric scent and that is quite shocking to the touch. It has some unknown connection to the rock pillars on the island.

100962.name: Jakotsu Mine: Rock Pillar Pearl
100962.desc: A precious pearl that emits Electro energy and a strangely-colored light. It seems to have some connection with the rock pillars on the island.

100963.name: Jakotsu Mine: Rock Pillar Warding Stone
100963.desc: A gem that has an electric scent and that is quite shocking to the touch. It has some unknown connection to the rock pillars on the island.

100964.name: Fort Mumei: Rock Pillar Pearl
100964.desc: A precious pearl that emits Electro energy and a strangely-colored light. It seems to have some connection with the rock pillars on the island.

100965.name: Fort Mumei: Rock Pillar Warding Stone
100965.desc: A gem that has an electric scent and that is quite shocking to the touch. It has some unknown connection to the rock pillars on the island.

100966.name: Naku Weed Seed
100966.desc: A bag of Naku Weed seeds.

100967.name: High-Quality Chilled Meat
100967.desc: Chilled Meat that appears to be of high quality. It should make for some good cooking indeed.

100968.name: Piping-Hot Braised Meat
100968.desc: Braised Meat made using the Supreme Cuisine Machine. Fresh and steaming hot.

100969.name: Family Letter
100969.desc: The page has already yellowed and become incredibly brittle. A single touch might break it.

100970.name: Tattered Letter
100970.desc: Someone's private thoughts are written in this tattered letter. Unfortunately, the years have eaten away at the words that were penned until they became blurred, and if not for someone having dug it up, these past events may have forever slept under the soil.

100971.name: Pharmacist's Notebook (I)
100971.desc: Notes left by Yasumoto. They still smell strongly of Naku Weed.

100972.name: Pharmacist's Notebook (II)
100972.desc: Notes left by Yasumoto. It has been conscientiously protected from rain damage.

100973.name: Pharmacist's Notebook (III)
100973.desc: Notes left by Yasumoto. It shows some signs of blotching and water damage.

100974.name: Unsealed Letter
100974.desc: A letter that seems brand new but that has already been opened. It gives off a light sakura scent.

100975.name: Inaba Tousaburou Kyuuzou's Final Words
100975.desc: A letter filled with words from margin to margin. Its author has gone missing.

100976.name: Star-Shaped Gem
100976.desc: A mysterious gem of unknown make. It shines like a star even when placed inside your backpack.\nPerhaps this is the key to completing a certain "image."

100977.name: Stone Slate
100977.desc: A stone slate with Ishine Script carved into it.\nPerhaps it may be of some use on Tsurumi Island...?

100978.name: Kamuijima Cannon Map
100978.desc: A map that records the positions of the Kamuijima Cannons.

100980.name: High-Quality Rice
100980.desc: High-quality rice that you obtained from Brunn. It looks like it'll cook well.

100981.name: Fragrant Rice Pudding
100981.desc: Rice Pudding made using the Supreme Cuisine Machine. One wonders how it might taste...

100982.name: Anemo Slime-Swallowed Bamboo Shoots
100982.desc: Bamboo Shoots that have been swallowed by Anemo Slimes. Who knows what special flavor they might add...

100983.name: Piping-Hot Oncidium Tofu
100983.desc: Oncidium Tofu made using the Supreme Cuisine Machine. One wonders what flavors this is going to have...

100984.name: Fossil Bag
100984.desc: A bag containing the suspected fossil of the Lunar Leviathan. Give it to Kujirai Momiji... though one wonders if she can accept this reality.

100985.name: "Treasury" Key
100985.desc: A key treasured by the bandits. This must be one of the keys to finding the secret treasure... right?

100986.name: Incomplete Notes
100986.desc: A tattered page. For some reason, it gives off the stench of stale grain.

100987.name: Tattered Paper
100987.desc: A crumpled note with very messy, illegible handwriting.

100988.name: Picture Commemorating Seirai Island
100988.desc: A picture of some place on Seirai Island. Who knows why it would be buried here...

100989.name: Picture Commemorating Seirai Island (II)
100989.desc: A picture you got from Mr. Oda Tarou, it seems to show some place on Seirai Island...

100990.name: Picture Commemorating Seirai Island (III)
100990.desc: A picture you got from Mr. Oda Tarou, it seems to show some place on Seirai Island...

100991.name: Picture Commemorating Seirai Island (IV)
100991.desc: A picture you got from Mr. Oda Tarou, it seems to show some place on Seirai Island...

100992.name: Fujiwara Toshiko's Treasure Map
100992.desc: A treasure map you obtained from Fujiwara Toshiko. According to her, this map hides the means by which certain mechanisms may be activated.

100993.name: A Bag of Beans
100993.desc: Beans you got from Sango. Arataki Itto seems to be allergic to beans, so these may prove to be useful tools in stopping him from resisting too much.\nSango says they're not free, though. Hopefully they don't cost too much...

100995.name: Right-Side Photo
100995.desc: A picture of Neko, taken from the right.

100996.name: Left-Side Photo
100996.desc: A picture of Neko, taken from the left.

100997.name: Inferior Starsilver
100997.desc: Starsilver with low luster and dull coloration. It will most likely not sell for a high price.

100998.name: Quality Starsilver
100998.desc: Starsilver with great luster and a lovely coloration.

100999.name: Key
100999.desc: A unique-looking key. You can open the cage holding Bennett with it.

101000.name: Box of Clothes
101000.desc: This box contains the clothes that Ningguang asked you to go get. As she said, "I need a change of mood, and a change of clothes will facilitate that."

101001.name: Iron Chunk
101001.desc: This iron chunk can be turned into a multitude of handy items in the hands of a skilled craftsman.

101002.name: White Iron Chunk
101002.desc: Skilled hands can make this into something brilliant.

101003.name: Crystal Chunk
101003.desc: An uncut crystal. Only professional craftsmanship can bring out its true value.

101004.name: Magical Crystal Chunk
101004.desc: These crystal chunks can be refined into Weapon EXP materials by using Original Resin.\nCrystals from mines that were eroded by the energy of the Ley Lines cannot be processed by ordinary means.

101006.name: Starsilver
101006.desc: A rare and precious ore formed by the unique geographical conditions and Ley Lines of Dragonspine.

101008.name: Amethyst Lump
101008.desc: An uncut crystal that can only be found in Inazuma. Some professional craftsmanship will bring out its true value.

101009.name: Condessence Crystal
101009.desc: A bright and clear crystal with a core that is both tough and malleable.

101010.name: Rainbowdrop Crystal
101010.desc: A crystal that gives off an iridescent glow. Exceptionally tough and malleable, it has been regarded by Snezhnayan craftspeople as the best forging material since ancient times.\nIt is believed that when the moon's chariot was shattered, its blood-stained axle-tip fell into the earthly realm beneath the moon, transforming into an iridescent crystal. From that day on, the people of this land no longer worshipped the dead gods. The survivors who knew what the monarchs of the night died for, however, still futilely sing those long-forgotten names.

101101.name: Northlander Sword Billet
101101.desc: Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star swords. \nPhilosophers believe marble has the potential to be sculpted into a beautiful statue. Likewise, these billets have the potential to become something greater.
source_list: Reward for completing Trounce Domain Challenge in Mondstadt, Liyue, or Inazuma, or the Dominator of Wolves Challenge

101102.name: Northlander Bow Billet
101102.desc: Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star bows. \nPhilosophers believe marble has the potential to be sculpted into a beautiful statue. Likewise, these billets have the potential to become something greater.
source_list: Reward for completing Trounce Domain Challenge in Mondstadt, Liyue, or Inazuma, or the Dominator of Wolves Challenge

101103.desc: Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star claymores. \nPhilosophers believe marble has the potential to be sculpted into a beautiful statue. Likewise, these billets have the potential to become something greater.
source_list: Reward for completing Trounce Domain Challenge in Mondstadt, Liyue, or Inazuma, or the Dominator of Wolves Challenge

source_list: Reward for completing Trounce Domain Challenge in Mondstadt, Liyue, or Inazuma, or the Dominator of Wolves Challenge

101106.name: Northlander Sword
101106.desc: An unknown sword from the Northlands

101107.name: Northlander Bow
101107.desc: An unknown bow from the Northlands

101108.name: Northlander Claymore
101108.desc: An unknown claymore from the Northlands

101109.name: Northlander Catalyst
101109.desc: An unknown catalyst from the Northlands

101111.desc: Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star swords.\nPhilosophers believe that there are four purposes behind earthly things. The purpose of these billets is to become a weapon worthy of accompanying a hero.
source_list: Sumeru and Fontaine Trounce Domain Challenge Reward

101112.desc: Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star bows.\nPhilosophers believe that there are four purposes behind earthly things. The purpose of these billets is to become a weapon worthy of accompanying a hero.
source_list: Sumeru and Fontaine Trounce Domain Challenge Reward

101116.desc: Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star swords.\nIn terms of the "state" of the many weapons that can be crafted from billets, while their potential has long been contained within the original materials, the exact forms these weapons will ultimately take remain unknown to this day...
source_list: Natlan, Nod-Krai, and Snezhnaya Trounce Domain Challenge Reward

Can be used to forge 4-star polearms.\nIn terms of the "state" of the many weapons that can be crafted from billets, while their potential has long been contained within the original materials, the exact forms these weapons will ultimately take remain unknown to this day...
source_list: Natlan, Nod-Krai, and Snezhnaya Trounce Domain Challenge Reward

101201.name: Onikabuto
101201.desc: A strange beetle that inhabits areas rich with Electro energy. Its docile and sedentary temperament could not be more different from the fierce, demonic visage displayed on its armored shell.

101202.name: Sakura Bloom
101202.desc: Blossoms from the Sacred Sakura at the Grand Narukami Shrine, filled with a fondness for Inazuma.

101203.name: Crystal Marrow
101203.desc: A crystal that contains a sliver of Tatarigami power. Adding this material during smelting will greatly increase the strength and toughness of metals.

101204.name: Dendrobium
101204.desc: A vibrant plant that has also been named the "lycoris" by the poets. It was once thought extinct in the Inazuman archipelago, only to re-emerge now upon the battlefields. It is said that it blooms most enchantingly where much blood was spilled.

101205.name: Naku Weed
101205.desc: Even on windless days, this plant will tremble lightly amid the cries of thunder. The parts of it that resemble petals are in fact extensions of the leaves meant to protect the fragile flower.

101206.name: Sea Ganoderma
101206.desc: A plant species that only grows in certain regions and islands of the ocean. Though it looks like a fungus of some sort, it actually comes from a substance secreted by certain soft-bodied organisms.

101207.name: Sango Pearl
101207.desc: A precious pearl that grows in the coral of Watatsumi. Gives off a cool sheen like that of the moonlight.

101208.name: Amakumo Fruit
101208.desc: The fruit of the Amakumo Grass, which grows on Seirai Island. You can hear it crackling with a tiny current if you hold it up to your ear.

101209.name: Fluorescent Fungus
101209.desc: A mushroom that glows like a night-light. Some curious power lies hidden within it.

101210.name: Seagrass
101210.desc: A plant that grows in shallow seas. It adds a unique flavor to dishes.

101211.name: Lavender Melon
101211.desc: A brightly-colored fruit. The flesh within transforms into food with a unique mouthfeel when cooked.
source_list: Found in the wild in Inazuma

101212.name: Starshroom
101212.desc: A fungus with a cap that resembles a five-pointed star. It is quite hardy indeed. Once it matures, the center of the cap will split open.
101212.title: Starshroom
101212.effect: Restores 300 HP for the selected character.

101213.name: Rukkhashava Mushrooms
101213.desc: A fungus that grows in layers upon layers, like a sea of clouds, and which mostly grows on trees deep in the rainforest.
source_list: Recommendation: Found in the Ashavan Realm

101214.name: Padisarah
101214.desc: A holy and noble plant. The conditions for growth in its environment are very demanding. The flower buds can be processed to make valuable spices.

101215.name: Nilotpala Lotus
101215.desc: Growing in the forest wetlands, these plants only bloom at night with flowers as bright as the moon.
source_list: Found at water bodies in Sumeru

101216.name: Harra Fruit
101216.desc: Commonly grown in the hot and humid rainforest, this fruit has a special spicy aroma. When ground to powder, spices can be made from it. It is the most valued spice plant in Sumeru.

101217.name: Kalpalata Lotus
101217.desc: Flowers from vines that grow on cliff sides. It is called a lotus only because it has a similar appearance to one. Aside from that, it bears no other similar properties to the lotus.
source_list: Found in the mountains of Sumeru

101218.name: Zaytun Peach
101218.desc: The fruit of a forest shrub. Its flesh is firm and sweet. It is said to have a calming effect on the mind.

101219.name: Sumeru Rose
101219.desc: Bright and beautiful, these pure purple flowers give off a pleasant fragrance that will give any passerby pause. While some like to call this a type of "rambler rose," its relative lack of multiple flowers means that it falls under a different floral classification.

101220.name: Henna Berry
101220.desc: A fruit that grows even in the most hostile of desert environments. Its vibrant crimson fruits are made even more lovely against a backdrop of yellow sand.
source_list: Found in the deserts of Sumeru

101221.name: Ajilenakh Nut
101221.desc: A fruit that grows on evergreen trees within desert oases. The flesh under the tough skin is thick, sweet, and delicious, making it an important food source amongst the desert peoples.
source_list: Found in the desert oases of Sumeru

101222.name: Sand Grease Pupa
101222.desc: You can only find such husks deep in the desert where the Quicksand Eels breed. The hardened shell is meant to protect the Quicksand Eels' larval bodies until they finally acclimate to the conditions of the dry desert.
source_list: Found in the deserts of Sumeru

101223.name: Mourning Flower
101223.desc: Crimson flowers that bloom on ancient battlefields. They can even flourish in the depths of the desert. Their drooping flowers seem to be in mourning for heroes long past.
source_list: Found in the deserts of Sumeru
Recommendation: Found in the Asipattravana Swamp

101224.name: Trishiraite
101224.desc: A splendorous stone that can be found in the depths of desolate mountains, seemingly formed from congealed elemental energy.
source_list: Found in the deserts of Sumeru

101225.name: Scarab
101225.desc: A tenacious beetle that finds repose within the vast ocean of desert sand. The golden pattern on such beetles' shells hints at some deep relationship between them and the ancient ruins that dot the desert.
source_list: Found in the desert ruins of Sumeru

101226.name: Activated Starshroom
101226.desc: A fungus with a cap that resembles a five-pointed star. It seems to be bursting with vitality.
101226.title: Activated Starshroom
101226.effect: Restores 800 HP for the selected character.

101227.name: Scorched Starshroom
101227.desc: A fungus with a cap that resembles a five-pointed star. It seems to be a little singed.
101227.title: Scorched Starshroom
101227.effect: Restores 1 HP for the selected character.

101228.name: Viparyas
101228.desc: A flower without seeds. \nOnce the earth remembers, the Viparyas will bloom.

101229.name: Pluie Lotus
101229.desc: A plant that grows in environments rich with Hydro. This plant can be found everywhere in Fontaine after its long rainy seasons. The plant is named "Pluie" — which means "rain" in the local tongue — for that reason.
source_list: Found near lakes and river banks

101230.name: Bulle Fruit
101230.desc: A fruit that grows in warm and damp environments with ample sunlight. Inside this round and rotund fruit hides a sweet and refreshing surprise.
101230.effect: Restores 300 HP for the selected character.

101231.name: Marcotte
101231.desc: A pink flower with a pearl-like luster and rich scent profile. It is one of the most important ingredients in a perfumer's arsenal.

101232.name: Beryl Conch
101232.desc: A conch-like structure that gives off a faint glow. Despite the name, it is not a shell but something condensed from pure elemental energy.

101233.name: Romaritime Flower
101233.desc: An ethereal and elegant blue flower. Its tender petals are elastic and water-absorbent, making it the ideal raw material for various daily necessities.

101234.name: Tidalga
101234.desc: An algae floating with the tides that sustains itself by feeding on substances produced by other plants. Though often mistaken for zooplankton, based on its nature, Tidalga is actually a type of phytoplankton.

101235.name: Lumidouce Bell
101235.desc: A serene and tranquil violet flower. It has a light, soft, and lasting scent and is often used for making luxurious perfumes.
source_list: Found in the north of the Court of Fontaine

101236.name: Rainbow Rose
101236.desc: A delicate and tender pink flower. Despite their name, Rainbow Roses are essentially more akin to Lilies.

101237.name: Lumitoile
101237.desc: A soft-bodied animal that emits a gentle light. Often found climbing the walls of buildings near the water or underwater.

101238.name: Lakelight Lily
101238.desc: A clear and clean azure flower, it is born where Water Veins come together. It has a simple, cool, and elegant fragrance, pungent and refreshing yet gentle.

101239.name: Subdetection Unit
101239.desc: Detection units produced by Fontaine Research Institute using new models of artificed components. Its original purpose was monitoring all kinds of environmental data.
source_list: Recommendation: Found in Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region

101240.name: Spring of the First Dewdrop
101240.desc: A limpid drop of dew floating amidst the waters of Morte Region. It is different from other pure water bodies, as though it is a conglomeration of even more pure and primordial Elemental Energy.
source_list: Recommendation: Found underwater in Morte Region

101241.name: Clearwater Jade
101241.desc: Jade from Chenyu Vale. Named for its cool, refreshing touch, that is much like clear water.
source_list: Recommendation: Found in Chenyu Vale: Southern Mountain

101242.name: Chenyu Adeptea
101242.desc: Tea grown in warm, moist areas in Chenyu Vale. After millennia of careful cultivation, the tea today emits a rich fragrance that can be savored from several streets away.

101243.name: Grainfruit
101243.desc: This plant is named after the giant grains that grow along the cob.

101244.name: Candlecap Mushroom
101244.desc: A fungus that grows on cliff faces or at the foot of mountains, and which shines like a little lamp. You can feel a hint of warmth when your hand draws close.
101244.effect: Restores 300 HP for the selected character.

101245.name: Spinel Fruit
101245.desc: The crystalline trees that grow widely in areas with Liquid Phlogiston produce these gem-shaped fruits after absorbing phlogiston.

101246.name: Cacahuatl
101246.desc: A crop rich in flavor. The fleshy part itself features a unique bitterness and its seeds, after being fermented and baked, can be made into other delicacies.

101247.name: Sprayfeather Gill
101247.desc: A special feather-shaped species that grows by the seaside. It looks kind of like a seagrass but is in truth a soft-bodied aquatic coral with a unique shape.
source_list: Recommendation: Found near the "People of the Springs"

101248.name: Brilliant Chrysanthemum
101248.desc: A flower with a shape like floating wings. Its petals sway in an unbelievably relaxed, serene manner as they are caressed by the wind.
source_list: Recommendation: Found near the Stadium of the Sacred Flame

101249.name: Quenepa Berry
101249.desc: Bluish, juicy berries that grow in large amounts near the Scions of the Canopy. Their shape is similar to that of Flamegranates.
source_list: Recommendation: Found below the "Scions of the Canopy"

101250.name: Saurian Claw Succulent
101250.desc: A succulent shaped like the paw of a great animal.
source_list: Recommendation: Found in the Sulfurous Veins

101251.name: Embercore Flower
101251.desc: A strange flower that can be found all over the plains and highlands. Mature buds will bloom after being hit.

101252.name: Glowing Hornshroom
101252.desc: A fungus that emits a faint light in the darkness. It is so named because its shape resembles the horny crest of an Iktomisaurus.
source_list: Recommendation: Found near the "Masters of the Night-Wind"

101253.name: Withering Purpurbloom
101253.desc: A flower, the leaves and petals of which look scorched and withered, that can often be seen in places where ash abounds.

101254.name: Skysplit Gembloom
101254.desc: A strange plant whose flower's exterior resembles stone. Only in bloom does it reveal a resplendent, crystal-like core.

101255.name: Dracolite
101255.desc: Formed gradually in areas rich in Phlogiston, these red, scale-like crystals are blazing-hot to the touch.

101256.name: Red Berryshroom
101256.desc: An ordinary-looking mushroom with an extraordinary flavor. Only grows near the orchard at Varesa's house. Since Paimon gave it a cute name, its taste must have been truly memorable for her.
source_list: Recommendation: Found in the orchards of Atocpan

101257.name: Portable Bearing
101257.desc: A portable bearing of a type that was mass-produced after the Fatui moved into Nod-Krai. Excessively worn units are discarded like obsolete personnel.\nA few of them have a vestige of kuuvahki left inside. As they are difficult to imitate, they are occasionally used as currency by merchants in Nasha Town.\nIt's said that people tried to forge these bearings for that reason, but went bankrupt in the end because the cost of forging them was higher than their market value.
source_list: Recommendation: Found at the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop

101259.name: Icy Pebble
101259.desc: A pebble commonly found on Nod-Krai's coasts, characterized by a naturally occurring hollow. Touching it sends a faint chill through your finger.\nAccording to ancient legends, the hollows in these pebbles were once shelters revealed to the fae by the Frost Moon — gateways to the ethereal. In another story popular in Nasha Town, the legendary thief, Reed Miller, was surrounded when a runestone given to him by a holy lady of the Frost Moon as a token of her love allowed him to conceal himself and escape his pursuers. Naturally, the Frostmoon Scions vehemently reject this claim, as these pebbles do not display any such magical properties.

101261.name: Frostlamp Flower
101261.desc: A flower that resembles a candle lamp, commonly found near water. It emits a cold, simple aroma that has a calming effect.\nThe contrasting colors of its stamen and stem are thought to symbolize the two different types of kuuvahki, yet despite this symbolism, it is one of the few rare plants that are immune to kuuvahki's influence. As a result, the Frostmoon Scions sometimes regard it as a symbol of faithlessness and apostasy.\nIt is said that this strangely shaped flower first appeared at the end of the dark calamity five hundred years ago, but this claim has never been rigorously verified.
source_list: Recommendation: Found in the Final Night Cemetery
Recommendation: Found near the Frostmoon Enclave

101262.name: Nocturnal Blossom
101262.desc: A flower in two entwined colors with a strong affinity for kuuvahki. Its light fragrance and conspicuous color have made it an excellent natural dye.\nIts contrasting colors are thought to symbolize the two different types of kuuvahki, so the followers of the Frostmoon Scions sometimes regard it as the Moon Maiden's blessing.\nIt is said that this strangely shaped flower first appeared decades after the dark calamity ended five hundred years ago, a claim widely reflected in the verses of the Frostmoon Scions, though it has never been rigorously verified.

101263.name: Moonfall Silver
101263.desc: A silver crystal as pure and pristine as moonlight. It possesses almost perfect elemental affinity.\nIn the legacy of the Frostmoon Scions, these crystals were born five hundred years ago alongside the Moon Maiden, and were believed by the Moonchanter at the time to be a gift from the moon, hence the name "Moonfall Silver". However, in older documents written by Snezhnayan chroniclers, the descendants of the golden realm were already using secret silver woven by the Frostmoon thousands of years in the past. The threads that connect these two tales are unclear — the only certain thing is that these crystals make excellent elemental conductors in the eyes of Nod-Krai's craftspeople.

101264.name: Lakkaberry
101264.desc: A fruit as white as pearl that tastes refreshingly sweet.\nIn the legends of the Frostmoon Scions, these fruits, like kuuhenki, are a gift from the Moon Maiden, a sacred symbol blessed by the new moon. Therefore, sharing and eating delicious Lakkaberries is also a form of worshipping Kuutar.\nEven when not associated with the divine, their plumpness and sweetness alone are enough to awaken one's appetite.

101265.name: Midsommar Berry
101265.desc: A fruit that grows in the warmer parts of Nod-Krai. It is beloved by animals emerging from winter and hungry children alike.\nIn the legacy of the Frostmoon Scions, Midsommar Berries are regarded as a symbol of life and abundance, for they only flourish during the warmth of spring and summer.\nThere is a tale that tells of the endless struggle between the King of Winter Icelea and the King of Midsommar Oak — twin monarchs that slay each other as the seasons change, returning from the underworld to rule in turn until the end of time. Most Snezhnayan scholars dismiss this as a primitive religious metaphor for the alternating seasons — or at least that's what they tell themselves.

101268.name: Winter Icelea
101268.desc: A hardy plant known for withstanding relentless wind and frost, it survives even in the coldest depths of winter.
source_list: Found at the Pillar of Embla

101269.name: Pine Amber
101269.desc: A gem formed from the resin of the towering ancient trees that once blanketed Nod-Krai. Over ages, the resin hardened into crystalline amber, now shining with vivid, radiant hues.
source_list: Recommendation: Found near the Favonius Keep

101270.name: Teardrop of the Moon
101270.desc: A clear, radiant azure crystal that holds an exceptionally pure form of kuuvahki. It possesses a near-perfect affinity with all types of elemental energy.

101271.name: Windrest Flower
101271.desc: An exquisite flower that remains delicate and fresh, found primarily in the northern part of Mondstadt.\nIts fragrance is clear and enduring, making it one of the primary ingredients used in perfumery.

101272.name: Etherwing Moth
101272.desc: A singular entity bathed in a divine, golden radiance, drifting through uncanny interstices as if a moth in flight.
source_list: Recommendation: Found on Windrest Peak and Temple of Space
Recommendation: Found in Millhaven and the Pillar Hall Central Zone

101275.name: Frostfairy Flower
101275.desc: A sacred flower that blooms no matter how harsh the wind and snow. It always radiates a faint, mesmerizing glow that draws the hearts of all who see it.
source_list: Recommendation: Found in White Birch Snowgrave

101276.name: Flockingweed
101276.desc: A peculiar plant once suspected to be a hybrid of plant and animal, though it was later proven to be nothing more than an ordinary plant covered in a coat of animal-like fuzz.

101277.name: Golden Fern
101277.desc: A fern whose edges radiate a faint golden shimmer. It is said to take on a remarkably unique flavor when stewed.

101278.name: Red Beet
101278.desc: A hardy herbaceous plant capable of thriving even in frozen soil. To survive such an unforgiving environment, it develops a thick, succulent root.

101279.name: Glaciafruit
101279.desc: A star-shaped fruit born from Prime Ice that has undergone a peculiar transformation in the permafrost. Once the branch it grows upon is removed, the fruit falls naturally onto the snow.

101280.name: Snowball Flower
101280.desc: A charming flower with a spherical cluster of petals. When snow settles upon it, the entire bloom looks just like a tiny snowball.

101281.name: Rimecurrant
101281.desc: A richly flavored berry that sprouts from frost-rimed, icy branches.

101282.name: Lumifluorite
101282.desc: A strange fluorite formed under the influence of the powers of the Shadow Realm.
source_list: Recommendation: Found in Shadow Realms and nearby area

101301.name: Birch Wood
101301.desc: Timber obtained from birches. It is easy to work with and produces smooth cuts. Furniture made using such wood is both beautiful and durable.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

101302.name: Cuihua Wood
101302.desc: Timber obtained from Cuihua Trees. With its lovely color and unique make, it will surely be able to take on myriad uses upon undergoing suitable workmanship.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

101303.name: Pine Wood
101303.desc: Timber obtained from pines. Its color and grain are nothing to write home about, but its unpretentious nature is elegant in its own right. The wood is very sturdy as well. In able hands, its products should be able to resist moth and rot alike.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

101304.name: Sandbearer Wood
101304.desc: Timber from the Sandbearer Tree. Said to be an exceptionally hardy plant resistant to wind and rain with a long lifespan.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

101305.name: Bamboo Segment
101305.desc: Segments of bamboo that are light and far stronger than their humble appearance might suggest. It lets off a light fragrance.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

101307.name: Fragrant Cedar Wood
101307.desc: Wood from the Cedar tree. Also known as the "Fragrant Cedar" for the aromatic oils it contains.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

101308.name: Fir Wood
101308.desc: Wood from the tree known as "Faber's Fir." Widely used for its fine quality and attractive grain.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

101309.name: Yumemiru Wood
101309.desc: Timber obtained from Sakura Trees. Exquisite in quality and full of moisture, people say that it can lull people into dreams as sweet as the warm spring.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

101310.name: Maple Wood
101310.desc: Timber from the Amur Maple. Excellent quality wood with a fine color and texture.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

101311.name: Aralia Wood
101311.desc: Wood from the Inazuman Cedar. It is soft, has straight veins, and gives off a light fragrance.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

101312.name: Otogi Wood
101312.desc: Wood from the Otogi Tree. It has just the right amount of moisture and oil, and as such has a great many uses.\nCan be used to create furnishings.

101313.name: Brightwood
101313.desc: Timber from the Brightwood Tree. It seems to have different properties from ordinary wood — soft but extremely resilient, easy to dye, and can be used for special purposes. \nCan be used to create furnishings.
source_list: Recommendation: Cut from the forests of Sumeru

101314.name: Karmaphala Wood
101314.desc: The wood of the Karmaphala Tree. One can easily get a nice, smooth surface while working on this material and obtain a rather eye-pleasing result without going through any sophisticated processes.\nCan be used to create furnishings.
source_list: Recommendation: Cut from the forests of Sumeru

101315.name: Adhigama Wood
101315.desc: The wood of the Adhigama Tree. Can be found everywhere and therefore appears rather ordinary, but the wood is durable and easy to handle.\nCan be used to create furnishings.
source_list: Recommendation: Cut from the forests of Sumeru

101316.name: Mountain Date Wood
101316.desc: Wood of the Mountain Date Tree. Although it neither feels special to touch nor possesses a special texture, it retains water exceedingly well and is thus easy to grow.\nCan be used to create furnishings.
source_list: Recommendation: Cut from the deserts of Sumeru

101317.name: Athel Wood
101317.desc: Wood of the Athel Tree. It has a special texture and is resilient to both drought and humidity, making it very durable.\nCan be used to create furnishings.
source_list: Recommendation: Cut from the deserts of Sumeru

101318.name: Mallow Wood
101318.desc: Wood from the Mallow Tree. With a tough core, it is suitable for building the foundations and frames of houses. It is easy to craft and process, so it takes relatively less manual labor to produce beautiful furniture.\nCan be used to create furnishings.
source_list: Recommendation: Cut from the wilds of Fontaine

101319.name: Linden Wood
101319.desc: Wood from the Linden Tree. With a smooth texture and light color, few wood chips are produced even during fine processing. Often carved into delicate handicrafts or used to make compact parts for wooden mechanisms.\nCan be used to create furnishings.
source_list: Recommendation: Cut from the wilds of Fontaine

101320.name: Ash Wood
101320.desc: Wood from the Ash Tree. With its extremely high strength, it is not only used for making strong load-bearing components, but also for making sheets to be used as wall reinforcements, and for transportation crates subject to frequent shocks.\nCan be used to create furnishings.
source_list: Recommendation: Cut from the wilds of Fontaine

101321.name: Cypress Wood
101321.desc: Wood from the Cypress Tree. The core has a relatively large radius, with thinner sapwood. Though not solid or reliable as metal, the wood possesses unique advantages for buildings components with a large surface area.\nCan be used to create furnishings.
source_list: Recommendation: Cut from the wilds of Fontaine

101322.name: Torch Wood
101322.desc: Wood from the Torch Tree. It has a soft texture, can be easily cut, stays dry easily, and the color is compatible with many bright paints. This makes it a common choice for artisans making delicate decorations.\nCan be used to create furnishings.
source_list: Recommendation: Cut from the wilds of Fontaine

101323.name: White Chestnut Oak Wood
101323.desc: Timber obtained from White Chestnut Oak Trees. It strikes a balance between hardness and toughness, making it easy to process. Though it appears no different from most other wood, its color grows lighter once processed using methods common to the tribes of Natlan, becoming nearly white, hence the name.\nCan be used to create furnishings.
source_list: Recommendation: Cut from the wilds of Natlan

101324.name: Ashen Aratiku Wood
101324.desc: Timber obtained from Ashen Aratiku Trees. Other than being lighter, it isn't all that different from most regional trees in Natlan. Mature Saurian companions can carry it with ease, and some legends even tell of tribal warriors who use bundles of such timber as fitness gear.\nCan be used to create furnishings.
source_list: Recommendation: Cut from the wilds of Natlan

101325.name: Flammabomb Wood
101325.desc: Timber obtained from Flammabomb trees. Unlike what their names suggest, such timber is resistant to catching fire or exploding once processed using methods recommended by the Collective of Plenty.\nCan be used to create furnishings.
source_list: Recommendation: Cut from the wilds of Natlan

101326.name: Peach Palm Wood
101326.desc: Timber from Peach Palm Trees. As the name suggests, the bark has the feel of coconut palm husks, and is both smooth and aesthetically pleasing once sanded and polished, with exceptional hardness and humidity-resistant qualities...\nCan be used to create furnishings.
source_list: Recommendation: Cut from the wilds of Natlan

101327.name: Silver Fir Wood
101327.desc: Wood harvested from the Silver Fir Tree. Humans have favored this type of wood since ancient times for its wide range of uses, from crafting barrels to constructing frameworks.

101328.name: Hazelnut Wood
101328.desc: Wood sourced from the Hazelnut Tree. Though the subspecies this wood comes from vary wildly in appearance, they mostly share the same unique compounds that offer excellent resistance to insects and decay, making it a remarkably durable material.

101329.name: Pedunculate Oak Wood
101329.desc: Wood sourced from the Pedunculate Oak Tree. While its density is relatively low, it boasts impressive toughness and water resistance, making it a common choice for buildings near bodies of water.

101330.name: Alder Wood
101330.desc: Wood from the Alder Tree. It demonstrates considerable resistance to moisture and cold, making it a fine raw material for both furniture and musical instruments.

101331.name: Snow Poplar Wood
101331.desc: Wood from Snow Poplars that have smooth surfaces and light, soft textures. A fine choice for making all sorts of small woodworking products...

101332.name: White Birch Wood
101332.desc: Wood from White Birches that boasts high density and toughness. Used for building structures for which bending resistance is a necessity...

101333.name: Bluebeech Wood
101333.desc: Wood from Bluebeeches with even grain patterns that can better withstand wear and tear. In Snezhnaya, it is often used in layered panels involved in structures and implements for long-term use.

101334.name: Larch Wood
101334.desc: Wood from Larches. They possess considerable hardness and are highly corrosion-proof. Snezhnayans often use it to build pillars and boards.

101401.name: Fabric
101401.desc: Some fabric of fine make. It will surely be of use in making furnishings.

101402.name: Red Dye
101402.desc: Red dye. It will surely be of use in making furnishings.

101403.name: Yellow Dye
101403.desc: Yellow dye. It will surely be of use in making furnishings.

101404.name: Blue Dye
101404.desc: Blue dye. It will surely be of use in making furnishings.

101501.name: Torn Page: Toki Alley Tales (Prologue)
101501.desc:
Collect all 10 pages to form Toki Alley Tales (Prologue).

This page billows about in the breeze, seemingly having dropped from a very old novel.
Perhaps you might be able to reconstruct the complete text, should you find other torn pages elsewhere.

101502.name: Torn Page: Toki Alley Tales (I)
101502.desc:
Collect all 10 pages to form Toki Alley Tales (I).

This page billows about in the breeze, seemingly having dropped from a very old novel.
Perhaps you might be able to reconstruct the complete text, should you find other torn pages elsewhere.

101503.name: Torn Page: Toki Alley Tales (II)
101503.desc:
Collect all 10 pages to form Toki Alley Tales (II).

This page billows about in the breeze, seemingly having dropped from a very old novel.
Perhaps you might be able to reconstruct the complete text, should you find other torn pages elsewhere.

101504.name: Torn Page: Toki Alley Tales (III)
101504.desc:
Collect all 10 pages to form Toki Alley Tales (III).

This page billows about in the breeze, seemingly having dropped from a very old novel.
Perhaps you might be able to reconstruct the complete text, should you find other torn pages elsewhere.

This page billows about in the breeze, seemingly having dropped from a very old novel.
Perhaps you might be able to reconstruct the complete text, should you find other torn pages elsewhere.

101506.name: Torn Page: Toki Alley Tales (V)
