Collect all 10 pages to form Toki Alley Tales (V).

This page billows about in the breeze, seemingly having dropped from a very old novel.
Perhaps you might be able to reconstruct the complete text, should you find other torn pages elsewhere.

101507.name: Toki Alley Tales (Prologue)
101507.desc: They say that in the past, when the fragile and short-lived mortals had yet to cross over the sea unto these lands, Inazuma was once a land that belonged to the tanuki. They say, too, that human history began as drunken tanuki nonsense... Welcome to Toki Alley, a place where history and wild tales intertwine.

101508.name: Toki Alley Tales (I)
101508.desc: The great tengu are naught but brutal braggarts, and especially when drunk! — Tanuki Historical Commentary

101509.name: Toki Alley Tales (II)
101509.desc: Mother once warned that a beautiful face can hide deceptive intentions. If she looks as lovely as the moonlight, she must either be a fox spirit, or some old bake-neko hag of significant power — Tanuki Historical Commentary

101510.name: Toki Alley Tales (III)
101510.desc: They say that those who make the ameonna cry will bring inescapable sorrow upon themselves. —Tanuki Historical Commentary

101511.name: Toki Alley Tales (IV)
101511.desc: The tragedy of mortals is to lack self-knowledge, and that of the youkai is the lack of any such tragic troubles. —Tanuki Historical Commentary

101512.name: Toki Alley Tales (V)
101512.desc: Will this middle section filled with regret lead to a more interesting story thereafter?

101513.name: Pass Permit
101513.desc: A pass permit you obtained from Yae Miko. With this, you can enter Tenshukaku without restrictions and meet the Raiden Shogun.\nYou heard that this was made for emergencies, but that Yae Miko seems to have never had a chance to use it.

101514.name: Dango Milk
101514.desc: A creative snack made by adding sticky dango to milk. It is sweet and has a dense mouthfeel. All the customers who have tried it love it.\nStill, it is dango that's been added in — drink too much and you might lose your appetite.

101515.name: Realm Dispatch
101515.desc: A realm dispatch that you obtained from Tubby. It seems to be able to allow your companions to come and go in your realm as they please...\nAfter acquiring this item, you can invite companions to reside in your Serenitea Pot from the Placement Screen.

101518.name: Thunder Sakura Crab
101518.desc: A crab that lives beside the Thunder Sakura. One wonders if it has any unique properties...

101519.name: Fresh Seagrass
101519.desc: Fresh Seagrass. It looks like it would make a good meal.

101520.name: Fresh Sakura Bloom
101520.desc: A fresh sakura bloom. One can't be sure how Julie is going to use it in her dish...

101521.name: Fresh Snapdragon
101521.desc: Fresh snapdragon. It should be most suitable for cooking.

101522.name: Fresh Bird Egg
101522.desc: A fresh egg that should be most amenable to cooking.

101523.name: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune: Prologue
101523.desc: Stories about memories are always closely intertwined with transience. This book is not all-new, but is an adaptation of "Urakusai's Chronicles of the Six Kitsune."

101524.name: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune (I)
101524.desc: The story of the "Black Fox" Itaru was actually the third volume in the original "Urakusai's Chronicles of the Six Kitsune." It appears at the front of this edition due to the writer's personal preference.

101525.name: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune (II)
101525.desc: This volume recounts the clash between "Black Fox Itaru" and the "Twin Oni of Tokaku." This tale was missing from the original text, but it was fortunately rediscovered at a later date. It is presented here in an edited form.

101526.name: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune (III)
101526.desc: In the 500-year-old "Urakusai's Chronicles of the Six Kitsune," Youzan and Yui went on to have their own tales. But at this time, the mother-daughter pair are still reliant on Itaru to rescue them.

101527.name: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune (IV)
101527.desc: This is the tensest tale of the series, said to have been written by Urakusai upon his return from Liyue. It is featured in full in this writer's adaptation.

101528.name: Sangonomiya Chronicles
101528.desc: Historical annals written by the famous Shogunate historian Kujou Michizane, who was known as one of the "The Three Kujou Dignitaries," or "The Great Calligrapher." It chronicles the history of Watatsumi Island in broad strokes.

101529.name: The Saga of Hamavaran (Preface)
101529.desc: The prefaces of the new light novel "The Saga of Hamavaran," now combined into their own separate volume due to a business model adjustment!

101530.name: The Saga of Hamavaran (I)
101530.desc: "How could this happen..." An ordinary scholar from Sumeru is unexpectedly assigned an unpopular specialization and ordered to go forth to the land of thunder and lightning... The curtains slowly rise on an adventure in the nation of many shores!

101531.name: The Saga of Hamavaran (II)
101531.desc: "'Ghost-calling'? Is that the same as 'spirit-warding' back home?" With confusing questions swirling in his mind, Hamavaran begins to speak with his newfound traveling companion. An unexpected journey begins!

101532.name: A Legend of Sword (I)
101532.desc: Amid a sea of stars that spin in reverse, light-centuries of war unfold down on the planet's surface... With this grandiose opening comes an all-new tale of gallantry!

101533.name: A Legend of Sword (II)
101533.desc: Amid a sea of stars that spin in reverse, no battle is legendary enough to be any more than a ripple in the silence for those who dwell upon the shore... But for the warriors in the thick of it, the war is all there is.

101534.name: A Legend of Sword (III)
101534.desc: Amid a sea of stars that spin in reverse lies a small chain of shattered isles, each of which has its own history, featuring tales heroic and trivial alike. This heroic tale is set in the time of the Suruga Shogunate.

101535.name: A Legend of Sword (IV)
101535.desc: There is a saying in Inazuma: "What are bandits but the children of war?" In times of tumult, even the harvest is a battlefield... See how this unfolds in the latest volume of "A Legend of Sword"!

101536.name: A Legend of Sword (V)
101536.desc: Amid a sea of stars that spin in reverse, in nondescript village in a remote corner of the shattered isles, a ronin who has fallen upon hard times forms an alliance with a group of farmers. A great battle with the bandits draws near...

101537.name: Sacred Sakura Cleansing Summary
101537.desc: A tattered scroll containing information related to the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual. Some pages seem to bear the cinnabar seal of some shrine.

101538.name: Fresh Mushroom
101538.desc: A mushroom that did not originally grow in this area, but began to grow with wild profusion after absorbing sufficient special nutrition.

101539.name: Crab Bait
101539.desc: Crab bait that you got from Xudong. Laying it should attract crabs.

101540.name: Someone's Diary V: Jinren Island
101540.desc: A diary left behind by someone in the wilderness that tells of the owner's unfortunate encounters at Jinren Island.

101541.name: Diary of Roald the Adventurer: Ritou
101541.desc: A diary left behind by the famed adventurer, Roald. The pages bear both the refreshing scent of sakura flowers and the bitterness of tobacco leaves.

101542.name: Grand Narukami Shrine Omamori
101542.desc: An omamori given to you by Yae Miko.\n"You can take this out and have a look whenever you think of me as well, you know?"

101543.name: Official Tenryou Commission Document
101543.desc: Obtained from Kujou Takayuki. None are privy to these contents save him and the Shogun — or so they tell you. It has the seal of the Kujou Clan Head on it.

101544.name: Tenryou Commission Secret Letter
101544.desc: Obtained from Kujou Takayuki. The contents are a bit ambiguous, but it isn't difficult to see that some of it involves an exchange of intelligence with the Fatui.

101545.name: Supersized Firework
101545.desc: Yoimiya's pride and joy as the current owner of Naganohara Fireworks. It still seems to be in an experimental state. Nothing's going to go wrong... right?

101546.name: Special Magical Crystal Ore
101546.desc: The Special Magical Crystal Ore mentioned in the sailing log. It looks exactly the same as normal magical crystal ore, so there must be some other key factor that allows it to attract the Lunar Leviathan.

101547.name: Ore Slag
101547.desc: Slag left behind amidst some ore on Dragonspine. The valuable portions have been taken away, and the rest is just worthless, useless dross — or at least, that's how people might be inclined to see it. They would have carried it off as well otherwise, right?

101548.name: Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation (I)
101548.desc: The princess who was prophesied to bring destruction witnesses the imminent fall of her nation, and it is at this moment when a wandering warrior descends from the skies, ignorant of the truth.\nThe pair's journey amidst the fires of an ancient warring period are about to begin!

101549.name: Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation (II)
101549.desc: "A princess who brings destruction. Hah. Isn't that just an excuse for making war?"\nThey travel to the center of the world in search of the truth behind the prophecy.\nThe super-popular romantic adventure continues!

101550.name: Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation (III)
101550.desc: The two, who have entered the field of battle, finally witness the true Avici. The truth behind the fires of war that have swept across the world will be revealed here!\nThis volume comes with some super value-added extras!

101551.name: Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation (IV)
101551.desc: "Go back to hell, you jumped-up vengeful spirit!"\nThe riveting flashback chapter! What lies within the warrior's buried past?\nHere comes a new chapter in the adventures of the princess who lost her nation and the warrior!

101552.name: Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation (V)
101552.desc: "If this world requires your sacrifice to be saved, then it might as well burn."\nHaving reached the Sky Tower at the heart of the world at last, is this... finally the end of the pair's tale?

101553.name: Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation (VI)
101553.desc: The truth of the world is revealed — and what a terrible joke it is! Even when separated, the two cannot escape the chains of fate.\nThis may be the final volume of "Princess Mina of the Fallen Nation," but our story isn't over yet!

101554.name: Flowers for Princess Fischl (0)
101554.desc: The preliminary volume of the "Flowers for Princess Fischl" series.\nThis work originally came in a violet and black wooden box as a limited edition gift, but many hardcore fans of the series who wanted to collect the whole saga were enraged by the great amount of content versus the small number of copies printed.\nDue to this, Yae Publishing House would name this book "Volume 0" and sell it separately. Eventually, the original work, the boxed collector's edition, and Volume 0 would all come to be regarded as standard by fans.

101558.name: Teyvat Travel Guide - Inazuma
101558.desc: A magazine by the Adventurers' Guild. Each issue introduces great sceneries across Teyvat. This issue includes a short traveling diary of Alice the Traveler in Inazuma.

101559.name: Drifting Bottle With Letter
101559.desc: A floating bottle that you fished up accidentally. The cork on this bottle has already been damaged, and the letter within has been mildewed. Thankfully, you discovered it in time, or its contents may have become lost to time altogether.

101560.name: Onibudou
101560.desc: A standalone volume from the light novel series "Onibudou," written by Junkichi, a writer with Yae Publishing House. This collection contains the first two major arcs in the story. The quality of the serialized version varies quite a bit, but it still enjoys a degree of popularity amongst readers.

101561.name: Grand Narukami Shrine Omamori
101561.desc: An omamori that served a critical purpose within the Plane of Euthymia.\nAccording to Yae Miko, "This item was given to you by the lovely, sagacious Lady Yae Miko."

101570.name: Lucky Omamori
101570.desc: An omamori that Thoma gave you. It is said to be able to bring good luck.

101571.name: Box of Nails
101571.desc: A box of nails obtained from a Treasure Hoarder camp. You can use it for repairs.

101572.name: Planks
101572.desc: Wooden planks obtained from a Treasure Hoarder camp. You can use them for repairs.

101573.name: Rope
101573.desc: Rope obtained from a Treasure Hoarder camp. You can use it for repairs.

101575.name: Kito's Sachet
101575.desc: A sachet carried by Kito and Kina. It seems to have been woven from two smaller sachets before being carefully hidden in a wooden box.

101576.name: Treasure Map Fragment
101576.desc: A treasure map fragment left behind by Shitoki's brother. The vellum made from animal hide has the faint scent of sea-salt on it.

101577.name: Treasure Map Fragment
101577.desc: A treasure map fragment left behind by Shitoki's brother. The vellum made from animal hide has the faint scent of sea-salt on it.

101578.name: Treasure Map Fragment
101578.desc: A treasure map fragment left behind by Shitoki's brother. The vellum made from animal hide has the faint scent of sea-salt on it.

101579.name: Treasure Map Fragment
101579.desc: A treasure map fragment left behind by Shitoki's brother. The vellum made from animal hide has the faint scent of sea-salt on it.

101580.name: A Treasure Map Left for Shitoki
101580.desc: A complete Treasure Map made from several fragments. It gives off a faint sea-salt scent.

101581.name: Makiri's Charm
101581.desc: A sturdy bag that seems seawater-proof. It's full of blessing from the ancestral spirits.

101582.name: General Purpose Directional Conduction Component
101582.desc: A basic, common component often found in various creations of an ancient civilization, the function of which seems to be ensuring that these creations continue operating. Due to their close similarity in makeup to the components used in Pursina's Spikes, they can be used to replace its damaged parts. To think that Pursina's Spikes need such priceless objects to repair them... What a terrifyingly high-maintenance device.

101583.name: Rust-Worn Key
101583.desc: A rusted key. Who knows how long it has been here...

101584.name: Heavy Key
101584.desc: A key that feels heavy in your hand. What door will it open?

101585.name: Intact Key
101585.desc: A key that at least looks intact. One wonders who might have left it here...

101586.name: Sumida's Letter
101586.desc: A letter given to you by Sumida.\nGive this letter to Kama in Ritou.

101587.name: New Firework Model
101587.desc: Yoimiya's new firework model. Who knows what it will do...

101588.name: New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune (V)
101588.desc: Commentary regarding ancient matters that was specially added to the "New Chronicles of the Six Kitsune." If you find it an insipid, monotonous slog, dear reader, you may skip this volume. But as far as the author is concerned, this is one waste of words and emotion that cannot be avoided.

101589.name: Northland Bank Check
101589.desc: A check with the emblem of the Northland Bank printed on it. It can be exchanged for Mora.

101590.name: Scrawled Treasure Map
101590.desc: This is an awful specimen of a treasure map. Its lines are random and its grids scrawled. You could probably sell this for a significant amount of Mora by claiming that it is the work of some stream-of-consciousness artist, though.

101591.name: Kiminami Anna's Invigorating Kitty Meal
101591.desc: An Invigorating Kitty Meal made personally by Kiminami Anna. You're not certain if Neko will like it or not...

101592.name: Autake Slate
101592.desc: An example of the Ishine Script that was once used on Tsurumi Island.\nIt probably needs to be returned to some place in the Autake Plains.

101593.name: General Purpose Directional Conduction Component
101593.desc: A basic, common component often found in various creations of an ancient civilization, the function of which seems to be ensuring that these creations continue operating. Due to their close similarity in makeup to the components used in Pursina's Spikes, they can be used to replace its damaged parts. To think that Pursina's Spikes need such priceless objects to repair them... What a terrifyingly high-maintenance device.

101594.name: General Purpose Directional Conduction Component
101594.desc: A basic, common component often found in various creations of an ancient civilization, the function of which seems to be ensuring that these creations continue operating. Due to their close similarity in makeup to the components used in Pursina's Spikes, they can be used to replace its damaged parts. To think that Pursina's Spikes need such priceless objects to repair them... What a terrifyingly high-maintenance device.

101595.name: General Purpose Directional Conduction Component
101595.desc: A basic, common component often found in various creations of an ancient civilization, the function of which seems to be ensuring that these creations continue operating. Due to their close similarity in makeup to the components used in Pursina's Spikes, they can be used to replace its damaged parts. To think that Pursina's Spikes need such priceless objects to repair them... What a terrifyingly high-maintenance device.

101596.name: A Preliminary Study of Sangonomiya Folk Belief
101596.desc: This paper was written by Shihab Purbiruni, a scholar of modern history from Sumeru, two years before the civil war in Inazuma. It details the folk beliefs of Watatsumi Island and the Sangonomiya people, and puts forward some relatively new academic propositions.

101597.name: The Life of Mouun the Shrine Maiden
101597.desc: For the people of Watatsumi, the legends of the Archon War are always filled with bitterness. Many of these millennia-old folksongs tell of a shrine maiden by the name of Mouun, who once rode upon the back of a sea monster, following the Great Serpent unto a tragic, moving end.

101598.name: Debates on the "Viceroy of the East"
101598.desc: The "Viceroy of the East," or "Touzannou" sung of in Watatsumi folk tradition is also known as the "Akuou" all across Raiden's domains. He was the first vassal ruler of the Great Serpent Orobashi, and he was also the last.

101599.name: Treasured Tales of the Chouken Shinkageuchi (I)
101599.desc: The first part of a traditional Inazuman novel. This particular volume is also known as "Shinkageuchi," and was once a restricted text. It contains a fantastical tale about the first Raiden Shogun and her kagemusha, depicting the benevolent sagacity of the first Shogun and the great valor of her kagemusha. However, due to the great popularity of another book known colloquially as "Raiden Reincarnation," many people became interested in stories of this kind. This book thus wound up being published in a haphazard manner.

101600.name: Mysterious Stone
101600.desc: This object seems to carry the Ishine Script that was once used on Tsurumi Island.\nBring this stone back to its rightful place.

101601.name: Diary of Roald the Adventurer: Tsurumi Island
101601.desc: A diary left behind by the famed adventurer, Roald. The pages bear both the moist smell of the fog and a certain fungal scent.

101602.name: Fresh Meat
101602.desc: Food that Thoma has prepared for the stray cats and dogs. This should go like hotcakes.

101603.name: Fresh Fish
101603.desc: Food that Thoma has prepared for the stray cats and dogs. A slightly fishy smell wafts off it.

101604.name: Bag of Retrieved Items
101604.desc: A batch of abandoned goods that you found at a warehouse at the south wharf. They essentially have no value.

101605.name: Repaired Comb
101605.desc: The comb that Ningguang commissioned Mingxing Jewelry to repair. It belongs to a special informant. The damage to the comb was originally quite severe. The fact that it could be repaired to this extent is quite impressive indeed.

101606.name: Mysterious Flyer
101606.desc: A pamphlet you obtained from the Ms. Hina Fan Club. You've got to say that the design looks kind of familiar...
101606.title: Investigate

101607.name: Rigorous Schedule
101607.desc: A schedule that you created for Ningguang. The various items are all laid out in a clear and easy-to-read manner.

101608.name: Simple Schedule
101608.desc: A schedule that you created for Ningguang. Simple, cogent, and to the point.

101609.name: Starsplinter Iron
101609.desc: One of the ores required to create Wonder Cores. It has the power to resonate with Visions.

101610.name: Subrosium
101610.desc: One of the ores required to create Wonder Cores. It can often be found where dawn meets dusk.

101611.name: Wonder Core
101611.desc: The core component to the Jade Chamber's mechanisms. When combined with Adepti Sigils, they can be used as the control center of the Jade Chamber.

101612.name: Adepti Sigil
101612.desc: Adepti Sigils made by Shenhe. They contain dense adeptal energy.

101613.name: Records of a Changing Village
101613.desc: Documents announcing the villagers' migration. It states that the village was forced to relocate due to a god's remains.

101614.name: Ragged Notebook
101614.desc: A ragged notebook you found in the village. It records the happenings of long ago, now buried by the passage of time.

101615.name: Mountainous Miscellany
101615.desc: This text contains all manner of strange legends about Mt. Tianheng's stones, including tales about many rare ores. It is said that if you stand in the middle of the lake south of Mt. Tianheng at dusk, you will find the legendary Subrosium.

101616.name: Neatly-Written Note
101616.desc: The paper of this letter is slightly brittle and its ink is also a little smudged. It seems that both it and its owner have borne the assault of the waves. Unfortunately, while they encountered the same tribulations, they did not share the same fate.

101617.name: Little Meng's Drifting Bottle
101617.desc: A bottle containing Little Meng's various troubles. You wonder what's inside...

101618.name: Lumenstone
101618.desc: A special stone mined from the depths of The Chasm. It is said that it has catalytic properties.\nIt almost blazes with light in the gloomy mines, but it loses all such effects the moment one leaves The Chasm.\nIt seems to have other unique properties as well that have yet to be discovered.

101619.name: Muning's Note
101619.desc: The Ministry representative Muning gave you this note. Despite its short length, the word "prohibited" appears 8 times. If you give this to an adventurer named Zhiqiong, you will receive the aid you need.

101620.name: Treasure Map Fragment
101620.desc: A fragment of a larger map that seems to indicate the location of treasure.\nIf you can find the other fragment, that should complete the picture.

101621.name: Treasure Hoarders' Treasure Map
101621.desc: This treasure map, once torn in two and kept in different hiding spots by the Treasure Hoarders, is now whole again.\nIf you follow the symbol on it, you might discover some special treasure!

101622.name: Storehouse Security Key No. 1
101622.desc: A key to a certain storehouse that was hidden in a very obvious place, yet was never found by the Treasure Hoarders. Guess they're not as good at their job as they think, huh?

101623.name: Storehouse Security Key No. 2
101623.desc: A key to a certain storehouse that was hidden in an incredibly obvious place, yet was never found by the Treasure Hoarders. They should probably go back to Hoarder school.

101624.name: A Set of Cannonballs
101624.desc: Cannonballs for the Mountainator, also known as the Safe Blasting Mechanism 2156. Although you used the Lumenstone Adjuvant to clear the unknown pollutants away, there is still a stench about them that can be detected even while covering your nose.\nUgh. Do you really have to touch it?

101625.name: Special Unmoving Essential Oil
101625.desc: A dangerous substance made using the formula that Clitopho provided by compressing two Unmoving Essential Oils into one very dense bottle filled with Geo elemental energy.\nDue to its fame as a highly unstable concoction, only madmen or experienced miners would dare use it, making it an uncommon sight indeed.\nHandle with utmost care!

101626.name: Key to a Stony Hall
101626.desc: According to Khedive's initial speculations, this construct may be a "key" that could open the door to some ruin somewhere.

101627.name: Photo of a Strange Rock
101627.desc: You took this picture of a strange rock that can be seen on the walls of The Chasm. You do not know what the patterns on the rock mean, but perhaps it could be of value to some researchers.

101628.name: Akademiya Recommendation Letter
101628.desc: This letter, carefully crafted, is sealed in the name of "Ecologist Khedive Pursina."\nYou got this as a gift from Khedive. He claims that this is even more precious than gold, and can gain you the help of the House of Purbiruni.\nKhedive himself believes monetary remuneration to be something of an insult... Hopefully, this doesn't prove to be a trend with people from Sumeru.

101629.name: Orb of the Blue Depths
101629.desc: A strange gem left behind by a foe from the Abyss. If you look into it hard, it is almost as if you are looking into a long-borne dream shrouded by a deep fog.

101630.name: Metal Key
101630.desc: A key wrought of metal that has been worn down with rust accumulated over many years.

101631.name: Miner's Key
101631.desc: Such keys are commonly found in the mines, but one wonders why it would appear here.

101632.name: Blessings of Wisdom
101632.desc: A suspicious object you obtained from Xamaran. It is claimed that this can clear the source of the foul energy. Condensed from the fungus' absorbed nutrients, the agglomeration of spores... and a thick sense of humor.

101633.name: Mountainator Cannonball (Fuse Attached)
101633.desc: A cannonball with a fuse carefully attached. Ready to be fired at any time!

101634.name: Toy Doll
101634.desc: A toy belonging to miner Qi Ding's daughter. It looks pretty tattered and it's hard to imagine that any kid would like it. But the intricate stitch-work shows that this was once quite the pricey item.

101635.name: Flower of Farsight
101635.desc: One of the six lost offerings scattered throughout The Chasm... possibly? It seems just like an ordinary Qingxin, and one that has newly sprouted as well, seeing as how its white petals have never been touched by dew.\nWho knows how many people have once climbed up to high heights to pick one such fresh flower? Who knows if these flowers eventually bore witness to partings or reunions?

101636.name: Skyfeather
101636.desc: One of the six lost offerings scattered throughout The Chasm, a feather that fell from an eagle that flew over the top of the cavern. The Millelith seem to enjoy collecting these tough feathers to use as ornaments.\nIt is said that eagle feathers fit valiant warriors best, and so tend to be used to decorate the armor and arms of the bravest, such that they might break the enemy formation with all the swiftness of that great bird of prey.

101637.name: Sundial of Ages
101637.desc: One of the six lost offerings scattered throughout The Chasm. It seems quite old now, but the etchings are still very clear, and so it can still be used.\nThe sun is a rare sight down in The Chasm, and it is easy to lose track of time. But someday, this sundial will once again track the passage of years.

101638.name: Cup of Commons
101638.desc: One of the six lost offerings scattered throughout The Chasm. Neither stone nor gem, it somehow still became part of the Treasure Hoarders' loot hoard.\nIt has been filled by turns with fine wine, fair treasure, and blood. Now, its previous shame has been washed away, and it is ready to take on new memories.

101639.name: Helm of Warding
101639.desc: One of the six lost offerings scattered throughout The Chasm. It was found hidden in the living quarters of the miners. A slightly less discerning eye might have mistaken it for a miner's hat.\nIt is heavily scarred and pitted, making one wonder how many miners' lives it must have saved.

101640.name: Warrior's Spear
101640.desc: One of the six lost offerings scattered throughout The Chasm. It was lost amid the ancient battlefield five hundred years ago. The long years have worn the edge of the spear-point away, but it still looks quite ominous nonetheless.\nOne can imagine that it was once wielded by a warrior most brave, earning the cheers of the young wherever it swept, even unto The Chasm itself.

101641.name: Brass Ring
101641.desc: A ring that you got off a Golden Weasel Thief. See how it glitters, see how it shines! The Weasel Thief must have planned on using it to attract a mate, and it does indeed look quite valuable. One imagines that its owner must be quite distressed at the moment.

101642.name: Archaic Stone
101642.desc: A strange, rare ore that was mined from The Chasm.\nThese rocks can only be found in the ore veins of the oldest mountains. It is so rare that most merchants have probably never heard of it.\nHowever, the changes in The Chasm have led to the emergence of much low-quality Archaic Stone, a fact that has given the merchants of Huishan Hall quite the headache.

101643.name: Shriveled Seed
101643.desc: A seemingly withered object that seems to, by normal judgment, be a seed. However, it still has a surprising amount of life in it yet.\nBest not to eat it for now...

101644.name: Lumenstone Ore
101644.desc: The raw ore from which Lumenstone may be found. If processed properly, it can be used to strengthen the Lumenstone Adjuvant you have. Why not hit Jinwu up and ask her?

101645.name: Yue Chuan's Drifting Bottle
101645.desc: A drifting bottle that contains Yue Chuan's reply to Little Meng. You wonder if it'll reach him...

101648.name: Hiraizumi's Goods
101648.desc: Fresh soy milk. It'll go bad quick if improperly stored.

101649.name: Cell Key
101649.desc: A metal key that you obtained from the Fatui. It should be able to open some kind of door.

101650.name: Freshly-Picked Calla Lily
101650.desc: A freshly-picked Calla Lily. Suitable for being used as a specimen.

101651.name: Freshly-Picked Small Lamp Grass
101651.desc: A freshly-picked Small Lamp Grass. Suitable for being used as a specimen.

101652.name: Freshly-Picked Cecilia
101652.desc: A freshly-picked Cecilia with a pleasant fragrance.

101654.name: Ruin Machine Core
101654.desc: The core section of a Ruin Guard. Old and new versions of this device are incompatible, and it thus cannot be used to empower other objects. However, the leftover energy should be enough to power one Ruin Guard.

101655.name: Date's Key
101655.desc: Date's key. Unfortunately, this will not open the treasury of a distinguished Enkanomiya family. It will only open the way to the Heterodoxa labyrinth.

101656.name: Pile of Lavender Melons
101656.desc: This pile of Lavender Melons may have been collected and placed here by some kind of animal. They look a bit like Onikabuto from a distance.

101657.name: Fine Incense
101657.desc: Incense you got from Wang Ping'an. Looks to be of good quality.

101659.name: Curious Cube
101659.desc: An unknown construct that you discovered in the depths of The Chasm. It resembles an intricately-made cube.

101660.name: A Note Someone Stuffed You
101660.desc: As you were walking down the streets of Inazuma, someone stuffed this note onto your person. Two strange symbols are drawn on it.

101661.name: Special Bamboo Slip
101661.desc: A Bamboo Slip upon which Momoyo has applied some specially made elemental powder. Store and handle it with care! The powder has some measure of poison in it — and of course, you'll get yelled at for improper handling.

101662.name: "Final Instructions"
101662.desc: Fatui operational orders that you obtained from Lyudochka. They detail an operation that will take place in the future on Watatsumi Island. This intelligence is very important — peoples' lives are at stake here!

101663.name: Bag of Clothes
101663.desc: A bag that contains Lyudochka's Fatui uniform. Considering the controversial nature of Fatui uniforms, it is best not to let other people see this.

101664.name: Special Fortune Slip
101664.desc: A specially made fortune slip that describes how your luck will be like today. There is nothing different about this Fortune Slip, save for the fact that you got it for the fake Bamboo Slip.\nWhose fortune does this Fortune Slip describe?

101665.name: Strange Object
101665.desc: A strange item that you fished up from the underground waterways in The Chasm. It's wet, and you cannot tell if this is a living or dead thing.

101666.name: Bedrock Key Location Diagram
101666.desc: A simple diagram that Zhiqiong drew in haste. It indicates the general locations of several Bedrock Keys.

101667.name: Light Mora Purse
101667.desc: A Mora purse you found in a treasure chest. The feeling you had when weighing it was one of immense disappointment.

101668.name: Full Mora Purse
101668.desc: A Mora purse you found in a treasure chest. Compared to the previous purse you found, this one provides a decent amount more comfort.

101669.name: Plump Fish
101669.desc: A fish you just obtained from the river. It might be considered a gift from nature. It is so excellent that it only needs to be grilled a little to be delicious as can be.

101671.name: Yun Jin's Personal Letter
101671.desc: A letter that Yun Jin personally wrote to Shiyun. It seems to hold the key to turning the situation around.

101672.name: Lyudochka's Letter
101672.desc: The letter that Lyudochka asked someone from Yae Publishing House to pass on to you. It contains her reasons for leaving without saying why. However, whether you will accept her reasons for departing or not is a different story.\nIt was you who discovered her presence and changed her fate... Might you be able to do still more to change this ending for the better?

101673.name: Lyudochka's Mora Purse
101673.desc: The Mora purse that Lyudochka left behind. It contains a decent sum of Mora, but even Paimon doesn't want to use it.

101674.name: Fatui Code Sheet
101674.desc: A certain ever-somnolent member of the Shuumatsuban wrote this Fatui Code Sheet.\nReading it does not merely let you know that "these Fatui speak very oddly indeed" — you can also feel the recorder's intense lethargy penetrating the paper in the form of saliva.

101675.name: Light Purse
101675.desc: A purse you got from Mona. It contains the amount she needs to pay her rent.

101676.name: Marjorie's Gift
101676.desc: A present that you got from Marjorie. You've heard that children will like it...

101677.name: Viktor's Gift
101677.desc: A gift you got from Viktor. He seems to have also put a letter under the gift box.

101678.name: Fresh Wolfhooks
101678.desc: Fresh Wolfhooks that Schuster picked. Thankfully, they haven't been damaged by monsters yet.

101679.name: Lyudochka's Fortune Slip
101679.desc: A specially made fortune slip that describes how your luck will be like today. There is nothing different about this Fortune Slip, save for the fact that you used it to open Lyudochka's heart.\nNow, this Fortune Slip has returned to your hands, along with her heartfelt blessings. If you've got the time, why not go to the Grand Narukami Shrine to see her?

101680.name: The Serpent and Drakes of Tokoyokoku
101680.desc: A novel based on Watatsumi Island's folktales. The original edition of this text was transcribed on Watatsumi Island and brought back to Narukami Island by a merchant while the former's serpent god yet lived. No one reads this ancient tome nowadays, its role supplanted by all the light novels on the market. This book describes the unique cosmological outlook of the Watatsumi people before they came to adopt aspects of Narukami culture, and a recent resurgence in traditional novel publishing has allowed it to see the light of day once more.

101681.name: Before Sun and Moon
101681.desc: A chronicle that ordinary folk have been forbidden to read. The writing is a mix of fables and histories from the beginning of the world to the creation of the Dainichi Mikoshi.

101682.name: Hydrological Studies in Byakuyakoku
101682.desc: This text records the geography and hydrology of Byakuyakoku. With the sealing of the depths and the emigration of the people of Watatsumi, as well as the passing of long years, this book is now useless.

101683.name: Bathysmal Vishap Experimental Records
101683.desc: Experimental Records of the Bathysmal Vishaps. No vishaps were killed in the writing of these records.

101684.name: In the Light, Beneath the Shadow
101684.desc: A puzzle book for children of ages nine to twelve. As a book from a transitory period, it uses Narukami-style names with Byakuyakoku subscripts.

101685.name: The Miraculous Adventures of the Traveler
101685.desc: "This is a rather orthodox light novel, with its contents essentially being an edited version of real life in Teyvat. What is surprising, however, is that the author seems to be highly knowledgeable about Watatsumi Island, with many vivid, almost lifelike descriptions." — Ms. Hina

101686.name: The Miraculous Adventures of the Traveler
101686.desc: "This light novel is based on school life and depicts the antics of all manner of schoolyard oddballs. A very entertaining read." — Ms. Hina

101687.name: The Miraculous Adventures of the Traveler
101687.desc: "This story is quite wild and can be almost disorienting to read initially, but its wonderment grows on you, and it contains many a moment of gut-busting laughter. I liked it very much." — Ms. Hina

101688.name: The Miraculous Adventures of the Traveler
101688.desc: "By blending many styles together, this seemingly thin book transports you into a great many tales. I can only imagine that its author must also be a very interesting person. I happen to know someone like that, in fact — something that lends this book a very familiar touch." — Ms. Hina

101690.name: Muning's Note
101690.desc: The Ministry representative Muning gave you this note. Despite its short length, the word "prohibited" appears 8 times. If you give this to an adventurer named Zhiqiong, you will receive the aid you need.

101691.name: Frostglaze Crystal
101691.desc:
A glaze crystal produced in the depths of The Chasm, this special Glaze Sand Crystal ore was one of many scattered about during the battle against the giant ruin machine. Glaze Sand Crystal ore is a regional specialty of The Chasm, but this one is different from the rest.
Under the radiance of the blue crystal and the power of the Abyss, a strange spiral pattern has emerged within this stone, and it is cold, almost chilling to the touch.
This once smooth crystal has been transformed into this shape by the great might that descended from the heavens and the miasma that arose from the earth's depths — and perhaps the form it has taken is itself a warning unto mortals.
If the interaction of these forces alone could twist stone and metal thus, if that ordinary heroine was truly able to witness the end of the pitch-dark path, how would she have faced the discovery she would make?

101692.name: Light Realm Sigil
101692.desc: A mark symbolizing the recognition of Enkanomiya's Tokoyo Ookami.\nThey can be offered up to the Statue of the Vassals of Watatsumi, thus upgrading the Bokuso Box.

101693.name: Light Realm Core
101693.desc: You discovered this mysterious stone while exploring the darkened realm of Enkanomiya.\nThe Light Realm gave humans additional means to resist the Abyss.

101694.name: Bloodied Sergeant's Insignia
101694.desc: The bloodied and muddied insignia of a Fatui sergeant. You have no idea how it ended up in the depths of The Chasm.

101695.name: Kapral Nikolay's Diary
101695.desc: A letter left behind by Kapral Nikolay. Its contents have long ceased to be whole.

101696.name: Kapral Nikolay's Diary
101696.desc: A fragment of Fatui Kapral Nikolay's diary. It gives off a rather unpleasant smell, but that's at least better than being covered in mud.

101697.name: Mora Purse
101697.desc: You were asked by Xu from Feiyun Commerce Guild to deliver this to Huishan Hall's representative Muning, who is at The Chasm. It contains a rather sizable sum of Mora.

101698.name: A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits
101698.desc: A light novel that has been popular in Inazuma lately. It contains all manner of bizarre tales involving ancient youkai.

101699.name: Dream Sakura
101699.desc:
You held a single sakura petal in your hand before leaving Raiden Makoto's realm of consciousness.
Its existence is a mystery. It appears no different from ordinary sakura petals, and there it silently sits in your storage just like any of the others. But you can no longer touch it, nor can you feel its weight or warmth. When an object loses any of the attributes that one would normally ascribe to it, how can its "existence" be proven for sure?
As you think back on the many sights the petal must have witnessed in the past, a certain guess comes to mind: that which sustains this sakura petal's existence must be someone's will. But as to who this person is, and whether they are intentionally or unintentionally keeping this petal in existence, neither can be known. Nor can you prove whether that willpower is one derived from yearning, trust, or gratitude.
Perhaps, when "that person's will" changes, so too will this sakura petal disappear.
Just to be safe, it might be best to check back from time to time and see if it still exists.

101700.name: Aphotium Ore
101700.desc: A special ore created due to the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri. As Enkanomiya's environment has undergone extreme changes, the memories and thoughts of Watatsumi Omikami scattered throughout Enkanomiya have coalesced into medullae, which then transformed into ore.

101701.name: Tokoyo Legume
101701.desc: A special plant that was produced via the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri. With the awakening of the Sangacorexes, the elemental energies within Enkanomiya have been pacified. This is a naturally-growing fertilizing crop that will turn into loam within the soil once it decays.

101702.name: Husk Gem
101702.desc: A jewel that fell from the armor of a special Shadowy Husk after you defeated it. You can feel a will surging within it. Perhaps it might be more correct to say that this will manifested itself through the armor rather than manipulated it.

101703.name: Fragmented Accessory
101703.desc: A small accessory you got from Kokomi. It seems to be the fragment of another object. According to her, it might come in handy at some point.

101704.name: Fragmented Accessory
101704.desc: A fragment that you got from "Enjou." He stole this from the Dainichi Mikoshi, so this should be a relic of Enkanomiya.

101706.name: Tsumi's Map
101706.desc: A map drawn by Tsumi. There are some markings on it.

101707.name: Hakuen Michimitsu Amenoma
101707.desc: The heirloom blade of the Iwakura Clan.\nAlthough the one who forged this blade possessed great skills, and though it is true that this sword has slain many a foe, it does not possess any special powers. Nor has the Iwakura Succession ever obtained a Vision. Their excellent swordsmanship was purely a result of their honing of mind, body, and technique.\nThis blade has been submerged in water for a long time and seems to have completely rusted.

101708.name: Wooden Cage Key
101708.desc: Someone from the Kanjou Commission left this behind. You should be able to use this to rescue Shinnojou.

101709.name: Damaged Stone Slate
101709.desc: A seemingly ordinary stone slate. Who knows what secrets it might hold...
101709.title: Damaged Stone Slate

101710.name: Mysterious Stone Slate
101710.desc: The final stone slate you obtained. Secrets within secrets, eh?
101710.title: Mysterious Stone Slate

101711.name: Yanbo's Note
101711.desc: A somewhat complete note, written in a neat hand. It seems to have been a letter left for an old friend.

101712.name: Nikolay's Letter
101712.desc: A letter you found off one of the Black Serpent Knights. The name of the letter's recipient is neatly written: "Katarina Snezhevna, My Dear Elder Sister," while the sender's name is written somewhat haphazardly, though you can make out the words "Your Brother, Nikolay Snezhevich."

101714.name: Fragrant Seasoning
101714.desc: Seasoning created using the recipe given to you by Nazafarin. It has a tangy aroma and serves to bring out the flavor in any dish it is added to.

101715.name: Fragrant Vegetarian Abalone
101715.desc: A delicious dish with some extra seasoning! It gives off a titillating aroma... But whose tastes will this dish suit? Invite your friends, invite your pals — get them to try this new dish!

101716.name: The Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival!
101716.desc: This is a most lavish invitation letter, whether in its construction or its content. The letter describes a large-scale, deep-rooted, nationally-acclaimed event in which you shall be a most important guest, the radiant star of the show.

101717.name: Worksite Records
101717.desc: This was originally a ledger, but appears to have been re-purposed as a site log instead. The latest daily happenings at The Chasm have been scribbled into its pages, though not much of this information is of any particular use.

101719.name: Fragrant Mint Salad
101719.desc: A delicious dish with some extra seasoning! It gives off a titillating aroma... But whose tastes will this dish suit? Invite your friends, invite your pals — get them to try this new dish!

101720.name: Fragrant Triple-Layered Consommé
101720.desc: A delicious dish with some extra seasoning! It gives off a titillating aroma... But whose tastes will this dish suit? Invite your friends, invite your pals — get them to try this new dish!

101724.name: Zhiqiong's Letter
101724.desc: A letter left by a young adventurer. There is a slightly bitter scent of Qingxin on this piece of paper.

101725.name: Arrival Schedule
101725.desc: A list of guests and their time of arrival on ships bound for the Irodori Festival.\nYour task is to welcome and lend your aid to guests according to the information presented in this schedule.

101726.name: Five Kasen Summary
101726.desc: A summary of the information concerning the Five Kasen, which you got from Yae Publishing House's Hirayama.\nAlthough the content is quite sparse, you can still get the gist of the Five Kasen and the great flair they had in their heyday.

101727.name: The Five Kasen's Splendor: Suikou
101727.desc: A sheet of paper Venti found in a cargo crate within the wharf warehouse. A poem entitled "The Five Kasen's Splendor: Suikou" is written upon it.

101728.name: The Five Kasen's Splendor: Aoi no Okina
101728.desc: A sheet of paper Xingqiu found beneath his luggage. Someone seems to have left it there while he was napping. A poem entitled "The Five Kasen's Splendor: Aoi no Okina" is written upon it.

101729.name: The Five Kasen's Splendor: Akahito
101729.desc: A sheet of paper that some mysterious person left behind. This person must have originally intended to leave it on Kazuha's person, only to be unexpectedly detected by the latter and forced to flee in a hurry, leaving the sheet behind. A poem entitled "The Five Kasen's Splendor: Akahito" is written upon it.

101730.name: The Five Kasen's Splendor: Sumizome
101730.desc: Ayaka found this on a flower stand at the festival venue. This sheet of paper, however, only contains one line of text.

101731.name: The Five Kasen's Splendor: Sumizome
101731.desc: Ayaka found this on a flower stand at the festival venue. Once submerged in water, this sheet of paper reveals the full poetic text of "The Five Kasen's Splendor: Sumizome."

101732.name: Ancient Forging Blueprint
101732.desc: An ancient forging blueprint. The Shogun once ordered the Kaedehara Clan to forge a Goshintou according to it.\nAfter being soaked in water, it becomes clear that some of the text has been blurred — someone tampered with the blueprint, dooming the forging to failure and triggering the tragedy that followed...

101733.name: Kaedehara Yoshinori's Letter
101733.desc: A blank piece of paper that was hidden in an old flower pot. When dipped in water, it reveals a long-sealed secret.\nAfter telling everyone about the truth that was concealed within, Kazuha said that "this letter may still be of use to you," before handing it over to you.

101734.name: Taliesin's Manuscript
101734.desc: A very thick poetic manuscript. If you were to give it a generous review, it would be "mediocre," while an honest review would see it getting a "hard to read." It resembles bone-dry historical records more than it does poetry.

101737.name: Fragrant Stir-Fried Shrimp
101737.desc: A delicious dish with some extra seasoning! It gives off a titillating aroma... But whose tastes will this dish suit? Invite your friends, invite your pals — get them to try this new dish!

101738.desc: A delicious dish with some extra seasoning! It gives off a titillating aroma... But whose tastes will this dish suit? Invite your friends, invite your pals — get them to try this new dish!

101753.desc: A delicious dish with some extra seasoning! It gives off a titillating aroma... But whose tastes will this dish suit? Invite your friends, invite your pals — get them to try this new dish!

101754.name: Sayu's Salary
101754.desc: This was originally intended to buy bedding and other materials by which sleep quality might be improved, but on the other hand, Sayu has no wish to sleep forever just yet.

101755.name: Statue of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder
101755.desc: The Statue of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder that Sara has been hankering after. Go on, go give it to her.

101756.name: Kokomi's Shopping List
101756.desc: A shopping list of books compiled by Kokomi. All the genres, unit prices, and amounts of the books she desires have been written down here in her elegant script.

101757.name: Toy Fox
101757.desc: The gift that Gorou got when helping Kokomi purchase books during the Irodori Festival. Gorou then gave it to you as thanks for accompanying him.\nEvery time you look at it, you can't help but remember the sight of every hair on Gorou's body standing on end as he heard the word "fox."

101758.name: Salary Bag
101758.desc: It is said that opening this will bring you bad luck. It seems lighter than you assumed it might be...?

101760.name: A Complete Chart of Ako's Treasure
101760.desc: A complete nautical chart pieced together after all four parts of the clue were collected, leading to the treasure hidden by Ako Domeki and company before they left this place.

101764.name: "Outlander Brigade: When the Wind of Death Blew Towards the Blond Samurai" Script
101764.desc: A "film script" you obtained from Xavier.

101765.name: "Mushounin" Script
101765.desc: A new film script that Xavier finished overnight, much thicker than his last one. What you have here merely contains Act I.\nThe willpower one can harness to achieve a goal is truly amazing.

101766.name: A Legend of Sword (VI)
101766.desc: "In essence, the great battle in space is no different from the armed conflict between commoners which took place ten years ago on that barren planet..." Soon, the name of that man shall be known across the Galaxy, matching that of the Emperor.

101767.name: Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power
101767.desc: A popular light novel in Inazuma which tells the story of a mere mortal suddenly turning into the Raiden Shogun. The story is well-received for its novel plot and has inspired many light novelists.

101768.name: Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?
101768.desc: A popular light novel in Inazuma which tells the story of the "good-for-nothing" Shogun and the "good-at-everything" Kitsune Guuji. The novel is in the same collection as "Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power," but not by the same author. What they share in common, however, is their popularity.

101769.name: Let's Go, Dodoco!
101769.desc: Message From the Editor: "Let's Go, Dodoco!" is the combined work of an older girl and a younger girl. Every chapter brims with their gentleness and good wishes, as the story is intended as a gift to our readers. I hope this book — in spite of its small volume — can bring you some simple joy after a long day of work.

101770.name: Ako's Treasure: Location 1
101770.desc: Before Ako Domeki and company left, they had hidden a treasure here and agreed to unearth it when they met in the archipelago again. The secret of where the treasure is was split into four parts, and this is the first part.

101771.name: Ako's Treasure: Location 2
101771.desc: Before Ako Domeki and company left, they had hidden a treasure here and agreed to unearth it when they met in the archipelago again. The secret of where the treasure is was split into four parts, and this is the second part.

101772.name: Ako's Treasure: Location 3
101772.desc: Before Ako Domeki and company left, they had hidden a treasure here and agreed to unearth it when they met in the archipelago again. The secret of where the treasure is was split into four parts, and this is the third part.

101773.name: Ako's Treasure: Location 4
101773.desc: Before Ako Domeki and company left, they had hidden a treasure here and agreed to unearth it when they met in the archipelago again. The secret of where the treasure is was split into four parts, and this is the fourth part.

101774.name: Yajna Grass
101774.desc: One of the ingredients for making the elixir Arahaoma. "Yajna" is said to mean "the realization of death."

101775.name: Zohrah Mushroom
101775.desc: One of the ingredients for making the elixir Arahaoma. "Zohrah" is said to mean "lost in a tipsy dream."

101776.name: Barsam Flower
101776.desc: One of the ingredients for making the elixir Arahaoma. "Barsam" is said to be a sacred tree that has long vanished in history.

101779.name: Arahaoma
101779.desc: An elixir of Aranara. A mere drop of it is all it takes to unveil Aranara's pure and pristine dreams to the forest.

101780.name: "Mushounin" Script
101780.desc: A new film script that Xavier finished overnight, much thicker than his last one. What you have here merely contains Acts I and II.\nThe willpower one can harness to achieve a goal is truly amazing.

101781.name: "Mushounin" Script
101781.desc: A new film script that Xavier finished overnight, much thicker than his last one.\nThe willpower one can harness to achieve a goal is truly amazing.

101782.name: Jinwu's Soup
101782.desc: A thick soup that Jinwu made for sick miners. It's nutritious, fragrant, and makes you feel warm inside when you drink it.\nDon't let it go cold, now.

101795.name: Bag of Ornaments
101795.desc: A bag of decorations that Old Chou gave you as compensation for Tang Wuchou's misfortunes. They are very roughly made, owing to having been manufactured by the Treasure Hoarders within The Chasm using smuggled ore, and can barely be considered to possess any aesthetic qualities at all. As such, there is no hope at all of them selling well in Liyue. The only thing good you could say about these ornaments is that they are at least made using the right materials...

101796.name: Vasmrti
101796.desc: An item you obtained after traversing the nursery. It is translucent and seems to contain the memories of the earth.

101797.name: Let's Go, Dodoco!
101797.desc: Message From the Editor: "Let's Go, Dodoco!" is the combined work of an older girl and a younger girl. Every chapter brims with their gentleness and good wishes, as the story is intended as a gift to our readers. I hope this book — in spite of its small volume — can bring you some simple joy after a long day of work.

101798.name: Sea Route Log
101798.desc: A log indicating how to find the clues, left by the ones who hid them. If you navigate as it directs, you may indeed find a clue regarding the treasure left by Ako Domeki and company.

101799.name: Route Log: I
101799.desc: A log indicating how to find the clues, left by the ones who hid them. If you proceed as it directs, you may indeed find a clue regarding the treasure left by Ako Domeki and company.

101800.name: Route Log: II
101800.desc: A log indicating how to find the clues, left by the ones who hid them. If you proceed as it directs, you may indeed find a clue regarding the treasure left by Ako Domeki and company. Still, this is, what, the second log you've found already? Hopefully, it can lead you directly to the clue this time.

101801.name: Asterism Shard
101801.desc: A mysterious shard engraved with a pattern of stars. It seems to be the key to solving a certain mechanism puzzle somewhere.

101802.name: Asterism Shard
101802.desc: A mysterious shard engraved with a pattern of stars. It seems to be the key to solving a certain mechanism puzzle somewhere.

101803.desc: A mysterious shard engraved with a pattern of stars. It seems to be the key to solving a certain mechanism puzzle somewhere.
