101807.desc: A mysterious shard engraved with a pattern of stars. It seems to be the key to solving a certain mechanism puzzle somewhere.

101808.name: Asterism Shard
101808.desc: A mysterious shard engraved with a pattern of stars. It seems to be the key to solving a certain mechanism puzzle somewhere.

101809.name: Vasoma Fruit
101809.desc: A fruit with mysterious powers.\nBija is indispensable for helping Rana, and the Vasoma Fruit is indispensable for obtaining Bija.

101811.name: Garland
101811.desc:
A garland woven by Arama.
Garlands of this kind represent the blessings from all of Vanarana and once channeled endless powers during the fight with Marana's Avatar. But their blazing light has now faded, perhaps because they burned so relentlessly.

Every flower on the garland is connected with the lovely, tiny heart of an Aranara, and all of them together constitute the gate to Mahavanaranapna. Aranara will support those who wear such garlands. As friends, they ease the wearers' pains, ward off their nightmares, aid them through lightless days, and fill the emptiness in their hearts.

101812.name: Garland
101812.desc: A garland woven by Arama.\nGarlands of this kind represent the blessings from all of Vanarana.

101813.name: Bija
101813.desc: The crystallization of what is most precious to Aranara. It is not only a fruit but also a seed of hope.

101814.name: Arana's Flower
101814.desc: A flower gifted to you by Arana.\nYou promised Arana that the evil shall be punished.

101815.name: Araja's Flower
101815.desc: A flower gifted to you by Araja.\nAraja seems to have lost important memories.

101816.name: Nameless Flower
101816.desc: A flower gifted to you by an unknown Aranara.\nA symbol of Aranara friendship. One who receives this flower willingly recognizes this friendship.

101817.name: Arapandu's Flower
101817.desc: A flower gifted to you by Arapandu.\nCan power the Varuna Contraption and adjust the amount of water contained within the earth, thus breathing new life into the forest.

101818.name: Arakunti's Flower
101818.desc: A flower gifted to you by Arakunti.\nHappy moments spent with friends are like Nilotpala Lotuses in the water.

101819.name: Aranakula's Flower
101819.desc: A flower gifted to you by Aranakula.\nFearful though Aranakula was, this little creature still ventured into the Fungus-infested forest to tend to "the Memory of Stone."

101820.name: Arabalika's Flower
101820.desc: A flower gifted to you by Arabalika.\nIt seems to contain the power to destroy a Ruin Guard with one strike.

101821.name: Aranaga's Flower
101821.desc: A flower gifted to you by Aranaga.\n"Season of rain returns, plants rejoice... The pomegranate sings, the apples clap."

101822.name: Aranakin's Flower
101822.desc: A flower gifted to you by Aranakin.\n"Wind that doesn't return, water that doesn't flow backwards... Sweet dreams and bitter aftertastes."

101823.name: Aragaru's Flower
101823.desc: A flower gifted to you by Aragaru.\n"Old leaves, swollen fruit... Drifted dreams, fallen flowers."

101824.name: Ararycan's Flower
101824.desc: A flower gifted to you by Ararycan.\nThere is neither soil nor water inside the Ruin Golem. It must be a nightmarish place for Ararycan.

101825.name: Araesha's Flower
101825.desc: A flower gifted to you by Araesha.\nThe biggest mystery is perhaps why Araesha describes the riddles as being "delicious"... Is it because they are all about food?

101826.name: Arakara's Flower
101826.desc: A flower gifted to you by Arakara.\nFor Arakara, who nurtures Viparyas, flowers given to friends must be most precious indeed.

101827.name: The Siblings' Flowers
101827.desc: Flowers gifted by Arapacati and her brothers.\nLonging to be connected as "siblings" are, these Aranara have each taken on the role of sister or brother. Their obsession with cooking stems from the wish to share food with family.\nThat being said, an Aranara's tastebuds are not to be trusted.

101828.name: The Song Gatherers' Flowers
101828.desc: Flowers gifted to you by the Song Gatherers.\n"No matter how dark the sky and land get, as long as your spirit emits warm, golden light like the sun, there will always be hope."

101829.name: Aralila and Aranishat's Flowers
101829.desc: Flowers gifted by Aralila and Aranishat.\nWe ourselves are the strongest. Of that, there is no doubt!

101830.name: Arakanta's Flower
101830.desc: A flower gifted by Arakanta.\nArakanta used to love hanging out with Rishboland Tigers. But now, he has created a new game for his Nara friend.

101832.name: Stories of You and the Aranara
101832.desc: So many wonderful things transpired during your adventures with the Aranara. In the world of the Aranara where stories are highly valued, maybe someone is willing to "exchange" these with you.

101833.name: "Emergency Adjustment Plan"
101833.desc: This map was contained within the plans that a Fatuus named Oleg accidentally dropped. All the encampment positions and Fatui patrol routes have been marked out here.

101834.name: Asterism Shard
101834.desc: A mysterious shard engraved with a pattern of stars. It seems to be the key to solving a certain mechanism puzzle somewhere.

101835.name: Key
101835.desc: A key that you found near the mysterious plant. This may be used to open a certain door in a high-up location within Xinyan's Mirage.

101836.name: Bottle of Spring Water
101836.desc: A bottle of spring water. The Glacial Spring Water that Blazing Heart desires should be stored within.

101837.name: Frozen Soul's Petal
101837.desc: An uncanny petal. At first glance, it seems like ice molded into the shape of a petal, but it is quite soft to the touch.\n"Plant my petal at the ending point of the intersection of melodies, and what had once sunk into the earth will re-emerge with the music."\nThat's what Frozen Soul said.

101840.name: Rock Garden Rough Stone (Left)
101840.desc: Mountain rocks. They look suited in all ways to be used as base materials from which to carve rocks for the bonsai's left side.

101841.name: Rock Garden Rough Stone (Right)
101841.desc: Mountain rocks. They look suited in all ways to be used as base materials from which to carve rocks for the bonsai's right side.

101842.name: Rock Garden Carving Tools
101842.desc: Carving tools that you found on the Mondstadt-style mountains. You might be able to use them to carve the base materials you have into a rock garden.

101843.name: Rock Garden Carving Tools
101843.desc: Carving tools that you found on the Inazuma-style mountains. You might be able to use them to carve the base materials you have into a rock garden.

101847.name: Small Gear
101847.desc: A small gear. No matter how small a gear is, it can be of use sometime, perhaps?

101848.name: Medium Gear
101848.desc: A medium gear. "The pivotal one," as we call it.

101849.name: Drive Gear
101849.desc: A gear that can transmit a measure of force. After all, momentum is key.

101850.name: Large Gear
101850.desc: A large gear. Its weight and the noise it emits will make an impression for sure.

101851.name: Duplex Gear
101851.desc: A rather small duplex gear. Double the flanks, double the labor hours.

101852.name: Large Duplex Gear
101852.desc: A fairly large duplex gear. The bigger the size is, the more it takes to manufacture.

101853.name: Driven Gear
101853.desc: A gear that requires power to rotate. It can be very helpful. Really. Can someone help rotate it, please?

101854.name: Leisurely Rocks: Left
101854.desc: Slightly soft bonsai rocks. They seem to be able to summon a leisurely and comfy breeze. These can be placed on the left side of the bonsai.

101855.name: Leisurely Rocks: Right
101855.desc: Slightly soft bonsai rocks. They seem to be able to summon a leisurely and comfy breeze. These can be placed on the right side of the bonsai.

101856.name: Hoverlight Rocks: Left
101856.desc: Rocks of moderate hardness. It is said that a glimmer will dance across the surface of these rocks during stormy weather. These can be placed on the left side of the bonsai.

101857.name: Hoverlight Rocks: Right
101857.desc: Bonsai rocks of moderate hardness. It is said that a glimmer will dance across the surface of these rocks during stormy weather. These can be placed on the right side of the bonsai.

101858.name: Unyielding Rocks: Left
101858.desc: Very hard bonsai rocks that have an air of firmness to them. These can be placed on the left side of the bonsai.

101859.name: Unyielding Rocks: Right
101859.desc: Very hard bonsai rocks that have an air of firmness to them. These can be placed on the right side of the bonsai.

101860.name: Living Spring
101860.desc: Water obtained from the source of the rivers flowing across Apam Woods. According to Arapas, soup made from such spring water is a Supreme Delicacy. But one wonders if it really is any different from ordinary water...

101861.name: A Box of Components
101861.desc: A box full of components. They all look quite intact, perhaps because monsters have no interest in them...

101862.name: Note of Unknown Origin: I
101862.desc: You found this note in the mysterious space. Its content seems similar to that of a journal.

101863.name: Note of Unknown Origin: II
101863.desc: You found this note in the mysterious space. Its content seems similar to that of a journal.

101864.name: Note of Unknown Origin: III
101864.desc: You found this note in the mysterious space. Its content seems similar to that of a journal.

101865.name: Note of Unknown Origin: IV
101865.desc: You found this note in the mysterious space. Its content seems similar to that of a journal.

101866.name: A Note
101866.desc: A wrinkled note with horrendously slanted handwriting.

101867.name: Redemption Voucher 1
101867.desc: Used to redeem Mirrorpool Horned Owl: Turning

101868.name: Redemption Voucher 2
101868.desc: Used to redeem Mirrorpool Horned Owl: Dancing

101869.name: Redemption Voucher 3
101869.desc: Used to redeem Mirrorpool Horned Owl: Air Time

101870.name: Redemption Voucher 4
101870.desc: Used to redeem Thundering Horned Owl: Turning

101871.name: Redemption Voucher 5
101871.desc: Used to redeem Thundering Horned Owl: Dancing

101872.name: Redemption Voucher 6
101872.desc: Used to redeem Thundering Horned Owl: Air Time

101873.name: Redemption Voucher 7
101873.desc: Used to redeem Flowfire Horned Owl: Turning

101874.name: Redemption Voucher 8
101874.desc: Used to redeem Flowfire Horned Owl: Dancing

101875.name: Redemption Voucher 9
101875.desc: Used to redeem Flowfire Horned Owl: Air Time

101876.name: Redemption Voucher 10
101876.desc: Used to redeem Traveling Horned Owl

101877.name: Redemption Voucher 11
101877.desc: Used to redeem Mirrorpool Triped: Tipping

101878.name: Redemption Voucher 12
101878.desc: Used to redeem Mirrorpool Triped: Jiggy

101879.name: Redemption Voucher 13
101879.desc: Used to redeem Mirrorpool Triped: Sitting

101880.name: Redemption Voucher 14
101880.desc: Used to redeem Thundering Triped: Tipping

101881.name: Redemption Voucher 15
101881.desc: Used to redeem Thundering Triped: Jiggy

101882.name: Redemption Voucher 16
101882.desc: Used to redeem Thundering Triped: Sitting

101883.name: Redemption Voucher 17
101883.desc: Used to redeem Flowfire Triped: Tipping

101884.name: Redemption Voucher 18
101884.desc: Used to redeem Flowfire Triped: Jiggy

101885.name: Redemption Voucher 19
101885.desc: Used to redeem Flowfire Triped: Sitting

101887.name: Part: Breeze
101887.desc: A part of the "Evermotion Mechanical Painting" that Félix Yogue is trying to restore.

101888.name: Part: Sky
101888.desc: A part of the "Evermotion Mechanical Painting" that Félix Yogue is trying to restore.

101889.name: Part: Clouds
101889.desc: A part of the "Evermotion Mechanical Painting" that Félix Yogue is trying to restore.

101890.name: Part: Company
101890.desc: A part of the "Evermotion Mechanical Painting" that Félix Yogue is trying to restore.

101891.name: Part: Lonely
101891.desc: A part of the "Evermotion Mechanical Painting" that Félix Yogue is trying to restore.

101892.name: Part: Meadow
101892.desc: A part of the "Evermotion Mechanical Painting" that Félix Yogue is trying to restore.

101893.name: Forensic Office Research Log Excerpt
101893.desc: A research log excerpt with plenty of crinkles. The handwriting is still very much legible.

101894.name: Note of Unknown Origin
101894.desc: You found this note in the mysterious space. Its content seems similar to that of a journal.

101896.name: Crystalline Core
101896.desc: The crystalline core component that was missing from the curious Fatui machine. According to Persikov's manuscript, the machine can be restarted if three such cores are found and inserted into the device.

101897.name: Crystalline Core
101897.desc: The crystalline core component that was missing from the curious Fatui machine. According to Persikov's manuscript, the machine can be restarted if three such cores are found and inserted into the device.

101898.name: Crystalline Core
101898.desc: The crystalline core component that was missing from the curious Fatui machine. According to Persikov's manuscript, the machine can be restarted if three such cores are found and inserted into the device.

101902.name: Reverberating Key
101902.desc: A key related to a certain mysterious plant. It seems to be able to open some door somewhere...

101903.name: A New Letter
101903.desc: A letter the head housemaid, Adelinde, just received. It needs to be sent to Dawn Winery for archiving.\nThe paper is slightly wrinkled. Maybe the person who wrote the letter was in a hurry and couldn't find a desk.

101904.name: Dawn Winery's Top-Quality Grape Juice
101904.desc: A gift from Diluc. A bottle of grape juice with luxury packaging. It is something Paimon has long been looking forward to, but more so a memento of the time when you and your friends handled the crisis together.\nIt is also Diluc's personal favorite, produced using only Dawn Winery's best quality grapes.\nBeing "Master Diluc's favorite grape juice" seems to have inestimable commercial value...

101905.name: Slime Condensate-Soaked Soil
101905.desc: Soil soaked with Slime Condensate. What will Akim use this sticky stuff for?

101906.name: Whopperflower Root Soil
101906.desc: Soil collected from Whopperflower roots. What will Akim use it for?

101907.name: Moist Soil
101907.desc: Moist soil collected from the bottom of rocks. What will Akim use it for?

101908.name: Starlight Coalescence
101908.desc: A translucent crystal that seems to hold coalescent starlight within it. This item seems to be key to solving a certain mechanism puzzle somewhere.

101909.name: Dragonspine Supplies: Ham
101909.desc: Ham meant to be used for resupply. It will keep longer in low-temperature conditions.

101910.name: Nightwatch Contract
101910.desc: A contract penned and signed personally by the Prinzessin der Verurteilung herself. It may be used to authorize the opening of navigational sites. Those who should produce this letter of warrant shall be authorized forthwith to spread their black feathers where dawn meets dusk, and envelop the skies in night's own embrace.

101911.name: Special "Concresoil" for Toys
101911.desc: Special "Concresoil" Akim made for Nima. What kind of pot warriors will Nima make with it?

101913.name: Whopperflower Root Soil
101913.desc: Soil collected from Whopperflower roots. What will Akim use it for?

101914.name: Fertile Soil (Reportedly)
101914.desc: You can't tell whether this soil is fertile or not.\nWhat will Akim use this for?

101915.name: Discarded "Concresoil"
101915.desc: "Concresoil" of poor quality. It looks to be in terrible condition...

101916.name: Tenryou Commission's Missing Person Poster
101916.desc: An official missing person poster with the Tenryou Commission's symbol on it.

101917.name: Sea Salt-Crusted Key
101917.desc: A key found in the Golden Apple Archipelago, seemingly able to open a lock somewhere...

101919.name: Special Bird Egg
101919.desc: A bird egg needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. This special egg was collected from a specific tree, but it does not look particularly special.

101920.name: Special Mushroom
101920.desc: A mushroom needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. For some reason, mushrooms of this kind hold some appeal for monsters such that they would willingly collect them...

101921.name: Special Mint
101921.desc: Mint needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. For some reason, mints of this kind hold some appeal for monsters such that they would willingly collect them...

101922.name: Special Harra Fruit
101922.desc: Harra Fruit needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. For some reason, Harra Fruits of this kind hold some appeal for monsters such that they would willingly collect them...

101923.name: Special Sweet Flower
101923.desc: Sweet Flower needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. For some reason, Sweet Flowers of this kind hold some appeal for monsters such that they would willingly collect them...

101925.name: Box Lunch from Tighnari
101925.desc: Emergency food that Tighnari prepared for Haypasia. Paimon took a peek into the lunchbox, finding some traditional Sumeru delicacies that looked very tasty inside.

101926.name: Letter to Haypasia
101926.desc: A letter from Tighnari to Haypasia. In the letter, Tighnari explains your identity and situation after coming to Sumeru and requests that Haypasia help clear up your doubts.

101927.name: Box Lunch from the Traveler
101927.desc: Food that you have specifically prepared for Haypasia. The box contains Sweet Madame and Radish Veggie Soup. You hope Haypasia will like it.

101928.name: Tighnari's Introduction Letter
101928.desc: A letter from Tighnari to Rohawi, a researcher from Amurta. In the letter, Tighnari requests that Rohawi use his prowess in collecting information to help you.\nRohawi's address in Sumeru City is also attached therein.

101929.name: Bag of Transaction Funds
101929.desc: A bag of Mora given by Alhaitham for purchasing Canned Knowledge. You can feel the heavy weight of the bag.

101930.name: Package of Canned Knowledge
101930.desc: Canned Knowledge purchased at Dori's booth with the Mora given to you by Alhaitham. Packaged as common commodities to keep it low-key.

101931.name: Canned Knowledge "Swordfighting Techniques VIII"
101931.desc: Canned Knowledge labeled "Swordfighting Techniques VIII." It was bought from Dori's booth at the price of 100,000 Mora at Paimon's instigation. You have no idea where the first seven in the series are, but things like "Combat Techniques" will always be useful. Well, probably.

101932.name: Bag of Intel Transaction Funds
101932.desc: A bag of Mora provided by Alhaitham for buying the intel on the whereabouts of the Divine Knowledge Capsule.

101933.name: Picture of the Transaction
101933.desc: A picture of a scene where the "Divine Knowledge Capsule" is being traded.\nIn the picture, there is Mizri, the leader of Ayn Al-Ahmar, and the Divine Knowledge Capsule giving off a red glow in his hand.

101934.name: Informant Code Chart
101934.desc: A code chart given to you by Alhaitham. Seems like whoever seeks to purchase "special commodities" from Dori has to provide the right code first.\nCheck this code chart before visiting Dori's contact, just in case.

101935.name: Misplaced Conch 1
101935.desc: This Imaging Conch should have been placed somewhere else but was abandoned here by someone, causing it to project images out of their proper order. Return it to its rightful place, and who knows what you might find...

101936.name: Misplaced Conch 2
101936.desc: This Imaging Conch should have been placed somewhere else but was abandoned here by someone, causing it to project images out of their proper order. Return it to its rightful place, and who knows what you might find...

101937.name: Misplaced Conch 3
101937.desc: This Imaging Conch should have been placed somewhere else but was abandoned here by someone, causing it to project images out of their proper order. Return it to its rightful place, and who knows what you might find...

101938.name: Prescription Medication from Bimarstan for Gurgen
101938.desc: Medication prescribed for Gurgen. It should be taken along with abundant rest.

101939.name: Prescription Medication from Bimarstan for Azra
101939.desc: Medication prescribed for Azra. It smells incredibly bitter.

101940.name: Prescription Medication from Bimarstan for Aftab
101940.desc: Medication prescribed for Aftab. Taker of this medication needs to practice a bland diet.

101941.name: Fresh Harra Fruit
101941.desc: Harra Fruit needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. For some reason, Harra Fruits of this kind have an appeal to monsters. They would often linger around areas where these Harra Fruits are...

101942.name: Fresh Zaytun Peach
101942.desc: A special Zaytun Peach needed for making Angler Kayvan's special bait. It seems nothing different than a regular Zaytun Peach.

101944.name: "The Best Water"
101944.desc: Water collected in Vanarana, clear, cold, and refreshing — a leaf falling on top of it would look as if floating in the air. This is transparent water of extraordinary quality.

101945.name: Silver Pocket Watch
101945.desc: This is certainly not a new pocket watch. But you can tell that it has been carefully polished, evidence of how much the owner really cares about it. Inside is a photograph centering on a young girl from Snezhnaya.

101946.name: Old Insignia
101946.desc: This looks like a Fatui insignia, but it's all scratched up somehow.

101947.name: Fresh Slime Condensate
101947.desc: Slime Condensate that looks really fresh. Who knows what Garcia needs it for...

101948.name: Sareh's Note
101948.desc: This time, we are looking for a kitten named Lale with black and white fur. If you wish to call for Lale's attention in cat language, you need to say "Meow, meow meow meow, meeeeow!" with the tone going downward then upward, before ending on an even higher note.

101949.name: Sareh's Note
101949.desc: This time, we are looking for a kitten named Nargis with dark-gray fur. To call for Nargis's attention in cat language, you need to say "Meow! Meow meow, meow." Stress the first meow, and be quick while saying the following meows.

101950.name: Sareh's Note
101950.desc: This time, we are looking for a kitten named Rozan with gray and black stripes. To call for its attention in cat language, you should say "Meow meow meow, meow meow meow." Say it quickly with no elongation.

101951.name: Fresh Nilotpala Lotus
101951.desc: Flowers that grow in wetlands in the forest and bloom at night. Their fresh petals are important ingredients for the treatment of Eleazar.

101952.name: Rose Sprout
101952.desc: A flower sprouting in the faded Withering Zone, tender yet tough.

101953.name: Eagle Feather of The Brave
101953.desc: The brave young ones known as Javans are said to have this tough eagle feather as their symbol.

101954.name: Florescent Talisman
101954.desc: A talisman woven with childish skills. Its meaning remains unknown. The Dendro energy in it keeps the flower fresh for a long time. But apart from that, there is nothing special about this talisman.

101955.name: Freshly-Picked Mushroom
101955.desc: Mushrooms collected at the location designated by Hanbei. Although these mushrooms grow on tree trunks, they don't look special at all. They aren't going to cause any trouble, are they?

101956.name: Strange Sumeru Rose
101956.desc: A Sumeru Rose affected by the Ley Lines. It seems a little different from normal...

101957.name: Riddle Note
101957.desc:
"A mirror not made of glass reflects every drama."
Another riddle you got from the chest indicated by the previous riddle.
Who wrote these riddles...
Maybe the answer is hidden somewhere associated with dramas?

101958.name: Riddle Note
101958.desc: "The sole path to knowledge."\nA riddle that is surprisingly straightforward to read.\nBut what does "the sole path" mean in this case?

101959.name: Riddle Note
101959.desc: "The flowers in the pond are blooming, with watery pearls there lingering."\nThe third riddle found from a chest.\nPerhaps this might be some kind of plant?

101960.name: Riddle Note
101960.desc: "Please go to the front door of the Temple of Knowledge at noon."\nThis riddle is like some kind of "invitation"...

101961.name: Rafiq's Shipbuilding Materials
101961.desc: Shipbuilding materials Rafiq bought. You've heard that these have cost him a fortune...

101962.name: Little Dried Flower
101962.desc: It looks like an ordinary little dried flower, but it was once a precious gift. It deserves to be cherished, just like the forgotten friendship of the past.

101963.name: Activated·Canned Knowledge
101963.desc: Canned Knowledge labeled "Swordfighting Techniques VIII." It was bought from Dori's booth at the price of 100,000 Mora at Paimon's instigation. You have no idea where the first seven in the series are, but things like "Combat Techniques" will always be useful. Well, probably.

101964.name: Persikov's Manuscript
101964.desc: Notes penned by the Fatui researcher Persikov. These notes contain a map, and if you follow its instructions, you should be able to find the crystalline cores that the Cognitive Mimicry device is missing...

101965.name: Normal Wood
101965.desc: Viktor bought this. He claims that he'll use it to do wood carving.

101966.name: Fatui Meal
101966.desc: A meal box containing two Panipuri. Viktor and Vsevolod should be a little hungry by now...

101967.name: Treasure Map in a Box
101967.desc: A treasure map placed at the bottom of a box. It indicates the location of the "good stuff" with simple markings.

101968.name: Glinting Component
101968.desc: A piece of the Primal Construct that barred your path. This component seems to be reacting with nearby devices, constantly gleaming and glinting as it does.

101969.name: Sacred Seal: Valley
101969.desc: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? Either way, researchers believe this symbol to have initially stood for "valley."

101970.name: Sacred Seal: Bird Head
101970.desc: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? Most believe the etchings here symbolize a bird's head.

101971.name: Sacred Seal: Raised Arm
101971.desc: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? Either way, researchers believe this symbol to have been a phonetic symbol, and that its extended meanings may have included respect or submission.

101972.name: Sacred Seal: Sandstorm
101972.desc: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The shape of this symbol should be derived from the storms that ravage the desert.

101973.name: Sacred Seal: Auricle
101973.desc: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The symbol on this plate looks like an auricle, but a consensus has not been reached on this matter.

101974.name: Sacred Seal: Forest
101974.desc: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? A majority of researchers believe this to represent the forest, and that this suggests that the modern-day desert was not always a desolate wasteland.

101975.name: Sacred Seal: Thunderstrike
101975.desc: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The shape of this symbol should be derived from the lightning that is ever so rare a sight in the desert.

101976.name: Sacred Seal: Danger
101976.desc: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The symbol seems to indicate the hazardous circumstance of hanging a chisel hammer on a cliff, and is thought to have emerged at a later date.

101977.name: Sacred Seal: Chisel Hammer
101977.desc: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The symbol for a chisel hammer is one of the earliest words to emerge.

101978.name: Sacred Seal: Sunrise
101978.desc: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The origin of this symbol is the rising sun.

101979.name: Sacred Seal: Right to Rule
101979.desc: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? This symbol is the spitting image of a ruler seated upon a throne.

101980.name: Sacred Seal: Sheep Head
101980.desc: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building, though the origin of this writing seems unclear. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? Most believe that the etchings here symbolize a sheep's head.

101981.name: Sacred Seal: Crocodile Head
101981.desc: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The source of this symbol is probably the Spinocrocodile's frighteningly huge maw.

101982.name: Sacred Seal: Giant Serpent
101982.desc: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? Though Haravatat researchers believe this to be a symbol for a giant serpent, Amurta researchers have proposed a different view, arguing that the Great Red Sand is not home to any snakes. As such, the meaning of and inspiration for this word is still being contested.

101983.name: Sacred Seal: Ceremony
101983.desc: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The original meaning of this symbol was most likely "sacrifice," with an extended meaning of "rites" or "ceremonies" emerging later.

101984.name: Sacred Seal: Labor
101984.desc: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The symbol here appeared at the same time as the chisel hammer, and is one of the earliest words to emerge.

101985.name: Sacred Seal: Dune
101985.desc: A stone plate with ancient text on it that seems to have once been part of a certain building. The desert sands play host to many an unknown wish. Who made them, and who carries them now? The civilization from the era of King Deshret had different words for dunes of different shapes, something that has brought researchers no lack of headaches.

101987.name: Golden Rose Seeds
101987.desc: Compared to Sumeru Roses, Golden Roses are a unique species more suited to the deserts. To survive, it has had to protect itself with a shield of mud and stone, but in the right environment, it may yet recoup its original beauty.

101988.name: Transparent Ruins Record (I)
101988.desc: A stone slate that you found in the transparent ruins near the Mausoleum of King Deshret. This seems to be a record left by a lost civilization.

101989.name: Record of Lamb-Devourer Rock
101989.desc: A stone slate that you found in the secret Eremite base within Lamb-Devourer Rock. This seems to be a record left by a lost civilization.

101990.name: Record of the Tomb of Carouses
101990.desc: A stone slate that you found in the Tomb of Carouses. This seems to be a record left by a lost civilization.

101991.name: Soheil's Old Notes
101991.desc: These are the notes left by Soheil, an Akademiya researcher, who entered the desert to study when he was young. They look very old, but they are not crinkled.

101992.name: Record of Aaru's Shut
101992.desc: A stone slate that you found at the highest point of the Mausoleum of King Deshret. This seems to be a record left by a lost civilization.

101993.name: Twilight Theater Head's Notes
101993.desc: The script for "Drama Phantasmagoria: Tale of the Sword-Wielding Princess!" The meandering scribbles appended to the script seem to be annotations from the theater troupe head, some of which contain such radical instructions as to render their adoption unlikely in the extreme.

101994.name: Freshly-Picked Harra Fruit
101994.desc: A freshly picked Harra Fruit. Perfect for cooking.

101995.name: Unsigned Note
101995.desc: An unsigned note. No one knows who left it...

101997.name: Remelting Device
101997.desc: This device, developed by alchemist Hajanad, is cleverly designed with an internal chamber capable of withstanding high pressure and high temperature to withstand the explosion from the "remelting effect". The special valve can be opened automatically at the right time to release the fully mixed medicament smoke and provide the user with assistance in combat. However, judging from some of its details, this experiment seems to be suffering from a shortage of funds. Hajanad's research doesn't seem to be all that well-funded...

101998.name: Remelting Tablet
101998.desc: A masterpiece of the alchemist Hajanad, a truly special solid potion. Theoretically, this alchemy tablet can be stored for a long time and is quite safe and easy to carry and transport. However, when in use, the tablet needs to be put into the "remelting device," where the two solid agents will be mixed via micro-explosion to obtain complete efficacy.\nAnd it is always a little disturbing to think that the device in hand may explode...

102001.name: Pyro Shard
102001.desc: A shard that broke off a larger Pyro Crystal. Gives 50 Pyro Energy when absorbed.
102001.effect: Gives 50 Pyro Energy to all party members

102002.name: Hydro Shard
102002.desc: A shard that broke off a larger Hydro Crystal. Gives 50 Hydro Energy when absorbed.
102002.effect: Gives 50 Hydro Energy to all party members

102003.name: Dendro Shard
102003.desc: A shard that broke off a larger Dendro Crystal. Gives 50 Dendro Energy when absorbed.
102003.effect: Gives 50 Dendro Energy to all party members

102004.name: Electro Shard
102004.desc: A shard that broke off a larger Electro Crystal. Gives 50 Electro Energy when absorbed.
102004.effect: Gives 50 Electro Energy to all party members

102005.name: Anemo Shard
102005.desc: A shard that broke off a larger Anemo Crystal. Gives 50 Anemo Energy when absorbed.
102005.effect: Gives 50 Anemo Energy to all party members

102006.name: Cryo Shard
102006.desc: A shard that broke off a larger Cryo Crystal. Gives 50 Cryo Energy when absorbed.
102006.effect: Gives 50 Cryo Energy to all party members

102007.name: Geo Shard
102007.desc: A shard that broke off a larger Geo Crystal. Gives 50 Geo Energy when absorbed.
102007.effect: Gives 50 Geo Energy to all party members

102008.name: Primordial Elemental Shard
102008.desc: A shard that broke off a larger Elemental Crystal. Gives 50 Elemental Energy when absorbed.
102008.effect: Gives 50 Elemental Energy to all party members

103001.name: Pyro Jikaka
103001.desc: A fruit taken from a Pyro Jikaka tree. Gives 30 Pyro Energy when eaten.
103001.effect: Gives 30 Pyro Energy to all party members
