104201.name: Dust of Azoth
104201.desc: A device that can transmute elemental Ascension Materials and change their Elemental Type.\nIts practical uses notwithstanding, alchemy is the study of the nature of matter and the rules that underpin its transformations, and ultimately it seeks to comprehend the working principles of the world and the flow of the ley lines.\nIt is not known who would share alchemical achievements of this magnitude with the civilizations of the world and why. But although the power to fundamentally transmute elemental energy in its crystallized and inert form is a highly useful one, this device also conceals the grave danger of disrupting the elemental balance...

104300.name: Masterless Stella Fortuna
104300.desc: A precious material required for raising Ascension Limits.\nA Masterless Stella Fortuna, adrift apart from the flow of fate. It awaits a voice to weave it once more into the song of the world.
source_list: Obtained from To Temper Thyself and Journey Far

104301.name: Teachings of Freedom
104301.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nFreedom is the spirit of the land of the wind.\nThe freedom to live is one of such. It is the freedom to live freely and healthily without concerns of one's own safety.

104302.name: Guide to Freedom
104302.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nFreedom is the spirit of the land of the wind.\nThe freedom of travel is one of such. It is the freedom to traverse the land freely without being obstructed.

104303.name: Philosophies of Freedom
104303.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nFreedom is the spirit of the land of the wind.\nTo sing is one such freedom. To sing on the land created by the Anemo Archon is to send your heart away with the song on the wind.

104304.name: Teachings of Resistance
104304.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nResistance is the backbone of the land of the wind.\nThe history of Mondstadt is one of resistances. People rose up to prevent past conflicts from ever being forgotten, like sprouts breaking through the soil, like the eternal wind eroding through stone walls.

104305.name: Guide to Resistance
104305.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nResistance is the backbone of the city of Wind.\nThe history of Mondstadt is one of resistances. People rose up to grant the citizens of Mondstadt the freedom they now enjoy, like the Anemo Archon blowing away the snow, or like Vennessa rising up to fight.

104306.name: Philosophies of Resistance
104306.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nResistance is the backbone of the land of the wind.\nThe history of Mondstadt is one of resistances. People rose up to allow the future Mondstadt's poetry to freely be that of the wind and be spread across the land.

104307.name: Teachings of Ballad
104307.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nPoetry is the soul of the land of the wind.\nPoetry is the manifestations of beautiful feelings. On a beautiful day, the breezes carry with them poetry that touches the heart of people like the wind caressing the leaves.

104308.name: Guide to Ballad
104308.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nPoetry is the soul of the land of the wind.\nPoetry is the manifestations of the will to encourage. In the dark days, the gales in the streets and alleyways whisper words of fury, like the battle drums, like the low rumbling before the storm.

104309.name: Philosophies of Ballad
104309.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nPoetry is the soul of the land of the wind.\nPoetry is the manifestations of the desire to spread the word. Though nothing is eternal, though nothing will be the same, the wind's poetry will still spread beyond the skies, the land, the seas to every corner of the world.

104310.name: Teachings of Prosperity
104310.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nProsperity is the people's pursuit in the land of Geo.\nProsperity is the blessing of Liyue, it is the foundation of the great city built by the gods and the people of Liyue, and it is the source of the peace and safety of the land.

104311.name: Guide to Prosperity
104311.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nProsperity is the people's pursuit in the land of Geo.\nProsperity is the promise made by Liyue to its children: To repay the hard-working laborers with enough gold to brighten up this land.

104312.name: Philosophies of Prosperity
104312.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nProsperity is the people's pursuit in the land of Geo.\nProsperity is Liyue's past, present, and future. This prosperity is unmatched and unobtainable by any other nations — it all belongs to Liyue and its inhabitants.

104313.name: Teachings of Diligence
104313.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nIndustriousness is the foundation of the land of Geo.\nDiligence is having the bravery and the strength to conquer mountains and seas and to pursue gold and prosperity through honest, hard work.

104314.name: Guide to Diligence
104314.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nIndustriousness is the foundation of the land of Geo.\nIndustriousness is the catalyst that flows in the blood of the people of Liyue, able to turn rocks into gold. It is what lies behind the greatness of its great commercial port.

104315.name: Philosophies of Diligence
104315.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nIndustriousness is the foundation of the land of Geo.\nIndustriousness is believing in one's own ability to earn a place in the land of the gods through sweat, wisdom, and power.

104316.name: Teachings of Gold
104316.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nGold is the symbol of the land of Geo.\nGold is the blood that flows deep within Liyue's veins, the muscle that makes up Liyue's beating heart, and the bones that make Liyue stand proud.

104317.name: Guide to Gold
104317.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nGold is the symbol of the land of Geo.\nGold symbolizes conversion. This is the unspoken understanding between Liyue's mountains, land, city, and people. In Liyue, industriousness is converted into gold, and gold into prosperity.

104318.name: Philosophies of Gold
104318.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nGold is the symbol of the land of Geo.\nGold is the wealth of Liyue, but Liyue's true wealth is the hearts of its people that shine like gold.

104319.name: Crown of Insight
104319.desc: A precious Talent Level-Up material.\nOnce a medium for the storage and transfer of wisdom in ancient times. Now, wisdom is found in ancient texts and in profound speech. Nevertheless, this Crown of Insight must still be able to impart some transcendent power and wisdom to its bearer.

104320.name: Teachings of Transience
104320.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nTransience is the dream of the nation of thunder.\nFleeting glories are the highest expression of mortal beauty, for are we mortals not like the flashing lightning itself? Like a lovely dream or blossoming spark, we shall leave a gorgeous mark on the eternal night sky.

104321.name: Guide to Transience
104321.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nTransience is the dream of the nation of thunder.\nWe find the greatest joys in mortal life in transient dreams, for is life itself not like the shadow of the thunder? Pursue your dreams into the clouds if you wish, and enjoy the unexpected silence of the dim lamp-lit nights.

104322.name: Philosophies of Transience
104322.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nTransience is the dream of the nation of thunder.\nThe fleeting nature of this mortal world is the essence of beauty, for are our lives in this world not akin to the levin flash? Yet the might of the divine comes suddenly, and before the roar of eternity, who can stand?

104323.name: Teachings of Elegance
104323.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nElegance is the form of the nation of thunder.\nElegance brooks no flattery, and the elegant are ever noble. They are like the sea eagles who soar on high to contend with the resounding storms. They will not cater to philistine vulgarity, as one would not cast a flower crown into the mud, staining its dignity.

104324.name: Guide to Elegance
104324.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nElegance is the form of the nation of thunder.\nElegance shuns arrogance. The elegant are ever humble, and only by discarding vanity and sloth may one see clearly — and is there not beauty and loveliness even in the basest of appearances?

104325.name: Philosophies of Elegance
104325.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nElegance is the form of the nation of thunder.\nElegance abhors vulgarity, and the elegant ever walk alone. Resisting base evils, unmoved by base loves, never taking refuge in base ignorance — that is how one perceives the chasm between the elegant and the contemptuous.

104326.name: Teachings of Light
104326.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nLight is the yearning of the land of thunder.\nThe ruler who claims to have perceived all forever aims to hoard celestial glory. But this vision that cannot be shared only leads people to long for it more fiercely, like moths diving into the flame.

104327.name: Guide to Light
104327.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nLight is the yearning of the land of thunder.\nThough the sun rays themselves should be blocked by layers upon layers of clouds, there are still those in the thunder god's land who dream of piercing that wrathful sea of lightning to pursue the glory of the divine, fearing not that they shall be cruelly struck down.

104328.name: Philosophies of Light
104328.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nLight is the yearning of the land of thunder.\nThough they must live forever on the earth, humanity will always reach for the light. Mortals will pursue and surpass, and they will never stop. A sealed eternity may, perhaps, look magnificent, but its essence is death.

104329.name: Teachings of Admonition
104329.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nAdmonition is the branches of the nation of wisdom.\nAdmonition comes from a pure heart. Only sensible words of goodwill can express profound wisdom and free the sprout of knowledge from the shackles of arrogance.

104330.name: Guide to Admonition
104330.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nAdmonition is the branches of the nation of wisdom.\nAdmonition is paired with wise thinking. Careful deliberation affords humble words a clarity that convinces the wise and enlightens the foolish. Such words allow wisdom to flow like an unobstructed river.

104331.name: Philosophies of Admonition
104331.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nAdmonition is the branches of the nation of wisdom.\nAdmonition is completed by good deeds. What is done confers real meaning upon what is said. When one's mind, words, and deeds are aligned, their nourishment shall guarantee the fruition of wisdom's tree.

104332.name: Teachings of Ingenuity
104332.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nIngenuity is the leaf-veins of the nation of wisdom.\nIngenuity springs forth from benevolent consideration. They say that "a poisonous tree bears no kind fruit." Similarly, ingenious nascent ideas are always born from determined and benign minds, for only they are worthy bearers of wisdom.

104333.name: Guide to Ingenuity
104333.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nIngenuity is the leaf-veins of the nation of wisdom. Ingenuity sets words of integrity on the right path. One who thinks out of goodwill and in a clever and careful fashion never deviates from the path of boons. Yet one who thinks with contempt and malice shall taint their words with despicable colors.

104334.name: Philosophies of Ingenuity
104334.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nIngenuity is the leaf-veins of the nation of wisdom.\nIngenuity is completed by harmonious conduct. What is done completes what is thought. Wisdom blooms where the mind, words, and practice converge.

104335.name: Teachings of Praxis
104335.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nPraxes are the roots of the nation of wisdom.\nPraxes stem from an unwavering will. All wisdom is manifested through the unyielding pursuit of goodness. Where goodness is not practiced, ingenuity and eloquence wither.

104336.name: Guide to Praxis
104336.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nPraxes are the roots of the nation of wisdom.\nPraxes validate words of honesty. Though one speaks and acts out of goodwill, one has not yet obtained wisdom. Wisdom, born from action, is a signet pressed upon honest words.

104337.name: Philosophies of Praxis
104337.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nPraxes are the roots of the nation of wisdom.\nPraxes bring forth the fruit of wisdom. Practice grants itself meaning, and it is only by treading a path that unites action, speech, and thought that the wise may reach perfection.

104338.name: Teachings of Equity
104338.desc: Talent Level-Up Material.\nThe shore of the Nation of Water is equity.\nEquity sets boundaries on rights. Without equity, the rights granted by law will be abused, and become a tool to damage our virtuous customs.

104339.name: Guide to Equity
104339.desc: Talent Level-Up Material.\nThe shore of the Nation of Water is equity.\nEquity is the foundation upon which Fontaine was founded. Equity forms the standard of the law. If law loses the essence of equity, it will become a chessboard played for profit.

104340.name: Philosophies of Equity
104340.desc: Talent Level-Up Material.\nThe shore of the Nation of Water is equity.\nEquity is the foundation upon which Fontaine was founded. Equity requires the continuous and steady support of morality and law, and morality and law constantly change based upon the invariant principle of equity.

104341.name: Teachings of Justice
104341.desc: Talent Level-Up Material.\nThe sword of the Nation of Water is justice.\nThe law of Fontaine walks with the sword of justice in hand. Without the guidance of justice, all law is reduced to meaningless words, to be tampered with and slaughtered at a whim.

104342.name: Guide to Justice
104342.desc: Talent Level-Up Material.\nThe sword of the Nation of Water is justice.\nThe law of Fontaine walks with the sword of justice in hand. Justice must be blind, and those who wield the sword of justice must not be led astray by their own interests or affairs.

104343.name: Philosophies of Justice
104343.desc: Talent Level-Up Material.\nThe sword of the Nation of Water is justice.\nThe law of Fontaine walks with the sword of justice in hand. Justice means judgment and reconciliation, the blade of judgment arrests the actions of evil, while reconciliation maintains order.

104344.name: Teachings of Order
104344.desc: Talent Level-Up Material.\nThe shield of the Nation of Water is order.\nAll law in Fontaine ultimately serves to maintain a stable order. Without order, there is chaos, and there can be no fairness in chaos.

104345.name: Guide to Order
104345.desc: Talent Level-Up Material.\nThe shield of the Nation of Water is order.\nAll law in Fontaine ultimately serves to maintain a stable order. Without the guarantee provided by order, justice will be reduced to unlimited violence, a weapon used by all against all.

104346.name: Philosophies of Order
104346.desc: Talent Level-Up Material.\nThe shield of the Nation of Water is order.\nAll law in Fontaine ultimately serves to maintain a stable order. Equity and justice come from order, and serve order. Like the still, ripple-less surface of the waters of Fontaine, order is the cornerstone of Fontaine's existence.

104347.name: Teachings of Contention
104347.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nContention is the principle by which all is weighed in the Nation of Pyro.\nWhat defines strength, and what weakness? Only victory and defeat. The results of a contest are more convincing than any words.

104348.name: Guide to Contention
104348.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nContention is the principle by which all is weighed in the Nation of Pyro.\nThough humans cannot fly at the speed of winged beasts, nor match the flexibility of slimes, yet still, they have their own unique strengths. Sometimes, understanding both why and how to compete is the key to knowing oneself.

104349.name: Philosophies of Contention
104349.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nContention is the principle by which all is weighed in the Nation of Pyro.\nIts purpose is to make yourself stronger. After the outcome of a competition has been decided, the victor gains the confidence to be sure of their direction, while the loser gains insights on how they must become stronger. Beyond winning or losing, this is the true meaning of contention.

104350.name: Teachings of Kindling
104350.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nOffering up kindling is the established rule of the Nation of Pyro.\nFor something gained, something must be given. If you wish to obtain something, you must first pay the corresponding price, just like the offerings that should be made as kindling in the process of incineration.

104351.name: Guide to Kindling
104351.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nOffering up kindling is the established rule of the Nation of Pyro.\nTo acquire a certain amount of something, one must first pay the corresponding price. Sometimes, you may end up paying too much to obtain something; while other times, you may pay too little, and lose it as a result. Understanding how to strike this balance between giving and receiving is one of the meanings of offering kindling.

104352.name: Philosophies of Kindling
104352.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nOffering up kindling is the established rule of the Nation of Pyro.\nWhat is meant by offering kindling is to offer up a sacrifice before one obtains something, though it does not always guarantee a response or return. Its true meaning lies in paying a price without expecting a reward — for in the end, the day when the fruits will be reaped is sure to come.

104353.name: Teachings of Conflict
104353.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nConflict is considered reason in the Nation of Pyro.\nRather than avoiding conflict, one should face confrontations head-on. Once the outcome has been made manifest, the path forward should be determined accordingly.

104354.name: Guide to Conflict
104354.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nConflict is considered reason in the Nation of Pyro.\nConflicts can always be resolved by greater powers. This fact means that they can always be managed, as opposed to developing into something uncontrollable. Conflict is also a kind of limitation, preventing people from endless shirking of responsibilities without weighing the costs. It demands that participants settle their scores decisively and efficiently.

104355.name: Philosophies of Conflict
104355.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\nConflict is considered reason in the Nation of Pyro.\nThe premise of conflict is that all parties involved must confront their own desires with the utmost sincerity. Only then, amid the fight or debate, can they remain mindful of what they wish to achieve and stay true to their original objectives.

104356.name: Teachings of Moonlight
104356.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\n"Moonlight" is the blessing of the land beneath the moon.\nThings come in all sizes, and people come in all states of wisdom. Yet under the moonlight, all are equal.

104357.name: Guide to Moonlight
104357.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\n"Moonlight" is the blessing of the land beneath the moon.\nThe cloud-veiled moonlight glows but faintly over the boundless dark wilds. Yet its fragile glimmer is a guide through the endless night.

104358.name: Philosophies of Moonlight
104358.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\n"Moonlight" is the blessing of the land beneath the moon.\nPraying to the new moon for guidance and fortune is a rite passed down from the days of the first people. Tonight's moonlight seems no different from any other night, yet where is the new moon that people once looked to?

104359.name: Teachings of Elysium
104359.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\n"Elysium" is the dream of the land beneath the moon.\nThere are those who are desperate to get in, and those who are desperate to get out. Perhaps Elysium is not a place one can ever truly reach.

104360.name: Guide to Elysium
104360.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\n"Elysium" is the dream of the land beneath the moon.\nTo create a paradise without borders or distinctions upon a land overflowing with bitterness and sorrow — though it might be but a childish delusion, it may yet be a foundation for the future.

104361.name: Philosophies of Elysium
104361.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\n"Elysium" is the dream of the land beneath the moon.\nSeldom do we share the same dreams of paradise. For those who wish not to settle for the present, there is no greater paradise than Nod-Krai. Yet for all the rest, the truth is quite the opposite.

104362.name: Teachings of Vagrancy
104362.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\n"Vagrancy" is the living of the land beneath the moon.\nEnjoy a moment's respite, then depart before the sky turns black. Dawn is not the end, but the beginning of another journey.

104363.name: Guide to Vagrancy
104363.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\n"Vagrancy" is the living of the land beneath the moon.\nTo live is to wander, for none of us can settle in this world. What is remembered is not the moment of arrival, but the footprints that we leave along the way.

104364.name: Philosophies of Vagrancy
104364.desc: Talent Level-Up material.\n"Vagrancy" is the living of the land beneath the moon.\nThrough thunder and storms, across mountains and snowfields, though scarred and weary, the wanderer does not stop — nor will they till they find a place to call home.

104365.name: Teachings of Charity
104365.desc: Talent Level-Up Material.\nCharity is the salvation of the frozen realm.\nIt is the love and vigilant care shared among mortals. Across this vast and boundless land, it is the warmth by which the people withstand the biting frost, soothing the deep-seated scars etched into their memories.

104366.name: Guide to Charity
104366.desc: Talent Level-Up Material.\nCharity is the salvation of the frozen realm.\nIt breeds mercy for others. In the realm of wind and snow, whosoever sincerely repents for the sins of their soul shall find absolution in the name of Charity.

104367.name: Philosophies of Charity
104367.desc: Talent Level-Up Material.\nCharity is the salvation of the frozen realm.\nIt is a boundless grace extended to all living things. It collapses the divide between the highborn and the low, transcending both bloodline and nation. Its watchful gaze beholds all of humanity, offering sanctuary to the unfortunate and promising eternal liberation unto all.

104368.name: Teachings of Fortitude
104368.desc: Talent Level-Up Material.\nFortitude is the defining character of the frozen realm.\nIt stems from a raw yearning for survival. Even if scattered far from fertile soil, a fragile seed can rely on this desperate longing to drive its roots deep beneath the frozen tundra.

104369.name: Guide to Fortitude
104369.desc: Talent Level-Up Material.\nFortitude is the defining character of the frozen realm.\nIt brings forth the will to grow. Though shattered by the bitter cold, a fragile seed can still harness this will to break through the frozen earth, pushing forth fresh sprouts to life across a landscape blanketed in wind and snow.

104370.name: Philosophies of Fortitude
104370.desc: Talent Level-Up Material.\nFortitude is the defining character of the frozen realm.\nIt breeds the prosperity of life itself. The people here have never bowed to the biting cold, just as a fragile seed defiantly chooses to bloom amidst the blizzards. This civilization has witnessed centuries of bitter winter, yet remains vibrant much like the Frostfairy Flower that flourishes season after season.

104371.name: Teachings of Glory
104371.desc: Talent Level-Up Material.\nGlory is the sacred faith of the frozen realm.\nIt is a spark buried deep beneath the frozen soil; if one can but trace its true form, they shall grant themselves the courage to stand against the biting cold.

104372.name: Guide to Glory
104372.desc: Talent Level-Up Material.\nGlory is the sacred faith of the frozen realm.\nIt is an ember flickering in the deep night, a beacon upon which all who trek across the snowfields fix their gaze. Just as they are certain the blizzards will wane and the dawn will break, they are certain that the path they tread remains the true one.

104373.name: Philosophies of Glory
104373.desc: Talent Level-Up Material.\nGlory is the sacred faith of the frozen realm.\nIt is the undying flame upon the beacon hearth, bound now to live or die with the frozen realm. The flame ignites a noble passion, and to sustain its eternal burn, the people would gladly offer up their all.

105002.name: Sanctifying Unction
105002.desc: Artifact EXP material. Gives 2,500 EXP.\nMaterial that contains the distilled essence of great power. It can contribute to the enhancement of artifacts.

105003.name: Sanctifying Essence
105003.desc: Artifact EXP material. Gives 10,000 EXP.\nArtifacts are themselves the physical manifestation of ideals and memories. Materials such as this, which contain the distilled essence of the power thereof, can make these memories and ideals clearer and stronger still.

105005.name: Sanctifying Elixir
105005.desc: A material that is consumed when defining Artifacts with the Artifact Transmuter.\nArtifacts are themselves the crystallized physical manifestation of ideals and memories. This is one of the applications of the noble art of Alchemy — namely, to preserve ideals by crystallizing them inside the essence of material objects. Only in this way can they be molded according to need.
source_list: Obtained from To Temper Thyself and Journey Far
Obtained from making offerings to the Tablet of Tona
Obtained from Tribal Secret Spaces in Natlan
Obtained from Joint Meeting Point Construction in Nod-Krai

105006.name: Dust of Enlightenment
105006.desc: The power of Artifacts stems from stories. Thus, sacred or profane writings may reshape them.\nThere is no good or evil inherent in stories, while songs and words have the power to save as well as destroy — such was the belief of the emissary who once conveyed revelations on the holiest one's behalf, governing the nations on earth and their glory, and who eventually fell from the high heavens. To this day, whether pure or impure, these feathers can still inscribe false revelations and rewrite fated tales, yet the only outcome of defying the world is to scatter into dust.
source_list: Obtained from To Temper Thyself and Journey Far
Obtained at Kuuhenki's Hidden Trove in Nod-Krai
Obtained from Gnostic Hymn and Gnostic Chorus

106001.name: Test Temporary stamina Growth Item
106001.desc: Test item for increasing max stamina temporarily

107001.name: Anemoculus
107001.desc: A substance that has accumulated intense Anemo energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

107002.name: Elemental Dust
107002.desc: Shattered fragments of the Oculus Crystal. Shows hidden treasure nearby.

107003.name: Geoculus
107003.desc: A substance that has accumulated intense Geo energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

107004.name: Adventure Treasure Pack
107004.desc: Daily highscore reward. Grants 1 random T1 Character Ascension material.

107005.name: Skyrider Greatsword Chest
107005.desc: This chest opens automatically, granting a Skyrider Greatsword.

107006.name: Mondstadt Shrine of Depths Key
107006.desc: A key that can break the seal on the ancient Shrines of Depths scattered around Mondstadt.\nThese Shrines of Depths sealed themselves off when the civilization that built them was lost. Keys lost deep within domains are able to break the seals. Or perhaps that, for a moment, these keys help the seals to forget all that they have lost.

107007.name: Liyue Shrine of Depths Key
107007.desc: A key that can break the seal on the ancient Shrines of Depths scattered around Liyue.\nThese Shrines of Depths sealed themselves off when the civilization that built them was lost. Keys lost deep within domains are able to break the seals. Or perhaps that, for a moment, these keys help the seals to forget all that they have lost.

107008.name: Inazuma Shrine of Depths Key
107008.desc: A key that can break the seal on the ancient Shrines of Depths scattered around Inazuma.\nThese Shrines of Depths sealed themselves off when the civilization that built them was lost. Keys lost deep within domains are able to break the seals. Or perhaps that, for a moment, these keys help the seals to forget all that they have lost.

107009.name: Fragile Resin
107009.desc: An item used to restore Original Resin by 60 points.\nThis crystalline substance pulsates with a little energy that can be absorbed by Original Resin.\nThe flow of energies of all sorts is the source of many wonders and challenges in this world. Those same energies are also contained within this crystal.

107010.name: Crimson Agate
107010.desc: A type of crystal formed from the combination of concentrated life force with an energy unique to Dragonspine. Makes for an ideal nutrient for growing Frostbearing Trees.

107011.name: Crimson Agate (Display)
107011.desc: A type of crystal formed from the combination of concentrated life force with an energy unique to Dragonspine. Makes for an ideal nutrient for growing Frostbearing Trees.

107012.name: Transient Resin
107012.desc:
An item that can be used to replenish Original Resin. Once used, it will replenish 60 Original Resin.
Once obtained, it will <color=#FF5E41CC>automatically dissipate</color> after a period of time.
·The expiration time will be calculated from the Monday after this item is obtained, and it will disappear seven days from then.
·Multiple Transient Resins obtained on different weeks will have their expiration dates counted independently.

Pure energy that will dissipate with time. In this, it is similar to all else that is lovely in this world. But seize this opportunity and go make the world a slightly better place, as is fitting for one who dwells within the bounds of "time."

107013.name: Vial of Adeptal Speed
107013.desc: A small bottle that seals some adeptal energy within. Will immediately complete a furnishing when used.

107014.name: Electroculus
107014.desc: A substance that has accumulated intense Electro energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

107015.name: Moonchase Charm
107015.desc: These jade talismans have been placed in various areas by the Adventurers' Guild. They are made from crystal-clear and gently lustrous Plaustrite Shards. It is said that these talismans contain the essence of the bright white moon and store the reminiscences that people have of festivals past.

107016.name: Lumenspar
107016.desc: A sky-blue crystal that glitters so brightly that it brings forth echoes of the heavens above, which cannot be seen from underground...\nIf you hold it up to your ear, you can almost hear a soft sigh coming from within.\nThis might sound strange, but this crystal also gives off a faint warmth.

107017.name: Dendroculus
107017.desc: A substance that has accumulated intense Dendro energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

107018.name: Sumeru Shrine of Depths Key
107018.desc: A key that can break the seal on the ancient Shrines of Depths scattered around Sumeru.\nThese Shrines of Depths sealed themselves off when the civilization that built them was lost. Keys lost deep within domains are able to break the seals. Or perhaps that, for a moment, these keys help the seals to forget all that they have lost.

107019.name: Blank Dynamic Card
107019.desc: A blank card with a painted back. It is said that if you put the name of your desired dynamic card on this blank card, you can get the very skin from the Association agent located at the tavern.

107020.name: Match Invitation Letter
107020.desc: You can select a player from the Player List via the invitation board, and then entrust The Cat's Tail to send out an invitation using this Invitation Letter. The invited player will head over to the tavern and wait for a duel with you.

107021.name: Lucky Coin
107021.desc: Currency verified and used by the Genius Invokation TCG Society. Can be used to purchase various items related to Genius Invokation TCG. It is said that these coins were initially named as such in the hopes that they would bring those carrying them luck. However, perhaps it is those who are sufficiently lucky who are able to possess them...

107022.name: Plume of Purifying Light
107022.desc: Fragment left by Khvarena. Carrier of past memories.

107023.name: Hydroculus
107023.desc: A substance that has accumulated intense Hydro energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

107024.name: Voucher Box
107024.desc: Box that contains Joyeux Vouchers. They have a unique flower-like shape and can only be found in the Veluriyam Mirage. They are also important collectibles for guests who wish to win rewards. Using the Flowing Joyspar and Felicitous Joyspar seems to allow one to more effectively find them...

107025.name: Fontaine Shrine of Depths Key
107025.desc: A key that can break the seal on the ancient Shrines of Depths scattered around Fontaine.\nThese Shrines of Depths sealed themselves off when the civilization that built them was lost. Keys lost deep within domains are able to break the seals. Or perhaps that, for a moment, these keys help the seals to forget all that they have lost.

107026.name: Spirit Carp
107026.desc: A Spirit Carp formed from the condensed adeptal energy, swimming freely amidst mountains and river valleys.

107027.name: Natlan Shrine of Depths Key
107027.desc: A key that can break the seal on the ancient Shrines of Depths scattered around Natlan.\nThese Shrines of Depths sealed themselves off when the civilization that built them was lost. Keys lost deep within domains are able to break the seals. Or perhaps that, for a moment, these keys help the seals to forget all that they have lost.

107028.name: Pyroculus
107028.desc: A substance that has accumulated intense Pyro energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

107029.name: Jubilant Feather
107029.desc: Like a mystical gem crystallized from peals of joyous laughter, it appears as two pages intertwined, or perhaps a feather flying freely. After being touched, "Excerpts of Bliss" can be retrieved from it...\nIt seems that their locations can be quickly ascertained using Jocund or Joyous Letters...

107030.name: Lunoculus
107030.desc: A substance that has accumulated intense kuuvahki energy. Offer it to the Statue of the New Moon and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

107031.name: Borderland Shrine of Depths Key
107031.desc: A key that can break the seal on the ancient Shrines of Depths scattered around Nod-Krai.\nThese Shrines of Depths sealed themselves off when the civilization that built them was lost. Keys lost deep within domains are able to break the seals. Or perhaps that, for a moment, these keys help the seals to forget all that they have lost.

107032.name: Kuuhenki Shrine Key
107032.desc: A key that can break the seal on the ancient Kuuhenki Shrines scattered around the Frost Moon.\nThese shrines that were built upon the moon's surface lost the benevolent being in whom faith was vested in ancient days as the will of the moon faded away. These secret keys found upon the frigid lunar soil can be used to break the seals — or perhaps they only use the fading voices of the past to help the shrines forget all that has come to ruin.

107034.name: Memory Factor
107034.desc: The fundamental building blocks of "Civilization."\nAny creation of "Civilization" that fades from the collective memory of humanity will eventually disintegrate into Memory Factors. Offer them to the Memory Core within the Temple of Space, and you may receive a blessing from the memories drifting within the interstices...

107035.name: Cryoculus
107035.desc: A substance that has accumulated intense Cryo energy. Offer it to the Statue and help reinstate the power it has lost over the years.

107036.name: Shadow Wingdrop
107036.desc: A strange, liquefied substance left behind by a creature born within the Shadow Realm.

107037.name: Snezhnaya Shrine of Depths Key
107037.desc: A key that can break the seal on the ancient Shrines of Depths scattered around Snezhnaya.\nThese Shrines of Depths sealed themselves off when the civilization that built them was lost. Keys lost deep within domains are able to break the seals. Or perhaps that, for a moment, these keys help the seals to forget all that they have lost.

108001.name: Suspicious Fisherman's Toast
108001.desc: Onion-covered toast. Not quite cooked right. You'll notice its imperfection, even if you eat it while fishing.
108001.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 88 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108002.name: Fisherman's Toast
108002.desc: Onion-covered toast. A favorite amongst fishermen, they will stuff a bag with it and sit by the river all day.
108002.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 107 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108003.name: Delicious Fisherman's Toast
108003.desc: Onion-covered toast. Exudes a wonderful aroma. Are the fish biting for the bait, or is it the toast they're after?
108003.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 126 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108004.name: Suspicious Teyvat Fried Egg
108004.desc: An egg fried on one side. A bit hard in the middle. One can only hope it still has its nutrients.
108004.effect: Revives a character and restores 50 HP.

108005.name: Teyvat Fried Egg
108005.desc: An egg fried on one side. The yolk flows out nicely when broken. So satisfying.
108005.effect: Revives a character and restores 100 HP.

108006.name: Delicious Teyvat Fried Egg
108006.desc: An egg fried on one side. With a taste of the summer sun, it invigorates you from the first bite.
108006.effect: Revives a character and restores 150 HP.

108007.name: Suspicious Steak
108007.desc: A grilled steak. Its color is a little bleak, almost as if it feels sorry for itself for being a sorry excuse for a steak.
108007.effect: Revives a character and restores 50 HP.

108008.name: Steak
108008.desc: A grilled steak. High heat has locked the juices in, giving one high expectations for when the meat is cut open.
108008.effect: Revives a character and restores 100 HP.

108009.name: Delicious Steak
108009.desc: A grilled steak. Juicy, flavorsome, fragrant steak. One bite and you feel yourself come alive.
108009.effect: Revives a character and restores 150 HP.

108010.name: Outrider's Champion Steak!
108010.desc: Amber's specialty. One side is obviously uncooked. The other side gives off a subtle scent of something burnt. Close your eyes and have a big mouthful, just to keep Amber happy if nothing else.
108010.effect: Revives a character and restores 10% of Max HP, then restores an additional 150 HP.

108011.name: Suspicious Chicken-Mushroom Skewer
108011.desc: A skewer of mushrooms and poultry. At first glance it's hard to tell which is which.
108011.effect: Restores 8% of Max HP and an additional 800 HP to the selected character.

108012.name: Chicken-Mushroom Skewer
108012.desc: A skewer of mushrooms and poultry. Fresh poultry is complimented by fragrant mushrooms. Don't be picky, chow down!
108012.effect: Restores 9% of Max HP and an additional 1,000 HP to the selected character.

108013.name: Delicious Chicken-Mushroom Skewer
108013.desc: A skewer of mushrooms and poultry. All the best the wild has to offer are pierced on just one stick.
108013.effect: Restores 10% of Max HP and an additional 1,200 HP to the selected character.

108014.name: Fruity Skewers
108014.desc: Kaeya's specialty. A chewy skewer with a rich sweet aftertaste. Wait... Is this really the smell of fruit?
108014.effect: Restores 16% of Max HP and an additional 1,350 HP to the selected character.

108015.name: Suspicious Flaming Red Bolognese
108015.desc: Bolognese covered with a meat sauce. A bit chewy and annoyingly sticks to your teeth.
108015.effect: Restores 18% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 300 HP every 5s for 30s.

108016.name: Flaming Red Bolognese
108016.desc: Bolognese covered with a meat sauce. The meaty, herby aroma really gets your appetite going.
108016.effect: Restores 20% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 390 HP every 5s for 30s.

108017.name: Delicious Flaming Red Bolognese
108017.desc: Bolognese covered with a meat sauce. The beautiful, authentic flavors take you on a culinary adventure from the first bite to the last.
108017.effect: Restores 22% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 470 HP every 5s for 30s.

108018.name: Mysterious Bolognese
108018.desc: Lisa's specialty. With an inexplicable aura, this bolognese is so exotic that you can never have enough. Did she actually enchant it with some kind of magic?
108018.effect: Restores 26% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 570 HP every 5s for 30s.

108019.name: Suspicious Radish Veggie Soup
108019.desc: Radish-based vegetable soup. The vegetables within appear to have been victims of a frost.
108019.effect: Restores 8% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 210 HP every 5s for 30s.

108020.name: Radish Veggie Soup
108020.desc: Radish-based vegetable soup. Its flavor is delicately between tart and sweet. With luscious radish, it's a well-balanced dish.
108020.effect: Restores 9% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 260 HP every 5s for 30s.

108021.name: Delicious Radish Veggie Soup
108021.desc: Radish-based vegetable soup. The clear aromas are perfectly accompanied by a sunny summer afternoon.
108021.effect: Restores 10% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 300 HP every 5s for 30s.

108022.name: Suspicious Tea Break Pancake
108022.desc: A stack of round pancakes. A burnt scent masks what you can only assume should be a sweet taste. The berries are the only thing saving this dish.
108022.effect: Revives a character and restores 250 HP.

108023.name: Tea Break Pancake
108023.desc: A stack of round pancakes. A staple originating from afternoon tea in manors. Only the best berries should be picked for this dish.
108023.effect: Revives a character and restores 400 HP.

108024.name: Delicious Tea Break Pancake
108024.desc: A stack of round pancakes. Tender and fluffy, the sweet-smelling pancakes taste like clouds. A heavenly delicacy, no doubt.
108024.effect: Revives a character and restores 550 HP.

108025.name: Suspicious Fried Radish Balls
108025.desc: Fried Radish Balls. Way too oily, and leaves you looking for something to drink to cut through the grease.
108025.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 66 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108026.name: Fried Radish Balls
108026.desc: Fried Radish Balls. Fragrant and crispy. Make sure to eat them while they're hot! Said to be a recipe from Liyue.
108026.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 81 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108027.name: Delicious Fried Radish Balls
108027.desc: Fried Radish Balls. It's insane that something so delicious comes from plain old radishes! All who eat them will truly understand Liyue's culinary reputation.
108027.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 95 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108028.name: Suspicious Satisfying Salad
108028.desc: A vegetable salad. Regrettably, it seems the best time to plate the potatoes and boiled eggs was missed.
108028.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 6% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108029.name: Satisfying Salad
108029.desc: A vegetable salad. Not just steamed potatoes and fresh vegetables, but also a hard-boiled egg to top it off. Satisfying to both the eyes and stomach.
108029.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 9% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108030.name: Delicious Satisfying Salad
108030.desc: A vegetable salad. Fresh, light, and varied. You'd never get tired of eating this, even if you had to eat it for the rest of your life.
108030.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 12% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108031.name: Suspicious Sweet Madame
108031.desc: Honey-roasted fowl. The sweet flowers have been burnt off, revealing the bitter taste of the overcooked fowl.
108031.effect: Restores 20% of Max HP and an additional 900 HP to the selected character.

108032.name: Sweet Madame
108032.desc: Honey-roasted fowl. The honey and sweet flowers come together to complement the tender fowl meat.
108032.effect: Restores 22% of Max HP and an additional 1,200 HP to the selected character.

108033.name: Delicious Sweet Madame
108033.desc: Honey-roasted fowl. Tender and sweet, the meat has perfectly fused with the honey, ensuring the only thing left of this dish will be the cleanly-picked bones.
108033.effect: Restores 24% of Max HP and an additional 1,500 HP to the selected character.

108034.name: Suspicious Northern Smoked Chicken
108034.desc: Smoked fowl paired with vegetables. It's true. You really ought to try your own cooking before serving it to your guests. It's not too late to make a new one, perhaps?

108035.name: Northern Smoked Chicken
108035.desc: Smoked fowl paired with vegetables. A staple for Northerners, often made for honored guests.

108036.name: Delicious Northern Smoked Chicken
108036.desc: Smoked fowl paired with vegetables. A dish fit for a king. Go on, find one and serve him with pride.

108037.name: Suspicious Cream Stew
108037.desc: A meat and vegetable stew. Surprisingly dry for something that's meant to have liquid.
108037.effect: Decreases all party members' sprinting Stamina consumption by 15% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108038.name: Cream Stew
108038.desc: A meat and vegetable stew. The thick juices taste great with the tender meat and vegetables.
108038.effect: Decreases all party members' sprinting Stamina consumption by 20% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108039.name: Delicious Cream Stew
108039.desc: A meat and vegetable stew. These warm, buttery ingredients are so good that you almost want to dive into the cream stew and cuddle up with them.
108039.effect: Decreases all party members' sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108040.name: Spicy Stew
108040.desc: Barbara's specialty. Carrots cut into cute little stars make this dish... Wait, AHH, where did this spiciness come from!?
108040.effect: Decreases all party members' sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 1500s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108041.name: Suspicious Mushroom Pizza
108041.desc: A pizza covered in cheese and mushrooms. If you can bite through the brick-like texture... At least it can ease your hunger.
108041.effect: Restores 26% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 450 HP every 5s for 30s.

108042.name: Mushroom Pizza
108042.desc: A pizza covered in cheese and mushrooms. When still warm, the cheese becomes stretchy and gooey, making it extremely satisfying to eat.
108042.effect: Restores 28% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 620 HP every 5s for 30s.

108043.name: Delicious Mushroom Pizza
108043.desc: A pizza covered in cheese and mushrooms. It's a party in your mouth and the cheese and mushrooms invited all their delicious friends.
108043.effect: Restores 30% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 790 HP every 5s for 30s.

108044.name: Invigorating Pizza
108044.desc: Jean's specialty. This pizza almost seems more art than food. Just one slice is enough to have you raring to go. Is this what keeps Jean working so hard?
108044.effect: Restores 34% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 980 HP every 5s for 30s.

108045.name: Suspicious Mondstadt Hash Brown
108045.desc: A fried cake of mashed potatoes. It's said that a hash brown without jam is not worthy of the Mondstadt name... But is this even a hash brown?
108045.effect: Restores 30% of Max HP and an additional 600 HP to the selected character.

108046.name: Mondstadt Hash Brown
108046.desc: A fried cake of mashed potatoes. A little bit of pinecone helps give it a nice crunch, and great with a bit of jam. Loved by people of all ages.
108046.effect: Restores 32% of Max HP and an additional 1,250 HP to the selected character.

108047.name: Delicious Mondstadt Hash Brown
108047.desc: A fried cake of mashed potatoes. Close your eyes and feel the mild breeze and sweet dew that Mondstadt offers.
108047.effect: Restores 34% of Max HP and an additional 1,900 HP to the selected character.

108048.name: Puppy-Paw Hash Brown
108048.desc: Razor's specialty. Carefully shaped to resemble a wolf's paw. You can really feel the effort he has put into trying human cooking.
108048.effect: Restores 40% of Max HP and an additional 2,350 HP to the selected character.

108049.name: Suspicious Calla Lily Seafood Soup
108049.desc: A balanced combination of seafood. The bitterness of the calla lily, the astringency of the mint, the fishiness of the crab... Getting all the negatives together like this takes skill.
108049.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 165 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
