108548.name: Suspicious Ile flottante
108548.desc: A dessert made of egg whites. Despite trying to froth up the egg whites until your hands were sore, and although you tried to save it by spreading the mixture over the sauce you prepared, the two melt into a total mess... Uh, how about thinking of it as a new beverage and having a sip?

108549.desc: A dessert made out of egg whites. The cooking process is simple: Froth up the egg whites properly, and half the battle is won. Place the heated egg whites on the sauce, and you're done. The dessert has an exquisite look and is the first choice of Fontainian ladies for afternoon tea.

108550.name: Delicious Ile flottante
108550.desc: A dessert made of egg whites. Light egg-white dew that floats on the creamy sauce is like mysterious treasure chests awaiting travelers' exploration. "Enjoyment" would be an understatement, for the dessert brings you the joy of opening a luxurious chest!

108684.desc: Aqua-blue ice cream. The large chunks of sea salt ambushed your taste buds, causing you to blank out... By the time you mustered up the valor to try again, the dessert had melted into more of a milkshake...
108684.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 215 and healing effects by 6% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108685.name: Blubbercream
108685.desc: Aqua-blue ice cream. The best way to while away a sweltering day is by enjoying some refreshing ice cream. It chills the body and cools the soul, giving one a feeling akin to having leaped into the sea, all worries dissipating as the heat flees your mouth, leaving naught but pure joy.
108685.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 261 and healing effects by 8% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108686.name: Delicious Blubbercream
108686.desc: Aqua-blue ice cream. The likeness of the earnest, adorable Blubberbeast printed on the cup adds a humorous touch, and the buttery creaminess is interwoven with a light, silken saltiness. It is as if your senses, too, have been invited to embark on an unforgettable undersea odyssey — one that you hope shall never end!
108686.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 308 and healing effects by 10% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108687.name: Suspicious Crisp Croissant Combo
108687.desc: A small pastry-and-coffee combo. The stony bread stands solid against your teeth, having seemingly been robbed of all moisture. The bitter drink stained with sourness is such that you'd be pardoned for thinking it some kind of medicinal concoction. The only saving grace is that this isn't the main course...
108687.effect: Decreases all party members' climbing and sprinting Stamina consumption by 15% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108688.name: Crisp Croissant Combo
108688.desc: A small pastry-and-coffee combo. Roll and fold the dough, lather it in egg wash, and place the creation into the oven. Soon, it will have expanded into an exquisite pastry, piping hot as it triumphantly exits the oven. It is said that the act of brushing the egg wash on is like a baker's signature — and it seems this one has fine penmanship indeed.
108688.effect: Decreases all party members' climbing and sprinting Stamina consumption by 20% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108689.name: Delicious Crisp Croissant Combo
108689.desc: A small pastry-and-coffee combo. The two pointy pieces of bread conceal fluffy softness within crispy crusts, and the aromatic butter dances in perfect harmony with the intense coffee aroma, a match made in heaven. Whether by early morning light or brief break hour, to partake of this lovely combo is to salve even the most exhausted soul.
108689.effect: Decreases all party members' climbing and sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108690.name: A Magical Mix
108690.desc: A marvelous specialty sealed within a tiny bottle that looks no different from any ordinary drink. Perhaps there is some magic spell on it that makes drinks taste better... But does such magic really exist?

108691.name: Suspicious Meatnado
108691.desc: A rather popular meat dish. At first, things were going well enough, but at the final, crucial moment, the rolled meat suddenly fell apart, causing the meat and side dishes to look like the aftermath of a wild storm...
108691.effect: Restore 15 Stamina after any party member defeats an opponent. This effect can be triggered once every 3s. Lasts 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108692.name: Meatnado
108692.desc: A rather popular meat dish. Bacon and other garnishes are placed over thin slices of meat, which are then rolled up and pan-fried until browned, then simmered in a broth. When the finished dish is cut open, the meat slices stay tightly wrapped around the filling, just like a tornado.
108692.effect: Restore 20 Stamina after any party member defeats an opponent. This effect can be triggered once every 3s. Lasts 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108693.name: Delicious Meatnado
108693.desc: A rather popular meat dish. The rich meat fragrance sweeps through you, body and soul, satisfying what your imagination envisions for bountiful meat. No wonder, then, that this dish often finds itself a place at any joyous gathering.
108693.effect: Restore 25 Stamina after any party member defeats an opponent. This effect can be triggered once every 3s. Lasts 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108694.name: Suspicious Apple Roly Poly
108694.desc: A traditional apple dessert. Apples are apples, and dough is dough. To force them into a commonality they do not share is to create an awkward mess that even the most flavorful butter cannot rescue.
108694.effect: After you activate a Petrified Tree, a Ley Line Outcrop, or open a Treasure Chest, restore 16% HP and an extra 600 HP to all party members. This effect can occur once every 5s. Lasts 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108695.name: Apple Roly Poly
108695.desc: A traditional apple dessert. The secret to its crispy and delicious flavor lies in the thin pastry crust. Apparently, the best pastry chefs in Mondstadt are said to be capable of making pastries so thin that you could carry on reading even if you placed it over the page.
108695.effect: After you activate a Petrified Tree, a Ley Line Outcrop, or open a Treasure Chest, restore 18% HP and an extra 900 HP to all party members. This effect can occur once every 5s. Lasts 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108696.name: Delicious Apple Roly Poly
108696.desc: A traditional apple dessert. The mere aroma of the apples gives a feeling akin to situating oneself before a warm hearth. Before you can even think to slowly appreciate it, your hands move as if compelled by some other person, knife and fork in tow, reaching out for the next piece.
108696.effect: After you activate a Petrified Tree, a Ley Line Outcrop, or open a Treasure Chest, restore 20% HP and an extra 1,200 HP to all party members. This effect can occur once every 5s. Lasts 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108700.name: Suspicious Glittering Gemstones
108700.desc: Multicolored biscuits. This is exhausting to chew, almost as if your teeth are grinding against real gemstones... Perhaps you might even cause mortal hurt to your foes with this, were you to throw them from a hidden location in battle and catch them unawares.
108700.effect: A little surprise from the Children of Echoes.

108701.name: Glittering Gemstones
108701.desc: Multicolored biscuits. First, use dough to create a gemstone fitting, before adding jam of different colors and flavors to the setting. The result resembles nothing so much as an exquisite gemstone pendant, but be careful not to mix them up with the real thing!
108701.effect: A little surprise from the Children of Echoes.

108702.name: Delicious Glittering Gemstones
108702.desc: Multicolored biscuits. The sour and sweet jam gives off the clear luster of crystalline form, adding a shine to the crunchy treats. Such radiance! Such tastiness! What could this be but equal even to the most precious jewels?
108702.effect: A little surprise from the Children of Echoes.

108703.name: Suspicious Hot Spring O'Clock
108703.desc: A pizza made using Grainfruit. The combination of sweet Grainfruit and salty cheese can make for a romantic encounter but also an irreconcilable clash... Unfortunately, the flavor on this one appears to be the latter.
108703.effect: A little surprise from the People of the Springs.

108704.name: Hot Spring O'Clock
108704.desc: A pizza made using Grainfruit. Grainfruit is scattered across the crust before a thick layer of cheese is poured on top, and the whole thing is delivered into the oven. The final touch is to then draw a little Koholasaurus picture on it. Eat it while it's hot — the warmth will remind you of a serene time spent enjoying a soothing soak in a hot spring.
108704.effect: A little surprise from the People of the Springs.

108705.name: Delicious Hot Spring O'Clock
108705.desc: A pizza made using Grainfruit. The cheese pull is like a golden waterfall, descending into your mouth bedecked in juicy Grainfruit. The sweetness and saltiness blend on your tongue, luring forth a boundless appetite within you — even when you finish the whole thing, you could go for more.
108705.effect: A little surprise from the People of the Springs.

108706.name: Suspicious Puff Pops
108706.desc: A snack with lots of different flavors. To eat several in a row is to experience a myriad of strange flavors that... burn your stomach? Did you just have bad luck with flavors, or are they all like this?
108706.effect: A little surprise from the Scions of the Canopy.

108707.name: Puff Pops
108707.desc: A snack with lots of different flavors. If you close your eyes, you won't be able to guess what flavor you'll get next, and eating them is sure to increase your heart rate — and that's what makes this popular amongst the Scions of the Canopy. By the way, the "pop" part of the name comes from the sound of Grainfruit kernels bursting open under high temperatures.
108707.effect: A little surprise from the Scions of the Canopy.

108708.name: Delicious Puff Pops
108708.desc: A snack with lots of different flavors. These surprising flavors of these "little bombs" explode between your teeth. Your left and right hands work in unison, sending more hurtling headlong into your mouth. Om nom nom — amid the sound of chewing, all your stress melts away.
108708.effect: A little surprise from the Scions of the Canopy.

108709.name: Suspicious Saurus Crackers
108709.desc: Crackers shaped like little Saurians. The bland taste and exquisite appearance make for a horrendous contrast, and when combined with the hard mouthfeel, makes for something that's neither delectable nor inedible... Hmm, would Saurians accept using these as teething sticks?
108709.effect: Restores 30% of Max HP and an additional 600 HP to the selected character.

108710.name: Saurus Crackers
108710.desc: Crackers shaped like little Saurians. Light, crispy, sweet, and fragrant, with adorable patterns on top to boot — how could the people of Natlan not be won over by such delectable snacks? Apparently, even the Saurians love 'em... But are crackers really the type of thing Saurians eat?
108710.effect: Restores 32% of Max HP and an additional 1,250 HP to the selected character.

108711.name: Delicious Saurus Crackers
108711.desc: Crackers shaped like little Saurians. The enticing aroma of butter draws forth the delightful interplay between the Cacahuatl and Grainfruit, while the cute shapes make them truly hard to put down. In the end, even the crumbs that slipped through your fingers were not to be spared!
108711.effect: Restores 34% of Max HP and an additional 1,900 HP to the selected character.

108712.name: Suspicious Forest of Color
108712.desc: A salad made from fresh fruit and vegetables. Each bite of this is no different from eating raw fruits and vegetables straight up... And once you give it any consideration, you realize that you forgot to add sauce.
108712.effect: Revives a character and restores 250 HP.

108713.name: Forest of Color
108713.desc: A salad made from fresh fruit and vegetables. Blanch the Grainfruit, chop the other ingredients, drizzle over the sauce, then stir until evenly mixed. Extremely simple to make, but even more importantly, it's so healthy that no matter how much you eat, you won't feel stressed!
108713.effect: Revives a character and restores 400 HP.

108714.name: Delicious Forest of Color
108714.desc: A salad made from fresh fruit and vegetables. Sweet, sour, and many others constitute a forest of flavor for you to wander through, leaving you with a lasting touch of freshness from your taste buds to your heart.
108714.effect: Revives a character and restores 550 HP.

108715.name: Suspicious Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce
108715.desc: Grilled Fish doused in a delicious sauce. The thick sauce has all but drowned out the fish's natural flavors, and the strident taste of mint has all but wiped that of Grilled Fish out.
108715.effect: Restores 8% of Max HP and an additional 800 HP to the selected character.

108716.name: Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce
108716.desc: Grilled Fish doused in delicious sauce. The fish is scored, stuffed with spices, then baked. Once cooked, a thick mint sauce is generously drizzled over the top. The refreshing aroma of the fish is enough to whet anyone's appetite.
108716.effect: Restores 9% of Max HP and an additional 1,000 HP to the selected character.

108717.name: Delicious Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce
108717.desc: Grilled Fish doused in a delicious sauce. Crisp, fragrant fish skin, tender fish meat... Ordinary methods, extraordinary flavor.
108717.effect: Restores 10% of Max HP and an additional 1,200 HP to the selected character.

108718.name: Suspicious Tatacos
108718.desc: Thin tacos with filling. The shell looks like thin fabric, but is in truth as cold and hard as iron. The filling's not bad, though, so laying the shell aside, could make for some decent grilled shrimp...
108718.effect: Revives a character and restores 900 HP.

108719.name: Tatacos
108719.desc: Thin tacos with filling. Making Tatacos is a three-part process — you bake the tacos first, you add vegetables and grilled shrimp second, then finally, you drizzle sauce over the top. In Natlan, it's hard to say which is a more common sight — phlogiston or Tatacos.
108719.effect: Revives a character and restores 1,200 HP.

108720.name: Delicious Tatacos
108720.desc: Thin tacos with filling. When your tongue touches the piping-hot shell and its rich filling, a pleasant fragrance gushes out from within, reminding you of a saying from Natlan — "Life might disappoint, but Tatacos, never!"
108720.effect: Revives a character and restores 1,500 HP.

108721.name: Suspicious Sour Sauce Ceviche
108721.desc: Raw pieces of fish with a fruity fragrance. Having not been marinated for nearly long enough, the fish lacks flavor. Fortunately, the fresh ingredients allow the dish as a whole to muddle through, albeit leaving a sense of regret behind.
108721.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 66 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108722.name: Sour Sauce Ceviche
108722.desc: Raw pieces of fish with a fruity fragrance. The fish — which must be fresh — is first skinned and cut into thick chunks, then marinated in the sour sauce until the fish turns white, after which shredded vegetables are added for seasoning. A combination of sour and spicy flavors, it is one of Natlan's most classic flavors.
108722.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 81 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108723.name: Delicious Sour Sauce Ceviche
108723.desc: Raw pieces of fish with a fruity fragrance. The sheer fragrance bowls you over in the first wave, with sourness and spiciness bringing up the rear, granting this fish layers akin to the tides, with you the surfer on a sea of flavor. Even when the tumult has subsided, your yearning remains.
108723.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 95 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108724.name: Suspicious Chocolate
108724.desc: Small spherical snacks. The Cacahuatl's unique flavor has been destroyed by a deluge of sugar, ruining the layers in the flavor, leaving naught but stale, sickening, sticky sweetness... You can clean your teeth afterward, sure, but what about the remaining Chocolate?

108725.name: Chocolate
108725.desc: Small spherical snacks. It is said that where the Cacahuatl was grown has a decisive influence on the flavor of the Chocolate, bestowing upon it a completely unique flavor — whether that be rough earthy undertones or sweet fruity notes... You never know the flavor you're gonna get with the next bite.

108726.name: Delicious Chocolate
108726.desc: Small spherical snacks. The texture is smooth as swan-down, and as it gradually melts, the Cacahuatl brings out a certain warmth that blends in time with a feather-light sweetness, with a magical final flourish that leaves smiles on everyone's faces.

108727.name: Suspicious Stuffed N' Mashed Potatoes
108727.desc: An exquisitely colorful dish. The colors are distinct, and the shape regular, promoting an anticipation that is choked in the crib by the bone-dry potato. Are you sure this is potato mash and not steamed egg yolks?
108727.effect: Restores 26% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 450 HP every 5s for 30s.

108728.name: Stuffed N' Mashed Potatoes
108728.desc: An exquisitely colorful dish. Mash the potatoes into a fine creamy state, add various fillings in the middle, then finally, drizzle with sauce for a touch of brightness. The end result is not dissimilar from a finely-made cake, and is the favorite dish of many in Natlan.
108728.effect: Restores 28% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 620 HP every 5s for 30s.

108729.name: Delicious Stuffed N' Mashed Potatoes
108729.desc: An exquisitely colorful dish. The eye-catching colors and soft, delicate texture contain overlapping tastes that bump against your tastebuds in a flavor firework show. Such a perfect appetizer leaves you in unsurpassed anticipation for the main dish.
108729.effect: Restores 30% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 790 HP every 5s for 30s.

108730.name: Suspicious Cup O' Grainfruit
108730.desc: A snack made from Grainfruit. The overheating has caused most of the moisture to evaporate away. Only the dried, utterly unappetizing kernels remain.
108730.effect: Restores 8% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 210 HP every 5s for 30s.

108731.name: Cup O' Grainfruit
108731.desc: A snack made from Grainfruit. The kernels are broken off, then steamed together with Embercore Flower nectar. Each and every one of them ends up being juicy, fragrant, and irresistibly sweet.
108731.effect: Restores 9% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 260 HP every 5s for 30s.

108732.name: Delicious Cup O' Grainfruit
108732.desc: A snack made from Grainfruit. The fresh, plump kernels explode on the tip of your tongue, like a lively party that leaves a lingering sweet aftertaste.
108732.effect: Restores 10% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 300 HP every 5s for 30s.

108733.name: Suspicious Grainfruit Meat Soup
108733.desc: A soup that consists of a mixture of meat and vegetables. The finished product is ashen-grey, a far cry from the bright green you had hoped for... Might this be saved by adding some more vegetables?
108733.effect: Restores 20% of Max HP and an additional 900 HP to the selected character.

108734.name: Grainfruit Meat Soup
108734.desc: A soup that consists of a mixture of meat and vegetables. When ordering Grainfruit Meat Soup in Natlan, customers can choose from a variety of different broths as well as a wide range of side dishes. The only fixed rule is this — it must contain lots of Grainfruit.
108734.effect: Restores 22% of Max HP and an additional 1,200 HP to the selected character.

108735.name: Delicious Grainfruit Meat Soup
108735.desc: A soup that consists of a mixture of meat and vegetables. Any single spoonful includes soft meat, crunchy veggies, and a titillating spiciness... This cornucopia of shifting flavors decrees that you entertain seconds!
108735.effect: Restores 24% of Max HP and an additional 1,500 HP to the selected character.

108736.name: Suspicious Grainfruit Chips
108736.desc: Crispy triangular chips. The oily, crunchy pieces collide with sickly sticky cheese to create a greasy texture that can only be stomached once, but never again.
108736.effect: Restores 18% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 300 HP every 5s for 30s.

108737.name: Grainfruit Chips
108737.desc: Crispy triangular chips. After being scooped out of the oil-filled pot, the deep-fried chips are drizzled with sauce, sprinkled with cheese, and finally topped with shredded meat — thus is a hearty Natlan breakfast born.
108737.effect: Restores 20% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 390 HP every 5s for 30s.

108738.name: Delicious Grainfruit Chips
108738.desc: Crispy triangular chips. Crunch-crunch-crunch go the crispy pieces! You simply cannot stop pairing it with the sweet and sour sauce, the rich, fragrant cheese, the delicious shredded meat... Why does this combination have to. Be. So. Delicious?
108738.effect: Restores 22% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 470 HP every 5s for 30s.

108739.name: Suspicious Fried Shrimp Beanballs
108739.desc: A deep-fried snack. The oil in the pot has mercilessly stripped the shrimp of moisture, resulting in a shriveled texture that could have been shown magnanimity if not for the jarring, hard mouthfeel. It's a good thing there are only two products... That makes dealing with them easy enough.
108739.effect: Increases all party members' Shield Strength by 20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108740.name: Fried Shrimp Beanballs
108740.desc: A deep-fried snack. First, deep fry the bean flour balls, then stuff them with fillings, fried shrimp, and sauce. Though they may be slightly complicated to prepare, the fact that they're so delicious makes it all worth it.
108740.effect: Increases all party members' Shield Strength by 25% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108741.name: Delicious Fried Shrimp Beanballs
108741.desc: A deep-fried snack. After experiencing the culinary magic known as deep-frying, this has gained a golden luster, with a crisp shell that tightly locks the juices in along with a crackling, satisfying toothsomeness. Alas, for there only being two per dish! Alas, for you desire more!
108741.effect: Increases all party members' Shield Strength by 30% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108742.name: Suspicious Blazed Meat Stew
108742.desc: A spicy meat stew. The excessive spiciness sets your mouth ablaze... and your stomach too, once you force the meat down your belabored gullet. Now if only there was a large cup of water to put these flames out...
108742.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 10% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108743.name: Blazed Meat Stew
108743.desc: A spicy meat stew. Raw meat is seasoned with an array of different spices, then slow-cooked until tender. The moment you open the lid, a hot and spicy aroma wafts out to greet you. When you're not sure what to eat when it's time to celebrate, you can't go wrong with this!
108743.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 15% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108744.name: Delicious Blazed Meat Stew
108744.desc: A spicy meat stew. All manner of spices bring out the rich aroma of meat. A well-tuned spiciness awakens your slumbering tastebuds with its touch, and as the meat meets your teeth, its rich juices spill forth, filling your heart with sumptuous joy. Not a drop, you declare, shall be spared. Not one drop.
108744.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108745.name: Saurian Hunter's Reward
108745.desc: Kinich's specialty. The large, richly flavored chunks of meat come in hot... and spicy to boot. Ajaw keeps mumbling by your side. "Consider yourself lucky to enjoy this for free! Why, in days past, we would only reward ourselves thus for a true big-game hunt. Indeed, you should be offering delicious fruit juice unto me as thanksgiving!" To which Kinich helpfully supplies, "Just eat. Ignore his nonsense."
108745.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 20% and CRIT DMG by 20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108746.name: Pass the Luck
108746.desc: Mualani's specialty. Feet planted on her surfboard, dish in hand, she made not one, not two, but three loops around you before placing the sizable lobster before you. "Ta-da! Super huge and freshly caught — a stroke of luck if ever there was one! And now, I pass that luck onto you!" Her cheerful words all but grant the bean balls wrapped around the shrimp a golden glow.
108746.effect: Increases all party members' Shield Strength by 35% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108747.name: Impeccably Organized
108747.desc: Kachina's specialty. The chips are arrayed in neat rows, fried just right. In their crunchy deliciousness, you can see Kachina's earnestness and care. Would it be too much motivation for her if you were to tell her how you felt about the dish, plus some compliments?
108747.effect: Restores 26% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 570 HP every 5s for 30s.

108748.name: Suspicious Golden Apple Pastry
108748.desc: A little dessert made from apples. Having been left be too long, the softened outer skin now hides yet softer innards, with a flavor far removed from your envisaging... Uh oh. Your mouth's getting stuck shut...
108748.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 224 and CRIT Rate by 6% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108749.name: Golden Apple Pastry
108749.desc: A little dessert made from apples. After being sliced into evenly sized pieces, the apples are mixed with sugar and other spices. The mixture is boiled until it thickens, then wrapped in square puff pastry and baked until it turns golden and puffy. The crispy puff pastry envelops a soft filling within, a delicious treat suitable for anyone.
108749.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 272 and CRIT Rate by 8% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108750.name: Delicious Golden Apple Pastry
108750.desc: A little dessert made from apples. The honey-sweet filling surges across your taste buds like a thread of golden light passing through the interlaced fingers of tree and leaf and warming your very heart. Ah, how could you ever stop at one of these?
108750.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 320 and CRIT Rate by 10% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108751.name: Suspicious Delights of Wondrous Wanderings
108751.desc: A dessert box based on the recipes of several different companions, simply overflowing with heartfelt intentions. There's nothing wrong with the structure itself, but you smell a strange disharmony in its scents... You are apprehensive about giving it a go. Hmm, could it work as a memento instead?
108751.effect: Restores 30% of Max HP and an additional 600 HP to the selected character.

108752.name: Delights of Wondrous Wanderings
108752.desc: A dessert box based on the recipes of several different companions, simply overflowing with heartfelt intentions. Neatly arranged rows of delicate pastries line the box — but what will this goodwill gesture taste like?
108752.effect: Restores 32% of Max HP and an additional 1,250 HP to the selected character.

108753.name: Delicious Delights of Wondrous Wanderings
108753.desc: A dessert box based on the recipes of several different companions, simply overflowing with heartfelt intentions. The artisanry here is akin to the exquisite scene of the moon cutting through the clouds. Indeed, you can barely bear to eat such a precious gift.
108753.effect: Restores 34% of Max HP and an additional 1,900 HP to the selected character.

108754.name: Suspicious BBQ Beef Heart Skewers
108754.desc: Commonly seen street-stall barbeque. The fire blazed out of control, burning the outside to charcoal in an instant, while inside, the meat is still half raw. Maybe you can cut off the burnt bits and put the rest back over the charcoal, and try grilling it again, but over a smaller flame this time...

108755.name: BBQ Beef Heart Skewers
108755.desc: Commonly seen street-stall barbeque. Marinated beef heart is threaded onto skewers before being barbequed over charcoal, grilling forth an enticing aroma and captivating luster. Add on a bit of grilled grainfruit and potato, and you've assembled the eternal golden ensemble of Natlan's street food scene!

108756.name: Delicious BBQ Beef Heart Skewers
108756.desc: Commonly seen street-stall barbeque. The crackling flames and sizzling sounds herald an imminent feast, igniting your craving for that first bite. The firmness of the thick hunks of meat and the abundance of savory juices that burst forth with every bite perfectly complement one another in a culinary experience that might be called bathing in BBQ bliss.

108757.name: Suspicious Xocoatl
108757.desc: A Natlan drink made from Cacahuatl. If you had to guess before you took a swig, you might assume it would taste either sweet or bitter, but never in a million years would you have expected the sourness that sets upon the tip of your tongue... Did someone add the wrong ingredients?
108757.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 165 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108758.name: Xocoatl
108758.desc: A Natlan drink made from Cacahuatl. Initially, bitter Cacahuatl was ground up and blended with various spices, creating the eponymous "bitter water." Much evolution later, added sugar would transform the final product into something fragrant, delectable, and broadly popular, though the name indicating "bitter water" has never changed.
108758.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 200 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108759.name: Delicious Xocoatl
108759.desc: A Natlan drink made from Cacahuatl. The rich, deep fragrance of the Cacahuatl is infused with a pure creaminess, tenderly caressing your tongue with the softness of smooth silk, leaving behind a touch of sweetness that is more than enough to melt your heart.
108759.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 235 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108760.name: Fruit-Flavored Milk Candies
108760.desc: Xilonen's specialty. As you sit side-by-side atop the tree, she passes you an exquisite box filled with... variously shaped candies? "Cacahuatl is actually considered a kind of fruit. So, it should be fine to call candies made out of cacahuatl and milk 'fruit-flavored.' C'mon, let's dig in." So saying, she swiftly snatches one, tossing it into her mouth before biting down.

108761.name: Suspicious Surf, Turf, and Perch
108761.desc: A large platter with a mix of meat and vegetables. First, you find yourself biting into a half-raw skewer of meat; next, a chunk of charred fish. The contrast is so jarring that you simply can't muster up the courage to take a third bite...
108761.effect: Decreases all party members' gliding and sprinting Stamina consumption by 15% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108762.name: Surf, Turf, and Perch
108762.desc: A large platter with a mix of meat and vegetables. Various ingredients from the sea, land, and air have been roasted and mixed together. There's something for everyone here, making it a must-have at any important banquet in Natlan.
108762.effect: Decreases all party members' gliding and sprinting Stamina consumption by 20% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108763.name: Delicious Surf, Turf, and Perch
108763.desc: A large platter with a mix of meat and vegetables. Thick, juicy chunks of meat have soaked up all the spices, mingling delightfully with the crispness of the fruit and vegetables on the tip of your tongue, touching more than just your taste buds, as your stomach is also moved to satisfaction. No wonder this dish has so many loyal fans.
108763.effect: Decreases all party members' gliding and sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108764.name: Suspicious Volcano Cake
108764.desc: A volcano-shaped cake. The "mountain" has failed to fully contain the "lava" within, resulting in a collapse that genuinely resembles a volcanic eruption, bringing calamity to the tray beneath. Looks like some cleanup is in order before the next try...
108764.effect: Revives a character and restores 900 HP.

108765.name: Volcano Cake
108765.desc: A volcano-shaped cake. The ingredients were mixed together, stirred into a thick paste, then poured into a mold for baking. Timing it to perfection allows the outer layer to solidify while the filling remains soft and gooey, just like a real volcano.
108765.effect: Revives a character and restores 1,200 HP.

108766.name: Delicious Volcano Cake
108766.desc: A volcano-shaped cake. The steaming hot "little volcano" finds its perfect foil in the icy-cool "ash cloud" that rises above. Aside from its irresistible sweetness, the aroma of the flowing "lava" brings you a deep sense of satisfaction and comfort.
108766.effect: Revives a character and restores 1,500 HP.

108767.name: Suspicious Grainfruit Wrap
108767.desc: A staple food wrapped in big leaves. It basically tastes the same as biting into raw Grainfruit, begging the question of what the purpose of cooking it was...
108767.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 88 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108768.name: Grainfruit Wrap
108768.desc: A staple food wrapped in big leaves. There's a simple saying in Natlan that goes like this: "A leaf to wrap your Grainfruit with will always fall." It's used to express the idea of things being fated to happen.
108768.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 107 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108769.name: Delicious Grainfruit Wrap
108769.desc: A staple food wrapped in big leaves. The light fragrance of Grainfruit rises up from the soft, velvety filling within. As it melts in your mouth, its sweet and spicy notes combine with a touch of saltiness, resulting in a gustatory experience that is nothing short of sumptuously rich.
108769.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 126 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108770.name: Suspicious Mystique Soup
108770.desc: A drink made from Grainfruit. One sip and all your taste buds begin to tingle. It's almost like an "endless aftertaste," for the flavor is so intense that it lingers on the tip of your tongue, and even drinking water cannot wash it away.
108770.effect: A little surprise from the Masters of the Night-Wind.

108771.name: Mystique Soup
108771.desc: A drink made from Grainfruit. Originally invented as a type of medicine by a certain shaman of the Masters of the Night-Wind, the recipe has been altered with the passage of time and is now a common drink at social gatherings.
108771.effect: A little surprise from the Masters of the Night-Wind.

108772.name: Delicious Mystique Soup
108772.desc: A drink made from Grainfruit. The cup is full of still, bright liquid, with the magnificent hues of a gemstone with a stunning gradient. Its subtle fragrance and delicate sweetness combine to evoke the mysteries of an ancient tribe, leaving those that partake yearning for more.
108772.effect: A little surprise from the Masters of the Night-Wind.

108773.name: Suspicious Sing Your Heart Out
108773.desc: A cool-flavored throat lozenge. Its icy taste rushes through your mouth, setting your teeth chattering involuntarily and nearly half-freezing your heart. Forget about singing your heart out — even just making yourself understood is now a challenge...
108773.effect: A little surprise from the Flower-Feather Clan.

108774.name: Sing Your Heart Out
108774.desc: A cool-flavored throat lozenge. Said to be the Flower-Feather Clan's secret weapon for soothing their throats and protecting their vocal cords — so eat one and go sing your heart out! Just make sure you don't go overboard, as too much sugar can leave your throat feeling hoarse.
108774.effect: A little surprise from the Flower-Feather Clan.

108775.name: Delicious Sing Your Heart Out
108775.desc: A cool-flavored throat lozenge. These exquisitely crafted candies seem to send a wave of coolness down your throat, relieving hoarseness like bubbling springwater spilling forth and cleansing parched earth. Your voice is left sounding as clear as a newly-fledged hatchling, eager to spread its wings and fly up into the sky.
108775.effect: A little surprise from the Flower-Feather Clan.

108776.name: Honey-Glazed Ceviche
108776.desc: Ororon's specialty. "This is to honor my elders." And without further ado, the fish slices were served up, glistening with juicy deliciousness. From the sweet, delicate flavor, you can tell that the sauce most likely contains honey of the highest caliber, the gathering of which must have required a great deal of thought and effort. It's not often that you get to witness such displays of filial respect.
108776.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 114 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108777.name: Moment of Respite
108777.desc: Chasca's specialty. Piled high with ingredients, few can resist the aroma of this dish. Even someone in the midst of an argument might find their anger turn to hunger at the mere whiff of it. Wait a moment, those Saurians who were rolling around in the distance just now... Why have they suddenly started looking this way too?
108777.effect: Decreases all party members' gliding and sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 1800s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108778.name: Suspicious Magmic Ode
108778.desc: An ancient Natlan dish. If there's still a hint of hope when the coarse, sandy texture touches your tongue, that last shred of optimism vanishes the moment the earthy taste hits your palate. When exactly did it sneak its way in?
108778.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 10% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108779.name: Magmic Ode
108779.desc: An ancient Natlan dish. Traditionally, the ingredients are wrapped in large leaves and steam-baked in a pit using red-hot stones. When billows of steam begin to rise like clouds, this Natlan delicacy, perfect for sharing with larger groups, is ready to serve.
108779.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 15% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108780.name: Delicious Magmic Ode
108780.desc: An ancient Natlan dish. The meticulous roasting locks the juices tightly within the ingredients, while a subtle smokiness lingers like faint golden threads sewn on rare woven scrolls, elevating the flavor to new heights. A single bite will make anyone uncontrollably cheer in delight.
108780.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108781.name: Suspicious Qingxin Flower Cake
108781.desc: A cake made from flowers. The dry, hard texture and bland flavor bear no resemblance to the delicate nature that flowers should possess. One can't help but wonder if the filling is actually made of scraps of paper...

108782.name: Qingxin Flower Cake
108782.desc: A cake made from flowers. Prepared with Qingxin petals still glistening with their morning dew, the filling is wrapped in many layers consisting of two different types of pastry — a flaky crust and a buttery dough. Baked to perfection, Qingxin Flower Cakes are best enjoyed fresh from the oven.

108783.name: Delicious Qingxin Flower Cake
108783.desc: A cake made from flowers. With a gentle bite, the blossoms swaying in the mountains seem to bloom in your mouth, and the fragrance of flowers feels as if it seeps into your very soul. As you reluctantly finish the last bite, a faint, lingering scent remains on your fingers...

108784.name: Suspicious Drunken Plums in Snow
108784.desc: An elegant-looking Liyue dish. The final presentation seems flawless, but hidden within the carefully disassembled crab meat are small, unnoticed fragments of shell. Before indulging, one must overcome a sense of unease, as there's always the risk of your teeth meeting a shard of hard chitin...
108784.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 215 and healing effects by 6% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108785.name: Drunken Plums in Snow
108785.desc: An elegant-looking Liyue dish. Once the crab is steamed, its roe and meat are carefully removed, stir-fried, then returned to the shell. Egg whites are whipped into a frothy coating to seal the crab shell, topped with finely chopped ham for a touch of color, then the whole thing is baked. Together, the succulent crab meat and fluffy egg whites make a combination that's sure to impress.
108785.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 261 and healing effects by 8% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108786.name: Delicious Drunken Plums in Snow
108786.desc: An elegant-looking Liyue dish. The snow-like coating is soft and airy, like snowflakes gently falling onto your tongue. Then, the rich, fresh crab meat quickly envelops your taste buds, like radiant, resplendent plum blossoms blooming amidst the lonesome, serene snowfall, captivating and enchanting.
108786.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 308 and healing effects by 10% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108787.name: Hymn of Gathered Flame
108787.desc: Mavuika's specialty. A variety of seafood, perfectly grilled, harmonizes into an exquisite symphony of flavor. It resembles an eternal, noble anthem ringing in your ears, with the unquenchable flames igniting in tandem. The stirring, beautiful melody carries an inspiring power. Is this perhaps also a part of the Pyro Archon's immense strength?
108787.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 20% and CRIT DMG by 20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108788.name: Jade-Cut Flowers
108788.desc: Lan Yan's specialty. Before you, a young girl lowers her head, focused on weaving something with great care... In no time at all, a delicate rattan bowl appears in your hands, holding exquisite silver swallows and fragrant pastries. The girl's sincere, innocent smile seems almost like a spell, urging you to take a bite, and as you do, the flavors linger delightfully on your palate.

108789.name: Secret Art
108789.desc: Citlali's specialty. The fresh, tender greens are surprisingly crisp, while the grilled shrimp is firm with a hint of sweetness. The perfectly crafted shape can be easily picked up with just one hand... If only a captivating novel were at hand, paired with such a delicacy, you could easily lose yourself in it for a whole day and night. Is this the unique secret art of Granny Itztli's vast knowledge?
108789.effect: Revives the selected character and restores 20% of Max HP, then restores an additional 1,500 HP.

108790.name: Suspicious Bathhouse Manjuu
108790.desc: A filled Inazuman dessert. The dry, hard outer casing contains an even drier filling, the cloying sweetness of which makes it difficult to swallow. If you don't wish to drown your anticipation in disappointment, it's probably a good idea not to eat these before enjoying a good soak...

108791.name: Bathhouse Manjuu
108791.desc: A filled Inazuman dessert. These moreish morsels have a pleasant sweetness and are a fantastic source of energy. Originally handed out to bathers at the Aisa Bathhouse, these special snacks have since become a reliably welcome present for all occasions.

108792.name: Delicious Bathhouse Manjuu
108792.desc: A filled Inazuman dessert. The crispy, flaky outer casing protects a rich and delicate filling, its sweetness dissolving on your tongue like worries melting away in a hot spring. As you eat, your tiredness vanishes without a trace, leaving you relaxed and at ease.

108793.name: Dreams of Healing
108793.desc: Yumemizuki Mizuki's specialty. A pair of adorable mini-baku buns nestling together with their eyes tightly closed. Cute and carefree, they leave you wondering what sweet dreams they're lost in... Perhaps, once you take a bite, you might be able to share in their wonderful reveries.

108794.name: Suspicious Cheesy Crab Hotpot
108794.desc: A glittering, gold-topped feast. The charred ingredients stick stubbornly to the casserole dish, and after you tried your best to dredge up a spoonful, the first bite sent shivers down your spine. It's like you're being targeted by some sort of magma effigy — your senses scream at you to flee...
108794.effect: Increases all party members' Max HP by 20% and Energy Recharge by 14% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108795.name: Cheesy Crab Hotpot
108795.desc: A glittering, gold-topped feast. The ingredients are pre-fried and layered in a casserole dish before being baked until the cheesy topping begins to bubble. Whether for a family dinner or a festive gathering, this luxurious classic is sure to elicit gasps of admiration from everyone present.
108795.effect: Increases all party members' Max HP by 25% and Energy Recharge by 17% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108796.name: Delicious Cheesy Crab Hotpot
108796.desc: A glittering, gold-topped feast. The sweetness of crab meat is like the first ray of dawn that pierces the clouds. The dense, savory aroma of cheese invites the radiance of the morning sun onto your tastebuds, bathing your mouth in a warm, golden glow. The sensation of bliss sweeps a soul-warming path from your tongue to your stomach, uniting all your senses in adoration.
108796.effect: Increases all party members' Max HP by 30% and Energy Recharge by 20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108797.name: Suspicious Fruits Aplenty
108797.desc: Curiously flavored fruit juice made from a variety of ingredients. The sour Cacahuatl, the fibrous Grainfruit, the bitter Quenepa Berries, and the gooey eggs... They battle for attention on your taste buds, but you can't drum up the patience to let them finish. You desperately need a glass of water to wash it all down.
108797.effect: Restores 26% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 450 HP every 5s for 30s.

108798.name: Fruits Aplenty
108798.desc: Fresh and flavorful fruit juice made from a variety of ingredients. Its invigorating and healthy properties have made it a firm favorite among the fitness-obsessed tribespeople of the Collective of Plenty, who often recommend drinking two glasses a day.
108798.effect: Restores 28% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 620 HP every 5s for 30s.

108799.name: Delicious Fruits Aplenty
108799.desc: Fresh and flavorful fruit juice made from a selection of the finest ingredients. This otherworldly fragrance feels like being plunged into a fruit garden, bathed in gentle dawn-light, where dew-slick fruits melt into honey on the tongue, lifting your spirits and filling you with energy... Wait, why are your legs carrying you towards the gym?
108799.effect: Restores 30% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 790 HP every 5s for 30s.

108800.name: Suspicious Puffed Grainfruit Bars
108800.desc: A turgid, technicolor treat that has been cursed with a bland texture. Eating it almost feels like eating nothing at all. The only evidence left behind is the stains on your teeth.
108800.effect: Restores 20% of Max HP and an additional 900 HP to the selected character.

108801.name: Puffed Grainfruit Bars
108801.desc: A tasty, technicolor treat that is delightfully crisp and sweet. When displayed prominently on snack stands, it possesses an almost magical ability to make children's pocket money disappear.
108801.effect: Restores 22% of Max HP and an additional 1,200 HP to the selected character.

108802.name: Delicious Puffed Grainfruit Bars
108802.desc: A tantalizing, technicolor treat. Once you hear that delightful crunch, your mouth will be filled with a sweet and fruity fragrance, and your heart will be filled with joy. This is the power of the fabled "Pocket Money Pilferer"!
108802.effect: Restores 24% of Max HP and an additional 1,500 HP to the selected character.

108803.name: Suspicious Magma Eggs
108803.desc: A jet-black egg with a crust that has trapped too much heat from overcooking. The ominous color of the shell makes you feel uneasy, and you can't help but fear that something horrible will happen if you take a bite!

108804.name: Magma Eggs
108804.desc: A jet-black egg, formed by absorbing the essence of flame and rock. Despite its obsidian appearance, it tastes just like a regular boiled egg — unless, of course, one were to go out of their way to cook it in an irregular fashion...
108804.effect: Restores 9% of Max HP and an additional 1,000 HP to the selected character.

108805.name: Delicious Magma Eggs
108805.desc: A jet-black egg, with a beautiful frosty sheen observable in its darkness. Like a chunk of black jade slumbering in the mist, it's no wonder there are rumors about how it can prolong one's lifespan. That said, one can only hope it doesn't have the opposite effect...
108805.effect: Restores 10% of Max HP and an additional 1,200 HP to the selected character.

108806.name: Suspicious Cheesy Mushroom Skewer
108806.desc: A skewer covered in burnt cheese. The acrid smell gives notice that the Red Berryshroom has been reduced to a Black Burnedshroom. It looks so awful that you wonder if you might have turned a harmless mushroom into a poisonous one...
108806.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 6% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108807.name: Cheesy Mushroom Skewer
108807.desc: A skewer covered in mouth-watering cheese. The caps of Red Berryshrooms are removed, filled with a generous sprinkling of cheese, and then grilled to perfection. The rich aroma carries a faint fruity tang best enjoyed while hot.
108807.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 9% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108808.name: Delicious Cheesy Mushroom Skewer
108808.desc: A skewer covered in golden-brown, mouth-watering cheese. The mushrooms are almost as thick as steak. Although they don't smell like meat, the taste is far more splendid. A single bite blesses your whole mouth with the fragrant flavors packed within, as juicy joy overflows in abundance.
108808.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 12% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108809.name: Gold-Standard Healthy Meal
108809.desc: Iansan's specialty. A gold-standard meal, prepped by a gold-standard coach. The freshest ingredients are portioned to perfection and packed full of nutrients, with too many benefits to count! If you can bear eating it daily, maybe you too shall become a gold-standard trainee.
108809.effect: Revives a character and restores 15% of Max HP, then restores an additional 550 HP.

108810.name: Mt. Mushroom (For One)
108810.desc: Varesa's specialty. The young lady, with all the air of a bright pink marshmallow, effortlessly serves this mountainous dish with one hand. The fragrance of mushrooms, mingling with cheese, has you reaching for your cutlery before you even know it. Hey, umm... Is it even possible to finish eating this much food in a day?
108810.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 16% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108811.name: Suspicious Harvest's Boon
108811.desc: A strange-looking meal barely held together by the humble Grainfruit. The blackened outer shell reminds you of the importance of heat control. Considering the time and effort you spent gathering the ingredients... Maybe the inside's not as burnt. Perhaps it's still worth a try?
108811.effect: A little surprise from the Collective of Plenty.

108812.name: Harvest's Boon
108812.desc: A rich and comforting meal held together by the humble Grainfruit. Minced meat is stir-fried and placed in a baking pan with larger chunks of meat and eggs. The whole thing is then covered with a layer of mashed Grainfruit and baked until a tantalizing golden brown. This hearty dish can often be found on the tables of the Collective of Plenty during harvest festivals.
108812.effect: A little surprise from the Collective of Plenty.

108813.name: Delicious Harvest's Boon
108813.desc: A luxurious, flavor-packed meal held together by the humble Grainfruit. Your anticipation soars even as the oven's heat does, and once you taste it, the sweetness of Grainfruit and the savoriness of the minced meat break out into a joyful dance on your taste buds... Huh, your hands and legs are instinctively swaying along to the beat.
108813.effect: A little surprise from the Collective of Plenty.

108814.name: Suspicious Petit Gateau Debord: Revised Version
108814.desc: A petite version of the famous Gateau Debord. The small cake is like a piece of driftwood lost in a vast ocean, while the thick chocolate sauce is like a surging wave, enveloping not just the cake — and much of the plate — but also any tiny lingering foothold that hunger might have held in your stomach.
108814.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 224 and CRIT Rate by 6% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108815.name: Petit Gateau Debord: Revised Version
108815.desc: A petite version of the famous Gateau Debord. Even when compared to its namesake, of which only sixteen slices are sold each day, the extraordinary adventures you've experienced together are yet more precious and worthy of remembrance still. Perhaps when Escoffier scribbled down this recipe, she was thinking along these same lines...
108815.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 272 and CRIT Rate by 8% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108816.name: Delicious Petit Gateau Debord: Revised Version
108816.desc: A petite version of the famous Gateau Debord. The velvety sauce is like elusive silk, slipping between your fingers and alighting on your tongue, while the gentle melodies of afternoon tea circle in the air, enchanting your heart... Perhaps this little treat will appear before you again in your dreams tonight...
108816.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 320 and CRIT Rate by 10% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108817.name: Suspicious Candy Shells
108817.desc: Candies in a variety of different shapes. The powdered sugar coating has a grainy texture, reminiscent of grit trapped in an oyster's shell. Perhaps only those willing to battle through the coarseness of this coating will earn the right to enjoy the spoils within — sweet candy.
108817.effect: Increases all party members' Shield Strength by 25% and DEF by 165 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108818.name: Candy Shells
108818.desc: Candies in a variety of different shapes. It is said that a tiny fraction of the Candy Shells sold at the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland contain real pearls, and that the pleasure of tasting these is reserved for only the very luckiest of visitors. Might you be one of them?
108818.effect: Increases all party members' Shield Strength by 30% and DEF by 200 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108819.name: Delicious Candy Shells
108819.desc: Candies in a variety of different shapes. Their vibrant colors make them resemble gleaming gemstones resting majestically in an exquisite box, waiting to give their finder a sweet surprise. What could make someone happier than a trip to the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland? Why, a trip to the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland and a box of Candy Shells!
108819.effect: Increases all party members' Shield Strength by 35% and DEF by 235 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108820.name: Gateau Debord: Magnifique
108820.desc: Escoffier's specialty. Its lavish appearance is even more dazzling than any gateau you've seen before. It has an aura that captivates at first glance and a taste that is impossible not to love, like a soft, warm blanket that envelops every tastebud and suffuses your body with joy... Without a doubt, Escoffier's culinary talents have quietly reached new heights.
108820.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 384 and CRIT Rate by 14% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108821.name: Emotional Support
108821.desc: Ifa's specialty. "Eat up, bro." The voices of a human and a saurian follow one after the other as Ifa brings you a plate of fragrant cookies and Cacucu follows it up with a cup of rich Xocoatl — barely delivered with an enormous flapping of the wings. Caught between these competing aromas, your unexplained anxiety dissolves away... Awesome work, bro!
108821.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 282 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108822.name: Verdant Gift
108822.desc: Escoffier's inspired creation. A well-presented asparagus salad presented like a lush, green bouquet and drizzled with yellowy-orange sauce. A fresh, crisp mouthful that captures the vitality of soft, young shoots at the very instant they break the surface of the soil — it's almost as though Escoffier has moved beyond mastering the careful control of heat and flavor and is now cooking with time itself.
108822.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 320 and CRIT Rate by 10% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108823.name: Wave-Kissed Sands
108823.desc: Escoffier's inspired creation. Flowing cream crashes onto the palate like surf on the crest of a breaking wave, revealing the silky, velvety broth beneath. The soft, rich texture of the soup is a testament to the chef's masterful arts — one imbued with a mystical warmth.
108823.effect: Decreases all party members' sprinting and swimming Stamina consumption by 25% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108824.name: Gilded Hall
108824.desc: Escoffier's inspired creation. The crispy crust is like a small, golden castle, stoutly protecting chunks of succulent eel, juicy squab, and tender foie gras, all swimming in a rich mushroom sauce. A chorus of different flavors hits your tongue at once, with a complexity and richness deserving of its own footnote in history. Escoffier's culinary tour de force is enough to move you to your very soul.
108824.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 372 and CRIT DMG by 24% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108825.name: Autumn Frost
108825.desc: Escoffier's inspired creation. Layers of swirling chestnut cream paint the outline of Mont Automnequi, while a dusting of powdered sugar nestles on top, like frost clinging to the mountain slopes. The powerful aroma of chestnuts blends perfectly with the light and airy cream, leaving you licking your lips for more. You might say that Escoffier has summited the pinnacle of the culinary arts with this one.
108825.effect: Restores 42% of Max HP and an additional 2850 HP to the selected character.

108826.name: Suspicious Drink 455
108826.desc: A specially-blended drink that's all the rage right now. Except... you're not sure if there's something wrong with the formula, or you didn't mix the ingredients enough. The sour bits are too sour, the sweet bits are too sweet — and the fact that you can tell apart the "bits" in a liquid beverage is probably cause for concern...
108826.effect: Revives a character and restores 900 HP.

108827.name: Drink 455
108827.desc: A specially-blended drink that's all the rage right now. Besides its smooth and refreshing taste, it's known for replenishing lost energy from long bouts of physical exertion. Why not try a bottle when you're feeling parched?
108827.effect: Revives a character and restores 1,200 HP.

108828.name: Delicious Drink 455
108828.desc: A specially-blended drink that's all the rage right now.
