Fortunately, just as you're questioning your life choices — or at least those that apply to baked goods — a slight hint of berries hits your palate, reminding you that you are, in fact, not eating frozen soil...

108910.name: Lakkaberry Pie
108910.desc: A sweet treat from the borderlands. Once made using nothing but Lakkaberries, the recipe was later enhanced by adding Midsommar Berries to the mix. The two fruits complement each other perfectly, giving this sweet pie a rich, enticing flavor. The original name, however, remains unchanged.

108911.name: Delicious Lakkaberry Pie
108911.desc: A sweet treat from the borderlands. The comforting aroma of freshly baked pastry blends perfectly with the sweet yet tart flavor of the succulent two-berry filling. Rich flavors dance vividly across your tongue — no wonder this delightfully punchy treat has become a beloved and comforting staple on the tables of Nod-Krai.

108912.name: Suspicious Lohikeitto
108912.desc: A classic soup from the frigid regions. At first glance, it looks appetizing enough. However, a single sip reveals a burnt flavor that overwhelms your taste buds. You quickly inspect the pot and sure enough, the bottom is a charred, black mess... For the sake of your health, it's probably best to skip this one.
108912.effect: Restores 18% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 300 HP every 5s for 30s.

108913.name: Lohikeitto
108913.desc: Classic soup from the frigid regions. Succulent salmon is cut into chunks and cooked with fresh vegetables. Cream is added just before serving, along with other special seasonings, to create a bowl of warm, hearty chowder with a silky-smooth texture.
108913.effect: Restores 20% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 390 HP every 5s for 30s.

108914.name: Delicious Lohikeitto
108914.desc: A classic soup from the frigid regions. The creamy chowder, smooth as flowing silk, envelops each ingredient in its smooth embrace. As you take your first sip, you feel a gentle, cozy warmth spread throughout you, as if a vivid, golden sunrise is taking place inside your stomach.
108914.effect: Restores 22% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 470 HP every 5s for 30s.

108915.name: Piramida Nightingale
108915.desc: A drink whose colors are clear and elegant — this one does not appear to contain any alcohol. Legend has it that the Torchforger, Solovei, once gifted someone a nightingale, and that moment served as the inspiration for this drink. Now, only the nightingale's song remains, lingering amid the tranquil night.
108915.effect: Restores 30% of Max HP and an additional 1,750 HP to the selected character.

108916.name: Frontier Land
108916.desc: A layered drink of shifting shades — this one does not appear to contain any alcohol. The inspiration for this concoction is said to be Nod-Krai itself, with an initial icy chill that gives way to smoky, astringent notes. It's worth noting that the alcoholic version of this drink is a daily staple for many of the region's veteran adventurers.

108917.name: Wildberry Trail
108917.desc: A layered drink of different colors — this one does not appear to contain any alcohol. Incorporating two of Nod-Krai's signature berries, its vibrant colors feel light and cheerful, as if you're strolling down a path through a fertile orchard.
108917.effect: Restores 26% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 570 HP every 5s for 30s.

108918.name: Secrets Exchanged
108918.desc: Nefer's specialty. "How about this in exchange for a story?" No sooner are the words out of her mouth than a plate of fragrant, crispy spheres appears in front of you. Before you have time to agree, she gently catches your hand. "Oh, and by the way," she adds, "each mouthful buys at least one sentence." ...Sure enough, one has to pay the right price for a taste of Nefer's cooking...
108918.effect: Revives a character and restores 15% of Max HP, then restores an additional 550 HP.

108919.name: Sugar Sculpture: Nefer
108919.desc: A sugar sculpture crafted to capture a person's essence. The mysterious and unfathomable headdress brings to mind Nefer, the owner of the Curatorium of Secrets.
108919.effect: It looks great and tastes wonderful, but it doesn't really have any effect.

108921.name: "After-Class Practice"
108921.desc: Jahoda's specialty. After seeking advice on baking techniques from Ineffa for the sixth time, Jahoda finally presented her assignment — a handmade pastry. The shape is a bit wobbly, but the sweet scent of berries is irresistible, and the taste... well, it can't be too bad, right?
108921.effect: Restores 40% of Max HP and an additional 2,350 HP to the selected character.

108924.name: Apple Stew (Trial Version)
108924.desc: Durin's specialty. Imitating your every move at the stove, Durin prepared the very first dish of his life. Within its rich, fruity aroma lay his nascent understanding of this world's cuisine. Along its slightly crisped edges rested the fruits of his effort to restrain his own power.
108924.effect: Restores 40% of Max HP and an additional 2,350 HP to the selected character.

108926.name: Suspicious Spiced Fried Chicken
108926.desc: Fried chicken wrapped in a crispy green skin. But before you can even taste the fried chicken, the preponderance of spices already has you choking up... You planned to study after this filling meal, but it seems a glass of water is in order first...
108926.effect: Restores 30% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 510 HP every 5s for 30s.

108927.name: Spiced Fried Chicken
108927.desc: Fried chicken wrapped in a crispy green skin. The chicken is wrapped in a paste mixed with spices before being deep-fried. They say that finishing this will induce within you an urge to study hard... Can there be such an amazing thing in this world?
108927.effect: Restores 32% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 730 HP every 5s for 30s.

108928.name: Delicious Spiced Fried Chicken
108928.desc: Fried chicken wrapped in a crispy green skin. Take a bite while it's hot, and the spicy flavor will awaken your taste buds as the bountiful juices burst forth between your teeth, refreshing your spirit... In this state, you feel as if you could learn just about anything!
108928.effect: Restores 35% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 930 HP every 5s for 30s.

108929.name: Sugar Sculpture: Jahoda
108929.desc: A sugar sculpture crafted to capture a person's essence. The directional and guiding compass brings to mind Jahoda, the outstanding employee of the Curatorium of Secrets.
108929.effect: It looks great and tastes wonderful, but it doesn't really have any effect.

108930.name: Sugar Sculpture: Kuuhenki
108930.desc: A sugar sculpture modeled after a mysterious creature. With an ethereal form, it's a kuuhenki drifting gently in the moonlight.
108930.effect: It looks great and tastes wonderful, but it doesn't really have any effect.

108931.name: Suspicious Lucky Snow Delight
108931.desc: A Liyue confectionery made from rice. Its flavor is mild and ordinary, so forgettable that it vanishes from your mind almost immediately after the last bite.
108931.effect: Restores 30% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 510 HP every 5s for 30s.

108932.name: Lucky Snow Delight
108932.desc: A Liyue confection made from rice. The grains are ground into flour and then mixed with sugar and water before being pressed into molds and steamed to become a snow-white cake that evokes the promise of a rich and plentiful harvest.
108932.effect: Restores 32% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 730 HP every 5s for 30s.

108933.name: Delicious Lucky Snow Delight
108933.desc: A Liyue confection made from rice. Pure and white as fresh snow, it melts the moment it touches your tongue, offering a clean, delicate sweetness that lingers like a gentle echo.
108933.effect: Restores 35% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 930 HP every 5s for 30s.

108934.name: Suspicious Crispy Spring Rolls
108934.desc: A deep-fried Liyue snack. The crust was supposed to be crisp, but somehow it ended up soft and soggy — how strange... Wait, could this be the oil paper used to wrap the food...?
108934.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 165 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108935.name: Crispy Spring Rolls
108935.desc: A deep-fried Liyue snack. Shredded meat and vegetables are wrapped in a thin pancake, rolled into a tube, and then fried until golden. Crunchy on the outside, smooth on the inside, these little delicacies are cherished by old and young alike.
108935.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 200 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108936.name: Delicious Crispy Spring Rolls
108936.desc: A deep-fried Liyue snack. With a crisp crack, the juicy filling bursts forth as you bite. Beneath the golden, flaky shell are not only layers of flavor, but the vibrant, bustling spirit of Liyue itself.
108936.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 235 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108937.name: Suspicious Berry Herbal Candy
108937.desc: A Nod-Krai candy. Salty and astringent in a way you wouldn't expect from a candy, it hits so hard that anyone anticipating something sweet would howl in shock and dismay.
108937.effect: Increases all party members' Max HP by 20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108938.name: Berry Herbal Candy
108938.desc: A Nod-Krai candy made from local flowers, herbs, and berries. Its bright colors bring a small but welcome touch of sweetness to the vast frozen plains.
108938.effect: Increases all party members' Max HP by 22% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108939.name: Delicious Berry Herbal Candy
108939.desc: A Nod-Krai candy. The moment this translucent treat touches your tongue, waves of floral fragrance and sweet-tart berries fill your senses, fresh and delightfully sweet.
108939.effect: Increases all party members' Max HP by 25% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108940.name: Suspicious Veggie Pot Soup
108940.desc: A soup prepared by simmering a variety of shredded vegetables with light seasoning. The long simmer has left the greens soft and limp, a bit mushy in texture. Not exactly appetizing, but it'll fill you up.
108940.effect: Restores 30% of Max HP and an additional 600 HP to the selected character.

108941.name: Veggie Pot Soup
108941.desc: A soup prepared by simmering a variety of shredded vegetables with light seasoning. It's mild, flavorful, and great for your health.
108941.effect: Restores 32% of Max HP and an additional 1,250 HP to the selected character.

108942.name: Delicious Veggie Pot Soup
108942.desc: A soup prepared by simmering a variety of shredded vegetables with light seasoning. Cooked with simple, minimal techniques, it brings out the purest essence of the vegetables. With just one sip, a comforting warmth spreads from your stomach through your entire body.
108942.effect: Restores 34% of Max HP and an additional 1,900 HP to the selected character.

108943.name: Suspicious Fireside Merriment
108943.desc: A generous spread of hearty meat cuts. The dense fat, bitter and salty, hits the palate like a runaway carriage, leaving a lingering, oily trail down the throat... an intense assault few could endure.
108943.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 10% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108944.name: Fireside Merriment
108944.desc: A generous spread of hearty meat cuts combining Snezhnayan cured meats with Nod-Krai ham and sausage. Many older Nod-Krai locals like to savor it by the fire with a drink in hand.
108944.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 15% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108945.name: Delicious Fireside Merriment
108945.desc: A generous spread of hearty meat cuts. The thick raw cuts carry hints of pine and salt, the sausages give off a deep smoky fragrance, and the ham slices add a rich, savory touch. Bold and hearty, it's a feast any Nod-Krai local would give a thumbs-up to.
108945.effect: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108946.name: Suspicious Mushroom Phantasm
108946.desc: A bread with a sauteed vegetarian filling. After struggling through the charred crust, you finally get a taste, only to be hit with a muddy, earthy flavor. A few bites in, your head starts to spin... Could this be a new type of poisonous mushroom?
108946.effect: Revives a character and restores 900 HP.

108947.name: Mushroom Phantasm
108947.desc: A bread with a sauteed vegetarian filling. The cooked mixture is folded into rye dough, allowed to rise, and baked. It resembles a real mushroom so closely that, if not for the shallow cuts on its "cap," you'd almost mistake it for the real thing.
108947.effect: Revives a character and restores 1,200 HP.

108948.name: Delicious Mushroom Phantasm
108948.desc: A bread with a sauteed vegetarian filling. Its coarse, sturdy crust acts like a solid wall, sealing in the fragrant juices of the tender mushroom filling, creating a rustic yet satisfying taste that unfolds in your mouth.
108948.effect: Revives a character and restores 1,500 HP.

108949.name: Flavor of Spring
108949.desc: Zibai's specialty. Its color gleams like golden amber, reminiscent of her eyes. Its aroma is as familiar as a simple spring roll, yet each crisp bite reveals an unexpected resilience... Could this be a secret recipe from ancient Lang-Gan?
108949.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 282 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108950.name: Moonlit Mirage
108950.desc: Columbina's specialty. The translucent candy looks like droplets of dew gathered from moonlight. Its delicate sweetness flits in and out of reach, as if luring you into a beautiful, fleeting dream. You can't help but wonder at the skill and care that went into making it...
108950.effect: Increases all party members' Max HP by 30% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108951.name: Nightwatch Soup
108951.desc: Illuga's specialty. A steaming bowl of hot soup, just a sip after returning from the night patrol can melt away fatigue and ease tense nerves. Such an effect is likely the result of the young captain's years of accumulated experience, perfected into his own unique recipe.
108951.effect: Restores 40% of Max HP and an additional 2,350 HP to the selected character.

108952.name: Sugar Sculpture: Columbina
108952.desc: A sugar sculpture crafted to capture a person's essence. Its light, fluttering hair ornaments bring to mind Columbina, the Moon Maiden, whose very presence feels as airy as a gentle song.
108952.effect: It looks great and tastes wonderful, but it doesn't really have any effect.

108953.name: Sugar Sculpture: Illuga
108953.desc: A sugar sculpture crafted to capture a person's essence. The loyal messenger bird brings to mind Illuga, the young captain of Nightmare Orioles.
108953.effect: It looks great and tastes wonderful, but it doesn't really have any effect.

108954.name: Charred Mushroom Phantasm
108954.desc: A bread with a sauteed vegetable filling. Haphazardly cooked over a barely controlled fire, it comes out as a pitch-black charcoal mushroom. Just looking at it is enough to intimidate, and taking a bite could be downright risky...

108955.name: Suspicious Golden-Tempered Jade
108955.desc: A chicken dish native to Liyue. Its skin is a tantalizing bright yellow, beautifully contrasting with the pale, tender-looking meat beneath. Yet the moment you take a bite, regret sets in — the meat is dry and tough, wedging itself stubbornly between your teeth...
108955.effect: Restores 18% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 300 HP every 5s for 30s.

108956.name: Golden-Tempered Jade
108956.desc: A chicken dish native to Liyue. Prepared with simple spices, it strives to highlight the authentic flavor of fresh ingredients. The finished dish has smooth skin, tender meat, and a fresh taste, and is especially delightful when paired with a dipping sauce.
108956.effect: Restores 20% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 390 HP every 5s for 30s.

108957.name: Delicious Golden-Tempered Jade
108957.desc: A chicken dish native to Liyue. The skin has a satisfying firmness, and the meat is tender and flavorful. The natural gelatin from the chicken, set into a jelly, brims with the rich aroma of rendered chicken fat, and even the bones carry a subtle hint of sweetness. This dish is a true symphony of flavors, certain to delight even the most discerning gourmand.
108957.effect: Restores 22% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 470 HP every 5s for 30s.

108958.name: Hearty Indulgence
108958.desc: Varka's specialty. Generous cuts of smoked chicken thigh and tall glasses of Apple Cider, laid out in a rugged, bold style, say everything you need to know about its owner: whether in battle or at the table, he never holds back.

108959.name: Suspicious Harbor Fish Burger
108959.desc: A fish burger. It features a fillet of a dull, greyish hue that fills one with hesitation. A bitter surge assaults your senses from the very first bite, just like a cup of frigid seawater utterly douses any lingering sparks of hope. It seems excessive marinating has stripped the fish of the freshness it once possessed...
108959.effect: Increases all party members' Max HP by 20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108960.name: Harbor Fish Burger
108960.desc: A fish burger. Freshly baked bread is sliced open. Then, layers of crisp greens, seasoned fish fillet, and sliced onions are added to it. Finally, it is finished with a drizzle of sauce. The burger has a savory-tart flavor that truly whets the appetite.
108960.effect: Increases all party members' Max HP by 22% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108961.name: Delicious Harbor Fish Burger
108961.desc: A fish burger. The hearty bread, tender fish, and crunchy toppings create a collision of textures that compels one to devour it in great, eager bites. Local rumors claim some families have uprooted their entire lives to Dornman Port just for a daily taste of this authentic delicacy. It seems those tales were no exaggeration...
108961.effect: Increases all party members' Max HP by 25% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108962.name: Suspicious Millhaven's Morning Plate
108962.desc: A classic Millhaven breakfast. The cold mincemeat patty is as hard as a rock. It's like gnawing on a greasy brick... Ugh, was it really worth leaving a warm, cozy bed for a morning meal like this?

108963.name: Millhaven's Morning Plate
108963.desc: A classic Millhaven breakfast. Slices of mincemeat patty are heated through and served alongside fried eggs, sausages, and potatoes. Nutritious and hearty, this meal provides all the energy needed to power through a busy morning.

108964.name: Delicious Millhaven's Morning Plate
108964.desc: A classic Millhaven breakfast. Fresh from the oven, the rich aroma of savory meat and toasted char rises to meet you, instantly transforming morning drowsiness into a ravenous appetite. A brand new day should always begin with such a magnificent overture!

108965.name: Iridescence Under the Tree's Shade
108965.desc: Linnea's specialty. A "Lumi" crafted from sour cream sits at the center, surrounded by fruits that look like crystallized rainbows. Its adorable appearance brings warmth to one's heart. Upon closer inspection, each fruit bears the signature of a different land... The care she took in traversing mountains and rivers to gather these speaks louder than a thousand words.

108966.name: Sugar Sculpture: Linnea
108966.desc: A sugar sculpture crafted to capture a person's essence. The unique Jack Frost Lumi brings to mind Linnea, the advisor of the Adventurers' Guild.
108966.effect: It looks great and tastes wonderful, but it doesn't really have any effect.

108967.name: Suspicious Stuffed Tofu with Minced Meat
108967.desc: A savory tofu dish stuffed with a succulent meat filling. The first time you try to pick up a piece, the tofu falls apart completely. The second time, the tofu and filling separate on the spot... Tempting as the aroma is, after failing twice in a row, you've completely lost the will to try again.

108968.name: Stuffed Tofu with Minced Meat
108968.desc: A savory tofu dish stuffed with a succulent meat filling. Each block of tofu is hollowed out and packed with a perfectly seasoned minced meat, then seared until golden-brown before being braised in a rich, flavorful sauce. From humble, everyday ingredients emerges a taste of home, the most beloved and familiar comfort food found in every street and alleyway.

108969.name: Delicious Stuffed Tofu with Minced Meat
108969.desc: A savory tofu dish stuffed with a succulent meat filling. Four golden pieces sit neatly on a wide, gold-rimmed bone china plate. Steam rises in soft, fragrant curls, carrying an aroma that stirs the appetite at once. The tofu is finished in only a few bites, and the amber sauce left behind is too delicious to leave untouched — made to be poured over rice.

108970.name: Suspicious Mint Bubblegum
108970.desc: A soft, chewy candy. You brave the mint's powerful chill, puff up your cheeks, and with great effort finally blow a tiny bubble. Then, just before success is within reach, it leaks with a few sad little pffts, and the whole attempt is ruined...
108970.effect: Revives a character and restores 900 HP.

108971.name: Mint Bubblegum
108971.desc: A soft, chewy candy featuring a blend of two distinct flavors. With a bit of practice, you can blow impressively massive bubbles! Just watch out — if you push it too far and the bubble pops, you'll end up with a face full of sticky goo!
108971.effect: Revives a character and restores 1,200 HP.

108972.name: Delicious Mint Bubblegum
108972.desc: A soft, chewy candy. Its fresh flavor glides smoothly down your throat, bringing an instantly cool and refreshing sensation. Better still, with a gentle puff, you can blow a clear, glossy bubble. A perfect little treat for passing the time!
108972.effect: Revives a character and restores 1,500 HP.

108973.name: Spinning Special
108973.desc: Prune's specialty. "This Spinning Special is a game only grown-ups in Nod-Krai get to play! Hehe, I'll show you how it works." With a smug little flourish, she sets a drink-filled spinning tray in front of you. The juices are bright and colorful, sweet and delicious, but the moment you see the tray itself, your mind jumps to the words "Roulette Special"... Wait. Did she get the name wrong?
108973.effect: Decreases all party members' climbing and sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 1500s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108974.name: Gilded Chest
108974.desc: Nicole's specialty. "Surprised? I already knew how to make this a long time ago. Well, back then..." "Lately, I heard from Mr. Nine that it's become popular again in Liyue..." "A treasure chest design, and a culinary icon all in one? I'm a genius..." As a golden "treasure chest" is set before you, a flood of nonstop chatter instantly fills your mind... It could only be Nicole. Your head may be left buzzing from the barrage, but the delight on your taste buds is even more rewarding than opening a luxurious treasure chest.

108975.name: Boredom-Busting Bubblegum
108975.desc: Lohen's specialty. Seeing that you were bored, he handed you a few candies and grandly claimed they'd help pass the time. After only a few chews, he suddenly pulled out a mirror and flashed it in front of you, looking entirely too pleased with himself. Oh no — it was a setup all along! Your tongue was already dyed a bright blue-green... So by "help pass the time," he meant his own?
108975.effect: Revives the selected character and restores 20% of Max HP, then restores an additional 1,500 HP.

108976.name: Tea Party Polyphony
108976.desc: Sandrone's specialty. Appearing without fanfare at the tea party is an exquisitely crafted two-tiered assortment of pastries... Could she really have made this herself? Before the surprise in your eyes has time to fade, she folds her arms, turns slightly aside, and lifts her chin. "Hah? What's that look for? They're only tea snacks. Hardly a challenge." A faint, delicate sweetness drifts through the air, as if silently backing up her claim. Well then, best not keep them waiting!
108976.effect: Decreases all party members' climbing and sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 1500s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108977.name: Suspicious Birch-Steamed Pork Ribs
108977.desc: A dish made with branches and ribs. You casually take a piece, only to find it deep reddish-brown from drying, with lines across its surface like the rings of an old tree. Add in that coarse texture, and... Hold on. Surely this is not a branch mistaken for a rib?
108977.effect: Decreases all party members' gliding and sprinting Stamina consumption by 15% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108978.name: Birch-Steamed Pork Ribs
108978.desc: A dish made with branches and ribs. The ribs are marinated, air-dried, then placed on birch branches and steamed. When served, the meat is fall-apart tender, with a distinctive woody aroma. It is one of Nod-Krai's traditional festive dishes.
108978.effect: Decreases all party members' gliding and sprinting Stamina consumption by 20% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108979.name: Delicious Birch-Steamed Pork Ribs
108979.desc: A dish made with branches and ribs. With the lightest nudge of a fork, the meat falls from the bone like snow sliding from a branch. As it touches your tongue, its deep, savory richness mingles with the faint woodland aroma of steamed birch, finally melting into a warmth that leaves you wholly content.
108979.effect: Decreases all party members' gliding and sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108980.name: Suspicious Meat-Filled Rye Bun
108980.desc: Fish-stuffed bread. The bread is hard enough to pass for a shoe sole, while stubborn fish scales cling to your teeth and resist every attempt to scrape them off... One bite in, and you will already be looking for water to rinse your mouth.

108981.name: Meat-Filled Rye Bun
108981.desc: Fish-stuffed bread. The fish has its head and bones removed before being wrapped in bacon, encased in rye dough, and baked. The thickness of the bread is key to keeping the fish juicy.

108982.name: Delicious Meat-Filled Rye Bun
108982.desc: Fish-stuffed bread. Crack open its crisp, charred crust, and rich, savory oils come rushing out, followed by the clean sweetness of the fish. In the end, every flavor settles into the hearty crust, now steeped in fragrant juices. A single bite is enough to make even the bitter wind draw back.

108983.name: Tea Party Prelude: Herbal Tea
108983.desc: A floral herbal tea well worth savoring. Gentle and smooth, with a soft floral aroma that is both elegant and full-bodied. Its orange-red liquor glows like rosy light through clouds, soothing the heart with warmth and calm.
108983.effect: Restores 34% of Max HP and an additional 1,900 HP to the selected character.

108984.name: Tea Party Prelude: Artful Latte
108984.desc: A latte well worth savoring. Carefully ground from specially roasted coffee beans, it is finished with delicate foam art, soft and dense as mist. Its flavor is rich and mellow, with an unusually refined aroma that sets it apart.
108984.effect: Restores 34% of Max HP and an additional 1,900 HP to the selected character.

108985.name: Suspicious Pot-Braised Meat
108985.desc: A meat dish served in a clay pot. Due to an excessively long roasting time inside the pot, the meat has fallen apart into shredded strands that feel like chewing on an old blanket. One mouthful is enough to make you gently slide the pot further and further out of sight...
108985.effect: Restores 30% of Max HP and an additional 600 HP to the selected character.

108986.name: Pot-Braised Meat
108986.desc: A meat dish served in a clay pot. Cubed ingredients are placed into the pot, sealed with dough, and then baked in the oven. Once it is done, the crisp bread cap is lifted off, and sour cream is added for seasoning. The method itself is not complicated, but controlling the oven temperature and braising time takes quite the experience.
108986.effect: Restores 32% of Max HP and an additional 1,250 HP to the selected character.

108987.name: Delicious Pot-Braised Meat
108987.desc: A meat dish served in a clay pot. Cracking open the crisp puff pastry lid releases a sudden wave of savory, buttery fragrance with an inviting warmth. It feels just like basking in the cozy warmth after tossing a fresh log into the fireplace on a snowy winter night.
108987.effect: Restores 34% of Max HP and an additional 1,900 HP to the selected character.

108988.name: Suspicious Podvorye Smoked Sausage
108988.desc: Sliced sausage. The pieces are unevenly cut, with a few still stuck together. When picked up, they looked just like a string of weathered vines blackened with smoke...
108988.effect: Restores 8% of Max HP and an additional 800 HP to the selected character.

108989.name: Podvorye Smoked Sausage
108989.desc: Sliced sausage. A seasoned, stuffed, and smoked meat sausage, thinly sliced and served as is. A signature dish of Podvorye Restaurant, and a reliable choice no one at the table would turn down.
108989.effect: Restores 9% of Max HP and an additional 1,000 HP to the selected character.

108990.name: Delicious Podvorye Smoked Sausage
108990.desc: Sliced sausage. The firm texture sets the rhythm while smoky, savory flavors carry the melody, dancing across the palate in a perfectly harmonious duet. No wonder this is always the first plate to empty.
108990.effect: Restores 10% of Max HP and an additional 1,200 HP to the selected character.

108991.name: Suspicious Fish Curls
108991.desc: Sliced fish strips. The thicker parts are so frozen they might chip a tooth, while the thinner parts have already melted into mush... At the very least, under Snezhnaya's freezing temperatures, you probably won't have to worry about an upset stomach.
108991.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 66 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108992.name: Fish Curls
108992.desc: Sliced fish strips. Cut with a sharp blade at an angle across the surface of a whole frozen fish, shaving off thin, curling strips. Usually served with coarse salt, this is a common raw cold platter in Snezhnaya.
108992.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 81 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108993.name: Delicious Fish Curls
108993.desc: Sliced fish strips. Paper-thin ribbons of meat are piled in the dish like a small cluster of ice-sculpted petals. Pinch a piece into your mouth, and the crisp, clean sweetness hits the tip of your tongue with the fresh embrace of melting snow.
108993.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 95 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108994.name: Suspicious Snowrealm Okroshkas
108994.desc: A bowl of cold soup. It takes some effort to identify the ingredients floating in the cloudy broth. The vegetables are shredded like confetti, drowned alongside massive ham chunks. It seems the cook only remembered the ham at the very last second, tossing it in a desperate rush...
108994.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 165 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108995.name: Snowrealm Okroshkas
108995.desc: A bowl of cold soup. Cooked ingredients are arranged evenly in a bowl, then covered with a sour cream-based broth. Some Snezhnayans challenge themselves to down a large bowl of this soup in one go on the coldest days, taking it as proof that they are warriors who can conquer the bitter cold.
108995.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 200 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108996.name: Delicious Snowrealm Okroshkas
108996.desc: A bowl of cold soup. The shimmering, milky-white broth feels as crisp as fresh snow on the palate, followed instantly by a revitalizing burst of rich sour cream. With crunchy vegetables, firm egg yolks, and savory diced ham, every single spoonful offers a unique texture, as if you are opening a delicious mystery box.
108996.effect: Increases all party members' DEF by 235 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108997.name: Suspicious Borscht
108997.desc: A vibrant red soup dish. Everything about this dish feels half-hearted, looking as if someone simply dumped the leftover ingredients from a previous meal into the pot. Finishing it does make you feel somewhat warmer than before, but it is like a single match being struck, bringing nothing more than a fleeting moment of warmth.
108997.effect: Slightly decreases the rate of Sheer Cold accumulation for all party members for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108998.name: Borscht
108998.desc: A vibrant red soup dish. Once the broth is ready, various ingredients are added in batches and slow-simmered until their flavors meld. A spoonful of sour cream is often added just before serving. With every sip, a steady warmth spreads through the body, enough to keep the bitter cold at bay.
108998.effect: Somewhat decreases the rate of Sheer Cold accumulation for all party members for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

108999.name: Delicious Borscht
108999.desc: A vibrant red soup. The moment the hot broth slides down your throat, a soothing warmth takes hold, as if someone has lit a fire inside your chest. The heat quietly spreads until even the tips of your ears are warm. When trekking through a raging blizzard, this bowl of soup is worth far more than wrapping yourself in an extra coat!
108999.effect: Decreases the rate of Sheer Cold accumulation for all party members for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

110000.name: Crafted Items
110000.desc: Items produced through the Crafting System.

110001.name: Flour
110001.desc: A powder ground from wheat. No matter what it goes into, it brings a sense of satisfaction to the diner.

110002.name: Cream
110002.desc: A dairy product made from milk. An essential ingredient in making pastries.

110003.name: Smoked Fowl
110003.desc: Fowl that has been smoked. The firmness of the meat gives new texture to dishes.

110004.name: Butter
110004.desc: An extract from milk. With the appropriate application, it can bring rich aromas to even the most basic ingredients.

110005.name: Ham
110005.desc: Smoked leg meat. Even the thinnest slice is packed full of flavor.

110006.name: Sugar
110006.desc: A seasoning derived from Sweet Flowers. Has the power to give both energy and happiness.

110008.name: Jam
110008.desc: A gelatinous substance made from fruit and sugar. Even a little bit can easily wake up tired taste buds.

110009.name: Cheese
110009.desc: Made from fermented milk. High in energy, it's used in a wide range of dishes.

110010.name: Bacon
110010.desc: Smoked strips of pork. Crispy with a bit of fat, but not too greasy. Mmmmm... bacon.

110011.name: Sausage
110011.desc: Finely minced meat wrapped in a skin. A staple of every meat lover's daily diet.

110014.name: Spice
110014.desc: A seasoning with varied flavors. It is made from dried Harra Fruits and can enrich the taste of a dish. Therefore, Sumeru locals say, "Spice goes well with anything."

110015.name: Smetana
110015.desc: A dairy product produced through complex processes such as separation and fermentation. It has a smooth texture and a refreshing sourness, often serving as the finishing touch in many dishes.

110016.name: Rye Flour
110016.desc: A coarse, dark powder produced from grinding rye. Food made with it has a unique texture and a somewhat sour flavor.

110017.name: Honey
110017.desc: A rich, amber liquid with a classic sweetness, widely available in shops year-round. It can be used to sweeten beverages, craft sauces, or marinate various meats.
source_list: Sold at Snezhnayan general goods shops

111006.name: Heatshield Potion
111006.desc: A miraculous potion that boosts Pyro RES and makes one able to withstand high heat.\nIt works not by cooling the body, but by helping the body acclimate to high temperatures.
111006.effect: Increases all party members' Pyro RES by 25% for 300s.

111007.name: Desiccant Potion
111007.desc: A kind of potion that boosts Hydro RES and makes one able to withstand highly humid environments.\nIt is said to act like a desiccant and be highly effective at keeping items dry. It can also be ingested for the same effect.
111007.effect: Increases all party members' Hydro RES by 25% for 300s.

111008.name: Frostshield Potion
111008.desc: A miraculous potion that boosts Cryo RES and makes one able to withstand extreme cold.\nInduces a chilling sensation when drank, but once this sensation spreads throughout the body, the feeling of being cold disappears.
111008.effect: Increases all party members' Cryo RES by 25% for 300s.

111009.name: Windbarrier Potion
111009.desc: A mysterious potion that boosts Anemo RES and makes one able to withstand strong winds.\nIt works wonders for adventurers out in the world and is even said to keep the cold away.
111009.effect: Increases all party members' Anemo RES by 25% for 300s.

111010.name: Insulation Potion
111010.desc: A potion that boosts Electro RES and keeps one from getting electro-shocked.\nInduces a tingling sensation when drank. It is said to work by filling the body with inversely charged electrical energy, which counteracts the effect of Electro damage.
111010.effect: Increases all party members' Electro RES by 25% for 300s.

111011.name: Dustproof Potion
111011.desc: A potion that boosts Geo RES and keeps one from getting bothered by sand and dust.\nIt has a strange taste not unlike that of magnets. It keeps a traveler clean from all the sand and dust out there.
111011.effect: Increases all party members' Geo RES by 25% for 300s.

111012.name: Dendrocide Potion
111012.desc: A potion that boosts Dendro RES and suppresses the growth of plants.\nRather than killing the plants, it puts them in deep hibernation. It's also said to be good for the body if ingested.
111012.effect: Increases all party members' Dendro RES by 25% for 300s.

111013.name: Flaming Essential Oil
111013.desc: Grants greater affinity for Pyro, boosting Pyro DMG.\nIt is made of materials that gestate Pyro, which serves to draw in Pyro energy more effectively. It also makes the user more fired-up and passionate.
111013.effect: Increases all party members' Pyro DMG by 25% for 300s.

111014.name: Streaming Essential Oil
111014.desc: Grants greater affinity for Hydro, boosting Hydro DMG.\nIt's a slippery medicine for external use, able to better channel Hydro energy. It has a subtle fragrance.
111014.effect: Increases all party members' Hydro DMG by 25% for 300s.

111015.name: Frosting Essential Oil
111015.desc: Grants greater affinity for Cryo, boosting Cryo DMG.\nIt has a chilling sensation when applied, and helps one to better channel Cryo energy. It also helps to keep you cool-headed and calm.
111015.effect: Increases all party members' Cryo DMG by 25% for 300s.

111016.name: Gushing Essential Oil
111016.desc: Grants greater affinity for Anemo, boosting Anemo DMG.\nIt has a fragrant smell. It is said that using it during your travels will make you walk as if you're riding on the wind.
111016.effect: Increases all party members' Anemo DMG by 25% for 300s.

111017.name: Shocking Essential Oil
111017.desc: Grants greater affinity for Electro, boosting Electro DMG.\nIt induces a tingling sensation on the skin and renders the user better able to better channel Electro energy — but comes with a risk of causing an electrical fire that would definitely ruin your perfect hair.
111017.effect: Increases all party members' Electro DMG by 25% for 300s.

111018.name: Unmoving Essential Oil
111018.desc: Grants greater affinity for Geo, boosting Geo DMG.\nYou can feel the fine Geo pellets within when applied. It's said to help with physical injuries.
111018.effect: Increases all party members' Geo DMG by 25% for 300s.

111019.name: Forest Essential Oil
111019.desc: Grants greater affinity for Dendro, boosting Dendro DMG.\nIt's a nourishing external medicine that promotes growth of plants, able to better channel Dendro energy.
111019.effect: Increases all party members' Dendro DMG by 25% for 300s.

111023.name: Fruit Paste Bait
111023.desc: A very commonly-seen bait made from mashing, fermenting, and kneading Sunsettias and Wheat together. It atomizes very quickly upon hitting the water and exerts an incredible attraction on small fish. Due to the ease of its making, cheap price, and its excellent efficacy, it has also been jokingly called the "Fisher's Trusty Treasure."\n\nSuitable for catching Medakas, Dawncatchers, and Crystalfish.

111024.name: Redrot Bait
111024.desc: Fish bait made from mixing Dendrobium and mashed meat. The unique rank sweetness of this bait spreads very quickly in the water, attracting fierce aquatic predators. Use with caution, however! Put too much of this bait down and you might hook in nastier customers than you bargained for!\n\nSuitable for catching Sticklebacks, Bettas, Venomspine Fish, Akai Maou, and Snowstriders.

111025.name: False Worm Bait
111025.desc: This imitation worm bait is made mostly out of condensate, and will twist its body according to the underwater currents, resulting in its fatal attraction to overly-curious fish. Professionals will even add some fruit to it to increase its fragrance and make it utterly irresistable.\n\nSuitable for catching Shirakodai and Angelfish.

111026.name: Fake Fly Bait
111026.desc: Mimetic fly bait made from vibrantly-colored materials. It has no scent, and is specialized to attract large fish with sharp vision. It is often well-suited to more advanced angling techniques. The fishing associations of various regions regard the skilled use of such bait as one of the conditions for its members' advancement in rank.\n\nSuitable for catching Koi, Pufferfish, and Rays.

111027.name: Glowgrass Bait
111027.desc:
A special bait made from Magical Crystal Ore and Seagrass, it shines where no light illuminates, and may thus hold special attraction for those fellows who ever yearn for light.
If you should run out of these, you can get more from Kujirai Momiji.

Suitable for catching all fish species.
source_list: Obtained by completing Kujirai Momiji's quest

111028.name: Sugardew Bait
111028.desc: The bait is based on rose dew and has been mixed with sun-dried Harra Fruit powder. It has a spicy taste and a sweet aftertaste, just like the life of a fisherman. The harvest after going through all the weather-beaten days and roaring waves is particularly gratifying.\n\nSuitable for: Angler and Axe Marlin.

111029.name: "Pure Water"
111029.desc: It is said to be the legacy of a genius potioneer. It can draw out the purest strength from within one's body.
111029.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 320, CRIT Rate by 10%, and damage taken by 20% for 30s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

111030.name: Sour Bait
111030.desc: A type of bait based on flour mixed with the pulp and seeds of Bulle Fruit. When tossed into the water, it quickly spreads a sweet and sour fragrance that is irresistible to fishes such as Heartfeather Bass. A group of anglers once resorted to eating this bait in an emergency after they had run out of supplies, and were poisoned as a result. To prevent such accidents from happening again, this type of bait was made much sourer than it was before — so sour in fact that simply holding it up to their noses makes people feel dizzy and causes their eyes to stream, let alone putting it in their mouths...\n\nSuitable for catching Heartfeather Bass.

111031.name: Flashing Maintenance Mek Bait
111031.desc:
A unique type of Trap said to utilize technology developed by the Fontaine Research Institute. Equipped with a metal protective cage and hook bars, the device contains a light made from Marcotte extract.
When tossed in water, the light flashes at a certain frequency to attract nearby Maintenance Meks, which are often referred to as "Water Maintenance Fish" or "Iron Fish." Maintenance Meks have powerful bites, but they are only able to bite onto the specially made external bars which hook them firmly in place. The contraption is essentially a special kind of bait designed to catch valuable "Iron Fishes."

Suitable for catching Maintenance Meks.

111032.name: Strength Tonic
111032.desc: A potion of mysterious origins that has a simple formula. Some might even call it a healthy drink. As the name suggests, it can make people stronger.
111032.effect: Increases all party members' Physical DMG by 45%, CRIT Rate by 10%, and DMG taken by 20% for 30s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

111033.name: Spinelgrain Bait
111033.desc: Made from a mixture of Spinel Fruit and Grainfruit, this peculiar Natlan fish bait can maintain its shape even after having been submerged for extended periods of time. By dissipating flavor at a consistent rate, its remarkable power to attract fish continues unabated for a very long time indeed.\n\nSuitable for catching normal Rapidfish, Sunfish, and normal Unihornfish.

111034.name: Emberglow Bait
111034.desc: Made using a specialized method from a mixture of Embercore Flowers and Wheat, this peculiar Natlan fish bait is said to maintain a specific temperature underwater that certain fishes are sensitive to, thereby attracting their attention.\n\nSuitable for catching Phlogiston-dwelling fish.

111035.name: Berry Bait
111035.desc: A common bait in Nod-Krai, made from Midsommar Berries and flour. It has decent appeal to ordinary fish.\n\nSuitable for catching Axehead Fish.

111036.name: Refreshing Lakka Bait
111036.desc: Fish bait made from mixing Lakkaberries and Mint. It may look ordinary, but its unique blend of scent and hue proves irresistible to certain types of fish, earning it high praise from seasoned anglers.\n\nSuitable for catching Mauler Sharks and Crystal-Eyes.

111037.name: Glimmering Bait
111037.desc: A bait primarily crafted from sequins and coated with a trace amount of fluorescent material. When used correctly, it emits a glimmering brilliance. The central sphere contains smaller rattle beads that mimic the vibrations of small fish, making it exceptionally alluring to Snezhnayan fish.\n\nSuitable for: Snowfin and Starbloom Fish

112001.name: Primordial Essence
112001.desc: Particles condensed by the strength of the original elements. As a basic material, it is widely used in classic alchemy.

112002.name: Slime Condensate
112002.desc: A thick coating found on slimes. Most commonly seen material in elemental workshops.

112003.name: Slime Secretions
112003.desc: Mildly purified slime secretions. Harmful to the skin. Please avoid direct exposure.

112004.name: Slime Concentrate
112004.desc: Concentrated slime essence. When left alone, it will begin to move on its own.

112005.name: Damaged Mask
112005.desc: A broken bone mask that once belonged to some hilichurl.\nNow more broken than complete, it can no longer perform its primary function.

112006.name: Stained Mask
112006.desc: A bone mask, covered in unidentifiable stains, that emanates a mysterious odor.\nYet such is the devotion of hilichurls to masks that they will wear it nonetheless.
jump_descs: Dropped uncommonly by Lv. 40+ Hilichurl Shooters

112007.name: Ominous Mask
112007.desc: A glossy bone mask with oil markings painted on it, meant to intimidate enemies.\nNo one really knows why hilichurls are so fascinated with masks. Some say that it's because they don't want to see their own reflections in the water.
jump_descs: Dropped uncommonly by Lv. 60+ Hilichurl Shooters

112008.name: Divining Scroll
112008.desc: A scroll that likely relates to some kind of magic. Exudes an inexplicable but ominous warmth.

112009.name: Sealed Scroll
112009.desc: An old scroll lacking in detail and clarity. By following the images on it, some magical creatures can recreate a small part of its magic.

112010.name: Forbidden Curse Scroll
112010.desc: A scroll inscribed with ancient images. It is said that few can decipher its meaning, and the few scholars that have all went mad.

112011.name: Firm Arrowhead
112011.desc: A roughly produced arrowhead. Though unimpressive, neither it nor the bow should be underestimated, for even the bravest knight can be felled by an arrow from the rear.

112012.name: Sharp Arrowhead
112012.desc: A well-made arrowhead. Sharp enough to penetrate armor with the ease of a rock through the surface of water.

112013.name: Weathered Arrowhead
112013.desc: An old arrowhead coated in blood. The arrowhead has long since lost its sharpness and thus its use as a weapon.\nHowever, it represents the pride of a hunter and acts as both an amulet and a medal.

112014.name: Heavy Horn
112014.desc: A crude horn used by hilichurls to warn each other. Given the damage to the horn, it won't be warning anyone any time soon.

112015.name: Black Bronze Horn
112015.desc: A metallic monster horn that can only be obtained from especially strong hilichurls, since blowing on the horn takes real strength.

112016.name: Black Crystal Horn
112016.desc: A metallic horn with an ominous shine decorated with black crystals of an unknown source. It has hardly been used at all. It is likely a ceremonial item of the hilichurls'.

112017.name: Gloomy Statuette
112017.desc: An idol made in the likeness of some unknown person.\nEven though this carving has seen many years pass, it still has not been damaged in any way. It seems that its previous owner must have cherished it like some holy icon.

112018.name: Dark Statuette
112018.desc: An idol made in the likeness of some unknown, one-eyed person.\nYou can feel a strange warmth emanating from within as you hold onto it, like the shoulder of a dear friend. Perhaps this icon can indeed give people who understand its significance the courage to carry on.

112019.name: Deathly Statuette
112019.desc: A one-eyed carving that emanates an ominous energy, with no indication of what it's made of.\nAs you gaze upon this idol, you can almost hear a strange, comforting whisper...\n"See, my child. All that lies under the throne of heaven shall be destroyed by upheaval. The eternal peace of the pitch-dark void shall embrace us all."

112020.name: Dead Ley Line Branch
112020.desc: Fragile branches from deep within the earth. Even after years of aging, from beneath it's mottled surface you can see that its power is not yet entirely lost.

112021.name: Dead Ley Line Leaves
112021.desc: A twig from deep within the earth. Though it is far from where it once lay, its leaves still pulsate with energy.

112022.name: Ley Line Sprout
112022.desc: It is said that there was a great tree whose roots once spread out to every corner of the world, and this branch is said to be part of it. It is almost if it was never broken off and taken far away, for its vitality is such that it still sprouts new leaves even now.

112023.name: Chaos Device
112023.desc: Comes from ancient defunct relic structures. A part that once held the structure together. Its aesthetically-pleasing engineering is quite exquisite.

112024.name: Chaos Circuit
112024.desc: Comes from ancient defunct relic structures. Was once a logic circuit responsible for movement functions. Sadly, no one is able to make sense of how it worked.

112025.name: Chaos Core
112025.desc: Comes from ancient defunct relic structures. The core that once drove a mechanical beast. Should you come to understand its workings and reproduce it, you could perhaps change the world.

112026.name: Mist Grass Pollen
112026.desc: Strange spores created by Mist Grass in enclosed spaces. They are the Cicins' favorite food.

112027.name: Mist Grass
112027.desc: Well-preserved Mist Grass. Some would take advantage of the Cicins' love for the Mist Grass to control them.
jump_descs: Dropped by Lv. 40+ Fatui Cicin Mages

112028.name: Mist Grass Wick
112028.desc: A rare bundle of Mist Grass that gives off a faint glow. Those who carry it invite both the Cicins and misfortune.
jump_descs: Dropped by Lv. 60+ Fatui Cicin Mages

112029.name: Hunter's Sacrificial Knife
112029.desc: A sharp alloy weapon. Though its owner has been lost, it still reflects a disturbingly cold light.

112030.name: Agent's Sacrificial Knife
112030.desc: An oddly-shaped weapon made with superior Snezhnayan technology that once belonged to a senior agent. Proper training is required for using this strange weapon.

112031.name: Inspector's Sacrificial Knife
112031.desc: In the hands of its lord, this fierce weapon has handled many "debts." No one has eyes in the back of their heads, and this weapon and its related techniques are designed around that weakness.

112032.name: Recruit's Insignia
112032.desc: An insignia to identify the recruits. Makes one wonder about what the ones joining the Fatui's war machine were thinking.
jump_descs: Dropped uncommonly by Fatui Cicin Mages

112033.name: Sergeant's Insignia
112033.desc: An insignia with a different shape to distinguish the sergeants from new recruits. Perhaps there are complicated emotions behind it.
jump_descs: Dropped uncommonly by Lv. 40+ Fatui Agents
Dropped uncommonly by Lv. 40+ Fatui Cicin Mages

112034.name: Lieutenant's Insignia
112034.desc: An insignia to identify officers. The Fatui possess a colossal army, so there must be something extraordinary about the ones who achieved this rank within the group.
jump_descs: Dropped uncommonly by Lv. 60+ Fatui Agents
Dropped uncommonly by Lv. 60+ Fatui Cicin Mages

112035.name: Treasure Hoarder Insignia
112035.desc: A signet that proudly represents its owner's position as member of the Treasure Hoarders. The pursuit of treasure knows no bounds. That said... Is being a thief something to be proud of?

112036.name: Silver Raven Insignia
112036.desc: A raven insignia used by members of the Treasure Hoarders to identify each other. The Treasure Hoarders ask for no resume. Anyone who has an insatiable desire for treasure and is backed up by an equal amount of courage can become a worthy member.

112037.name: Golden Raven Insignia
112037.desc: A raven insignia that symbolizes the pride and the guiding principle of the Treasure Hoarders. Whether it's hidden amidst the vastness of the land or in the depths of the seas, as long as there are treasures to be hunted down, the spirit of Treasure Hoarders, who will stop at nothing to acquire them, will never die.

112038.name: Whopperflower Nectar
112038.desc: Nectar extracted from the stamen of a Whopperflower that contains trace amounts of elemental energy.\nThe taste of the nectar has a hint of Sweet Flower in it.

112039.name: Shimmering Nectar
112039.desc: Nectar that is full of pure elemental energy.\nScholars generally concur that Whopperflowers are advanced life forms among the elemental plants, but there has yet to be a satisfactory explanation regarding their predatory habits.

112040.name: Energy Nectar
112040.desc: A thick and sticky honey that is full of energy.\nThe Whopperflower hunts by tricking its prey, a process it uses to possibly evolve into a more powerful and pure form.

112041.name: Fragile Bone Shard
112041.desc: A bone shard once carried by a Geovishap.\nAlthough they are quite fragile, they seem to still harbor some indescribable power.

112042.name: Sturdy Bone Shard
112042.desc: A fragment of an unknown creature's bones that appear to be prized by Geovishaps for some reason.\nThe fragment appears to be quite aged. Despite being dragon-like beasts with no spoken language, they still seem to have some sort of special affection for these bone shards.

112043.name: Fossilized Bone Shard
112043.desc: A fossilized bone fragment sometimes found after defeating Geovishaps.\nGeovishaps all dream of growing into great dragons one day. They see these fossils as dragon bones and greatly cherish them, perhaps because they too hope to attain the dragons' longevity and power.

112044.name: Old Handguard
112044.desc: A battle-worn handguard that was once mounted on an Inazuman blade.\nFor those adept in the art of the sword, the tsuba is a defense from the edge of an opponent's blade. For beginners, it is a defense made for their own right hand, to protect it from itself.

112045.name: Kageuchi Handguard
112045.desc: A handguard mounted upon a sword of some distinction.\nInazuma has a long tradition of sword-making. When making swords, smiths will often make several different weapons at once, before choosing from among them the "shinuchi," or the best weapon, while the others are known as "kageuchi."

112046.name: Famed Handguard
112046.desc: An intricately-made handguard that was mounted upon a famed weapon.\nSome believe that swords have souls and lives of their own, and thus deserve their own names. Those who love their blades will be acknowledged by them in turn. But those who see their swords as friends or even lovers should be warned that this relationship is built on death and bloodshed. The passions of those who dance with their blade amid crimson showers must surely be cooled someday by fickle steel.

112047.name: Chaos Gear
112047.desc: Comes from a now-inactive ancient Ruin machine.\nThis is the energy source of that biomimetic mechanism.

112048.name: Chaos Axis
112048.desc: Comes from a now-inactive ancient Ruin machine.\nEven the great techniques and unknown power of this device must come to nothing should the machine that contained them ever fail to maintain structural integrity.

112049.name: Chaos Oculus
112049.desc: Comes from a now-inactive ancient Ruin machine.\nThe "Ruin" part of the name comes from the areas where they are most active. However, Ruin machines actually have little in common with the detritus in which they are often found.\nIn the ancient past, these ruins were once part of a civilization mighty enough to almost touch the dome of the firmament, while "ruin" still waits in the deep places of the earth, awaiting the order to arise and tread all kingdoms underfoot.

112050.name: Dismal Prism
112050.desc: This was once a prism that could polarize light, but has grown dull through the passing of years.

112051.name: Crystal Prism
112051.desc: A prism that can bend light.\nIllusory images can be made using such prisms, giving such devices — in a manner of speaking — the power to sway human hearts.

112052.name: Polarizing Prism
112052.desc: A prism that can bend light.\nIn the darkness, these prisms can spread thin light into a wider area. Perhaps this is due to this quirk that these prisms can grant a measure of peace to those whose hearts are oft shrouded in darkness.

112053.name: Spectral Husk
112053.desc: An energy core that allows the Specters to float. It contains a small amount of elemental energy.\nMost of the rest has already dispersed.

112054.name: Spectral Heart
112054.desc: An energy core that allows the Specters to float.\nThese elemental life-forms have strange behavioral patterns and will periodically surge in number before disappearing.

112055.name: Spectral Nucleus
112055.desc: A complete energy core that can sometimes be found after defeating Specters.\nThere is a debate among those who just have to divide the world into winners and losers: what floats better — a Specter or an Anemo Slime?

112056.name: Concealed Claw
112056.desc: Residual body tissue left behind by one of the Riftwolves.\nBy ordinary logic, these objects, so alien to this world, should not have remained behind after these abnormal creatures were excised from the land.

112057.name: Concealed Unguis
112057.desc: Body tissue left behind by one of the Riftwolves.\nThough they are quite wondrous indeed, these hunting hounds of "Alfisol" are nothing of note before Durin of "Humus."

112058.name: Concealed Talon
112058.desc: A sharp nail left behind by one of the Riftwolves.\nAll the marvels in the world must pale before "Cretaceus," the greatest work of them all.

112059.name: Fungal Spores
112059.desc: A small amount of glittering spore powder left behind by Floating Fungi. Seems that a sneeze is all it takes for this powder to vanish without a trace.

112060.name: Luminescent Pollen
112060.desc: A small parcel of luminescent Fungal Spore powder, a common medical ingredient in the land of rainforests. Merchants usually sell them in paper packets.

112061.name: Crystalline Cyst Dust
112061.desc: A huge lump of spore powder collected from a structurally complete spore cyst. Put it in an appropriate environment, and the area might be filled with a thriving aggregation of Floating Fungi later...

112062.name: Inactivated Fungal Nucleus
112062.desc: Body tissue left behind by a Fungus that has been exposed to intense elemental stimulation.\nIts soothing texture makes it shockingly good for stress relief. However, frequent usage can also easily lead to the Fungi multiplying, and thus the material is not suitable for any commercial use.

112063.name: Dormant Fungal Nucleus
112063.desc: Body tissue left behind by a Fungus that has been exposed to intense elemental stimulation.\nThere was once a protracted debate among Amurta researchers on whether the Fungi should be categorized as plants or animals. In the end, they reached an agreement and closed the case for good — the Fungi shall be its own category, neither plant nor animal.

112064.name: Robust Fungal Nucleus
112064.desc: Body tissue left behind by a Fungus that has been exposed to intense elemental stimulation.\nIt is generally believed that the Fungi evolved into more mobile forms to better disperse their spores.\nA poet once depicted a shared dream of the Fungi in which their spores covered every inch of the mountains and oceans. The world had never been more tranquil. Then the Fungi turned into fish, birds, beasts, men, and gods, relying on rainfall, land, and their own kind who had returned to the earth.

112065.name: Faded Red Satin
112065.desc: A piece of red satin used to cover the eyes. The fabric is slightly torn.\nMany Eremites tend to cover their eyes with textiles, but the original intention of this practice has long been lost to the sands of time.

112066.name: Trimmed Red Silk
112066.desc: A piece of red silk trimmed with simple decorations.\nA seasoned warrior can detect weaknesses from their foe's eyes and thus take advantage. The Eremites have long since lost a master to serve, and now they have no one to trust but themselves. Word has it that they are more than convinced that all things betray, even their own eyes.

112067.name: Rich Red Brocade
112067.desc: A piece of red brocade woven with golden thread.\nThose born in the gilded desert under the sun occasionally sing a song, of which the meaning has been forgotten. They would praise the scorching sun that illuminates the earth as equally as ever and bewail the afterglow at the end of the dusk. Some unfamiliar words recur at the end of the song, which are said to be the names of ancient gods. Legend has it that when the King of the Desert was still alive, his people chose to cover their eyes as they dared not look upon him, whose brilliance was beyond that of the sun.

112068.name: Chaos Storage
112068.desc: Comes from a now-inactive ancient Ruin Drake.\nRuin Drakes can absorb Elemental Energy from the outside and store it in this component inside their "neck."

112069.name: Chaos Module
112069.desc: Comes from a now-inactive ancient Ruin Drake.\nThe dragons were once the most primitive and ancient bodily form of the supreme elements until they were defeated, conquered, or assimilated.

112070.name: Chaos Bolt
112070.desc: Comes from a now-inactive ancient Ruin Drake.\nAmong the lost ancient kingdoms, there was a group of people who were obsessed with the idea of mimesis. Be it the Hypostases' pure ordered elements or the ancient primitive power of the dragons, these people believed that they might all be replicated and modified to the point where they had surpassed their natural counterparts.\nBy this means, a superior and unsullied bodily form could replace the continuously decaying and shattering order.

112071.name: Damaged Prism
112071.desc: A damaged component obtained from defeating a Primal Construct.\nThese uniquely-shaped machines are the eternal sentinels of the desert ruins, and they possess the power to pierce the mountains and reshape rocks. The same principles that power many mysterious devices above and beneath the earth also power these machines.

112072.name: Turbid Prism
112072.desc: An old component obtained from defeating a Primal Construct.\nIt is said that these machines are different from those ruin machines that come from deep within the desert, for they were not made as heralds of destruction or conquest.

112073.name: Radiant Prism
112073.desc: An exquisite component obtained from defeating a Primal Construct.\nThe lord of the barren desert once had a dream, and once made a great many promises.\nThe legends of the desert say that these machines were originally vehicles for these unknown promises, which now live on only within their mechanical memory banks.

112074.name: Desiccated Shell
112074.desc: The ruined shell of a Consecrated Beast.\nA tangible effigy to the grand calamity that devoured the lands of yore, usually only discovered in places few dare tread.

112075.name: Sturdy Shell
112075.desc: The sturdy shell of a Consecrated Beast.\nThe remains of a ruinous beast that once gnawed at the flesh of great, fallen beings. Even should the beasts sup a sliver of power from the gods of yesteryear, they too will greet the same end as said gods.

112076.name: Marked Shell
112076.desc: The marked shell of a Consecrated Beast inscribed with ancient script.\nOn the pallid contours of the shell, the regrets of a time long past have been inlaid. One day, the bones of the beast will scatter like dust in the wind, and then, finally, may the exalted deceased greet their final rest...

112077.name: A Flower Yet to Bloom
112077.desc: A wild flower that a Hilichurl Rogue treasured. It was plucked before it could bloom.\nThe hilichurl takes nothing with it in its sojourn across the wilderness save this flower.

112078.name: Treasured Flower
112078.desc: A wild flower that a Hilichurl Rogue treasured, bereft of any special qualities.\nFlowers can be used as gifts or offerings to express one's feelings in many cultures.

112079.name: Wanderer's Blooming Flower
112079.desc: A blooming wild flower that a Hilichurl Rogue treasured, bereft of any special qualities.\nThe eternal outlander asks not for reward, but only to see their deeds come to fruition...

112080.name: Transoceanic Pearl
112080.desc: A small crystal obtained from a defeated Fontemer Aberrant.\nFontemer Aberrants arise from Fontaine's sea. They are believed to be a unique life form born from the mysterious energy in the water.

112081.name: Transoceanic Chunk
112081.desc: A crystal obtained from a defeated Fontemer Aberrant.\nIt gives off a somewhat mysterious energy.\nAlthough many legends speak of great life forms residing in remote seas beyond human reach, ordinary oceans can hardly compare to the vibrant seas of Fontaine.

112082.name: Xenochromatic Crystal
112082.desc: A large crystal obtained from a defeated Fontemer Aberrant.\nIt contains a mysterious energy.\nAll rivers and seas originate in Fontaine, but the water loses all its unique properties once it flows outside Fontaine's borders.

112083.name: Meshing Gear
112083.desc: Clockwork meka's gear.\nIt is a crucial part of the meka's transmission structure. The whole system will malfunction if this gear is absent.

112084.name: Mechanical Spur Gear
112084.desc: Clockwork meka gear.\nAlthough many breakthroughs have been made in the kinematics of clockwork meka, its dynamics research has not seen any major advancements beyond the framework laid down by Alain Guillotin four hundred years ago.

112085.name: Artificed Dynamic Gear
112085.desc: Clockwork meka gear.\nPrecision processing and advancement of material science are the keys to clockwork meka development in Fontaine. With the help of advanced equipment, any engineer is capable of making a meka that outshines "Lord-Artificer" Alain Guillotin's creation.

112086.name: Drop of Tainted Water
112086.desc: A small drop of water obtained from a defeated Tainted Hydro Phantasm.\nThe life force in it has yet to ebb away.

112087.name: Scoop of Tainted Water
112087.desc: Water obtained from a defeated Tainted Hydro Phantasm.\nThe life force in it has yet to ebb away.\nToday, with the Oceanids extirpated from Fontaine, strange elemental life forms that are far from elegant have appeared in the waters.
jump_descs: Dropped by Lv. 40+ Tainted Hydro Phantasms

112088.name: Newborn Tainted Hydro Phantasm
112088.desc: A new life form that arose from the dispersed Tainted Hydro Phantasm. It is trapped inside a bottle.\nThe life contained within the waters is formless, and formless life is born of water and gains water's shape.
jump_descs: Dropped by Lv. 60+ Tainted Hydro Phantasms

112089.name: Rift Core
112089.desc: A shard left by Breacher Primus.\nIt bears no resemblance to any other known form of life in the world.

112090.name: Foreign Synapse
112090.desc: A shard left by Breacher Primus.\nThis strange life form originates in Elynas and inhabits the area.

112091.name: Alien Life Core
112091.desc: Breacher Primus's core.\nThere is no way to exterminate this life form. One reduced to nothing but its core will resurrect the next day or in decades. Luckily, it is neither aggressive nor intelligent, so Fontainians can just keep their distance.

112092.name: Old Operative's Pocket Watch
112092.desc: A standard-issue pocket watch given to Fatui Operatives.\nThe erosion and oxidation on the casing serve as a loyal record of its owners' days spent as an instrument, enforcing the Fatui's will.

112093.name: Operative's Standard Pocket Watch
112093.desc: A standard-issue pocket watch given to Fatui Operatives.\nThe head of the watch is not well-designed, as the outer casing has way too many sharp angles, which can cause excessive wear and tear on clothes. As such, there will always be those who will stuff this watch into a more practical, less distinctive casing for use.

112094.name: Operative's Constancy
112094.desc: An accessory with a Delusion mounted on it. This is source of the Fatui Operative's power.\nThat said, taking it off would not detract from the fact that said Operative has physical abilities far beyond that of ordinary humans, forged through long years of training and combat experience. As for them, they are well-aware that they have sacrificed their past, present, and future upon the altar of the Fatui's ideal paradise, such that the damage they cause themselves on account of using a Delusion's power matters not at all.

112095.name: Feathery Fin
112095.desc: A fin fragment taken from a defeated Xuanwen Beast's back.\nEven though Xuanwen Beasts can't fly over long distances, these feather-like fins enable them to swiftly pursue their prey.

112096.name: Lunar Fin
112096.desc: A fin taken from a defeated Xuanwen Beast's back.\nThe soft, moonlight-esque glow on the fin gives off a sense of serenity.

112097.name: Chasmlight Fin
112097.desc: An elegant fin taken from a defeated Xuanwen Beast's back.\nThe faint light it reflects contains traces of adeptal energy. In the still of the night, even the most violent beasts briefly sink into a peaceful slumber, reminiscing on times when dreams belonged not only to humans.

112098.name: Ruined Hilt
112098.desc: A stone hilt obtained from an ancient statue.\nIts luster has long been lost to the depredations of seawater.

112099.name: Splintered Hilt
112099.desc: A stone hilt obtained from an ancient statue.\nThe chips and grooves speak to the brutal battles its owner once weathered.

112100.name: Still-Smoldering Hilt
112100.desc: A stone hilt obtained from an ancient statue.\nOnly the recentness of its separation from its owner may explain the as-yet unextinguished flame within.

112101.name: Juvenile Fang
112101.desc: A tooth that fell from a Natlan Saurian.\nIt looks like it belonged to a juvenile creature. If there was a way to determine the age of its previous owner, perhaps it would show that they had not yet roamed the world for long.

112102.name: Seasoned Fang
112102.desc: A sturdy tooth that fell from a Natlan Saurian.\nWear and tear bear witness to the experiences and battles of its previous owner. Among the many Saurians of Natlan, one with such a tooth must have been considered a formidable warrior indeed.

112103.name: Tyrant's Fang
112103.desc: A sharp tooth that fell from a mighty Natlan Saurian.\nIts serrated edge and fearsome shape attest to the ferocity of its owner in battle. Among the many Saurians of Natlan, one with such a tooth must have been a ruthless tyrant indeed.

112104.name: Sentry's Wooden Whistle
112104.desc: The symbol of a Natlan tribal sentry.\nWarriors are not born as warriors. They must first acquire the skills of combat by learning under the tutelage of those who have already done so. This is the origin of the trainee position of sentry.

112105.name: Warrior's Metal Whistle
112105.desc: The symbol of a Natlan tribal warrior.\nA metal whistle that is given to individuals who have been officially recognized as tribal warriors. It is used to communicate and alert others to danger by those that patrol the tribe's vicinity. This is a duty that falls upon the warriors of the tribe.
jump_descs: Dropped by Lv. 40+ Sauroform Tribal Warriors

112106.name: Saurian-Crowned Warrior's Golden Whistle
112106.desc: Among Natlan's tribes, this is the symbol of a mighty, Saurian-Crowned warrior.\nA golden whistle that is bestowed only upon those who have won great honor for the tribe and shown valor of the highest order. Its symbolic significance now outweighs its practical use, for a Saurian-Crowned warrior is able to handle most crises alone.
jump_descs: Dropped by Lv. 60+ Sauroform Tribal Warriors

112107.name: Shard of a Shattered Will
112107.desc: A fragment that houses a Wayob Manifestation.\nIt is a broken shard of a shattered stone idol. Its capacity for channeling the Wayob's will and power is also extremely limited.

112108.name: Locus of a Clear Will
112108.desc: A jade idol that houses a Wayob Manifestation.\nYou can roughly make out the form of an idol figurine. It has a greater capacity for channeling the Wayob's will and power.

112109.name: Sigil of a Striding Will
112109.desc: An obsidian talisman that houses a Wayob Manifestation.\nIt consists of a jade idol figurine encased in obsidian. They say that in the past, people often used such figurines to attempt to communicate directly with the Wayob of the Night Kingdom. Perhaps this also explains why the Wayob can dwell within it and manifest itself in physical form.

112110.name: Ignited Stone
112110.desc: A shard obtained from the body of a defeated Avatar of Lava.\nThough it has been shattered to a great extent, on the inside, it still continues to burn. Perhaps this is a testament to the extraordinary vitality of phlogiston.

112111.name: Ignited Seed of Life
112111.desc: A condensed pile of burning matter obtained from the body of a defeated Avatar of Lava.\nIt emits a slight heat.\nAttempting to stop a stone pile of this size from incessantly burning away would be a hard task indeed. It is said that this is some primordial form of life.
jump_descs: Dropped by Lv. 40+ Avatars of Lava

112112.name: Ignited Seeing Eye
112112.desc: A core retrieved from within the body of a defeated Avatar of Lava.\nIt emits a considerable heat.\nIt is said that once such a core has formed, left to itself, it will develop into a new Avatar of Lava. In ancient times, it was once believed that all forms of life could be traced back to conflagration, and that in the spark of burning matter lay the origins of the soul and sentient wisdom. Perhaps the very existence of Avatars of Lava would bear out such a belief — or perhaps it was the emergence of this theory itself that explains how they came to inhabit the land of Natlan...
jump_descs: Dropped by Lv. 60+ Avatars of Lava

112113.name: Axis of the Secret Source
112113.desc: Comes from a now-defunct Secret Source Automaton.\nIt appears to be just a component that was used to connect two mechanisms.
jump_descs: Dropped by Secret Source Automaton: Hunter-Seeker

112114.name: Sheath of the Secret Source
112114.desc: Comes from a now-defunct Secret Source Automaton.\nIt appears to be the mechanism by which the Secret Source Automaton was powered, but its core is now empty.
jump_descs: Dropped by Lv. 40+ Secret Source Automaton: Hunter-Seeker

112115.name: Heart of the Secret Source
112115.desc: Comes from a now-defunct Secret Source Automaton.\nIt appears to be an intact core by which the Secret Source Automaton was powered, a strange device that seems to have been produced as a universal component. According to legend, the ingenious thinkers of antiquity drew upon the same wisdom used in the creation of golden patterns to design the blueprints by which these extraordinary machines functioned. Perhaps this core was one of them.
jump_descs: Dropped by Lv. 60+ Secret Source Automaton: Hunter-Seeker

112116.name: Refractive Bud
112116.desc: A leaf bud dropped by the monster known as the Tenebrous Mimiflora after being vanquished.\nIt is said that when this creature emerged from the Black Tide, the first things it grew were these tender buds capable of deflecting elemental power.

112117.name: Bewildering Broadleaf
112117.desc: An arrow-shaped leaf dropped by the monster known as the Tenebrous Mimiflora after being vanquished.\nAfter corroding the Ley Lines and extracting the memories within, the creature grows these leaves as a means of storing the information it has deciphered. There may be a close link between these intricately patterned leaves and the forms that their host can mimic.

112118.name: Illusory Leafcoil
112118.desc: A core formed from tightly coiled leaves, the remnant of the monster known as the Tenebrous Mimiflora after being vanquished.\nIt may appear lifeless and dull on the surface, yet a faint, ominous power can still be sensed pulsing within.\nPeople often wonder where the memories that such creatures drew from the earth go when they are slain. Perhaps the answer lies within this core...

112119.name: Cold-Cracked Shellshard
112119.desc: A chunk of shell carved from a Furnace Shell Mountain Weasel's back after its defeat.\nWhere it once blazed brightly, this piece has long since gone cold. The fire-like luster it once held is no more.
jump_descs: Dropped by Furnace Shell Mountain Weasels

112120.name: Warm Back-Shell
