120197.desc: Records of the Ancient Oases: Part IV

120198.name: Records of the Ancient Oases: Part V
120198.desc: Records of the Ancient Oases: Part V

120199.name: Records of the Ancient Oases: Part VI
120199.desc: Records of the Ancient Oases: Part VI

120201.name: Red Vulture's Feather
120201.desc: The feathers that abet a red vulture's ability of flight. It can be used to create vibrant pigments... Or even lethal poisons.

120202.name: Scorpion's Sting
120202.desc: A scorpion's stinger and the connected poison glands. A certifiable classic instrument for assassinations in the desert.

120203.name: Flying Serpent's Horn
120203.desc: This, as the name implies, is the horn of a flying serpent. The tribes of the desert will grind it down to powder to make ineffective potions and tout these creations as potent tonics to swindle researchers in the city. It sells quite well.

120214.name: Restored Blueprints of a Mechanical Behemoth's Power System
120214.desc: Restored Blueprints of a Mechanical Behemoth's Power System

120216.name: Random Weapon Shards
120216.desc: The shards of some random weapon. It is unknown how they ended up so broken...

120217.name: Unattributed Ramen Voucher
120217.desc: A thank-you gift for assisting "Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King" Arataki Itto in competing against Grandmaster Hanakado in the Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl. And it also serves as proof of the rapid rising of two beetle-fighting stars, "Oni King's Right Hand" and "Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon."\nThe "Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King" claims that as long as you show this voucher to the stall, you can "enjoy a free bowl of ramen for two months straight!" But... which stall is "the stall" exactly?

120221.name: Ancient Stone Key
120221.desc: A mysterious key held by the Matriarch of the Tanit tribe. It should be able to open a certain door somewhere...

120223.name: Plump Harra Fruit
120223.desc: Commonly grown in the hot and humid rainforest, this fruit has a special spicy aroma. When paired with other fruits, a greater layering of flavors can be achieved.

120224.name: Juicy Zaytun Peach
120224.desc: The fruit of a forest shrub. Its flesh is firm and sweet. It is said to have a calming effect on the mind, which presently makes it very suited for Layla.

120225.name: Fresh Apple
120225.desc: Crisp and fragrant. Aside from being eaten raw or used to ferment a beverage, roasting apples also brings forth a distinctive flavor.

120234.name: Dry Firewood
120234.desc: Firewood collected at one's leisure. The wood is of appropriate size and dryness for campfire. Food cooked using this will have the natural scent of charcoal. Hopefully, they will grant Layla a bit more vigor.

120237.name: Records of the Ancient Oases: Part VII
120237.desc: Records of the Ancient Oases: Part VII

120238.name: Records of the Ancient Oases: Part VIII
120238.desc: Records of the Ancient Oases: Part VIII

120239.name: Records of the Ancient Oases: Part IX
120239.desc: Records of the Ancient Oases: Part IX

120240.name: Records of the Ancient Oases: Part X
120240.desc: Records of the Ancient Oases: Part X

120244.name: Wine-Scented Letter
120244.desc: This letter has a faint whiff of alcohol. One can speculate as to the circumstances under which it was written. The sender seemed to have had little hope that it could be delivered.

120245.name: Strange Mushroom
120245.desc: Can mushrooms... really grow in a field like this?

120246.name: Nameless Taboo Medicine of the Royal Court
120246.desc: The smell of this stings your nose and will not easily fade. According to the records, this medicine requires the power of the God of Wisdom to awaken the addled mind. Perhaps it might be able to resist the "curse."

120247.name: Strange Mushroom-Watering Water
120247.desc: You drew this water at two in the afternoon from a waterfall beside a Statue of The Seven, just as Eide instructed.

120250.name: Piping-Hot Bamboo Shoot Soup
120250.desc: Bamboo Shoot Soup created using the Supreme Cuisine Machine. Zhongli rated this dish as such: "The appearance is exquisite, and the aroma rich and intense." Among its key ingredients are Nascent Bamboo Shoots. They're hard to come by... And due to a multiplicity of reasons, their commemorative value far exceeds their worth as cooking ingredients. Since this meal was created by an adeptus, it shouldn't spoil even if you just leave it in your bag.

120251.name: Warrior's Spirit Swordfighting Arena Ticket
120251.desc: Beyond nation, beyond identity, united only by mettle and might.

120257.name: Venti's Note
120257.desc: A paper with a simple map and something like an incantation on it. According to Venti, it contains the secrets to revealing the prophecy.

120259.name: Collei's Windblume
120259.desc: To Collei, the only flower that can serve as her Windblume and convey her gratitude and well-wishes is the Padisarah. She now offers their seeds to you.\nIn visiting Mondstadt again, Collei has taken a tentative step toward the future. May her coming days be as a small seed held within her palm, filled deep with the potential for light and hope.

120273.name: Great Song of Khvarena
120273.desc: The Great Songs of Khvarena contain immense power, but only the Pari can obtain the Khvarena's approval and unleash its potential through a special ritual...

120274.name: Schematic Clipped Inside Notes
120274.desc: The sketches taken from the mysterious investigative notes seem to list the structural layout of the ruined underground proving grounds and the location of the Great Song of Khvarena...

120275.name: Rene's Investigation Notes
120275.desc: Supposedly, these notes were left by a great researcher who yearned to "surpass mortality," and its contents detail his experiences exploring ruins, along with the knowledge he gained in the process...

120276.name: Notes Left by Someone
120276.desc: This appears to be notes left by a member of the Order of Skeptics. It has information on the lost Kory Drums and their traditional usage.

120277.name: Ancient Volume
120277.desc: An ancient document passed down from prior generations of Skeptics. The arcane language makes the contents hard to decipher.

120278.name: Udumbara Pistil
120278.desc: A pistil taken from a blooming Udumbara. It seems to bear some special significance to the Pari...

120279.name: Khvarena Inscription Fragment
120279.desc: A fragment of a lost monument inscription. It is not known why this piece was lost.

120280.name: Khvarena Inscription Fragment
120280.desc: A fragment of a lost monument inscription. Its faint light may only be captured by the divine bird's descendants.

120281.name: Khvarena Inscription Fragment
120281.desc: A fragment of a lost monument inscription. Returning all the fragments to their original positions may restore the inscription's original form.

120282.name: Khvarena Inscription Fragment
120282.desc: A fragment of a lost monument inscription. It is said to have a profound bond with the Pari.

120283.name: Korybantes: Vedana
120283.desc: A mysterious drum. This one has a Cryo marking on it.

120284.name: Korybantes: Rupa
120284.desc: One of the missing Kory Drums. This one has a Dendro marking on it.

120285.name: Korybantes: Samjna
120285.desc: One of the missing Kory Drums. This one has a Hydro marking on it.

120286.name: Korybantes: Sankhara
120286.desc: One of the missing Kory Drums. This one has an Electro marking on it.

120287.name: Korybantes: Vijnana
120287.desc: One of the missing Kory Drums. This one has a Pyro marking on it.

120288.name: Mysterious Energy Block
120288.desc: An energy block of refined Azosite formed via the condensation of pure elemental energy. It seems that they can be used as an energy source for large-scale power systems.

120290.name: Julien's Luggage
120290.desc: Waterlogged luggage. Supposedly packed with care. It is uncertain if the contents inside have suffered water damage from being soaked.

120291.name: Julien's Sketch
120291.desc: A sketch bearing a strange mix of colors.

120292.name: "Adventurer's Experience"
120292.desc: A copy of an Adventurer's Experience made by Julien. It seems no different from the original.\nAfter reading through it, however, only emptiness pervades the mind, with a sense that time was wasted without the requisite experience gained.

120293.name: Picture Left by the Wisdom Seelie
120293.desc: Hints left by the Wisdom Seelie. Hopefully this venture isn't as futile as before...

120294.name: Caravan Accounts
120294.desc: Accounts obtained from your target caravan. The information on it mostly relates to Dakan Al-Ahmar. Apart from the large amount of data and information on the movement of loot, the fact that Dunyarzad's father was named is quite concerning.

120298.name: Relic Replica Container (I)
120298.desc: A container holding a relic replica. It has been deliberately painted purple.

120299.name: Relic Replica Container (II)
120299.desc: A container holding a relic replica. It has been deliberately painted blue.

120300.name: Relic Replica Container (III)
120300.desc: A container holding a relic replica. It has been deliberately painted red.

120301.name: Korybantes Score: Vijnana
120301.desc: A drum score corresponding to Korybantes: Vijnana.

120302.name: Korybantes Score: Samjna
120302.desc: A drum score corresponding to Korybantes: Samjna.

120303.name: Korybantes Score: Rupa
120303.desc: A drum score corresponding to Korybantes: Rupa.

120304.name: Korybantes Score: Sankhara
120304.desc: A drum score corresponding to Korybantes: Sankhara.

120305.name: Korybantes Score: Vedana
120305.desc: A drum score corresponding to Korybantes: Vedana.

120306.name: "Returning Curios" Memento (I)
120306.desc: A memento discovered at a treasure site in the Veluriyam Mirage event, "Returning Curios." The treasure chest that contains it corresponds to the first code — "A sweet mist permeates all, gazing toward the dancing lamplight, I almost forget to breathe. In the end, memories of childhood guide me, and I take my seat beside the table in peace..."

120307.name: "Returning Curios" Memento (II)
120307.desc: A memento discovered at a treasure site in the Veluriyam Mirage event, "Returning Curios." The treasure chest that contains it corresponds to the second code — "A shooting star of vines carries me, traversing a forest so quiet and peaceful, to finally arrive in secluded dreamland so pure."

120308.name: "Returning Curios" Memento (III)
120308.desc: A memento discovered at a treasure site in the Veluriyam Mirage event, "Returning Curios." The treasure chest that contains it corresponds to the third code — "A blue, spotless ceiling, a floor of white candy, soft companions surround me, I too have wings!"

120309.name: Memento Collection Box
120309.desc: A special box you got from Idyia that is used to contain "Returning Curios" mementos. It is said that it can protect the items within for a long time. With this box, you can pick a special memento and treasure site to leave your very own mark on the Veluriyam Mirage...

120310.name: Mysterious Mora Pocketwatch
120310.desc: A Mora-shaped (and Mora-shiny) pocketwatch you accidentally found in the Veluriyam Mirage. This one bears a strong resemblance to a Mora pocketwatch left behind by a seasoned adventurer in the earliest days of "Returning Curios." One wonders how much it is worth.\nHowever, Idyia also says that "it's not about the value of the treasure or the watch, but the stories hidden inside the treasures!" Perhaps using monetary value as the measure of this memento is not the most fitting...

120311.name: Mural Fragment: Swirling Clouds
120311.desc: A Preprint fragment found within a mysterious cave that depicts the clouds floating in the Veluriyam Mirage. It seems that a projection at the correct angle from the Streaming Projector can restore a missing part of the mural...

120312.name: Mural Fragment: Central Hub
120312.desc: A Preprint fragment found within a mysterious cave that depicts the huge structure at the center of the Veluriyam Mirage. It seems that a projection at the correct angle from the Streaming Projector can restore a missing part of the mural...

120313.name: Mural Fragment: Sky Keep
120313.desc: A Preprint fragment found within a mysterious cave that depicts a city floating in the sky. It seems that a projection at the correct angle from the Streaming Projector can restore a missing part of the mural...

120314.name: Mural Fragment: Flower of the Valley
120314.desc: A Preprint fragment found within a mysterious cave that depicts the huge flowers visible from a Choo-Choo Cart entering the valley. It seems that a projection at the correct angle from the Streaming Projector can restore a missing part of the mural...

120315.name: Julien's Drawing Board
120315.desc: A drawing board that shows signs of use but is presently devoid of any brushstrokes.

120316.name: In Pursuit of the Lost Inscription
120316.desc: A note obtained from Sosi. It might contain clues about the lost monument fragments.

120317.name: Haniyyah's Gift of Marvelous Jellies
120317.desc: An exquisite gift offered by Haniyyah. It contains Marvelous Jellies much loved by the Fungi, and the Jellies themselves come in many unique flavors that can be fed to the Fungi based on their individual preferences.\nThe Marvelous Jellies are a refined version of the Floral Jellies that preceded them and retain their crystalline translucence and springy texture, sans the dangerous ingredients, thus making them the ideal feed for Fungi. That said, one should probably take care that the children don't eat it by mistake when storing it at home...

120318.name: Old Gear
120318.desc: It seems to be a part of a huge machine, but this lone gear that fell out may not be of any use. However, if the way to make it turn again is found, then perhaps the answers to some questions may in turn be discovered.

120319.name: Mountaineering Rope
120319.desc: Mountaineering rope favored by adventurers. It's a bit old but well-maintained, so it can still be used as per normal. This rope was left here as a gift. Perhaps it is not just ropes that a person relies on when scaling great heights, but friendly hands that reach out to you.

120320.name: Familiar-Looking Candy Box
120320.desc: A candy box that is often used in various celebrations in Sumeru. When the girl who would become a researcher was still young, she used to take one candy a day from the box. Back in those days, her biggest worry was that the candy would run out. After becoming a researcher, this empty candy box has become a nostalgic reminder of other possibilities in life. This candy box was left here as a gift. To the researcher, this is also a symbol of freedom from misery.

120321.name: Travel Lamp
120321.desc: A lamp that the boy often used when studying at night. The flame can be adjusted via a mechanism in the lamp, and this was perhaps quite magical to a child who had never seen such a lamp before. Every time he saw the light from this lamp, he will think of the old days when he played various hand shadow characters and animals. This lamp was left here as a gift. Maybe this is a way for him to let go of his burden and move on.

120322.name: Box of Special Potions
120322.desc: A box obtained from Bahador. Within it are some special potions. According to what he said, these potions might be of aid to exploring a certain Domain...

120323.name: Gear Drivetrain
120323.desc: A removable part that belongs to the central drive valve in the abandoned production zone.

120327.name: Locator
120327.desc: A Kshahrewar invention. When contestants carry these tracking devices, the locator can display their general locations. Additionally, should the contestants successfully complete their tasks, the locator will also sound.

120335.name: Food Seeds
120335.desc: The elemental life form known as the Floating Anemo Fungus gave you these seeds. Plant them in a field to grow food that the Fungi enjoy eating. But will there be any Fungi who remember how to till the fields in the future?

120336.name: King of Invokations
120336.desc: A light novel centered around the most popular card game in Teyvat — Genius Invokation TCG. The characters are unique and the story is exciting and full of twists, making it one of the hottest new works around.

120337.name: Strange Part
120337.desc: A strange mechanical part obtained near Merusea Village. It looks subtly different from common mechanical parts.\nYou have no idea why it ended up here, but beautiful metal products like this are loved by Melusines...

120338.name: Key to the Castle's Secret Chamber
120338.desc: An item that is key to the "Petrifying Gaze" scenario in Daiya's Three-Day Reverie, which can be used to open a secret chamber that conceals an ancient medicine. Its outer appearance is not much different from that of ordinary keys.

120339.name: Ancient Hex-Cleansing Remedy
120339.desc: An item that is key to the "Petrifying Gaze" scenario in Daiya's Three-Day Reverie.\nAccording to the Lone Hydro Eidolon, such remedies have the power to cleanse Wraith-cast hexes and restore petrified Hydro Eidolons to their original states.\nHowever, the outward appearance of the remedy indicates the use of a very common alchemy vessel. Is this narrative setting related to alchemy, or is the theater troupe just cutting costs...?

120340.name: "The Great Escape" Prop Book
120340.desc: A prop book that has been hollowed out and had digging tools put into it. Of course, as a stage prop, its other pages have long been stuck together. But then again, the "content" of a book is sometimes more important than its... content.

120342.name: Enigmatic Page (I)
120342.desc: An ancient paper whose contents are completely unintelligible.\nPerhaps there's some way to decipher the contents.

120343.name: Enigmatic Page (II)
120343.desc: An ancient paper whose contents are completely unintelligible.\nPerhaps there's some way to decipher the contents.

120344.name: Enigmatic Page (III)
120344.desc: An ancient paper whose contents are completely unintelligible.\nPerhaps there's some way to decipher the contents.

120345.name: Nameless Adventurer's Notes
120345.desc: Lost notes left in the desert. They seem to have been left by some adventurer.

120354.name: Emberglow Leaf
120354.desc: A leaf that you got from Nahida. It can be used to contact the Aranara. If you use it like a whistle, an Aranara will answer the call. The Aranara will only come because they trust Nahida. In other words, you can't just blow on any leaf you find and expect an answer.

120355.name: Sadife's Marked Map
120355.desc: A map marked by Sadife. Perhaps the case is somewhere close by...

120356.name: Sadife's Case
120356.desc: Sadife's case. It's stuffed to the brim and quite heavy.

120374.name: "Active Odor Imitating Bait"
120374.desc: A new fishing aid developed by Delaroche that applies the principles of odor analysis and advanced bait mimicry. It is said that its effect is "very powerful." You can tell by the appearance that Delaroche thinks the world of this bait, with protective wrapping and a special bag. However, it is unknown whether such meticulous measures will affect the basic function of the bait — even if it attracts fish, the fish themselves may be unable to even find a way to bite down upon it.

120376.name: Submerged Box
120376.desc: A sunken box. Details of the contents within are unknown...

120377.name: Submerged Box
120377.desc: A sunken box. It seems... a bit different from other boxes...?

120378.name: Ancient Key
120378.desc: A key that can unlock the path leading into the ruins of the Liliacruces Forum.\nIt has been submerged in water for a long time, but it hasn't decayed beyond recognition.

120379.name: Key to Some Place in the Institute
120379.desc: It should be able to open a certain door in the Institute of Natural Philosophy.

120382.name: Beautifully-Wrapped Gift Box
120382.desc: A gift in a beautiful gift box. According to Kaeya, it contains an exquisite lamp. It might be best to wait till you come back from vacation with Kaeya to open up his gift and admire it.

120383.name: Ripe Grapes
120383.desc: Grapes you picked with utmost care under Tunner's guidance. In time, they can be turned into rich wine.

120384.name: Heavy Pack
120384.desc: An overwhelmingly heavy pack, containing large quantities of paint. How will Depierris put these paints to use...

120386.name: A Jar of Fry
120386.desc: Fry that you obtained from Linorea. It is said that these fish have been hand-picked by her, and are perfectly suited to surviving in these waters...

120387.name: Prince Qubad's Intaglio
120387.desc: An Intaglio that symbolizes the noble origins of Prince Qubad in the play. It should have been strung on a beaded chain and worn on the prince's chest, but a fated tragedy made the prince abandon it.\nThe blood-red jewel is a crystallization of the question Kaeya asked you — that age-old question about destiny.\nThere is no need to rush to answer. In the future, use what you see, touch, and feel to prove the answer within your soul.

120400.name: Credit Coupons
120400.desc: A type of currency only used in the Fortress of Meropide.

120401.name: "The Art of Negotiation"
120401.desc: "A milestone in the science of success, this masterpiece written by a true genius is an absolute must-read!"\nAn exceptional book emphatically recommended by the editor of La Gouttiere, titans of the business world, and researchers at the Fontaine Research Institute!\nIt will impart deep insights and understanding into the abyss of human nature, a truly incomparable contribution to the science and art of success!

120403.name: Welfare Meal
120403.desc: A Welfare Meal from the Coupon Cafeteria. As it's free, there's an element of surprise and risk.\n\nUse to obtain a meal and a Fortune Slip.

120404.name: The History of the Decline and Fall of Remuria (I)
120404.desc: It is said that the great scholar Pulteney wrote this epic historical work concerning the ancient Remurian civilization in the early years of the founding of Fontaine.

120405.name: The History of the Decline and Fall of Remuria (II)
120405.desc: It is said that the great scholar Pulteney wrote this epic historical work concerning the ancient Remurian civilization in the early years of the founding of Fontaine.

120406.name: The History of the Decline and Fall of Remuria (III)
120406.desc: It is said that the great scholar Pulteney wrote this epic historical work concerning the ancient Remurian civilization in the early years of the founding of Fontaine.

120407.name: Fables de Fontaine (I)
120407.desc: A storybook containing various lore and tales authored by Marie Hericart de La Fontaine, most of which were not written by the author but are compiled from ancient poems which have since been lost.

120408.name: Fables de Fontaine (II)
120408.desc: A storybook containing various lore and tales authored by Marie Hericart de La Fontaine, most of which were not written by the author but are compiled from ancient poems which have since been lost.

120409.name: Fables de Fontaine (III)
120409.desc: A storybook containing various lore and tales authored by Marie Hericart de La Fontaine, most of which were not written by the author but are compiled from ancient poems which have since been lost.

120410.name: Robben versus Chesterton: Iridescent Brooch (I)
120410.desc: An entertaining novel quite popular in Fontaine. It tells a story about the thief "Phantom Gentleman" Fantomas Robben and the famous detective Chesterton's first confrontation. Disclaimer: This is a work of fiction. Any similarities to persons living or dead, or actual events is purely coincidental.

120411.name: Robben versus Chesterton: Iridescent Brooch (II)
120411.desc: An entertaining novel quite popular in Fontaine. It tells a story about the thief "Phantom Gentleman" Fantomas Robben and the famous detective Chesterton's first confrontation. Disclaimer: This is a work of fiction. Any similarities to persons living or dead, or actual events is purely coincidental.

120412.name: Robben versus Chesterton: Iridescent Brooch (III)
120412.desc: An entertaining novel quite popular in Fontaine. It tells a story about the thief "Phantom Gentleman" Fantomas Robben and the famous detective Chesterton's first confrontation. Disclaimer: This is a work of fiction. Any similarities to persons living or dead, or actual events is purely coincidental.

120413.name: The Fall of the Faded Castle (I)
120413.desc: A poem penned by an author unknown. The writing style seems to give off a strange and ominous aura.

120414.name: The Fall of the Faded Castle (II)
120414.desc: A poem penned by an author unknown. The writing style seems to give off a strange and ominous aura.

120415.name: The Fall of the Faded Castle (III)
120415.desc: A poem penned by an author unknown. The writing style seems to give off a strange and ominous aura.

120416.name: La Chanson d'Erinnyes (I)
120416.desc: How the emissary of King Remus came to Erinnyes, asking her for a gift of Aremori Castle's water and earth, and for her to submit to the Sumphonia Capitolii (which means "the eternal harmony").

120417.name: La Chanson d'Erinnyes (II)
120417.desc: How the Knights of every region united to lend their strength to Erinnyes, in opposition to the designs of the Capitoliani to invade.

120418.name: La Chanson d'Erinnyes (III)
120418.desc: How Erinnyes bid farewell to the Mistress of Many Waters, and how she threw her sword into the lake three times.

120419.name: Tales of a Snow-Winged Goose (I)
120419.desc: A short fairy tale that is quite popular in Fontaine. Many children saw the exquisitely drawn cover and thought it was really written by the kind Madam Snow-Winged Goose of legend.

120420.name: Tales of a Snow-Winged Goose (II)
120420.desc: A short fairy tale that is quite popular in Fontaine. Many children saw the exquisitely drawn cover and thought it was really written by the kind Madam Snow-Winged Goose of legend.

120421.name: Tales of a Snow-Winged Goose (III)
120421.desc: A short fairy tale that is quite popular in Fontaine. Many children saw the exquisitely drawn cover and thought it was really written by the kind Madam Snow-Winged Goose of legend.

120422.name: The Two Musketeers (I)
120422.desc: A series about conspiracy, revenge, justice, and evil that took Fontaine by storm.

120423.name: The Two Musketeers (II)
120423.desc: A series about conspiracy, revenge, justice, and evil that took Fontaine by storm.

120424.name: The Two Musketeers (III)
120424.desc: A series about conspiracy, revenge, justice, and evil that took Fontaine by storm.

120425.name: Time Trekker (I)
120425.desc: A Fontainian science fiction novel published by The Steambird. It tells the story of an engineer's travels using a time machine.

120426.name: Time Trekker (II)
120426.desc: A Fontainian science fiction novel published by The Steambird. It tells the story of an engineer's travels using a time machine.

120427.name: Time Trekker (III)
120427.desc: A Fontainian science fiction novel published by The Steambird. It tells the story of an engineer's travels using a time machine.

120428.name: Gift of "Parting"
120428.desc: A flowery accessory given away by Lyney at his magic shows. It is an arrangement of Lumidouce Bells, which symbolize parting.

120429.name: "Delightful Encounter"
120429.desc: A flowery accessory given away by Lyney at his magic shows. It is an arrangement of Lumidouce Bells, which symbolize parting, and Rainbow Roses that represent passion. Parting and passion are two separate perspectives sharing the same nature. What really matters is the present that we are living in.

120432.name: Red Stone
120432.desc: Red ore that you collected together with Mamere. It is said that the ore can be used to make paint.\nFor some reason, even though it's just an ore, it almost feels warm... Is your hand too cold?

120433.name: Treasure
120433.desc: An old pocket watch.\nIt has ceased to tick and tock, and its cover cannot be opened.

120434.name: Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz
120434.desc: A holy sword that bears a special meaning in a certain story.\nIt belongs to no one.

120435.name: （test）阅读物 玛丽安和莉利丝的故事

120436.name: Green Feather Accessory
120436.desc:
Sometimes, this feather has the power to advance a story forward and bring it to an end.
Its appearance itself represents a power that transcends the story.

Old yet well-preserved, it must have been cherished by many people.

120437.name: Typewriter Keycap
120437.desc: A newly purchased keycap. Though it does not quite fit in with its counterparts already on the typewriter... Well, let's just make do for now.

120438.name: "Beautifully-Written Letter"
120438.desc: A letter obtained from Decembre. According to him, this is a letter written to celebrate his child's birthday.

120439.name: "Marcotte"
120439.desc: A perfume named Marcotte. The primary ingredient is also Marcotte. Linorea often purchases this perfume.

120440.name: "Lakelight"
120440.desc: A perfume named Lakelight favored by Semaine. Does he wear this at work...?

120441.name: "Tidalga"
120441.desc: A perfume named Tidalga. It has the unique scent of algae. Come to think of it, what exactly is the "scent of algae"...?

120442.name: Fry
120442.desc: Fry that you obtained from Batasso. It is said that these fish have been hand-picked by him, and are perfectly suited to surviving in those waters...

120443.name: Heavy Box
120443.desc: A heavy box that contains many films.

120444.name: "Opera House Switcheroo" Case Record
120444.desc: A detailed case record of the murder and the disappearance that occurred during Lyney and Lynette's switcheroo magic show in the Opera Epiclese. If any difficulties are encountered during the investigation, please examine the clues and evidence collected so far to gather and organize your thoughts.

120445.name: "Water and Missing Person" Case Record
120445.desc: A detailed case record of the murder related to Navia's father, Callas, and the serial disappearances of young women case that is thought to be closely linked to the murder. If any difficulties are encountered during the investigation, please examine the clues and evidence collected so far to gather and organize your thoughts.

120446.name: Pure Pinecone
120446.desc: Much larger than an ordinary Pinecone. It must be because it is purer than an ordinary Pinecone.

120447.name: Empty Bottle
120447.desc: The meaning of an empty bottle is one full of air, which means other things can also be stored in it.

120448.name: "Key"
120448.desc: Said to be the key to the World of Intense Purity. In reality, it is a fluid, and thus can easily change shape to fit into any keyhole.

120450.name: Paimon's "Food Fund"
120450.desc: Paimon used part of her personal "Food Fund" to pay for your commission fee. Hmm, now that you think about it, she probably has more squirreled away, doesn't she?

120454.name: Experimental Crystal Light Path Component
120454.desc: A component found in a mysterious underwater space, it seems to be a core component in some kind of optical device. If placed in the correct position, it should be able to activate some kind of special device...\nAfter the experiment, please store critical components separately from the main devices. This is in accordance with standard security procedures.

120455.name: Punched Tape
120455.desc: Well-preserved punched tape. The data recorded within can only be deciphered using specialized machinery.

120456.name: Punched Tape
120456.desc: Punched tape with a bit of wear and tear. The data recorded within can only be deciphered using specialized machinery.

120457.name: Punched Tape
120457.desc: Punched tape collected in accordance with Sevigne's request. The data recorded within can only be deciphered using specialized machinery.

120458.name: Mysterious Ore
120458.desc: A mysterious green-yellow crystalline ore.\nOre of the same type seems to mutually attract.

120459.name: Arkhium Stock
120459.desc: The raw form of Arkhium, which can come together naturally under special circumstances.\nIt may be able to unleash limitless potential after being forged...

120460.name: Arkhium Lumenite
120460.desc: The result of forging Arkhium. It emits an unusual energy and light. They say that such things can be used to open a gate somewhere...

120461.name: Jabberwock's Holy Sword
120461.desc: A holy sword that bears a special meaning in a certain story.

120462.name: Absolution-Seeker's Testament
120462.desc: A letter you found in the Veluriyam Mirage. It is neatly folded and yellowed. It seems to be an object that someone left in the Domain long ago.

120463.name: Enigmatic Page (IV)
120463.desc: An ancient paper whose contents are completely unintelligible.\nPerhaps there's some way to decipher the contents.

120464.name: Enigmatic Page (V)
120464.desc: An ancient paper whose contents are completely unintelligible.\nPerhaps there's some way to decipher the contents.

120465.name: Enigmatic Page (VI)
120465.desc: An ancient paper whose contents are completely unintelligible.\nPerhaps there's some way to decipher the contents.

120466.name: Enigmatic Page (VII)
120466.desc: An ancient paper whose contents are completely unintelligible.\nPerhaps there's some way to decipher the contents.

120467.name: Enigmatic Page (VIII)
120467.desc: An ancient paper whose contents are completely unintelligible.\nPerhaps there's some way to decipher the contents.

120468.name: Enigmatic Page (IX)
120468.desc: An ancient paper whose contents are completely unintelligible.\nPerhaps there's some way to decipher the contents.

120469.name: Enigmatic Page (X)
120469.desc: An ancient paper whose contents are completely unintelligible.\nPerhaps there's some way to decipher the contents.

120470.name: Enigmatic Page (XI)
120470.desc: An ancient paper whose contents are completely unintelligible.\nPerhaps there's some way to decipher the contents.

120471.name: Enigmatic Page (XII)
120471.desc: An ancient paper whose contents are completely unintelligible.\nPerhaps there's some way to decipher the contents.

120472.name: Enigmatic Page (XIII)
120472.desc: An ancient paper whose contents are completely unintelligible.\nPerhaps there's some way to decipher the contents.

120473.name: Melody of Vesta
120473.desc: A bronze plate said to be a musical score recording an ancient melody, but it is difficult to understand due to the strange notations.

120474.name: Topyas's Token
120474.desc: The token of the self-proclaimed musician Topyas. She says it's used to play the Conch Harp.

120475.name: Strange Ore
120475.desc: An ore that gives off a strange glow. It has a compact and tough texture.

120476.name: Special Clock
120476.desc: A prototype timepiece made using special materials, reducing abrasion and wear on the internal gears. Due to its clamshell-inspired design, it can also be used underwater.

120486.name: Coffee Brewing Ingredients
120486.desc: Ingredients made by Arouet. Can be directly used to brew coffee.

120487.name: Specially Cooked Fish
120487.desc: Fish meat that Iaune has processed with a special method. Violetgold Angler Gulls seem to like it very much...

120488.name: Enhanced "Truesight Potion"
120488.desc: The improved version of the "Truesight Potion." If you drink it, who knows what kind of strange effects you'll feel...

120489.name: Credit Coupons (For Use During Investigation)
120489.desc: Special Credit Coupons you obtained when Neuvillette tasked you with investigating the Fortress of Meropide. Remember to use them for their designated purpose.

120490.name: Bait
120490.desc: Bait obtained from Boucicaut. Hopefully it will help Roialte with fishing...

120491.name: Fortune Slip
120491.desc: "Luck only brings fleeting pleasure, lifelong happiness requires hard work."

120493.name: Fortune Slip
120493.desc: "Misfortune is an illness, and caring friends are the cure."

120495.name: Fortune Slip
120495.desc: "The one who laughs loudest may not laugh to the last, but they certainly are the happiest when laughing."

120496.name: Fortune Slip
120496.desc: "After using your left cheek to strike the other person's hand, you must be sure to press the advantage, and continue attacking their hand with your right cheek."

120497.name: Fortune Slip
120497.desc: "Don't be depressed when you fail. Sometimes, a ship sinking to the bottom is also a kind of arrival."

120498.name: Fortune Slip
120498.desc: "You won't win a prize just because you bought a ticket, but you'll never win a prize if you never buy a ticket!"

120499.name: Fortune Slip
120499.desc: "Don't look for shortcuts, after all, the shortcut might already be clogged with hordes of people who've already found it."

120500.name: Fortune Slip
120500.desc: "Don't regret, or regret regretting, and definitely don't ever regret regretting regret."

120501.name: Fortune Slip
120501.desc: "The meaning of life is thinking, and the meaning of working is in giving up on life."

120502.name: Fortune Slip
120502.desc: "Luck that is easily obtained will not bring long-term happiness."

120503.name: Fortune Slip
120503.desc: "Just when you think it can't get any worse, you must be alert, for things can always get worse."

120505.name: Fortune Slip
120505.desc: "Misfortune will always come to an end. Once you are used to it, it ceases to be misfortune."

120506.name: Fortune Slip
120506.desc: "Don't retreat if you encounter obstacles. First, have a Welfare Meal. The obstacle won't disappear, but at least you've got a full stomach now."

120507.name: Fortune Slip
120507.desc: "Those with no freedom cannot be sad."

120508.name: Fortune Slip
120508.desc: "You shouldn't feel like you've got nothing. After all, you've got this delicious meal!"

120509.name: Fortune Slip
120509.desc: "Even if Whopperflowers disguise themselves as Sweet Flowers, the smart fox will not be fooled."

120510.name: Fortune Slip
120510.desc: "The secret to staying healthy: Don't get sick."

120511.name: Fortune Slip
120511.desc: "Even the sweetest Sunsettias fall from high branches. This is the result of maturity."

120512.name: Fortune Slip
120512.desc: "Don't believe maxims written on slips of paper."

120513.name: Fortune Slip
120513.desc: "Sometimes, happiness is like a Lumitoile. It can only be seen clearly when it is darkest."

120515.name: Fortune Slip
120515.desc: "Often, two small steps is better than one big step."

120516.name: Fortune Slip
120516.desc: "Don't worry, everything will get better! At least, that's what they asked me to write!"

120518.name: Fortune Slip
120518.desc: "I'm just a Fortune Slip, and cannot provide the answers to the difficulties you encounter. You must rely on yourself to overcome."

120519.name: Fortune Slip
120519.desc: "Setbacks may give you experience, but they won't give you Credit Coupons!"

120521.name: Mysterious Core
120521.desc: A mysterious core taken from a mysterious machine.\nAlthough it appears to be a gear, it is in fact a gear-shaped core — very mysterious indeed.

120522.name: Drained Conch Cup
120522.desc: An ancient conch container, and it can perhaps be traced back to an even older civilization.

120523.name: Unprocessed Widget
120523.desc: A widget that has neither been processed nor forged.

120524.name: Processed Widget
120524.desc: A widget that has been processed within the production zone.

120526.name: Pankration Fonta Cup
120526.desc: A trophy awarded for taking part in the Pankration recreational tournament as a coach, and guiding Genevieve and Poiret to victory in the championship. Made from classy-looking metal, under the right lighting, it gleams like shining Mora.\nWith this special trophy, you can get unlimited refills of refreshing Fonta at designated machines, drinking to your heart's content, and become the most satisfied enjoyer of fine drinks in the world...

120527.name: Soaked Punched Tape
120527.desc: Punched tape retrieved from the water. The data recorded within can only be deciphered using specialized machinery.\nAlthough it was made from a special waterproof material and has thus not yet been destroyed, it has been in there long enough to still feel rather wet even after being hauled out...

120528.name: Spur Gear C
120528.desc: A seemingly ordinary spur gear. It originally belonged to "Initial Skill Sample No. 2," but it seems to have been split from the main body by an immense external force...

120529.name: Spur Gear C
120529.desc: A seemingly ordinary spur gear. It originally belonged to "Initial Skill Sample No. 2," but it seems to have been split from the main body by an immense external force...

120530.name: Spur Gear T
120530.desc: A seemingly ordinary spur gear. It originally belonged to "Initial Skill Sample No. 2," but it seems to have been split from the main body by an immense external force...

120536.name: Sir Arthur's Wing
120536.desc: A clockwork wing that belonged to Sir Arthur.\nWhat the criminal did was unforgivable!

120537.name: Sir Arthur's Body
120537.desc: A clockwork body that belonged to Sir Arthur.\nWhat the criminal did was unforgivable!

120538.name: Sir Arthur's Head
120538.desc: A clockwork head that belonged to Sir Arthur.\nWhat the criminal did was unforgivable!

120540.name: Leftover Poissonchant Pie
120540.desc: It looks cute, but might cause stomach problems later...

120555.name: Mora Candy
120555.desc: Candy that looks like Mora. The candy itself is bittersweet, an adult flavor that kids have a hard time appreciating. But the golden wrapping paper is incredibly popular with children.

120556.name: Quality Wooden Board
120556.desc: A high-quality wooden plank with numerous uses. Place it under your clothes to block a potentially fatal attack, or use it for practicing martial arts.

120557.name: The Boar Princess (VIII)
120557.desc: The eighth part of this timeless classic.

120558.name: Casket of Tomes (Secondhand)
120558.desc: A cherished Casket of Tomes that its owner has been forced to part with for reasons unknown. For a limited time, comes with a copy of "Genius Invokation TCG: From Novice to the Summoners' Summit."

120559.name: Idol Poster
120559.desc: An extremely popular Inazuman idol poster, it is one of the best options of decorating a room. Discounts available if purchased together with Cute Dolls.

120560.name: Cute Doll
120560.desc: Certified by Roussimoff! Even the manliest man can't bear to part with such an adorable doll! Discounts available if purchased together with Idol Posters.

120561.name: Beast Trap
120561.desc: A mysterious trap for beasts. Place Credit Coupons on it, and it can lure in the greedy.

120562.name: Marvelous Bird Egg
120562.desc: A delectable taste that could revive the dead! If you eat it, it can counteract an entire day's worth of misfortunes.

120563.name: Delicious Tea Leaves
120563.desc: They have the mysterious effect of awakening the latent wisdom sleeping within. A unique flavor for a unique you!

120564.name: "Pure Water" (Case)
120564.desc: "Pure Water" sold by the case. Once, someone drank half a case and became the champion of the next Pankration tournament. To drink an entire case, you must have bravery surpassing that of a champion, and an even stronger digestive system.

120565.name: Fonta: Sweet Sakura
120565.desc: Specially flavored Fonta, said to use Inazuman Sakura Blooms as an ingredient. During its manufacture, the amount of sugar was reduced in order to avoid overwhelming the sakura flavor, but consumer feedback indicates that the so-called "sakura flavor" is more like the smell of a freshly-mown lawn.

120566.name: Fonta: Red Berry Blast
120566.desc: Specially flavored Fonta, said to use many different "red-colored fruits" as ingredients. It has a very enticing crimson color and layered flavor profile. But for reasons unknown, this flavor of Fonta is severely irritating to the bowels, and until the underlying reason is discovered, large-scale promotion of this type of Fonta has been suspended...

120567.name: Haggis
120567.desc: A dish with strong and distinctive flavors. Chop up the sheep offal, mix it with oatmeal, and stuff the mixture into a sheep stomach along with various seasonings and spices. When the dish is served, the stomach-bag is usually removed while the fillings are served with radish paste and mashed potatoes. This is a local specialty that Fontainians often cook as a treat for important guests.

120568.name: Coffee Bavarois
120568.desc: A refreshing dessert. Though it is one of Fontaine's trademark desserts, its recipe is very simple and straightforward. As long as the proportion of ingredients is right, hardly anyone could fail at making this dessert. It has an exquisite texture with a touch of refreshing cold taste, and can instantly lift your spirits.

120569.name: Barbeque Ribs
120569.desc: A crispy meat dish. Lightly fry the surface of the ribs until they exude a faint aroma, then wrap the crispy exterior with sauce, and finally, grill them slowly on low heat. The meticulous temperature control ensures that the exterior is perfectly crisp, while the meat within is kept juicy and tender.

120570.name: Trout Amandine
120570.desc: Fish fillets of a satisfying size, fried with butter before serving with a side of crispy fried almonds. According to the traditional recipe for this dish, a whole readied trout would be placed into the frying pan, but a new, fillet-featuring recipe for this dish has been gaining popularity recently as well.

120571.name: Suspicious Fowl
120571.desc: Fowl found by the side of the road. It might be from some birds who were victims of foul play.

120572.name: Fibery Romaritime Flowers
120572.desc: Romaritime Flowers plucked to help Lyney make magic pockets. It is said the Romaritime Flowers growing in this area are rich in fiber, and thus are great for making quality magic pockets.

120573.name: Childe's Vision
120573.desc: It appears as if Childe lost control of the Elemental Power within it before. The Vision has lost its glow now that its owner has left it behind.

120574.name: Magic Pocket Materials
120574.desc: In order to cope with the "prophecy crisis," it can't hurt to make more magic pockets. This bag full of materials is a sincere gesture of goodwill from you, Lyney, Freminet, and everybody else.

120575.name: Magic Pocket
120575.desc: A Lyney-style magic item that can not only be extremely useful for magic shows, but also has powerful storage capabilities to help the people of Fontaine cope with the "prophecy crisis."

120576.name: Puca's Token
120576.desc: Puca's token, which she lost in the depths of the mine. Hurry up and return it to her!

120590.name: Scattered Page
120590.desc: An old page obtained in the mysterious space. It should be able to prove that what transpired wasn't a dream...

120591.name: Talochard's Investigation Notes
120591.desc: These investigation notes shared by Talochard contain information on the missing Sir Arthur.

120593.name: Handwheel
120593.desc: A common handwheel, used to adjust regulating valves on the pipes around the Fortress of Meropide.

120594.name: Handwheel
120594.desc: A common handwheel, used to adjust regulating valves on the pipes in Kuisel's Clockwork Workshop.

120595.name: Handwheel
120595.desc: A common handwheel, used to adjust regulating valves on the pipes in Bravais' Press Works.

120596.name: Material for Thelxie's Weapon
120596.desc: A colorful gizmo retrieved from the water. Will be used to make Thelxie's weapon.

120597.name: Material for Thelxie's Crown
120597.desc: A colorful gizmo retrieved from the water. Will be used to make Thelxie's crown.

120598.name: Punched Tape
120598.desc: Punched tape made out of a special waterproof material. The data recorded within can only be deciphered using specialized machinery.

120599.name: Punched Tape
120599.desc: Punched tape retrieved from the tower near the Fontaine Research Institute. The data recorded within can only be deciphered using specialized machinery.

120600.name: Energy Concentrating Component
120600.desc: It was once an ordinary moving clockwork component but someone added an energy storage ring made from high-density materials.\nPerhaps just this single component is capable of powering the entire machine...

120601.name: 34th Independent Investigative Squad Deployment in Mont Esus (Eastern Quadrant) Deployment Plan

120603.name: 34th Independent Investigative Squad Deployment in Mont Esus (Eastern Quadrant) Disciplinary Procedures

120604.name: Traveler's Exclusive Interview Handbook
120604.desc: A record of the exclusive interview that the renowned reporter from the Steambird, Charlotte, had with the golden-haired Traveler. After various reorganizations and revisions of the information within, it is now fully able to take on various functions apart from "being published in the papers."

120611.name: Arkhium Inhibitor Condenser Component
120611.desc: A condenser component once installed on the Arkhium Inhibitor. According to Raimondo, after they are all reinstalled, the inhibitor can be restarted.

120612.name: "Special Report"
120612.desc: A special report privately printed by Chronie. It is said that the contents record the "truth" that the Fontaine Research Institute wishes to hide...

120613.name: Special Report
120613.desc: A special report privately printed by Chronie. It is said that the contents record the "truth" that the Fontaine Research Institute wishes to hide...

120614.name: Clue Book (Fortress of Meropide)
120614.desc: Records the various clues you found during your investigation in the Fortress of Meropide.

120615.name: Picture: Lotus Pond Beneath the Moon
120615.desc: A beautiful picture of the Lotus Pond bathing in moonlight.

120616.name: Picture: Guests of Qiaoying
120616.desc: A beautiful picture of Qiaoying Village.

120617.name: Picture: Tranquil Jademouth
120617.desc: A beautiful picture of the Jademouth.

120618.name: Picture: Mt. Xuanlian
120618.desc: A beautiful picture of Mt. Xuanlian.

120619.name: Chenyu Vale Scenery Guide
120619.desc: A tourism guidebook introducing charming scenic spots recommended by locals.

120621.name: Liam's Ballad
120621.desc: A clear bottle with a note that contains the deeds of someone named Liam and a strange drawing on the back.

120622.name: Rocky Avildsen's Disappearance
120622.desc: A clear bottle with a note that contains the history of someone named Rocky Avildsen and a strange drawing on the back.

120623.name: Athos's Confession
120623.desc: A clear bottle with a note that contains events from the life of someone named Athos and a strange drawing on the back.

120624.name: Parker's Hopes
120624.desc: A clear bottle with a note that contains records of someone named Parker and a strange drawing on the back.

120625.name: Barrow's Expectations
120625.desc: A clear bottle with a note that contains records of someone named Barrow and a strange drawing on the back.

120626.name: Autumn's Regrets
120626.desc: A clear bottle with a note that contains the history of someone named Autumn and a strange drawing on the back.

120627.name: Rouge's Writings
120627.desc: A clear bottle with a note that contains the records of someone named Rouge and a strange drawing on the back.

120628.name: Freeman's Announcement
120628.desc: A clear bottle with a note that contains the writings of someone named Freeman and a strange drawing on the back.

120629.name: Liam's Ballad
120629.desc: A clear bottle with a note that contains the deeds of someone named Liam and a strange drawing on the back. You followed the clues on the paper and found the treasure they left behind.

120630.name: Rocky Avildsen's Disappearance
120630.desc: A clear bottle with a note that contains the history of someone named Rocky Avildsen and a strange drawing on the back. You followed the clues on the paper and found the treasure they left behind.

120631.name: Athos's Confession
120631.desc: A clear bottle with a note that contains events from the life of someone named Athos and a strange drawing on the back. You followed the clues on the paper and found the treasure they left behind.

120632.desc: A clear bottle with a note that contains records of someone named Parker and a strange drawing on the back. You followed the clues on the paper and found the treasure they left behind.
