120633.desc: A clear bottle with a note that contains records of someone named Barrow and a strange drawing on the back. You followed the clues on the paper and found the treasure they left behind.

120634.name: Autumn's Regrets
120634.desc: A clear bottle with a note that contains the history of someone named Autumn and a strange drawing on the back. You followed the clues on the paper and found the treasure they left behind.

120635.name: Rouge's Writings
120635.desc: A clear bottle with a note that contains the records of someone named Rouge and a strange drawing on the back. You followed the clues on the paper and found the treasure they left behind.

120636.name: Freeman's Announcement
120636.desc: A clear bottle with a note that contains the writings of someone named Freeman and a strange drawing on the back. You followed the clues on the paper and found the treasure they left behind.

120637.name: Rainbow Rose's Ideals
120637.desc: A piece of paper formed by putting the eight notes together. The strange drawing turns out to be a complete Rainbow Rose.

120638.name: Left-Side Table File Box
120638.desc: A file box that ruthlessly attacked Ms. Chalmet's back. It was placed on the table on the left-hand side of the entrance. It would probably be easier to move if it was placed inside a bag...

120639.name: Right-Side Table File Box
120639.desc: A file box that ruthlessly attacked Ms. Chalmet's back. It was placed on the table on the right-hand side of the entrance. It would probably be easier to move if it was placed inside a bag...

120640.name: Mutual Aid Network Advertisement
120640.desc: A pamphlet given out by a very enthusiastic member of the Mutual Aid Network. It contains the basic principles of the Network. The logo on the cover looks a bit familiar...

120641.name: Fresh Jueyun Chili
120641.desc: A freshly-picked Jueyun Chili with a brilliant red coloration. This is what Diona wishes to use in her latest cocktail concoction.

120642.name: Fresh Berries
120642.desc: Brightly colored fruit with a sweet texture. An exceptionally fine picnic can be prepared by pairing it with other foods.

120643.name: Full Pankration Fonta Cup
120643.desc: The trophy for the Pankration recreational tournament, filled completely with Fonta.\nEven after being set down, a bubbling sound can be heard, a bit like the sound of "hot oil and juices in a pot of meat," making anyone who hears it hanker for food.\nHowever, the size of the trophy is in a category all its own, and few could swallow the contents in a single swig. Even if you forced yourself to manage the feat, you'd probably bloat up like a Blubberbeast and might even end up hospitalized...
120643.effect: Refreshing Fonta, a Font of Refreshment!

120644.name: Experimental Drink No. 1
120644.desc: An "experimental drink" created by Heinry. It is filled with fizzy bubbles, and has a slightly salty flavor...\nBut overall, it still maintains a bit of the orginal Fonta flavor... at least you know what you are drinking is still Fonta.

120645.name: Experimental Drink No. 2
120645.desc: An "experimental drink" created by Heinry. It is filled with fizzy bubbles, and you can even taste a bit of a slightly salty tea flavor?\nThis drink feels more like a bottle of "Salty Carbonated Tea," and not Fonta.

120646.name: Experimental Drink No. 3
120646.desc: An "experimental drink" created by Heinry. This Fonta has no bubbles whatsoever, and the saltiness is quite prominent.\nAt the very least, it still counts as Fonta.

120647.name: Experimental Drink No. 4
120647.desc: An "experimental drink" created by Heinry. It has no bubbles whatsoever, and is a bit like slightly salty tea.\nOkay, it's basically like a plain old bottle of tea.

120648.name: Experimental Drink No. 5
120648.desc: An "experimental drink" created by Heinry. Refreshing Fonta, a font of refreshment! Classic Fonta, aha!\nUh... but just making a bottle of classic Fonta is pretty meaningless.

120649.name: Experimental Drink No. 6
120649.desc: An "experimental drink" created by Heinry. A "sweet bubbly tea" bursting with bubbles. It tastes... not all that bad?

120650.name: Experimental Drink No. 7
120650.desc: An "experimental drink" created by Heinry. Refreshing Fonta, a font of— what!? This bottle's gone flat, who took off the cap and didn't finish drinking it!?

120651.name: Experimental Drink No. 8
120651.desc: An "experimental drink" created by Heinry. A "sweet bubbly tea" completely bereft of bubbles. Can... Can I just have a cup of tea instead?

120656.name: Diary of a Valiant Struggle
120656.desc: A record of the life experiences of a striver.\n"Knife those stupid birds straight through! This should be a good enough warning for them, right?"

120657.name: "Academic Assembly Hall" Picture
120657.desc: A photo taken in the Academic Assembly Hall. Who knows how Iaune will use it...

120658.name: Dodoco's Bomb-Tastic Adventure
120658.desc: A fairy tale that Lisa wrote based on the special game "Dodoco's Bomb-Tastic Adventure," featuring the Spark Knight, Dodoco, special Jumpy Dumpties, the Honorary Knight, and their white-colored helper in their victory over the fishies...

120659.name: Dodoco's Bomb-Tastic Adventure
120659.desc: A fairy tale that Lisa wrote based on the special game "Dodoco's Bomb-Tastic Adventure," featuring the Spark Knight, Dodoco, special Jumpy Dumpties, the Honorary Knight, and their white-colored helper in their victory over the fishies...

120660.name: Hat
120660.desc: A hat obtained from the Rag and Bone Shop. Though it isn't the same hat that was lost, it should be sufficient to handle the situation at hand.

120664.name: Dry Firewood
120664.desc: Dry firewood of moderate thickness, excellent for firemaking.

120665.name: Special Key
120665.desc: A special key, perhaps it can be used in a certain place.

120666.name: Special Key
120666.desc: A special key, perhaps it can be used in a certain place.

120667.name: Special Key
120667.desc: A special key, perhaps it can be used in a certain place.

120668.name: Special Key
120668.desc: A special key, perhaps it can be used in a certain place.

120669.name: Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Certificate

120670.name: Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Certificate

120671.name: Teardrop Key
120671.desc: A gem like a raindrop, or perhaps like someone's falling tear.

120699.name: Blanche's Letter
120699.desc: A letter, placed betwixt two Bulle Fruit.

120700.name: Thelxie's Fantastic Adventures
120700.desc: A children's fantasy book containing only three pages, it tells the story of a prince who overcomes loneliness.\nIt reads "For anyone in a tough spot" in small print on the back cover.

120702.name: Location No. 1 Materials
120702.desc: Heinry's lost materials. Who knows what kind of inspiration he'll get from them...

120703.name: Location No. 2 Materials
120703.desc: Heinry's lost materials. Who knows what kind of inspiration he'll get from them...

120704.name: Location No. 3 Materials
120704.desc: Heinry's lost materials. Who knows what kind of inspiration he'll get from them...

120705.name: "Iridescent Glory"
120705.desc: Shells and corals of all different hues and colors. Said to be the greatest treasure of the Water Imps, and the very reason they built the shining Rainbow Bridge in the Kingdom of Water Imps...

120714.name: Marvelous Jelly: Improved Fontaine Edition
120714.desc: An exquisite gift box from Haniyyah, the jellies within are loved by Fungi. There are many unique flavors, so Fungi with different preferences can be fed separately.\nWith a better understanding of the Fungi and her accumulated experience, Haniyyah has mastered the flavors of the Marvelous Jelly. The improved version is not only more nutritious, but also contains special Fontainian flavors. The healthy jellies allow the Fungi to eat well and live well!

120715.name: Spina di Rosula Uniform Gift Box
120715.desc: Navia prepared this gift, which contains a Spina di Rosula uniform, for Adele. The dimensions are a bit large for Adele at present, but it works just fine for a promise.

120716.name: Strangely-Shaped Key
120716.desc: A key you got from a member of Romeuf's gang. This seems to be the tool required to quickly stop the explosives.

120719.name: Rusty Iron Key
120719.desc: Someone must have dropped this here. Just what lock does it open?

120720.name: Old Insignia
120720.desc: An insignia that marks the owner's identity. If it's been left here and no one thought to look for it for a long time, perhaps the owner didn't care about it very much.

120721.name: "Persona"
120721.desc: One of the fabricated materials necessary to forge the Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz. It feels almost weightless.

120722.name: Unlocked "Treasure"
120722.desc: An old pocket watch.\nIt seems to have stopped at a certain instant, the beautiful memory of a moment becoming eternal.

120723.name: Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz
120723.desc: A sacred blade indwelt with great enough reason and will to create and destroy a universe, or a dream.

120724.name: Ancient Tree Branch
120724.desc: A branch taken from an ancient tea tree. It emits a faint adeptal energy...

120726.name: "A New Life's Beginning"
120726.desc: An exit card issued by the Fortress of Meropide. It's just a piece of paper, but it has been given a name most heartening.

120730.name: Root Cycle
120730.desc: One of the keys designed by the Narzissenkreuz Ordo for the tower. When combined, the keys form a peculiar shape of three and a half circles, for which there is a special explanation.\nThe innermost circle is the Cycle of Hyperborea, symbolizing the age when the world was frozen and the lost paradise.

120731.name: Root Cycle
120731.desc: One of the keys designed by the Narzissenkreuz Ordo for the tower. When combined, the keys form a peculiar shape of three and a half circles, for which there is a special explanation.\nThe middle circle is the Cycle of Natlantea, symbolizing the triumph over the evil dragon, a metaphor for humanity's victory over nature as well as the beasts within themselves.

120732.name: Root Cycle
120732.desc: One of the keys designed by the Narzissenkreuz Ordo for the tower. When combined, the keys form a peculiar shape of three and a half circles, for which there is a special explanation.\nThe third circle and outermost half circle are the Cycles of Remuria and Khraun-Arya, symbolizing the relationship between humans and gods.

120733.name: Simple Vault Key I
120733.desc: One of the keys that opens the iron barrier on the shattered vessel.

120734.name: Simple Vault Key II
120734.desc: One of the keys that opens the iron barrier on the shattered vessel.

120735.name: Simple Vault Key III
120735.desc: One of the keys that opens the iron barrier on the shattered vessel.

120744.name: Arataki Gang's Instant Ramen
120744.desc: A gift from Kuki Shinobu after helping the Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King power up and find new ways in Beetle Battle in Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp. \nDried ramen blocks are placed in a sturdy yet light box, with sealed condiments, exceptionally rigid utensils, and a bowl. Put the ramen and the condiments in the bowl, then pour in hot water to quickly make a bowl of ramen that doesn't taste too bad at all. Convenient, isn't it? \nBut according to the letter that Kuki Shinobu left in the box, neither she nor Arataki Itto got to eat this during their journey on the water to Liyue, because they only brought cookies and pickles. During their stay in Liyue, Kuki Shinobu was inspired by the wheaten foods there, and created this instant ramen so that Oni King's Right Hand and Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon could fight off their hunger during their travels...

120745.name: Foggy Forest Branch
120745.desc: A branch that glimmers with a jade-green light. It seems to have some kind of mysterious connection with the Foggy Forest Path.\nUpon closer inspection, it appears as though something is flowing within the branch.

120746.name: Fallen Bouquet
120746.desc: Wild flowers in bloom that were once cherished by someone. There is little special about it, unless that be the place where it fell.\nA little gratitude and remembrance may be the key to moving forward.

120747.name: Tripod
120747.desc: Urville's lost tripod. It should be usable once it is dried.

120748.name: Nadia's Token
120748.desc: A small gear. It seems very ordinary indeed.

120749.name: Tiny Conch
120749.desc: A beautiful conch. Nadia loves it a lot.

120750.name: Diving Set
120750.desc: Urville's lost diving equipment. It seems to have been damaged a bit.

120751.name: Sunken Coin Pouch
120751.desc: A commonly-seen coin pouch filled with Mora.

120754.name: Wangshan Hall Backup Key
120754.desc: A rusted key obtained from Huang the Third.

120755.name: The Paimon Special
120755.desc: According to Huang the Third, when Grand Master Guhua passed on his techniques, he would accept rice and salted meat as payment instead of Mora. Based on this anecdote, Paimon put all her heart (and salt) into this super special dish...

120757.name: A Bag of Mora
120757.desc: The compensation you received from Woliu. It contains a sum of Mora satisfactory to both parties.

120758.name: Woliu's Drilling Device
120758.desc: A box that contains a drilling device. Who knows what it'll dig up, exactly...

120759.name: Autumn's Gift
120759.desc: A musical toy sold at Bertin's House of Curiosities. It is very popular among children. This one appears to have been bought a long while back and is no longer the latest model available in the store.\nPresents are for sending to people, and if they cannot be sent to their original destination, then let them at least be left with one who will treasure them.

120760.name: Mysterious Xenochromatic Crystal
120760.desc: A large crystal obtained by defeating extremely powerful Fontemer Aberrants.\nThe power it contains is more mysterious than common Xenochromatic Crystals.\nMaybe someone will be willing to pay the right price for it.

120761.name: Recruitment Notice
120761.desc: Instructions filled in by Benoit Leroy. A map has been kindly appended to the address.

120762.name: Map Fragment
120762.desc: A damaged piece of paper that looks like the bottom-right corner of a map. There are strange points and lines drawn on it.

120763.name: Small Key
120763.desc: A small key that can even be used as a bookmark. Why was it not confiscated? And why does such a tiny key open such an important door?

120769.name: Carp Spirit Orb
120769.desc: An orb that was inlaid on the Golden Carp Fish statue. It contains an immense amount of adeptal energy.

120785.name: Ruin Machine Core
120785.desc: A power supply mechanism discovered in the ruins of Chenyu Vale. The residual energy within seems enough to activate one more Ruin Guard.

120786.name: Jade Fragment (Left)
120786.desc: A jade fragment with adeptal energy lingering around it. In the legends told by the ancestral peoples, all jades originally came from the same stone. If that holds true, it might be possible to join the jade fragments together...

120787.name: Jade Fragment (Right)
120787.desc: A jade fragment with adeptal energy lingering around it. In the legends told by the ancestral peoples, all jades originally came from the same stone. If that holds true, it might be possible to join the jade fragments together...

120788.name: Fragrant Wood "Huangcong"
120788.desc: An exquisitely carved piece of fragrant wood that is used in ceremonial rites and exudes a light fragrance. Judging from its shape, there seems to be another piece of fragrant wood to complement this one.

120789.name: Fragrant Wood "Chizhang"
120789.desc: An exquisitely carved piece of fragrant wood that is used in ceremonial rites and gives off the scent of something burnt. Judging from its shape, there seems to be another piece of fragrant wood to complement this one.

120790.name: "Our Chenyu Vale Trek" Album
120790.desc: A commemorative photo album containing many marvelous pictures. Shockingly, over half were taken by the same person.

120791.name: Ancient Autoharmonic Music Box
120791.desc: An ancient music box found in the Faded Castle. It contains the mysterious power of the Symphony.\nUse it to read musical scores left by the ancient civilization. Find more scores to unlock the civilization's secrets.

120792.name: Strange Key
120792.desc: A strange key. Who knows what lock it opens...

120793.name: Blank Score
120793.desc: This seems to be a musical score created using unknown materials by an ancient civilization.\nIts staves lie empty. No notes have ever been recorded here.

120794.name: Ancient Score
120794.desc: This seems to be a musical score created using unknown materials by an ancient civilization.\nThe melody recorded within can only be deciphered using a special device.

120795.name: Lost Grimoire
120795.desc: A strange book of magic that has, by the "symphony"'s power, calmed down at last.\nIf you have the chance, you might want to return it to its shelf.

120796.name: Shooting Practice Optical Lenses
120796.desc: An optical array provided by Special Security and Surveillance Patrol member Turenna. It appears to use some hard-to-grasp imaging techniques in conjunction with the sand table device from the "Thousand-Pace Interdiction Arcminute Sharpshooting Zone" to simulate using a musket to shoot at one's foes.\nThough this is considered in many ways insufficient for actual Patrol members' training regimens, it is more than enough to drum up interest in muskets and musketry, in developing one's talents for such, and for using such gifts for good.

120797.name: Perinheri (I)
120797.desc: This text is also known as "Hleobranto Innamorato." The author of the first edition claims to have based this tale on a legendary story known throughout Khaenri'ah, but there are none left who can verify this. It is an anthological work produced over several generations at this point.

120798.name: Perinheri (II)
120798.desc: This text is also known as "Hleobranto Innamorato." The author of the first edition claims to have based this tale on a legendary story known throughout Khaenri'ah, but there are none left who can verify this. It is an anthological work produced over several generations at this point.

120799.name: Anecdota Septentrionalis (I)
120799.desc: An ancient Remurian scroll you accidentally discovered in the ruins. There is no way to verify the truth of the words within.

120800.name: Anecdota Septentrionalis (II)
120800.desc: An ancient Remurian scroll you accidentally discovered in the ruins. There is no way to verify the truth of the words within.

120801.name: Anecdota Septentrionalis (III)
120801.desc: An ancient Remurian scroll you accidentally discovered in the ruins. There is no way to verify the truth of the words within.

120807.name: Autumn's Gift
120807.desc: A musical toy sold at Bertin's House of Curiosities. It is very popular among children. This one appears to have been bought a long while back and is no longer the latest model available in the store.\nThe chiming tune played in your palm takes the place of all the words that could not be said. This present, which could not be sent, has been forsaken, and is thus now yours.

120808.name: Package for the Leroy Family
120808.desc: The newspaper deliveryperson, Pip, has stuffed the papers that the Leroy family has not collected during this time into this package.

120809.name: Chioriya Boutique - Darkness Disguised Behind a Facade of Fashion

120810.name: Lovely Lumitoile
120810.desc: A Lumitoile collected from the seafloor. The shape is stellar and the color charming. It should be usable as a clothing accessory.

120812.name: Forgotten Key (I)
120812.desc: A key that seems to have been lost in the wilderness of Chenyu Vale. What could it be used for...?

120813.name: Forgotten Key (II)
120813.desc: A key that seems to have been lost in the wilderness of Chenyu Vale. What could it be used for...?

120815.name: Cultivation Area Expansion (I)
120815.desc: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

120816.name: Cultivation Area Expansion (II)
120816.desc: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

120817.name: Cultivation Area Expansion (III)
120817.desc: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

120818.name: Cultivation Area Expansion (IV)
120818.desc: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

120819.name: Cultivation Area Expansion (V)
120819.desc: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

120820.name: Cultivation Area Expansion (VI)
120820.desc: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

120821.name: Improved Alchemy Cauldron (I)
120821.desc: Enhances the performance of the alchemy cauldron, expanding the area into which ingredients may be placed when making potions.

120822.name: Improved Alchemy Cauldron (II)
120822.desc: Enhances the performance of the alchemy cauldron, expanding the area into which ingredients may be placed when making potions.

120823.name: Improved Alchemy Cauldron (III)
120823.desc: Enhances the performance of the alchemy cauldron, expanding the area into which ingredients may be placed when making potions.

120824.name: Improved Alchemy Cauldron (IV)
120824.desc: Enhances the performance of the alchemy cauldron, expanding the area into which ingredients may be placed when making potions.

120825.name: Angled Drop Bottle
120825.desc: A potion bottle with very distinctive angles, like a chiseled drop of water. When it comes to precious alchemical potions, not a single drop may be wasted...\nIt can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

120826.name: Heartstopping Heart Bottle
120826.desc: A potion bottle with a tall stem with a heart-shaped design. It is said that customers will find it aesthetically appealing no matter the color of the potion within...\nIt can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

120827.name: Tranquil Bay Bottle
120827.desc: A cleverly crafted bottle with a unique long neck design. They say that the designer of the bottle compared it to a "tranquil bay"...\nIt can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

120828.name: Gorgeous Gem Bottle
120828.desc: A potion bottle with a narrow mouth and wide body. The interweaving of a multitude of straight lines gives it the outward appearance of a large gemstone, bestowing it with an extra-luxurious look in the eyes of customers...\nIt can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

120829.name: Chonky Cat Bottle
120829.desc: A potion bottle with a round, curvy design, like a fat feline's head. The attention of customers who like cuteness is easily drawn to these bottles...\nIt can slightly improve the quality of the potion. All special bottles provide the same buff.

120830.name: Windwheel Aster's Aroma
120830.desc: A bottle decoration made from the combination of a Windwheel Aster and emerald-green leaves. It seems to be able to envelop the potion in a gentle breeze...

120831.name: Resplendent as a Crystalfly
120831.desc: An especially eye-catching bottle decoration fashioned in the shape of a Crystalfly that can sometimes grab the attention of customers in an instant...

120832.name: Perfect Gift Ribbon
120832.desc: A bottle ornament that is shaped like a ribbon tied into a bow. It seems to give the potions a feeling similar to that of a gift box, bursting with promises of pleasant surprises...

120833.name: Raspberry-Red Flying Flower Feather
120833.desc: A feather-shaped bottle ornament sprinkled with berry-red that is said to easily be associated by customers with the image of birds in flight...

120834.name: Gold Gild and Emerald
120834.desc: A bottle ornament with a golden frame and the appearance of an emerald gem. The "gemstone" is made of glass, and balances aesthetic appeal with cost...

120835.name: Shop Decoration: Blooming Morale
120835.desc: A decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop. A beautiful double-layered flower bed, it is said to have been donated by a certain member of the Investigation Team as a "morale booster."

120836.name: Shop Decoration: Blooming Atmosphere
120836.desc: A decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop. An array of blue and beige colored flowers, it was supposedly created by a certain member of the Logistics Company as an "item to build up the atmosphere."

120837.name: Shop Decoration: Potent Potions
120837.desc: A mounted decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop, it can be hung from the shop roof, and the pictured potion uses a classic shape that most people associate with...

120838.name: Shop Decoration: Portentous Potions
120838.desc: A mounted decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop, it is also used to advertise the alchemy shop throughout Mondstadt. The pictured potion uses a classic shape that most people associate with...

120839.name: Shop Decoration: Prismatic Effects
120839.desc: A mounted decoration specially for use by the Knights of Favonius alchemy shop, many small multicolored flags are hung from it, and the "prismatic" effect is said to be symbolic of the many myriad effects of the wondrous potions sold...

120841.name: Xuanlian Sacred Water
120841.desc: If not for its name, this so-called "sacred water" sourced from the vicinity of Mt. Xuanlian would never have been regarded as anything special. On the contrary, when looking at it after knowing its name, you feel like you can see some adeptal aura rising from the water.

120842.name: Ancient Jade Cup
120842.desc: An ancient teacup that seems to have been lost in the wilderness. It seems to exude a faint adeptal aura.

120843.name: Someone's Ledger
120843.desc: This ledger found in the Wangshan Hall contains detailed records of every last income and expenditure item.

120845.name: Votive Rainjade
120845.desc: The final gemstone hurled by the Adeptus Fujin in ancient times. Although it looks pretty much the same as other ordinary jade stones, it contains enough adeptal energy to transform the nearby water and land in an instant...

120851.name: Chizhang Map
120851.desc: The location of the warehouse seems to be recorded on this map the Millelith left behind.

120852.name: Mini Phonograph
120852.desc: A miniaturized phonograph that appears to have recorded certain sounds. It might perhaps come in handy...?

120853.name: Ancient City Key
120853.desc: It seems that this long-rusted key can be used to open a long-abandoned warehouse somewhere along the Chizhang Wall.

120854.name: Rust-Worn Key
120854.desc: Although this key, which you found in Chenyu Vale, is covered in rust, it looks like it can still be used...

120855.name: Beauteous Beryl Conch
120855.desc: A Beryl Conch collected from the seafloor. The shape is stellar and the color charming. It should be usable as a clothing accessory.

120856.name: Ravishing Romaritime Flower
120856.desc: A Romaritime Flower collected from the seafloor. The shape is stellar and the color charming. It should be usable as a clothing accessory.

120857.name: Fish Seized From a Pelican's Mouth
120857.desc: A fish you managed to retrieve from the mouth of a pelican at the Qiaoying Village docks. It seems to be an item that other creatures treasure greatly, so you might be able to make amends for a certain loss from a certain time by returning this to the daily feeding vessel of certain animals...

120858.name: Yellow Obsidian Fragment
120858.desc: An obsidian fragment with engraved patterns styled like those of the Children of Echoes, which you obtained by chance while exploring. It appears that you could form a full ring using three of them, though what that will achieve, you cannot tell.
source_list: Tequemecan Valley and Basin of Unnumbered Flames Exploration Reward

120859.name: Yellow Obsidian Ring
120859.desc: An obsidian ring with engraved patterns styled like those of the Children of Echoes. It is an ancient medium by which the tribe established contact with the deep night. Perhaps its strength can allow you to cross the boundary between this place and a certain other location...

120861.name: Invitation From the Arataki Gang
120861.desc: An invitation letter that is loud and colorful in both cast and content. It describes a passionate, freeform, wild, huge, border-crossin' rock 'n' roll festival, in which you shall be a special guest, there to awaken the burning rock 'n' roll soul within all present!

120862.name: Witness Pact
120862.desc: A document that seems to be of considerable age. Who knows how long it's been here?

120863.name: Great Clockwork Key
120863.desc: A clockwork device preserved to a very high standard. One can only wonder what mysterious power deserves such fine treatment.

120864.name: Felix Felicium
120864.desc: A peculiar potion Lisa concocted for you that seems to shine with a golden sheen. It is said to bring the user good luck, ensuring all their every endeavor will succeed until the effects wear off. As the ingredients required are exceedingly rare, and the brewing process devilishly complex, only a few have succeeded in concocting it.

120865.name: Concentrated Transoceanic Pearl
120865.desc: A special ingredient on the list that Sigewinne gave. Must be obtained from specific Fontemer Aberrants.

120866.name: Tainted Hydro Phantasm Extract
120866.desc: A special ingredient on the list that Sigewinne gave. Must be obtained from specific Tainted Hydro Phantasms.

120867.name: Courier's Trial Keystone
120867.desc: A stone mechanism used to unlock the gates of ancient altars. Among the Scions of the Canopy, this mechanism serves as a trial machine, where only the most experienced couriers are said to be able to acquire all three keystones in a short span of time.

120870.name: Lynette's Envelope
120870.desc: An envelope that belongs only to Lynette. Her name is penned on the back, and it contains a group photo and a photo of her on stage. The "threatening letter" has been stuffed in there, too.

120871.name: Talisman of Waxaklahun Ubah Kan
120871.desc: The talisman of the Sage of the Stolen Flame. It is said that the sage who once stole phlogiston from a dragon's claws left this behind as proof of a pact made with the tribes.

120872.name: Restored Score
120872.desc: The once-tattered score has been restored. Someone learned in music will surely be able to read the ancient melody contained within.

120873.name: Pages From a Lost Score (I)
120873.desc: A fragment of an ancient musical score. Indecipherable in its current form.

120874.name: A Ridiculously Common Branch
120874.desc: A very ordinary branch that has been processed by human hands in some way.\nIt might have been a prop used by children at play... But whatever it is, it couldn't have been some "barbarian token"...

120875.name: Cultivation Area Expansion (VII)
120875.desc: Adds another area for cultivating ingredients.

120876.name: Alchemeter
120876.desc: A custom Knights of Favonius device used to analyze alchemical ingredients. Place any alchemical shop ingredients within to analyze their special characteristics and increase the corresponding "ingredient level," allowing the efficacy of concocted potions to be increased in various ways...

120880.name: "I Got Reincarnated as an Onikabuto... And Flipped the World Upside Down"
120880.desc: Some light rock 'n' roll lyrics... or perhaps just bad poetry?

120884.name: Key With Frontal Notches
120884.desc: A key to a Saurian Cart with notched patterns that tend toward the key's front. Normally, local residents only transport Saurians in wooden carts when they can no longer move on their own power.

120885.name: Key With Centered Notches
120885.desc: A key to a Saurian Cart with notched patterns that are right smack in the key's center. Although they call these "Saurian carts," what usually happens is that the Saurian will pull the cart while someone sits on it.

120886.name: Key With Rear Notches
120886.desc: A key to a Saurian Cart with notched patterns that tend toward its rear. Perhaps this might open the door of quite a special cart indeed.

120888.name: Brickstacks Long-Range Lamp
120888.desc: A lamp that once hung in the Brickstacks Lighthouse. It shines brightly still, despite having been removed.

120889.name: A "Weapon-Like" Dragon Horn
120889.desc: A dragon horn that resembles a sword. It seems to have once belonged to a reckless dragon...

120890.name: Fell Dragon's Scale
120890.desc: A scale from which an ominous power radiates. They say that the fell dragon of Simulanka dropped this.

120891.name: Criminal's Testimony
120891.desc: Criminal testimonies compiled by Morgane. They record the results of today's interrogation.

120892.name: Rawat's Notes
120892.desc: A page of a notebook you found in a cupboard within Rawat's mother's residence. It marks out a location north of the Fontaine Research Institute.

120893.name: Scattered Star
120893.desc: A star that once hung high above Constellation Metropole. For some reason, it has fallen from the sky...

120894.name: Group Photo From an Unknown Time
120894.desc: A precious group photo that has surpassed the rules somehow, being taken by some unknown person using unknown means in a space that should no longer exist.

120912.name: Green Obsidian Fragment
120912.desc: An obsidian fragment with engraved patterns styled like those of the Scions of the Canopy, which you obtained by chance while exploring. It appears that you could form a full ring using three of them, though what that will achieve, you cannot tell.
source_list: Coatepec Mountain and Basin of Unnumbered Flames Exploration Reward

120913.name: Green Obsidian Ring
120913.desc: An obsidian ring with engraved patterns styled like those of the Scions of the Canopy. It is an ancient medium by which the tribe established contact with the deep night. Perhaps its strength can allow you to cross the boundary between this place and a certain other location...

120914.name: Azure Obsidian Fragment
120914.desc: An obsidian fragment with engraved patterns styled like those of the People of the Springs, which you obtained by chance while exploring. It appears that you could form a full ring using three of them, though what that will achieve, you cannot tell.

120915.name: Azure Obsidian Ring
120915.desc: An obsidian ring with engraved patterns styled like those of the People of the Springs. It is an ancient medium by which the tribe established contact with the deep night. Perhaps its strength can allow you to cross the boundary between this place and a certain other location...

120916.name: Night Jade
120916.desc: A nearly weightless black jade, enveloped in chilling flames. According to Natlan's legends, offering it at a specific altar might just open the path to the kingdom ruled by the night.

120917.name: Pages From a Lost Score (II)
120917.desc: A fragment of an ancient musical score. Indecipherable in its current form.

120918.name: Special Pickaxe
120918.desc: A special pickaxe used to excavate toytanium. It has the special power to slice through layers of rock, but will not harm said toytanium or any resident of Simulanka.

120919.name: Goddess's Manuscript (I)
120919.desc: A story written by the creator of this world. This is the blueprint that birthed Simulanka, a history that brooks no doubt.

120920.name: Goddess's Manuscript (II)
120920.desc: A handwritten manuscript penned by a fairytale writer. For some reason, there is a hole in the paper that resembles...

120921.name: Goddess's Manuscript (III)
120921.desc: A mere fairytale, penned by most mundane hands. If you look closely, the holes in the paper were made by a cat's paw...

120925.name: "Secret Elixir"
120925.desc: Said to be a secret elixir that belongs to the empathy clan, capable of increasing both the size and strength of residents of Constellation Metropole. Really, though, does this container really contain such a medicine?

120926.name: Guard's Spear
120926.desc: A long spear wielded by Constellation Metropole guards. Well-centered and elegant, you could throw it from ground level and strike down a flying dragon.

120927.name: Star Shard
120927.desc: A strange fragment that Orqo termed a Star Shard.

120928.name: Group Photo From an Unknown Time
120928.desc: A precious group photo that has surpassed the rules somehow, being taken by some unknown person using unknown means in a space that should no longer exist.

120929.name: Crude Obsidian Statue
120929.desc: A uniquely sculpted obsidian statue with very distinctive contours. It was once used by the people of Natlan as a medium to communicate with the "Night Kingdom."

120930.name: Red Metal Key
120930.desc: A key you found in the Sulfurous Veins. Who knows where the door it unlocks may lead...

120931.name: "Treasure Map" With the Vault's Location
120931.desc: A Treasure Map given to you by Florian, the "guard." It is said that within the vault it will lead you to, the Marechaussee Hunters of the past left behind a treasure with the power to defeat the evil sorcerer...

120932.name: "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day" Character Album
120932.desc: A book that commemorates the participants in this game of "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day." For both players and Game Master, it is full of memories of your adventures together. "And so shall I never despair"... Perhaps this exhortation holds a deeper meaning for the one who played the Marechaussee Hunter?

120939.name: Green-Edged Paper Slip
120939.desc: A special "pass" with green patterns drawn along its edges. It is not clear exactly what material this is made of, and it makes a rustling noise when you rub it. On one corner, it reads "If you have picked this up accidentally, please return it promptly to..." A small map has also been drawn on it.

120951.name: Water-Rusted Key
120951.desc: A key that soaked in water for a long, long time. Who knows if it can even unlock the door it was made to open anymore...

120952.name: Ancient Jadestone Fragment
120952.desc: A strange fragment picked up in the ancient ruins of Natlan. The exact material it is made from is hard to determine.\nFor some reason it feels warm to the touch.

120953.name: Perfect Heart of the Sacred Dragon
120953.desc: A flawless piece of jade. Before the fires of human civilization had ever been kindled, it was the heart of the Dragonlord Ix Uxul Tz'ib Bolon Ch'ule-L, ruler of Chichen Uctokah.\nIt once held the authority to command all devices within Ochkanatlan, the ineffable city, yet can no longer be used due to its energy having been completely exhausted.\nJust as with the half-humans who pursued it so relentlessly, the Dragonlord's quest for perfection was ultimately in vain, leading to naught but an end that was as cold and lifeless as jade.

120956.name: Fresh Sour Sauce Ceviche
120956.desc: Raw pieces of fish with a fruity fragrance. The sheer fragrance bowls you over in the first wave, with sourness and spiciness bringing up the rear, granting this fish layers akin to the tides, with you the surfer on a sea of flavor. Even when the tumult has subsided, your yearning remains.

120957.name: A Gem Meant as a Gift
120957.desc: A crystal-clear yellow gemstone. Paimon intends to give it to your Saurian companion... but you'll need to process the gem well before it's truly ready to be given away as a gift...

120958.name: Jewel Artisan's Toolbox
120958.desc: A suitcase that contains all the tools used by the "Gem Master" Kulahaw when working gems. Some of the tools within are not expensive, but they sure are handy.

120959.name: Jewel Artisan's Box of Parts
120959.desc: A suitcase containing parts required for jewel processing by "Gem Master" Kulahaw. The components inside are all made of precious materials.

120965.name: Iridescent Inscription Fragment
120965.desc: A fragment of a shattered Iridescent Inscription. It is broken beyond repair and can no longer serve its purpose. Though dismissed by many as delusional obsession, some still believe they hold the key to unraveling messages from ancient civilizations.

120968.name: Golden Entreaty
120968.desc: A white disc retrieved from the ruins of the Sage of the Stolen Flame. It is one of the essential tokens required to journey to the Great Volcano of Tollan and remove the "Flamelord's Blessing" from the little Tepetlisaur's back. Golden inscriptions are etched into the surface of the white disc, and when touched, one can sense the intricate patterns pulsating as if imbued with life.

120970.name: Cazcal's "Hora Special Care Kit"
120970.desc: A set of specialized Saurian care tools personally crafted by Cazcal. Each one has been specially modified for Hora's particular needs.

120971.name: "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day" Character Album
120971.desc: A book that commemorates the participants in this game of "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day." For both players and Game Master, it is full of memories of your adventures together. "And so shall I never despair"... Perhaps this exhortation holds a deeper meaning for the one who played the Marechaussee Hunter?

120972.name: "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day" Character Album
120972.desc: A book that commemorates the participants in this game of "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day." For both players and Game Master, it is full of memories of your adventures together. "And so shall I never despair"... Perhaps this exhortation holds a deeper meaning for the one who played the Marechaussee Hunter?

120973.name: "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day" Character Album
120973.desc: A book that commemorates the participants in this game of "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day." For both players and Game Master, it is full of memories of your adventures together. "And so shall I never despair"... Perhaps this exhortation holds a deeper meaning for the one who played the Marechaussee Hunter?

120974.name: "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day" Character Album
120974.desc: A book that commemorates the participants in this game of "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day." For both players and Game Master, it is full of memories of your adventures together. "And so shall I never despair"... Perhaps this exhortation holds a deeper meaning for the one who played the Marechaussee Hunter?

120975.name: "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day" Character Album
120975.desc: A book that commemorates the participants in this game of "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day." For both players and Game Master, it is full of memories of your adventures together. "And so shall I never despair"... Perhaps this exhortation holds a deeper meaning for the one who played the Marechaussee Hunter?

120976.name: "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day" Character Album
120976.desc: A book that commemorates the participants in this game of "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day." For both players and Game Master, it is full of memories of your adventures together. "And so shall I never despair"... Perhaps this exhortation holds a deeper meaning for the one who played the Marechaussee Hunter?

120977.name: "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day" Character Album
120977.desc: A book that commemorates the participants in this game of "Marechaussee Hunter: Judgment Day." For both players and Game Master, it is full of memories of your adventures together. "And so shall I never despair"... Perhaps this exhortation holds a deeper meaning for the one who played the Marechaussee Hunter?

120984.name: "Uthabiti"
120984.desc: Kachina's Ancient Name. This plain, unadorned obsidian seems to be a bit heavier than expected. It is said you can use it to find Kachina's approximate location...

120986.name: Purpose-Built Grappling Hook
120986.desc: A specialized grappling hook used by the Scions of the Canopy that is exceptionally safe. It's quite popular for both rock climbing and to assist with rapid descents.

120987.name: Ordinary Obsidian
120987.desc: A simple, unadorned piece of obsidian that can become a vessel for an Ancient Name.

120988.name: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (I)
120988.desc: The binding and layout are exquisitely made, but the actual content is all handwritten. Judging from the handwriting, there is more than one author. "Don't fuss about WHAT we're writing, the cover needs to look good! That's the only way it'll give off that 'masterpiece' feeling."

120989.name: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (II)
120989.desc: "You're more than halfway through and you haven't even pushed the plot forward one iota! Why is it all about the setting!?" "And what would you know? Besides, this stuff isn't fleshing the setting out. It's elucidating natural science and other miscellaneous disciplines!"

120990.name: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (III)
120990.desc: Some mysterious handwriting appears before the main text: "It's so rare for R to be in her right mind for a spell. Should she really be wasting the precious little lucid time she has writing this?" "Don't worry. For a witch, this is the most important thing."

120991.name: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (IV)
120991.desc: Some mysterious handwriting appears before the main text: "Tsaritsa be good, how are there this many unresolved plot threads? Please, have mercy on these old bones, would you?"

120992.name: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (V)
120992.desc: The writing here is practically a messy scrawl. Perhaps the author doesn't really write much, or perhaps something happened.

120993.name: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (VI)
120993.desc: "Is it still necessary to write this, the present moment being what it is?" "Allow me, then. Opportunities to return to this world are few and far between. Alice would think the same: If we don't continue, then everything would have been meaningless from the start."

120994.name: The Little Witch and the Undying Fire (VII)
120994.desc: The binding and layout are exquisitely made, but the actual content is all handwritten. Judging from the handwriting, there is more than one author. "I have already found the meaning of writing — that is to tell you: I do so wish you were here, too."

120995.name: The Feline Firm (I)
120995.desc: One day, the mysterious Feline Firm sends an invitation to the doorman Perroux... Just what kind of adventures await him?

120996.name: The Feline Firm (II)
120996.desc: Having deciphered the Felinese spell, Perroux finds the entrance to the firm, and just like that, "jumps into the shadows beneath"... And then?

120997.name: The Feline Firm (III)
120997.desc: The cat with the full-sleeve arm tattoo completed the ever-snoring cat boss's commission, but what did the other do? Perroux's curiosity remained unabated...

120998.name: The Feline Firm (IV)
120998.desc: Even the Feline Firm, which has seen nearly everything, can find itself at a loss from time to time. Just what devilish difficulty has confounded the conceited tabby boss that he must seek succor from Perroux?

120999.name: The Feline Firm (V)
120999.desc: A cat's magical boots and a cat's mysterious mask. Just how will they bring the long-furred cat to the Feline Firm?

121000.name: The Feline Firm (VI)
121000.desc: Witnessed by all the cats and the Master, will the tabby cat and the long-furred cat get hitched without a hitch, becoming cat husband-and-wife... or...?

121001.name: The Feline Firm (VII)
121001.desc: "Run, Perroux, run!" — For the Perroux that had grown cat ears, these words alone remained ringing in his mind...

121002.name: The Feline Firm (VIII)
121002.desc: "That said, it seems the Master has come into another springtime of love?" whispered the servants...\nBut this was something that happened much later.

121003.name: Broken, Graffiti-Marked Stone
121003.desc: Part of graffiti art that was once painted onto a wall. Perhaps, if you can put it back in place, you can see what the art was about...

121004.name: Shattered Night Jade
121004.desc: A nearly weightless black jade, enveloped in chilling flames. If it could be pieced together, perhaps something extraordinary might happen...

121005.name: Ancient Flint Key
121005.desc: A uniquely shaped key. It seems like rotating it to different angles will enable it to fit into various locks...

121006.name: Contending Spark
121006.desc: Small sparks born from conflict. They are precisely the forces that eternally sustain the Sacred Flame.

121007.name: "A Setting Sun That Never Sets"
121007.desc: A Sunsettia that grows within Simulanka. It can seemingly be used to make the Magic Tonic of the Forest of Blessings.

121008.name: "A Dragon That Cannot Fly"
121008.desc: A Snapdragon that grows in Simulanka. It can seemingly be used to make the Magic Tonic of the Forest of Blessings.

121009.name: "A Moon That Only Shines At Night"
121009.desc: A Nilotpala Lotus that grows in Simulanka. It can seemingly be used to make the Magic Tonic of the Forest of Blessings.

121010.name: Magic Tonic
121010.desc: Mystical ink created by the Forest Fairy using magic. It seems to be very important to those who dwell in the Forest of Blessings.

121011.name: Ogun's Testimony
121011.desc: A record of Ogun's testimony. It contains clearly-listed information on the time of Crafting Bench usage and purpose, and the victim's condition.

121012.name: Pampa's Testimony
121012.desc: A record of Pampa's testimony. Many exaggerations and redundancies in information make this one much harder to parse.

121013.name: The Locusts' Purchase Invoice
121013.desc: Amidst these items, only the reason for and quantity of the Loach Pearl purchase seems out of place.

121014.name: Anela's Testimony
121014.desc: A record of Anela's testimony. Seems like the content is not short on criticism of the Hawkwings, either...

121015.name: Key From a Balloon Platform
121015.desc: It looks like it's for opening a cage from a camp below a hot air balloon somewhere... But would someone really be kept in a cage like that?

121016.name: Fell Dragon's Picturebook
121016.desc: A picture book that concerns the "fell dragon of Simulanka" — that is to say, Durin. None know the tales that are recorded in this text.

121017.name: Dreams of the Ancient Capital
121017.desc: A book about a young woman named Lycia who sets out on a journey alone following the ruination of her homeland at the hands of a black dragon.

121019.name: Missing Package
121019.desc: An express delivery package misplaced by a careless courier. It appears slightly worn. Better hurry and deliver it to Michica.

121020.name: Damaged Package
121020.desc: An express delivery package with a damaged exterior. You can vaguely make these words out on the packaging: "From... Palette... cat..."

121021.name: Damaged Letter
121021.desc: A letter with a damaged exterior. You can vaguely make these words out on the envelope: "From... anca..."

121022.name: Slightly Squashed Package
121022.desc: An express delivery package with a damaged exterior. You can vaguely make these words out on the packaging: "Gemporium... Im..."

121023.name: Torn Letter
121023.desc: A letter with a damaged exterior. You can vaguely make these words out on the envelope: "From... irda..."

121024.name: Acat's Package
121024.desc: An express delivery package with a damaged exterior. According to Michica, the letter inside belongs to Acat, the owner of "Frida's Palette" located in the Stadium of the Sacred Flame.

121025.name: Chanca's Letter
121025.desc: A letter with a damaged exterior. According to Michica, the letter belongs to Chanca, the owner of "Weary Inn" located in the Stadium of the Sacred Flame.

121026.name: Imix's Package
121026.desc: An express delivery package with a damaged exterior. According to Michica, this package contains an invoice belonging to Imix, who can often be found at "Muhuru's Gemporium."

121027.name: Tirda's Letter
121027.desc: A letter with a damaged exterior. According to Michica, this letter belongs to Tirda, who is often found at "Golden Dusk."

121028.name: Map Left Behind by the First Chief
121028.desc: A map left behind by the first chief of the People of the Springs. It is said to indicate the route to the mysterious island, yet only skilled guides can decipher its secrets.

121030.name: Amina's Coin Pouch
121030.desc: A coin pouch that Amina gave you. Inside are funds to deal with scams.

121031.name: Kaulu's Recommended Expedition Equipment
121031.desc: Expedition equipment that Kaulu recommended you purchase. Though very expensive, the quality doesn't seem to be as good as he made it out to be.

121032.name: Photo With Ata
121032.desc: A photo with Ata, the Koholasaurus elder. Paimon seems to love it.

121033.name: Expedition Equipment Purchased by Mualani
121033.desc: High-end camping gear that Mualani has bought for this adventure.

121035.name: Path of Turnfire
121035.desc: An illustration of the Turnfire Night ritual. It resembles the Scions of the Canopy's totem.

121036.name: Mementos of Teyvat Album
121036.desc: #An album that features many of {NICKNAME} and Paimon's mementos of their adventures. Your adventure is not yet over, and you will certainly create many more memories in the future! This album is probably far too thin to contain all the pictures you've taken and will take, so after it's been filled, don't forget to go buy a new one with Paimon!

121037.name: Dopey Dazzler's Notes on Graffiti
121037.desc: A notebook written by the Graffiti Alliance member Dopey Dazzler, discussing what she knows of the art of graffiti. It describes some of the ideas behind creating "avant-garde" works and seems to be a gift she prepared for a star of the graffiti scene who has yet to arise...

121038.name: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (I)
121038.desc: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (I)

121039.name: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (II)
121039.desc: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (II)

121040.name: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (III)
121040.desc: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (III)

121041.name: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (IV)
121041.desc: Ancient Chronicle of the Dreamseeker Priest (IV)

121042.name: Fresh Sprayfeather Gill
121042.desc: Sprayfeather Gill that has been freshly picked. They said that its extracted juice can help you deceive a Koholasaurus's sense of smell.

121043.name: Amina's Compensation
121043.desc: Remuneration from Amina, as a token of appreciation for helping to convict the scammer "guide."

121044.name: Key to Somewhere
121044.desc: A metal key that can be found practically everywhere. Just like every lock has a key, sure there's a door out there somewhere it can open...

121045.name: Expedition Equipment Purchased by Mualani
121045.desc: High-end camping gear and a special record player model that Mualani has bought for this adventure.

121046.name: Expedition Equipment Purchased by Mualani
121046.desc: Various items that Mualani purchased for this adventure. Camping equipment is a necessity, of course, and the record player and records are for... entertainment during rest time, you suppose?

121047.name: Photo With Ata
121047.desc: A photo with Ata, the Koholasaurus elder. Paimon seems to love it.

121048.name: Commemorative Photo of You and Mualani
121048.desc: This memento that you took together captures the moment after you and Mualani completed the journey to the mysterious island with each other's help.

121049.name: Commemorative Photo of You and Mualani
121049.desc: This memento that you took together captures the moment after you and Mualani completed the journey to the mysterious island with each other's help.

121050.name: Shiny Shell
121050.desc: A strangely-shaped shell that you chanced upon in Toyac Springs. Whether or not it can be put to any use is unclear, but nevertheless, Paimon still likes it.

121051.name: Atea's Talisman
121051.desc:
"Sometimes I wonder — what if the hot springs were never to dry, nor friends to say goodbye..."
"If this land was no longer plagued by darkness, and our children could relish the joys within their reach, free from both care and worry..."
"If a world like that could really exist, just knowing it could would be enough, even if I didn't live to see it... Mavuika, my hot spring buddy and the god I trust and follow..."
"The flames bind us close, and even death cannot part us. Natlan is with you, and no one fights alone."

121052.name: Wooden Model Alpaca
121052.desc: An Alpaca model that shows signs of having been hit all over. This heavy object seems to need to be placed at a spot marked with graffiti...

121053.name: Strange Saurian Cart Key
121053.desc: A Saurian Cart's key that opens a cart somewhere.

121055.name: Note Left Inside a Treasure Chest

121056.name: Research Center Emergency Machine Operation Handbook
121056.desc: Research Center Emergency Machine Operation Handbook

121058.name: Maawe and Monetoo (I)
121058.desc: A woven scroll from the People of the Springs telling of how Maawe the Saurian whelp created the hot spring. Different paragraphs of this seem to have been penned by poets of different eras.

121059.name: Maawe and Monetoo (II)
121059.desc: A woven scroll from the People of the Springs telling of how Maawe the Saurian whelp created the hot spring. Different paragraphs of this seem to have been penned by poets of different eras.

121060.name: Maawe and Monetoo (III)
121060.desc: A woven scroll from the People of the Springs telling of how Maawe the Saurian whelp created the hot spring. Different paragraphs of this seem to have been penned by poets of different eras.

121061.name: Records of Hanan Pacha (I)
121061.desc: A fable, passed down from generation to generation, in which the legendary Sage of the Stolen Flame is the main protagonist. Professional historians, it is said, have analyzed its contents and come to a consensus that this tale has nothing to do with historical fact.

121062.name: Records of Hanan Pacha (II)
121062.desc: A fable, passed down from generation to generation, in which the legendary Sage of the Stolen Flame is the main protagonist. Professional historians, it is said, have analyzed its contents and come to a consensus that this tale has nothing to do with historical fact.

121063.name: Records of Hanan Pacha (III)
121063.desc: A fable, passed down from generation to generation, in which the legendary Sage of the Stolen Flame is the main protagonist. Professional historians, it is said, have analyzed its contents and come to a consensus that this tale has nothing to do with historical fact.

121064.name: The Tale of Qoyllor and Ukuku
121064.desc: A long-standing Natlan folk tale that was originally told orally. As such, there is now no way of knowing who the original author was.

121065.name: The Volcano Lord and the Shadow Pins
121065.desc: A woven scroll that depicts the legend of the hero Traore, a favorite among the children of the Nanatzcayan.

121067.name: Rust-Spotted Key
121067.desc: A rusty key that you might be able to use to open a door somewhere...

121068.name: Pilgrim's Chronicle
121068.desc: Obtained from the Lord of the Night, this material plays a key role in the creation of Ancient Names. Its essence is "memory," for Natlan's Ley Lines do not record the adventures of outsiders, and so, a special "vessel" is needed here.\nMemory flows within this receptacle, and if you focus on its surface, it will display the vital footprints you have left in Natlan.\nFrom what you've heard, Xilonen and Citlali had a rather easy time obtaining this material. This, you presume, is thanks to the Lord of the Night's gentleness and generosity.

121069.name: Pilgrim's Chronicle
121069.desc: Obtained from the Lord of the Night, this material plays a key role in the creation of Ancient Names. Its essence is "memory," for Natlan's Ley Lines do not record the adventures of outsiders, and so, a special "vessel" is needed here.\nMemory flows within this receptacle, and if you focus on its surface, it will display the vital footprints you have left in Natlan. Though the Ancient Name forging process is complete, these radiant tales of yours will not be erased.\nFrom what you've heard, Xilonen and Citlali had a rather easy time obtaining this material. This, you presume, is thanks to the Lord of the Night's gentleness and generosity.

121070.name: Somewhat Aged Copy of "Tequil the Brave"
121070.desc: Somewhat Aged Copy of "Tequil the Brave."

121071.name: Spanking New Copy of "Tequil the Brave"
121071.desc: Spanking New Copy of "Tequil the Brave."

121072.name: Pyrophosphorite
121072.desc: An ordinary-looking stone that seems to be the key to unlocking the secrets hidden within the legendary Tonatiuh.

121073.name: Dye Samples
121073.desc: Dye samples made from a special fruit, found deep within a cave. They seem to be the key to making that type of woven scroll.

121079.name: A Nameless Adventurer's Notes
121079.desc: Notes left by an adventurer of an unknown era. In them, they recorded their adventures in Ochkanatlan.

121080.name: A Nameless Adventurer's Notes
121080.desc: Notes left by an adventurer of an unknown era. In them, they recorded their adventures in Ochkanatlan.

121081.name: A Nameless Adventurer's Notes
121081.desc: Notes left by an adventurer of an unknown era. In them, they recorded their adventures in Ochkanatlan.

121083.name: Medicine of Greater Efficacy
121083.desc: Saurian medicine personally concocted by Mazkal. Its healing effect is outstanding.

121084.name: Medicine of Superior Taste
121084.desc: Saurian medicine personally concocted by Mazkal that tastes absolutely amazing.

121085.name: Scarlet Phlogiston Honey Pearl
121085.desc: An unpolluted Phlogiston Honey Pearl, and a gift from Xilonen.\nFrom the nearly-crimson color, you can tell that this is of the absolute highest quality.\nIn contrast to her words, the market value of this is astonishingly high.

121087.name: Magnifico's "Masterpiece"
121087.desc: An unforgettable group photo with Magnifico's signature on the back: "Friends, even the smallest of trees can cast the biggest of shadows!"

121088.name: Fires of Autumn Twilight (I)
121088.desc: A woven scroll from the Flower-Feather Clan. It seems like it consists of what were originally two separate stories from different eras that were then merged together at some unknown time.

121089.name: Fires of Autumn Twilight (II)
121089.desc: A woven scroll from the Flower-Feather Clan. It seems like it consists of what were originally two separate stories from different eras that were then merged together at some unknown time.

121090.name: Fires of Autumn Twilight (III)
121090.desc: A woven scroll from the Flower-Feather Clan. It seems like it consists of what were originally two separate stories from different eras that were then merged together at some unknown time.

121091.name: Springs of Hidden Jade (I)
121091.desc: What kind of passerby will the young man, lost in a secluded bamboo grove, meet along his way?

121092.name: Springs of Hidden Jade (II)
121092.desc: What kind of passerby will the young man, lost in a secluded bamboo grove, meet along his way?

121093.name: Mt. Lingmeng Gossip (I)
121093.desc: A book about the local folklore and ballads of Chenyu Vale. It contains many far-fetched folk legends.

121094.name: Mt. Lingmeng Gossip (II)
121094.desc: A book about the local folklore and ballads of Chenyu Vale. It contains many far-fetched folk legends.

121095.name: Mt. Lingmeng Gossip (III)
121095.desc: A book about the local folklore and ballads of Chenyu Vale. It contains many far-fetched folk legends.

121096.name: The Tale of Kuntur
121096.desc: A long-standing Natlan folk tale that was originally recounted orally. As such, there is now no way of knowing who the original author was.

121097.name: Mysterious Weapon Fragment: Arrow Rest
121097.desc: A fragment of a weapon once wielded by Sanhaj Kompore, Border Master of the Masters of the Night-Wind. It was broken into its currents state during the great war five hundred years past. According to Granny Itztli's intuition, it may aid the Traveler in some inexplicable way at some future point in their journey.

121098.name: Iktomi Scroll: Map
121098.desc: A woven scroll map, obtained through a clairvoyant vision, pointing to a mysterious place said to have vanished long ago — namely, the Mare Jivari.

121099.name: Tepal's Tattered Notes
121099.desc: An incomplete notebook in which Tepal has recorded his obsessions and dreams.

121101.name: Key Found by the "Painted Stone Challenge" Podium
121101.desc: A key you found by the "Painted Stone Challenge" podium. Going by the rules of common sense, you'd probably guess that the door it unlocks must be somewhere nearby said podium...

121102.name: Secret Art Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce
121102.desc: Grilled Fish doused in delicious sauce. Under your and Paimon's careful hands, the fish has been meticulously scored, stuffed with specially selected spices, then baked. Once cooked, a thick mint sauce is generously drizzled over the top. The refreshing aroma of the fish is enough to whet anyone's appetite.\nIf you can master the art of grilling fish this way, perhaps one day you and Paimon will earn the title of Grilled Fish Master Chefs...

121103.name: Purple Obsidian Fragment
121103.desc: An obsidian fragment with engraved patterns styled like those of the Masters of the Night-Wind, which you obtained by chance while exploring. It appears that you could form a full ring using three of them, though what that will achieve, you cannot tell.

121104.name: Purple Obsidian Ring
121104.desc: An obsidian ring with engraved patterns styled like those of the Masters of the Night-Wind. It is an ancient medium by which the tribe established contact with the deep night. Perhaps its strength can allow you to cross the boundary between this place and a certain other location...

121105.name: Crimson Obsidian Fragment
121105.desc: An obsidian fragment with engraved patterns styled like those of the Flower-Feather Clan, which you obtained by chance while exploring. It appears that you could form a full ring using three of them, though what that will achieve, you cannot tell.
source_list: Quahuacan Cliff and Ochkanatlan Exploration Reward

121106.name: Crimson Obsidian Ring
121106.desc: An obsidian ring with engraved patterns styled like those of the Flower-Feather Clan. It is an ancient medium by which the tribe established contact with the deep night. Perhaps its strength can allow you to cross the boundary between this place and a certain other location...

121107.name: Sunset-Blue Obsidian Fragment
121107.desc: An obsidian fragment with engraved patterns styled like those of the Collective of Plenty, which you obtained by chance while exploring. It appears that you could form a full ring using three of them, though what that will achieve, you cannot tell.

121108.name: Sunset-Blue Obsidian Ring
121108.desc: An obsidian ring with engraved patterns styled like those of the Collective of Plenty. It is an ancient medium by which the tribe established contact with the deep night. Perhaps its strength can allow you to cross the boundary between this place and a certain other location...

121116.name: Pakpaka Flying School Flying Tournament Invitation Letter

121119.name: Captured Photos
121119.desc: A batch of photos you got from the Fatui that clearly shows the structure of the Remnants of the Secret Source in this place. This picture shows a special mechanism with a very noteworthy shape.

121120.name: Nearby Flammabomb Wood
121120.desc: This tree has a rather frightening name, but is, in fact, not prone to spontaneous ignition. Its name simply comes from its striking crown, which resembles an exploding fireball...\nYou saw lumps of such processed wood scattered on the ground, yet no trees nearby that could produce it. Someone must have deliberately brought them here...

121121.name: Nearby Ashen Aratiku Wood
121121.desc: A tree that can be found in a specific region in Natlan. Their numbers are few...\nYou saw lumps of such processed wood scattered on the ground, yet no trees nearby that could produce it. Someone must have deliberately brought them here...

121122.name: A Nameless Adventurer's Notes
121122.desc: Notes left by an adventurer of an unknown era. In them, they recorded their adventures in Ochkanatlan.

121123.name: Smooth-Bitted Key
121123.desc: A key with a smoothly curved bit, almost like an arc. Somewhere out there, perhaps there's a door it could easily open...

121124.name: Straight-Bitted Key
121124.desc: A key with extremely straight bitting. Somewhere out there, perhaps there's a door it could easily open...

121125.name: Messily-Bitted Key
121125.desc: A key with worn teeth that look quite messy after many years of action. Perhaps it requires a bit of "technique" to actually use...

121126.name: Citlali's Handkerchief
121126.desc: A handkerchief that Citlali gave you as a gift. May its colors ever stay in your memory — as a present, and as a promise.

121127.name: Legend-Inscribed Woven Scroll
121127.desc: A woven scroll that Citlali helped you complete. It chronicles the legendary battle you undertook to become a hero of Natlan.

121128.name: "Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power," First Edition
121128.desc: The first edition of "Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power." A very costly item to collect on account of its limited print run.

121129.name: "Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?" Limited Deluxe Edition
121129.desc: The limited deluxe edition of "Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?" The Yae Publishing House released this limited print run in response to its readers. Stocks were all but emptied out the instant these came to market, making them a much sought-after collector's item amongst light novel lovers.

121130.name: Citlali's Handkerchief and Key
121130.desc: The key given to you by Citlali so that "you won't wake me up by beating on my door while I'm drunk." You carefully place it alongside the handkerchief she gave you. After all, you've collected so many keys in the past, so this one needs to have a special mark to stand out.

121145.name: Golden Entreaty
121145.desc: A white disc retrieved from the ruler of Cinder City's corroded ruins within Ochkanatlan. It is one of the essential tokens required to journey to the Great Volcano of Tollan and remove the "Flamelord's Blessing" from the little Tepetlisaur's body, and is said to have been one of the fragments left behind when the Flamelord's eye was split in two. According to legend, it is said that the ancient Dragonlord — who once held dominion over all light and wisdom — transformed one of his eyes into a conduit of supreme authority by which all flames might be governed, and that this became his only exploitable weakness...

121146.name: Helka's Notes
121146.desc: Notes written on pieces of paper printed with conch patterns.\nThese seem to be drafts made in preparation for composing a monster picture book, and apart from records and descriptions, they also contain some information intended for a companion. Perhaps someone might have switched the copy out for the original by mistake...

121147.name: A "Gift Envelope" From Paimon
121147.desc: To my best— no, bestest travel companion ever!!!

121148.name: Emblem of Valor
121148.desc: A commemorative portrait of you and your companions, which you obtained after assisting the combat readiness liaison Irade with stage certification.\nAccording to her, after having been crafted by three masters and certified by you, the stages may now have reached such a level of perfection as to require no further iteration. They will surely become the first port of call for warriors looking to challenge themselves and hone their martial prowess...

121149.name: Special Commemorative Letter
121149.desc: A souvenir obtained after assisting the combat readiness liaison in testing and certifying various stages...\nComplete the Archon Quest "Incandescent Ode of Resurrection" to use, thereby earning an "Emblem of Steadfast Valor" as a special gift.

121150.name: Emblem of Valor
121150.desc: A commemorative portrait of you and your companions, which you obtained after assisting the combat readiness liaison Irade with stage certification.\nAccording to her, after having been crafted by three masters and certified by you, the stages may now have reached such a level of perfection as to require no further iteration. They will surely become the first port of call for warriors looking to challenge themselves and hone their martial prowess...

121151.name: Special Commemorative Letter
121151.desc: A souvenir obtained after assisting the combat readiness liaison in testing and certifying various stages...\nComplete the Archon Quest "Incandescent Ode of Resurrection" to use, thereby earning an "Emblem of Steadfast Valor" as a special gift.

121159.name: Invitation From Miko
121159.desc: Miko has sent you a long-awaited letter. It seems she has something important she wants to discuss...

121160.name: Aisa Bathhouse Credit Coupon
121160.desc: A credit coupon given to you by Mizuki which allows you to visit the Aisa Bathhouse after hours. With this, you'll not only not disturb others, but more importantly, others are guaranteed not to disturb you.

121161.name: Leafy Dreams
121161.desc: An album given to you by Kinkaku and co. that is said to be able to transform and preserve recent wonderful memories. For some reason, when you open its pages, you are greeted by the scent of fresh leaves...

121162.name: Place of the Trial of Disembodiment Message
121162.desc: Place of the Trial of Disembodiment Message

121163.name: Rattan Toy: Hu Tao
121163.desc: A rattan figure that Lan Yan made specially for Hu Tao. It contains mysterious spellwork that can be used to distribute Fetor for the latter. However, due to your special relationship with the Ley Lines, your rattan figure cannot be linked up to the array...

121164.name: Hu Tao: Plum Branch
121164.desc: The night was suddenly filled with the fragrance of plum blossoms, spreading across the springtime sky and land.

121165.name: Zhongli: Rex Coin
121165.desc: A Fortune Coin with a special Guyan Sigil engraved into it. It is said that this is the symbol of Rex Lapis, and can be used as a protective talisman.

121166.name: Rattan Toy
121166.desc: A rattan toy left behind by someone, perhaps Lan Yan. It is slightly different from the ones at the fair, having a mysterious sigil stuck to it, indicating some other purpose.

121167.name: A Nameless Adventurer's Notes
121167.desc: Notes left by an adventurer of an unknown era. In them, they recorded their adventures in Ochkanatlan.

121168.name: Saurus Crackers: Tatankasaurus
121168.desc: Crackers shaped like little Saurians. The enticing aroma of butter draws forth the delightful, irresistible interplay between the Cacahuatl and Grainfruit, while the cute shapes make them truly hard to put down... Be that as it may, you received these treats on the parade of blessings and it might be nicer to keep them as an uneaten memento.

121169.desc: Crackers shaped like little Saurians. The enticing aroma of butter draws forth the delightful, irresistible interplay between the Cacahuatl and Grainfruit, while the cute shapes make them truly hard to put down... Be that as it may, you received these treats on the parade of blessings and it might be nicer to keep them as an uneaten memento.
