121175.name: That Which Was Once Ehecatl
121175.desc: A small-scale Secret Source Automaton. Now that it has lost all power, all that is left are echoes in an empty shell. It shows clear signs of careful maintenance, which afforded it brief function once reactivated, even after being lost in the outside world for so long.

121176.name: Aisa Bathhouse VIP Pass
121176.desc: A beautifully crafted invitation letter that emits a faint yet beguiling scent. It's claimed that such letters are sent to only the most valued of customers. The letter contains the establishment's location and introduces its three primary services.

121177.name: Mysterious Gift
121177.desc: A gift gained from playing games at the Mikawa Flower Festival. It appears to be an exquisitely-made furnishing...

121178.name: Glimpses of Mysterious Inazuma (I)
121178.desc: A collection of Inazuman folk stories transcribed by a traveling writer from Fontaine. Its pages contain a wealth of myths and strange tales passed down orally by people from all over Inazuma.

121179.name: Glimpses of Mysterious Inazuma (II)
121179.desc: A collection of Inazuman folk stories transcribed by a traveling writer from Fontaine. Its pages contain a wealth of myths and strange tales passed down orally by people from all over Inazuma.

121180.name: Men of Lithin (I)
121180.desc: A fantasy novel doing the rounds among the tribes of Natlan that is said to be translated from a popular work by the reputedly famous Fontainian author K'n-yan. The Natlanese who have visited the Court of Fontaine, however, claim to have been unable to find the original — nor has anyone managed to find a local who's ever heard of an author named "K'n-yan".

121181.name: Men of Lithin (II)
121181.desc: A fantasy novel doing the rounds among the tribes of Natlan that is said to be translated from a popular work by the reputedly famous Fontainian author K'n-yan. The Natlanese who have visited the Court of Fontaine, however, claim to have been unable to find the original — nor has anyone managed to find a local who's ever heard of an author named "K'n-yan".

121182.name: Men of Lithin (III)
121182.desc: A fantasy novel doing the rounds among the tribes of Natlan that is said to be translated from a popular work by the reputedly famous Fontainian author K'n-yan. The Natlanese who have visited the Court of Fontaine, however, claim to have been unable to find the original — nor has anyone managed to find a local who's ever heard of an author named "K'n-yan".

121183.name: Green Berryshroom
121183.desc: An ordinary-looking mushroom with an extraordinary flavor. Only grows near the orchard at Varesa's house. They're fast growers, so if you see one, eat it quickly.

121184.name: Permit to the Sacred Heart
121184.desc: An unadorned scale obtained from the Chamber of Deliberation and activated by the Secret Source Servant, Awanyu. It grants access to the Heart of the Sacred Mountain. Most dragon scales discolor and fade to white once removed from their masters as they lose the power that once ran through them. Yet this one, despite its long history, still glows gold in the darkness, displaying its might for all to see.

121185.name: Phlogiston Unit
121185.desc: A replaceable resource unit created by the ancient inhabitants of this place by harnessing the properties of Phlogiston. All Secret Source Automatons require Phlogiston Units to work, though the exact specifications of the units required depend on the complexity of each automaton's operations.

121196.name: Fusion Profusion: DJ Remix Selections
121196.desc: A series of songs handpicked by Xilonen that have earned her recognition, a selection truly unique to Natlan. Includes a "Master Xilonen Commemorative Photo" commissioned by several DJs. \nHowever, it seems that this record can only sound its best on professional equipment such as the Dance-Off Stage, and using unsuitable equipment may damage the disc surface... In any case, it makes for a one-of-a-kind collector's item and keepsake!

121198.name: Café Lutece House Grounds
121198.desc: Coffee procured exclusively for Café Lutece. The smell alone is enough to sharpen your senses. Make sure to bring it to Escoffier.

121199.name: Kompore the Cunning (I)
121199.desc: Said to be a tapestry personally woven by Master Sanhaj Kompore, its contents are both short and strange. Generally believed to be a work of pure fiction.

121200.name: Kompore the Cunning (II)
121200.desc: Said to be a tapestry personally woven by Master Sanhaj Kompore, its contents are both short and strange. Generally believed to be a work of pure fiction.

121201.name: Kompore the Cunning (III)
121201.desc: Said to be a tapestry personally woven by Master Sanhaj Kompore, its contents are both short and strange. Generally believed to be a work of pure fiction.

121202.name: Sundjatta's First Foray (I)
121202.desc: A woven scroll passed down for generations in the Children of Echoes. It tells the legend of a young Sundjatta from 500 years ago.

121203.name: Sundjatta's First Foray (II)
121203.desc: A woven scroll passed down for generations in the Children of Echoes. It tells the legend of a young Sundjatta from 500 years ago.

121204.name: Sundjatta's First Foray (III)
121204.desc: A woven scroll passed down for generations in the Children of Echoes. It tells the legend of a young Sundjatta from 500 years ago.

121205.name: Rangi Nui's End
121205.desc: An ancient folk song from the People of the Springs. It describes the tale of the legendary hero, Rangi Nui.

121206.name: The Headless Coquitao (I)
121206.desc: A woven scroll from the Masters of the Night-Wind. It is said that the stories within are older than the tribe itself, a claim that remains difficult to verify.

121207.name: The Headless Coquitao (II)
121207.desc: A woven scroll from the Masters of the Night-Wind. It is said that the stories within are older than the tribe itself, a claim that remains difficult to verify.

121209.name: Photo With Travel Companions
121209.desc: A photo of you and your travel companions; a memento of a land where humans and saurians coexist. Though our paths may eventually diverge, the memories we create together shall never fade.

121210.name: Photo With Travel Companions
121210.desc: A photo of you and your travel companions; a memento of a land where humans and saurians coexist. Though our paths may eventually diverge, the memories we create together shall never fade.

121212.name: Records Regarding "Creating the Secret Source Servants..."

121213.name: Records Regarding "Humans... and Exceptional Individuals Thereof"

121215.name: Records Regarding "Items That Should Perhaps Be Deleted..."

121220.name: Chamber of Deliberation: Sovereign Rulers' Council Records

121221.name: Chamber of Deliberation: Sovereign Rulers' Council Records

121222.name: Chamber of Deliberation: Sovereign Rulers' Council Records

121223.name: Secret Source Dragon Idol Workshop Engraving

121228.name: Chevalmarin Amusement Park Commemorative Map
121228.desc: A memento to remind you of the roaring success that you and your companions achieved with the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland. You drew this map together in a whimsical, storybook style, ensuring every enchanting attraction and adorable landmark stands out. Of course, the most important features are the friends who came to visit. Following Furina's advice, you added a snowy white beard to her portrait, like a coating of sweet cream, making sure the entire map "sounds delicious"...

121229.name: Chevalmarin Amusement Park Commemorative Map
121229.desc: A memento to remind you of the roaring success that you and your companions achieved with the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland. You drew this map together in a whimsical, storybook style, ensuring every enchanting attraction and adorable landmark stands out. Of course, the most important features are the friends who came to visit. Following Furina's advice, you added a snowy white beard to her portrait, like a coating of sweet cream, making sure the entire map "sounds delicious"...

121230.name: Chevalmarin Amusement Park Commemorative Map
121230.desc: A memento to remind you of the roaring success that you and your companions achieved with the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland. You drew this map together in a whimsical, storybook style, ensuring every enchanting attraction and adorable landmark stands out. Of course, the most important features are the friends who came to visit. Following Furina's advice, you added a scarlet beard to her portrait, like a smothering of bolognese sauce, making sure the entire map "sounds delicious"...

121231.name: Easybreeze Album
121231.desc: An album filled with precious memories from your time at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort. The Asha painted on the vibrant cover looks as though it's dancing.\nThe lilting melody of your holiday still lingers on the breeze, like an old friend from a distant land waiting for the chance to greet you once more.

121232.name: Hand-Drawn Map
121232.desc: A map from Albedo's manuscript. There are three locations marked on it.

121234.name: Wonderland Cosmosphere
121234.desc: One of the keys to the Miliastra Wonderland, this glittering crystal ball, adorned with star-shaped gemstones, was bestowed as a reward for passing the Hexenzirkel's trial.\nAccording to the one who presented it, it is not something that an ordinary person can master. Yet, the witch known as "Octavia" has been observing you and Paimon for some time. She has witnessed you overcome countless trials and dangers while displaying natural curiosity and courage, and showing remarkable creativity beyond the realms of mere adventure. For these reasons, she considers you the ideal candidates to become the new masters of the Miliastra Wonderland. Octavia firmly believes that together, the two of you will unlock the full potential of this wondrous world...

121236.name: Chevalmarin Amusement Park Commemorative Map
121236.desc: A memento to remind you of the roaring success that you and your companions achieved with the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland. You drew this map together in a whimsical, storybook style, ensuring every enchanting attraction and adorable landmark stands out. Of course, the most important features are the friends who came to visit. Following Furina's advice, you added a scarlet beard to her portrait, like a smothering of bolognese sauce, making sure the entire map "sounds delicious"...

121237.desc: A memento to remind you of the roaring success that you and your companions achieved with the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland. You drew this map together in a whimsical, storybook style, ensuring every enchanting attraction and adorable landmark stands out. Of course, the most important features are the friends who came to visit. Following Furina's advice, you added a snowy white beard to her portrait, like a coating of sweet cream, making sure the entire map "sounds delicious"...

121238.desc: A memento to remind you of the roaring success that you and your companions achieved with the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland. You drew this map together in a whimsical, storybook style, ensuring every enchanting attraction and adorable landmark stands out. Of course, the most important features are the friends who came to visit. Following Furina's advice, you added a snowy white beard to her portrait, like a coating of sweet cream, making sure the entire map "sounds delicious"...

121240.name: Portable Kuuvahki Charging Component
121240.desc: A charging component that stores kuuvahki for powering certain devices in case of emergency.

121241.name: Rantiy's Hat
121241.desc: It is said to be a sturdy safety helmet strong enough to withstand arrows and firearms.

121242.name: Welcome to Nasha Town!
121242.desc: This guide map — found after running into the kuuhenki at Nasha Town's docks — appears to highlight points of interest around town.

121243.name: Key to the "Hibernation Chamber"
121243.desc: On that ship that traversed the sea of stars, there should be only two keys, belonging to the golden-haired, traveling twins.

121244.name: Ayar Heroes' Cup Invitation
121244.desc: A mysterious invitation letter, with a line of crooked little letters inside: "Tour of the Return of the Sacred Flame."

121245.name: "Ultra-Amazing Miracle Tonic Guaranteed to Make You Taller with Zero Effort!"
121245.desc: A "miracle tonic" obtained from Dori.\nIt seems a little suspicious. Could growing taller really be this easy?

121246.name: Key (Important Item)
121246.desc: The "key" to rescuing the Alpaca Sheriff.

121250.name: Aino's Toolbox
121250.desc: A toolbox stored in the Workshop's Trove. Instead of tools, it contains a mysterious accessory.

121251.name: Aino's Toolbox (Empty)
121251.desc: A toolbox that once held Aino's accessory — an accessory that has since been taken.

121252.name: Ineffa's Toolbox
121252.desc: A toolbox stored in the Workshop's Trove. Instead of tools, it contains a mysterious accessory.

121253.name: Ineffa's Toolbox (Empty)
121253.desc: A toolbox that once held Ineffa's accessory — an accessory that has since been taken.

121254.name: Invitation Letter For a Ball Now Past
121254.desc: An invitation that lingers beyond the end of a ball now past — proof of that dreamlike gathering. Behind the now-empty eyes of the mask, a pair of pupils once witnessed the grandeur of that banquet.

121255.name: Dream-Mirror Remnant
121255.desc: An Abyss Crystal, a gift from Skirk to you. When worn, it can be used in your sleep to "dream-mirror" with her. To find the culprit, Skirk infiltrated your dreams, while you witnessed the memories deep within her heart. Use this crystal once more to revisit certain scenes of what happened back then...

121256.name: Training Review
121256.desc: After completing Skirk's rigorous training, you and she compiled a summary of your experiences, documenting your relentless efforts and her grueling trials. Though the training has ended, revisiting these records can still yield invaluable insights...

121257.name: Special Fortune Slip
121257.desc: A "Great Fortune" fortune slip written personally by Guuji Yae Miko of the Grand Narukami Shrine.\nIt is said that — or rather, Yae Miko says that — this Fortune Slip has some sort of special power...?

121258.name: Gift Egg Gifted by Capybara King
121258.desc: A shiny gift egg given to you by the Capybara King that feels wet to the touch.\nUse it to try your luck or keep it in your luggage as a souvenir, the choice is yours!

121259.name: Gift Egg Gifted by Cacasha
121259.desc: A shiny gift egg given to you by Cacasha that feels unnaturally smooth.\nUse it to try your luck or keep it in your luggage as a souvenir, the choice is yours!

121260.name: Gift Egg: Blood of This Land
121260.desc: A limited gift egg offered by the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, containing dishes and desserts from all over Natlan.

121261.name: Gift Egg: Let's Shred, Sharky!
121261.desc: A limited gift egg offered by the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, containing dishes and desserts from all over Natlan.

121262.name: Gift Egg: Bow Before Your King!
121262.desc: A limited gift egg offered by the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, containing dishes and desserts from all over Natlan.

121263.name: Gift Egg: Light of the Blazing Sun
121263.desc: A limited gift egg offered by the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, containing dishes and desserts from all over Natlan.

121264.name: Gift Egg: Where the Drinks Keep Flowing
121264.desc: A limited gift egg offered by the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, containing dishes and desserts from all over Natlan.

121265.name: Gift Egg: Fietena
121265.desc: A limited gift egg offered by the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, containing dishes and desserts from all over Natlan.

121266.name: Easybreeze Holiday Resort Invitation
121266.desc: An invitation letter from the Easybreeze Holiday Resort. "Summer" and "Holiday" are words that always seem to be able to light up the night sky in radiant colors.

121267.name: "Sun"
121267.desc: A Tenochtzitoc specialty offering purchased from the Easybreeze Market, bursting with the sweet scent of juicy fruit and fresh flowers.\nIt's said that when you offer it, you should light it in the center...

121268.name: Miniature "Sun"
121268.desc: A smooth-textured souvenir gifted to you for free at the Easybreeze Market.\nSince these candles came from the "sun," perhaps it's fitting to call them miniature "suns."

121269.name: Maite's IOU
121269.desc: An IOU note from Maite.\nAccording to her, this can be redeemed for a free meal at the "Speranza" restaurant in Nasha Town...

121270.name: Teyvat Commemorative Album
121270.desc: #An album filled with memories of people and events that {NICKNAME} has encountered on {M#his}{F#her} travels. On this unending journey forward, too much has happened, and too many faces have come and gone. Like a traveler who sleeps beneath the glittering stars each night, even their beauty may one day fade into numbness. To keep that day from coming, you must record every sight and soul you encounter. This is the wisdom that Paimon shared with you during your journey. It's been so many years, and Paimon has grown too. How heartwarming!

121271.name: Keepsake Photo With Yelan
121271.desc: After efficiently tracking down and completely dismantling the "Mora-laundering" team of the "Dark Financier," you enjoyed a brief vacation in Fontaine with Yelan. To commemorate this mission, you took a snapshot with the Forensic Imaging Device.

121272.name: Training Review (Read)
121272.desc: After completing Skirk's rigorous training, you and she compiled a summary of your experiences, documenting your relentless efforts and her grueling trials. Though the training has ended, revisiting these records can still yield invaluable insights...

121279.name: Krumkake Bolt
121279.desc: A bolt engraved with the Krumkake Craftshop's logo. It may serve some purpose there.

121280.name: Investigative Report: Bakunawa
121280.desc: An investigative report that someone left behind in a hurry.

121281.name: Investigative Report: Mare Jivari
121281.desc: An investigative report that someone left behind in a hurry.

121282.name: Investigative Report: Secret Cave
121282.desc: An investigative report that someone left behind in a hurry.

121283.name: Evermoon Seal
121283.desc: Collect all 3 seals to unlock the treasure vault on Hiisi Island.\n\nYou found this round, marked stone by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to piece together a shadow of the bright moon that once illuminated the world.

121284.name: Evermoon Seal
121284.desc: Collect all 3 seals to unlock the treasure vault on Paha Isle.\n\nYou found this round, marked stone by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to piece together a shadow of the bright moon that once illuminated the world.

121285.name: Evermoon Seal
121285.desc: Collect all 3 seals to unlock the treasure vault on Lempo Isle.\n\nYou found this round, marked stone by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to piece together a shadow of the bright moon that once illuminated the world.

121287.name: Pipilpan Idol Competition Brochure
121287.desc: A brochure filled with dazzling images introducing the format, entry conditions, and judges for the show.

121288.name: Dark Financier's Cipher
121288.desc: A code cipher compiled by Yelan using cracked codes from a criminal organization's encrypted communications. It can be used to turn seemingly random and nonsensical passages into easily understood messages. With this tool in hand, even the secret missives of the "Dark Financier's" underlings should become as clear as day...

121289.name: Invitation to an Auction
121289.desc: A plain-looking envelope, containing an invitation letter for an auction at the Hotel Debord. The most critical showdown in the case of the "Dark Financier" begins with this very event...

121290.name: Easybreeze Holiday Resort Map
121290.desc: A hand-drawn map displaying all of the Easybreeze Holiday Resort's many areas and gently sparking excitement for the fun attractions to come.

121293.name: Picture Gifted by Capybara King
121293.desc: A picture given to you by the Capybara King that appears to capture a certain place in the Easybreeze Holiday Resort. Keep an eye out during your travels.

121294.name: Picture Gifted by Cacasha
121294.desc: A picture given to you by Cacasha that appears to capture a certain place in the Easybreeze Market. Take your companions and have a look!

121295.name: Someone's Tattered Notes (I)
121295.desc: Notes discovered in the remains of Bakunawa.

121296.name: Someone's Tattered Notes (II)
121296.desc: Notes discovered in the remains of Bakunawa.

121297.name: Corroded Tattered Notes (III)
121297.desc: Notes showing signs of corrosion discovered in the remains of Bakunawa.

121298.name: Lavawalker's Resolution
121298.desc: A flower gifted to you by Enjou. Once a delicate bloom, freshly picked — when did it become like this?

121300.name: Investment Coupon
121300.desc: A coupon purchased from Mimisbrunnr Books.\nCan be used to tabulate one's investment returns once a week from Dhabit, the bookstore owner.

121301.name: Easybreeze Badge
121301.desc: An Asha-inspired badge produced by the Easybreeze Holiday Resort to show their appreciation. It can be exchanged for special items at a certain location within the resort.

121302.name: Investment Returns
121302.desc: Returns from one's investment in the portfolio promoted at Mimisbrunnr Books. All investments involve risks, and profit and loss are both common in the industry, but it would seem that generous returns are always an attractive prospect.

121303.name: Sugar Sculpture Box
121303.desc: A box containing delicate sugar sculptures. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

121308.name: Undying One's Mourning Bell
121308.desc: A bronze bell that was carried by a warrior who strode the dark abyss. Its peal can be heard on pitch-black nights.

121309.name: A Horn Unwinded
121309.desc: A horn that was once used to summon those who had sworn oaths. It has long since lost its purpose.

121310.name: Dyed Tassel
121310.desc: An ancient heavy helmet. It is an heirloom that bears the mark of a venerable lineage of northern warriors.

121311.name: Medicine from the Curatorium of Secrets
121311.desc: A special medication for treating "congenital kuuvahki sensitivity." Highly effective but hard to come by, the locals of Nod-Krai often rely on "special channels" — the Curatorium of Secrets — to get their hands on it. The price usually comes with a significant markup...

121312.name: "Wild Hunt" Phenomena Location Map
121312.desc: A map showing the locations of "Wild Hunt" phenomena, investigated and recorded by the Lightkeepers. In theory, this information is for internal use only.

121316.name: Memorata-Cognoscenti's Jest
121316.desc: An artificial flower stained with rust. It is said to be a keepsake from Reed Miller, the founder of the Treasure Hoarders.

121317.name: Inscripta-Cognoscenti's Feather
121317.desc: A feather as dark as night. It is said to be a keepsake from Reed Miller, the founder of the Treasure Hoarders.

121318.name: Devocina-Cognoscenti's Sorrow
121318.desc: A timepiece long since stopped. It is said to be a keepsake from Reed Miller, the founder of the Treasure Hoarders.

121319.name: Weavenexa-Cognoscenti's Intoxication
121319.desc: A goblet lavishly adorned. It is said to be a keepsake from Reed Miller, the founder of the Treasure Hoarders.

121320.name: Stratagema-Cognoscenti's Mask
121320.desc: A cold mask that once concealed a true face. It is said to be a keepsake from Reed Miller, the founder of the Treasure Hoarders. No adornments grace the mask but for the frosty moonlight that dances across its pure silver facade.

121321.name: Special Sugar Sculpture Box
121321.desc: A special box of custom-made sugar sculptures, seemingly crafted with someone in mind. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

121322.name: Special Sugar Sculpture Box
121322.desc: A special box of custom-made sugar sculptures, seemingly crafted with someone in mind. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

121323.name: Special Sugar Sculpture Box
121323.desc: A special box of custom-made sugar sculptures, seemingly crafted with someone in mind. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

121324.name: Special Sugar Sculpture Box
121324.desc: A special box of custom-made sugar sculptures, seemingly crafted with someone in mind. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

121326.name: Spare Bunker Handwheel
121326.desc: A spare handwheel used for maintaining the Doomsday Purification System. It shows no signs of rust, yet for some reason it still carries a faint, lingering scent of iron.
121326.title: Spare Bunker Handwheel

121327.name: Bounty Token: Trickster's Red Satin
121327.desc: A piece of red satin used to cover the eyes. It can be submitted at "The Flagship" as proof of a bounty fulfilled.\n"Some use luxurious fabric to obscure their eyes, while others veil their hearts with words they wish to hear. As they say in Sumeru, 'Everyone has lies they want to believe.'"

121328.name: Bounty Token: Lady's Brooch
121328.desc: A broken gear from the clockwork meka. It can be submitted at "The Flagship" as proof of a bounty fulfilled.\n"'Ah, my good sir, I could never forget the day I first laid eyes on that lady's captivating grace. Since that moment, she has never left my thoughts. She's not one to obey the will of others. If you should meet her, tread carefully — don't be drawn in by her dazzling beauty, like a moth to a flame.'"

121329.name: Bounty Token: Mud-Stained Handguard
121329.desc: A protective guard from an Inazuman blade that has witnessed countless battles. It can be submitted at "The Flagship" as proof of a bounty fulfilled.\n"This fleeting world — a body clad in sorrow. Cherry blossoms fall, untended by tomorrow. Spring departs, never to return."

121330.name: Recorded Intel
121330.desc: A record of intel procured and documented by an agent of the Curatorium of Secrets. The Adventurers' Guild might find this interesting...

121335.name: Data Storage Cassette
121335.desc: A cassette that seems to be used by the Fatui for storing data. Who knows what information this one contains?

121341.name: Conch-Patterned Pages
121341.desc: Densely covered with writing, the meaning of which is difficult to make out.

121344.name: Conch-Patterned Notebook
121344.desc: A handmade notebook, visibly worn from frequent use.

121345.name: Semyon's Notes
121345.desc: Notes written on pages printed with a conch pattern.\nThe notes are Semyon's observations at Maroon Basin, including his observations on Tassel Jellies, and his concerns about their living conditions.

121346.name: Well-Preserved Punched Tape
121346.desc: A punched tape recovered from the crashed collector, recording important experimental data.

121347.name: Airspace Data Collector 2.0
121347.desc: A device developed by Fanngel for the collection of data from high-altitude experiments.\nIts data collection module has been removed, but it can still block damage from lightning strikes. Although it only seems to be effective against the special lightning strikes in Nod-Krai...

121357.name: Toolkit
121357.desc: A bulging toolkit accidentally taken from the girl while trying to hide in that container. It's unclear what tools are inside.\nMaybe you should figure out a way to return it to her...

121358.name: Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau Floor Plan

121359.name: Spare Part
121359.desc: A spare part that looks like a clockwork key. Seems like it can be used to awaken Colonel Iron Whale.

121360.name: Lever
121360.desc: A lever for operating a lift. For reasons unknown, it was stolen by a Weasel Thief.

121361.name: Photo with Colonel Iron Whale
121361.desc: A photo pieced back together from recovered fragments.\nScrawled messily on the back are the words: "I'm a bad kid, but thank you. This time, it's not a lie."

121362.name: Special Sugar Sculpture Box
121362.desc: A special box of custom-made sugar sculptures, seemingly crafted with someone in mind. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

121363.name: Old Portable Bearing
121363.desc: An item that can be traded with the Hollowhands.\nAccording to Sisko, once you've collected enough Old Portable Bearings, you can trade them with The Hollowhands for a variety of valuable goods, including Vaino's targets.

121364.name: Stellafruit
121364.desc: A strange, star-shaped fruit that can often be found among the Rippleweeds beside Blue Amber Lake. It seems to contain a mysterious power...

121365.name: Training Ground Target
121365.desc: A target from Vaino's training ground. It always seems to get lost for some reason.

121366.name: Auni's Notes
121366.desc: Notes written on pages printed with a conch pattern.\nIt seems that this story, set in Moleyvalley and starring Sniffer Moles, was written by Auni. Elements of the story are claimed to be true, but which would they be...

121367.name: Collated Intel
121367.desc: A booklet comprising all the intelligence that has been obtained so far. The information within may come in handy in the future...

121368.name: Backup Program Module
121368.desc: A backup module left by Drzislav for Bobik's operating system.\nIt can restore Bobik's underlying systems quickly and allow the user to manually add or modify system commands.

121369.name: Damaged Photo
121369.desc: Despite some damage, you can still just about make out both the people and the background in this image.

121370.name: Damaged Photo
121370.desc: Despite some damage, you can still just about make out both the people and the background in this image.

121371.name: Damaged Photo
121371.desc: Despite some damage, you can still just about make out both the people and the background in this image.

121372.name: Damaged Photo
121372.desc: Despite some damage, you can still just about make out both the people and the background in this image.

121374.name: Apple Cider
121374.desc: Escorted all the way from Mondstadt by Mika, this Apple Cider is said to be a present prompted by a certain Cavalry Captain's proposal...
121374.effect: Restores 26% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 570 HP every 5s for 30s.

121375.name: Way-Opening Key
121375.desc: A key discovered with Mehrak's help. It's nice having a quiet yet considerate assistant by your side.

121376.name: Ragged Notes
121376.desc: Notes salvaged from all over the ruins. Based on the state of the fragile, yellowed paper, they appear to have endured the passage of many, many years.

121377.name: Ordered Notes
121377.desc: Notes with matching handwriting that have been painstakingly arranged in chronological order. These appear to chronicle a certain person's "adventures" in this place.

121378.name: Golden Key
121378.desc: A gleaming golden key. The key itself is worth a fortune.

121379.name: Silver Key
121379.desc: A shining silver key. Not as valuable as the golden one, but it is also far from ordinary.

121380.name: Iron Key
121380.desc: A plain iron key, one of the most ordinary and easy-to-find keys around.

121381.name: Iron Key
121381.desc: A plain iron key, one of the most ordinary and easy-to-find keys around.

121382.name: Strange Iron Coin
121382.desc: A coin that resembles a common iron coin, though it may be a different variant.

121383.name: Conch Notebook
121383.desc: A notebook compiled by Paimon containing a collection of notes obtained from the Conch Gang kids.

121384.name: Conch Notebook
121384.desc: A notebook compiled by Paimon containing a collection of notes obtained from the Conch Gang kids.

121388.name: The Legends of Reed Miller, Thief Extraordinaire (I)
121388.desc: An anthology of pulp fiction stories based on the exploits of Reed Miller that is wildly popular throughout Nod-Krai. Collated from various works and authors, the veracity of the stories within is as dubious as the quality of the paper they are printed on.

121389.name: The Legends of Reed Miller, Thief Extraordinaire (II)
121389.desc: An anthology of pulp fiction stories based on the exploits of Reed Miller that is wildly popular throughout Nod-Krai. Collated from various works and authors, the veracity of the stories within is as dubious as the quality of the paper they are printed on.

121390.name: The Legends of Reed Miller, Thief Extraordinaire (III)
121390.desc: An anthology of pulp fiction stories based on the exploits of Reed Miller that is wildly popular throughout Nod-Krai. Collated from various works and authors, the veracity of the stories within is as dubious as the quality of the paper they are printed on.

121391.name: Hymns of the Far North (I)
121391.desc: A book of hymns passed down for generations among the Frostmoon Scions, compiled by the priestess Ehrnrooth. Most of its contents, and the rites they serve, have long since fallen into disuse.

121392.name: Hymns of the Far North (II)
121392.desc: A book of hymns passed down for generations among the Frostmoon Scions, compiled by the priestess Ehrnrooth. Most of its contents, and the rites they serve, have long since fallen into disuse.

121393.name: Hymns of the Far North (III)
121393.desc: A book of hymns passed down for generations among the Frostmoon Scions, compiled by the priestess Ehrnrooth. Most of its contents, and the rites they serve, have long since fallen into disuse.

121394.name: Conch Echoes (I)
121394.desc: A tale passed down in this land since the earliest times, telling of children who spoke bearing conch shells in the empty frontier wastelands. The original author has long since been forgotten...

121395.name: Conch Echoes (II)
121395.desc: A tale passed down in this land since the earliest times, telling of children who spoke bearing conch shells in the empty frontier wastelands. The original author has long since been forgotten...

121396.name: Maite's Notes
121396.desc: Notes written on pages printed with a conch pattern.\nThese are observation notes written by Maite about the Crab Tsar before it became influenced by kuuvahki. They contain a great deal of unverified speculation about brachyuran society.

121401.name: The Man Who Became a Mule
121401.desc: A storybook gathered by the Adventurers' Guild. It tells a fairy tale that originated in the desert.

121403.name: Aged Pinecone
121403.desc: An old seed that's long past fresh. Even in desperate times, it's probably not a good idea to eat it.

121404.name: Aged Rye
121404.desc: Gray-brown grain, carrying a subtle whiff of mold...

121405.name: Mysterious Meat
121405.desc: A fresh chunk of meat that seems to be radiating an enigmatic aura. Wonder what it'll taste like?

121406.name: Curatorium Funds
121406.desc: A sum of money taken from the chest containing the Curatorium of Secrets's funds. Money doesn't grow on trees, so spend it wisely.

121407.name: Curatorium Funds
121407.desc: A sum of money taken from the chest containing the Curatorium of Secrets's funds. Money doesn't grow on trees, so spend it wisely.

121408.name: Curatorium Funds
121408.desc: A sum of money taken from the chest containing the Curatorium of Secrets's funds. Money doesn't grow on trees, so spend it wisely.

121409.name: "Shutterflash" Kamera
121409.desc: A custom-built Kamera equipped with Lepine-Pauline's latest "Shutterflash" lens.\nIts intricate inner workings can freeze the flutter of a bird's wings or the flash of a swordsman's strike in an instant. It captures the swiftest motion and preserves the most precious scenes, including every shining moment worth remembering when you reunite with friends.

121410.name: The Shiniest and Brightest Beryl Conch
121410.desc: You promised Puca that you would carefully select and gather the shiniest and brightest Beryl Conches for her.

121411.name: Pebble of Crystalline Essence
121411.desc: An egg-shaped stone infused with the power required for the Eye of Graeae to reclaim his physical form.\nOnce divided and seized by the Domovoy lord Alvis, its power was acquired by Aksinya through unknown means and placed within the hollow remains of the Alypium. Hidden within it may lie the secret of how, through rebirth, a mere mortal might transcend into a more perfect being.

121412.name: Snegovik Laboratory Key
121412.desc: A needle-like key.\nIt unlocks the laboratory doors of the Grand Duchess of the Snegurochka within the Alypium.

121413.name: Cat Food
121413.desc: It appears to be food prepared by Pavlina, the Grand Duchess of the Snegurochka, for a cat named Lala who was kept within the Alypium... It smells rather tempting — but at the end of the day, it's just cat food, so it probably tastes like cardboard.

121414.name: Rhinedottir's "Gift"
121414.desc: A gift from "Gold" Rhinedottir to Albedo.\nA new gift, a new quest.

121415.name: Ragged Doll
121415.desc: A doll crafted by Ihanti, bearing a certain resemblance to some dolls previously made by Jahoda.

121416.name: Access Insignia
121416.desc: One of a set of important insignia kept in separation by members of the Fatui. Only by gathering all three can the device leading to the inner chamber be activated. As for why there must be three, the mage merely explained that it was to create a "sense of participation."

121417.name: Severely Contaminated Teardrop Crystal
121417.desc: From a Dvalin completely consumed by the Abyss. The state of this tear reveals that the Dvalin in the story is beyond hope of healing.

121419.name: Special Sugar Sculpture Box
121419.desc: A special box of custom-made sugar sculptures, seemingly crafted with someone in mind. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

121420.name: Curatorium Funds
121420.desc: A sum of money taken from the chest containing the Curatorium of Secrets's funds. Money doesn't grow on trees, so spend it wisely.

121421.name: Moon-Prayer Night Pamphlet
121421.desc: A pamphlet handed out at Nasha Town's Moon-Prayer Night. It highlights a variety of fun booths and activities. With it in hand, guests are sure to enjoy an evening they won't soon forget.

121422.name: Greeting Card for Columbina
121422.desc: A greeting card prepared by Columbina's companions for Moon-Prayer Night. It carries their heartfelt wishes, hoping that wherever she is, she will remember the smiles they shared tonight.

121423.name: Moon-Prayer Candy From Columbina
121423.desc: A Moon-Prayer Candy made by Columbina for everyone to enjoy. Inspired by her boundless imagination, this candy holds a wide variety of surprising flavors, perhaps drawn from the tastes she remembers most fondly.

121424.name: Moon-Prayer Candy From Columbina
121424.desc: A Moon-Prayer Candy made by Columbina for everyone to enjoy. Inspired by her boundless imagination, this candy holds a wide variety of surprising flavors, perhaps drawn from the tastes she remembers most fondly.

121425.name: The Soulblazer Saga: Volume 2
121425.desc: The Soulblazer Saga, a historical fantasy comic series based on Natlan's local legends, is now available in a collector's edition!\nHeroes assemble, their brilliance shining brightest when destinies collide, forging a path for future generations with their lives through the crucible of fierce battles.

121426.name: Tale of "Durin"
121426.desc: The magic book left by "M" must ultimately be handed over to Durin, allowing him to continue writing the story. Alice created a replica of it and gifted it to you. After all, as a witness to this tale, you deserve a keepsake. Of course, this replica lacks any magical properties, but it for sure preserves all the twists and turns.

121427.name: Lantern Rite Gift: Gift of Radiant Night
121427.desc: A precious Lantern Rite gift prepared by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. It can be redeemed with Fortune Coins.

121428.name: Lantern Rite Gift: Gift of Seeking Light
121428.desc: A Lantern Rite gift prepared by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. It can be redeemed with Fortune Coins.

121429.name: Lantern Rite Gift: Gift of Distant Longing
121429.desc: A Lantern Rite gift prepared by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. It can be redeemed with Fortune Coins.

121430.name: Lantern Rite Gift: Gift of Joyous Wishes
121430.desc: A Lantern Rite gift prepared by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. It can be redeemed with Fortune Coins.

121431.name: Lantern Rite Gift: Gift of Venerable Virtue
121431.desc: A Lantern Rite gift prepared by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. It can be redeemed with Fortune Coins.

121432.name: Lantern Rite Gift: Gift of Guiding Moonlight
121432.desc: A Lantern Rite gift prepared by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. It can be redeemed with Fortune Coins.

121439.name: Wish
121439.desc: In the storytellers' tales, people entrusted their wishes to the Xiao Lanterns before releasing them into the sky. Yet there was a time when fiends sought to devour those wishes. Thanks to the intervention of an adeptus, their ascent was safeguarded...
source_list: Obtained by relighting Xiao Lanterns or by defeating certain enemies.

121440.name: Moonlight
121440.desc: In the storytellers' tales, there were once powerful demons that could devour the moonlight. To reclaim the radiance they had consumed, that adeptus stepped forward time and time again...

121441.name: Special Sugar Sculpture Box
121441.desc: A special box of custom-made sugar sculptures, seemingly crafted with someone in mind. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

121442.name: Red Key Card
121442.desc: One of three key cards required to open the sewer control room door. This one is red.

121443.name: White Key Card
121443.desc: One of three key cards required to open the sewer control room door. This one is white.

121444.name: Blue Key Card
121444.desc: One of three key cards required to open the sewer control room door. This one is blue.

121445.name: Invitation to the "Ritual"
121445.desc: A wondrous invitation that always seems to find its way into the hands of its rightful recipient.\nWith this invitation, one may journey to the House of Hesperides atop the icy peaks of Snezhnaya, to attend the wedding of Pavlina, the princess of the Snegurochka.

121446.name: Severed Fragment of Ikor
121446.desc: A fragment of Ikor's power, split off by Aksinya when the "ritual" was interrupted.\nFor some reason, it has taken the form of a glowing doll. Perhaps the desire to "fulfill the wishes of others" became the strings that controlled him long ago, and now he is nothing more than a puppet carrying a form of transcendent power.

121450.name: Irismoon Seal
121450.desc: Collect all 3 seals to unlock the treasure vault on Voidsea Outlook.\n\nYou found this round, marked stone by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to piece together a shadow of the bright moon that once illuminated the world.

121451.name: Irismoon Seal
121451.desc: Collect all 3 seals to unlock the treasure vault on Wavechaser Plain.\n\nYou found this round, marked stone by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to piece together a shadow of the bright moon that once illuminated the world.

121452.name: Irismoon Seal
121452.desc: Collect all 3 seals to unlock the treasure vault on Ashveil Peak.\n\nYou found this round, marked stone by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to piece together a shadow of the bright moon that once illuminated the world.

121453.name: Multi-Purpose Negotiation Tool
121453.desc: A heavy pouch filled with tokens capable of swaying those who "value wealth above all else." To some, this appears to be what passes for "sincerity"...

121454.name: The White Horse Adeptus Meets the White Horse Adeptus in Liyue Harbor
121454.desc: A photo titled by Paimon, capturing a moment of shared laughter among three friends.

121456.name: Marionette's Notebook
121456.desc: A relic from Sandrone, passed to you by The Knave. Its pages record many matters related to Sandrone.\nAlthough its cover and pages are worn with age, it is easy to see how much its owner once treasured it.

121458.name: Special Sugar Sculpture Box
121458.desc: A special box of custom-made sugar sculptures, seemingly crafted with someone in mind. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

121459.name: Special Sugar Sculpture Box
121459.desc: A special box of custom-made sugar sculptures, seemingly crafted with someone in mind. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

121462.name: That Which Has Lost Its Power
121462.desc: A curio whose power has faded away. Crafted from fine jade and bronze, it now waits quietly for the moment it might shine once more.

121463.name: Fresh Rye
121463.desc: The freshly harvested rye that carries a warm, comforting scent. Only after grinding and baking does it transform into a rich, full-bodied flavor.

121465.name: "The First Iron Coin"
121465.desc:
An aged iron coin engraved with a stylized raven sigil. Legend says it was forged by Reed Miller, founder of the Treasure Hoarders, and was the very first true "Iron Coin."
In a world without borders, in a paradise where no one suffers from hunger or cold, the gold bestowed and governed by the Deus Auri was never meant to serve as the foundation of human cooperation.
Humans should be masters of money, not its servants. Even if one cannot claim the heart of gold for themselves, all should be able to wield the wealth that inherently belongs to everyone.

But that is a story of a much later time. Whether it was the first iron coin or the ideals sung, interpreted, and twisted over the following centuries,
it all began on a winter night beyond the reach of lamplight, when two children slipped out of the academy, hiding from the adults' eyes, and carved a token for playing the Thief Extraordinaire.

121466.name: The White Horse Adeptus Meets the White Horse Adeptus in Liyue Harbor
121466.desc: A photo titled by Paimon, capturing a moment of shared laughter among three friends.

121467.name: Silver Lampwick
121467.desc: A sacred lamp capable of forming a protective barrier, now dimmed after its energy is depleted.\nOnce a ritual vessel of the Frostmoon Scions, it brought dreams and song to the lost people wandering the desolate lands. It has survived to this day only because it was left behind in the time-stilled tower.

121468.name: Silver Lampwick
121468.desc: A sacred lamp capable of forming a protective barrier, its faint light barely piercing the darkness.\nOnce a ritual vessel of the Frostmoon Scions, it brought dreams and song to the lost people wandering the desolate lands. It has survived to this day only because it was left behind in the time-stilled tower.

121469.name: Silver Lampwick
121469.desc: A sacred lamp capable of forming a protective barrier, its faint light shimmering quietly.\nOnce a ritual vessel of the Frostmoon Scions, it brought dreams and song to the lost people wandering the desolate lands. It has survived to this day only because it was left behind in the time-stilled tower.

121470.name: Silver Lampwick
121470.desc: A sacred lamp capable of forming a protective barrier, brimming with energy and shining brilliantly.\nOnce a ritual vessel of the Frostmoon Scions, it brought dreams and song to the lost people wandering the desolate lands. It has survived to this day only because it was left behind in the time-stilled tower.

121475.name: Forgotten Key
121475.desc: This might open a door somewhere.

121476.name: Tier I Bunker Access Card
121476.desc: A key card obtained from a peculiar terminal on the west side of Piramida. Its appearance is utterly unremarkable.\nFrom what you've been told, it should grant access to the bunker beneath the terminal.

121477.name: Tier II Bunker Access Card
121477.desc: A key card obtained from an experiment site. Its appearance is utterly unremarkable.\nNeat Snezhnayan text has been printed onto its surface: "Senior Maintenance Technician Aleksey Zakharevich Kotelnikov."

121478.name: Tier III Bunker Access Card
121478.desc: A key card obtained from an experiment site. Its appearance is utterly unremarkable.\nNeat Snezhnayan text has been printed onto its surface: "Chief Researcher Grazina Myklukho."

121485.name: The Research Notes of Master Ruggiero

121487.name: The History of the Decline and Fall of Remuria

121489.name: Automnequi Sermon Dictation: Concerning the Apocalypse

121490.name: Automnequi Sermon Dictation: Explications on the Chymical Marriage

121491.name: Great Detective Hurlock: The Alchemist and the Clockwork Saint

121493.name: Event Invitation
121493.desc: An invitation sent by Jean, Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. The message is brief and makes no mention of the event's details.

121494.name: Featherlight Mora
121494.desc: Mora found at Starfell Lake. Though it looks identical to ordinary Mora, it weighs only one-tenth as much, making the joy of acquiring wealth feel only one-tenth as great.

121495.name: Highly Elastic Fish Meat
121495.desc: Fish meat found at Starfell Lake. Though it looks like ordinary fish, it is exceptionally elastic — no matter how hard you press it, it quickly returns to its original shape. Rather than a cooking ingredient, it seems more like a method of stress-relief... best not to try eating it.

121505.name: Dodoco's Enchanted Candy
121505.desc:
A souvenir from Klee during your time helping run the Knights' drinks stand.
"Put everything together on the alchemy table, wish for the shape you want, say Mom's magic words, and... poof! Dodoco-shaped candy!"
As expected of a creation by Ms. Alice. Even using ingredients common across Teyvat, it holds a wonderfully complex sweetness. Take a small bite, and you can almost hear the echo of a sweet magic incantation in your mind...
Unfortunately, the supply is limited. Better keep one as a souvenir!

121506.name: A Message From the Legendary Thief Reed Miller

121511.name: Letter Buried in the Time Capsule

121512.name: A Brief History of the Pale Starborn
121512.desc: A book on fae history. Based on certain details within, it's believed to have been written by fae elders.

121513.name: Night Murmurs From the Far Border: Varcolac
121513.desc: A collection of folktales circulated in Snezhnaya, said to record all kinds of lesser-known fae tales. This volume tells the story of a dangerous fae known as the "Varcolac."

121514.name: Tales Carried by the Northwind
121514.desc: A poetry collection chronicling the deeds of successive Starshynas. Most of its contents were lost in past calamities. Only a small fraction of the original fragments have been recovered.

121518.name: Secret Source: Ancient Moon's Fount
121518.desc: An artificial core that uses Secret Source techniques to encapsulate highly concentrated Archaeolune Energy.

121519.name: A Letter Carried by the Wind
121519.desc: A letter that found its way into your bag at some point. Perhaps it was carried here by the wind.

121520.name: Varka's Invitation Ticket
121520.desc: A hand-drawn invitation ticket from Varka. Can be redeemed at the Good Hunter for a hearty, meat-filled feast.

121521.name: Varka's Invitation Ticket
121521.desc: A hand-drawn invitation ticket from Varka. Can be redeemed at the Good Hunter for a hearty, meat-filled feast. A small stamp reading "Used" is marked in the corner on the back.

121522.name: Varka's Secret Stash of Cash
121522.desc: Money Varka has set aside for drinks, brazenly tucked away in a desk drawer.\n"The most dangerous spot is actually the safest spot!" He might claim that, but the truth is he probably keeps the money here because he believes the acting Grand Master will neither spend it nor reveal its hiding place.\nAlthough this money was originally set aside to buy the Dandelion Wine as an offering to the Archon, now that plans have changed, maybe it can be used to reward the Honorary Knight who saved Varka — or given to the knight to reward each friend who helped rescue Varka instead.

121523.name: Varka's Secret Stash of Cash
121523.desc: Money Varka has set aside for drinks, brazenly tucked away in a desk drawer.\n"The most dangerous spot is actually the safest spot!" He might claim that, but the truth is he probably keeps the money here because he believes the acting Grand Master will neither spend it nor reveal its hiding place.\nThis money was originally set aside to buy the Dandelion Wine as an offering to the Archon, and has now been used to reward the Honorary Knight who saved Varka — or perhaps that knight might use it to treat every friend who helped save Varka.

121524.name: Paimon's Notes
121524.desc: Jot down anything Paimon doesn't understand. Who knows? It might come in handy someday! That's a top adventure tip from the clever Paimon!

121528.name: Unadorned
121528.desc: Without any extra ornaments, the backpack is beautiful yet practical in its original form.

121529.name: Badge: Nocturnal Blossom
121529.desc: This Nocturnal Blossom badge is a gift from the Conch Gang.

121530.name: Badge: Rainbowdrop Crystal
121530.desc: This Rainbowdrop Crystal badge is a gift from the Conch Gang.

121531.name: Badge: Capybara
121531.desc: This silver Capybara badge is a gift from the Conch Gang.

121532.name: Companion: Exclusive
121532.desc: A spacious and comfortable backpack reserved for your exclusive use.

121533.name: Companion: Shared
121533.desc: A shared backpack. It's not that spacious... but there's never a dull moment inside!

121535.name: Spirit Envoy Championship Champion Medal
121535.desc: A champion medal earned alongside Aguara in the "Spirit Envoy Championship." Looking upon it, one can almost see Aguara's heroic figure dominating the arena once more. Of course, this victory in the finals would never have been possible without the help of Linnea and Lumi...

121536.name: Special Perfume: Wind's Breath
121536.desc: A special fragrance crafted by Scents and Senses, a perfume shop in Mondstadt.\nThis understated and delicate fragrance, with a sillage that lingers long and fresh in the air, evokes the sweeping flower fields beneath Windrest Peak.

121537.name: Reassembled Note
121537.desc: A note written in a scrawling hand, its muddled words looking like the work of a drunkard...

121538.name: Cargo Crate Filled with Heavy Parts
121538.desc: A crate reclaimed from monsters. It appears to contain metal goods of considerable weight, though its owner remains a mystery...\nPerhaps inquiring with the knights in Dornman Port might point you toward a lead...

121539.name: Lost Balloon
121539.desc: A plain, unremarkable balloon. Like the wind within it, it always longs to drift far, far away...

121541.name: Pebble of Freezing Heart
121541.desc: An egg-shaped stone infused with the power required for the Eye of Graeae to reclaim his physical form.\nOnce used by the fae lord Pavlina to remedy the inherent flaws of the fae.\nHidden within it may lie the aspiration of how a mere mortal might ascend to a higher status through rebirth.

121542.name: Pebble of Serpentine Algae
121542.desc: An egg-shaped stone infused with the power required for the Eye of Graeae to reclaim his physical form.\nOnce used by the alchemist named Koshchei to create life in pursuit of eternity.\nHidden within it may lie the revelation of how a mere mortal might forge immortality through rebirth.

121543.name: Selected Moonfall Silver
121543.desc: Moonfall Silver selected by Dorota for exhibition. A closer look reveals a subtle distinction from common samples... Surely that isn't mere imagination.

121544.name: Icy Pebble
121544.desc: A pebble commonly found on Nod-Krai's coasts, characterized by a naturally occurring hollow. Touching it sends a faint chill through your finger.\nAccording to ancient legends, the hollows in these pebbles were once shelters revealed to the fae by the Frost Moon — gateways to the ethereal. In another story popular in Nasha Town, the legendary thief, Reed Miller, was surrounded when a runestone given to him by a holy lady of the Frost Moon as a token of her love allowed him to conceal himself and escape his pursuers. Naturally, the Frostmoon Scions vehemently reject this claim, as these pebbles do not display any such magical properties.

121545.name: Pine Amber
121545.desc: A gem formed from the resin of the towering ancient trees that once blanketed Nod-Krai. Over ages, the resin hardened into crystalline amber, now shining with vivid, radiant hues.

121546.name: Nocturnal Blossom
121546.desc: A flower in two entwined colors with a strong affinity for kuuvahki. Its light fragrance and conspicuous color have made it an excellent natural dye.\nIts contrasting colors are thought to symbolize the two different types of kuuvahki, so the followers of the Frostmoon Scions sometimes regard it as the Moon Maiden's blessing.\nIt is said that this strangely shaped flower first appeared decades after the dark calamity ended five hundred years ago, a claim widely reflected in the verses of the Frostmoon Scions, though it has never been rigorously verified.

121547.name: Frostlamp Flower
121547.desc: A flower that resembles a candle lamp, commonly found near water. It emits a cold, simple aroma that has a calming effect.\nThe contrasting colors of its stamen and stem are thought to symbolize the two different types of kuuvahki, yet despite this symbolism, it is one of the few rare plants that are immune to kuuvahki's influence. As a result, the Frostmoon Scions sometimes regard it as a symbol of faithlessness and apostasy.\nIt is said that this strangely shaped flower first appeared at the end of the dark calamity five hundred years ago, but this claim has never been rigorously verified.

121548.name: Winter Icelea
121548.desc: A hardy plant known for withstanding relentless wind and frost, it survives even in the coldest depths of winter.

121549.name: Special Sugar Sculpture Box
121549.desc: A special box of custom-made sugar sculptures, seemingly crafted with someone in mind. Best enjoyed quickly before they have a chance to melt.

121551.name: "Legendary Thief's Treasure" Location
121551.desc: A lead seemingly acquired by a gang member known as "The Butcher" while scraping together funds... Perhaps a massive haul lies waiting to be found.

121552.name: Lohen's Work Report
121552.desc: A comprehensive work report prepared by Lohen for Cardinal Seamus at the Favonius Cathedral. The report is so thorough... It's almost enough to make one doubt if Lohen was the one behind the pen.

121555.name: Lohen's "Friendship Fee"
121555.desc: A heavy Mora pouch, its opening shimmering with the golden glow of "friendship."

121556.name: Lohen's "Friendship Fee"
121556.desc: A now-empty Mora pouch, its opening once shimmered with the golden glow of "friendship."

121559.name: Vera's Melancholy: Final Volume (Version II)
121559.desc: The manuscript for the final volume of the "Vera's Melancholy" series. It was never published, however, because the author's portrayal of a certain princess from a galactic empire incurred enormous resentment from the princess who inspired the character. But somehow, the manuscript has found its way here.\nYu Huangyi cannot tell which volume was a piece of space debris salvaged by the mistress's sisters, and which was written by Hilda out of outrage at the original ending. After all, both are handwritten manuscripts...

121560.name: Vera's Melancholy: Final Volume (Version I)
121560.desc: It is said that the author of this work has rather questionable professional ethics — allegedly, the same story has been pitched to publishers as a "new work" again and again on various planets. This is perhaps the reason a kill order has been placed on the writer by a certain galactic empire.\nYu Huangyi cannot tell which volume was a piece of space debris salvaged by the mistress's sisters, and which was written by Hilda out of outrage at the original ending. After all, both are handwritten manuscripts...

121561.name: The Dream of Rhonabouillet
121561.desc: A book of poetry from Lenormand Publishing. It tells the story of a protagonist who travels back in time and falls in love with a maid at the court of the Lochknight.

121562.name: The Song of Ay-Khanoum
121562.desc: A lavish book of poetry with gilded pages, said to have been composed by a Jinn favored by the Goddess of Flowers in the days before the fall of the City of the Moon Maiden.\nSince according to the Vahumana the book had already been lost before the destruction of Tulaytullah, its contents are believed to be a later forgery.

121563.name: Revelations of Divine Love
121563.desc: A book of poetry said to have been composed by a priest of the ancient Church of Favonius under the guidance of the Anemo Archon. The work reflects on the distinction between the love of the gods and human love, and ultimately concludes that human compassion, friendship, and romantic affection are all inherently imbued with the sacred, for they all arise from the same longing for freedom.

121565.name: Photo With the Little Witches and Their Imaginary Friends
121565.desc: "This is a gift for the Little Hexenzirkel," Alice said.\nAs long as you still leave some room for beautiful fantasies, your innocence will never fade. For children, it nourishes carefree childhood days, and for grown-ups, a gentle refuge against the passage of time.

121566.name: Photo With the Little Witches and Their Imaginary Friends
121566.desc: "This is a gift for the Little Hexenzirkel," Alice said.\nAs long as you still leave some room for beautiful fantasies, your innocence will never fade. For children, it nourishes carefree childhood days, and for grown-ups, a gentle refuge against the passage of time.

121568.name: Notes by a Certain Noble Individual (I)
121568.desc: Notes by a Certain Noble Individual (I)

121569.name: Notes by a Certain Noble Individual (II)
121569.desc: Notes by a Certain Noble Individual (II)

121570.name: Notes by a Certain Noble Individual (III)
121570.desc: Notes by a Certain Noble Individual (III)

121571.name: Notes by a Certain Noble Individual (IV)
121571.desc: Notes by a Certain Noble Individual (IV)

121572.name: Notes by a Certain Noble Individual (V)
121572.desc: Notes by a Certain Noble Individual (V)

121573.name: Notes by a Certain Noble Individual (VI)
121573.desc: Notes by a Certain Noble Individual (VI)

121574.name: Anomalous Tree Marrow I
121574.desc: Suspected to be a resinous concretion exuded from Irminsul's incinerated trunk. Its form is peculiar, and where it remains exposed, a baleful light emanates from within.

121575.name: Anomalous Tree Marrow II
121575.desc: Suspected to be a resinous concretion exuded from Irminsul's incinerated trunk. Its form is peculiar, and where it remains exposed, a baleful light emanates from within.

121576.name: Anomalous Tree Marrow III
121576.desc: Suspected to be a resinous concretion exuded from Irminsul's incinerated trunk. Its form is peculiar, and where it remains exposed, a baleful light emanates from within.

121580.name: Anomalous Tree Marrow
121580.desc: Suspected to be a resinous concretion exuded from Irminsul's incinerated trunk. Its form is peculiar, and where it remains exposed, a baleful light emanates from within.

121581.name: Dango Milk "Infused With Magic"
121581.desc: A bottle of dango milk that looks ordinary and, in fact, is ordinary. According to Prune, however, she won it from a witch, so she believes it's anything but your average dango milk!

121582.name: Primal Construct Component
121582.desc: Commissioned by Nahida and Grand Sage Naphis, Alhaitham and Kaveh are undertaking an urgent project. As the next phase requires a vast supply of materials, they have turned to the Primal Constructs within The Mausoleum of King Deshret as the ideal source. Their ancient technology and high-grade components will be dismantled into microscopic parts, then reconfigured for a new environment.

121583.name: Witness of the Moon
121583.desc: The Moon Goddess once used her power to bear witness to the journey of the Moongazers. Now, it has become a witness to your journey as well.

121588.name: Lost Flower of Ancient Times
121588.desc: A preserved flower from a long-lost era, bearing a striking resemblance to a certain plant found in Teyvat. There may be a distant and ambiguous connection between the two.

121596.name: Sandrone's Tea Party Invitation Letter
121596.desc: A tea party invitation letter sent by Sandrone. The invitation is delicately patterned with exquisite handwriting. Is this what one calls a lady's elegance?

121597.name: Metal Control Wheel
121597.desc: A metal control wheel used to open a certain gate in the sewers.

121598.name: Sewer Lift Control Wheel
121598.desc: A control wheel used to operate the sewer lift.

121599.name: Lift Control Wheel
121599.desc: A control wheel used to operate the lift leading to the assembly hall.

121601.name: Ancient Mondstadt Royal Seal
121601.desc: Collect 2 Royal Seals to unlock the Noblesse Secret Treasury.\n\nYou found this ancient seal by chance while exploring. If you collect two with the same markings, you may be able to lock the vault left behind by the old aristocracies of Mondstadt.

121602.name: Segment-Domain Control Module: Zero Particle
121602.desc: Collect all 3 Domain Control Modules to unlock the Secret Hall of the Realms.\n\nYou found this strange module by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to open the secret hall within the Temple of Space.

121603.name: Frost Moon Seal
121603.desc: Collect all 3 seals to unlock the treasure vault in Ungien's Circle.\n\nYou found this round, marked stone by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to piece together a shadow of the bright moon that once illuminated the world.

121604.name: Frost Moon Seal
121604.desc: Collect all 3 seals to unlock the treasure vault in Moontide Sea.\n\nYou found this round, marked stone by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to piece together a shadow of the bright moon that once illuminated the world.
source_list: Moontide Sea, Dunanna Pit, Dark Side of the Moon Exploration Reward

121606.name: "Family Portrait" by Mamere
121606.desc: A family portrait that Mamere painted for her "family members" at a tea party hosted by Sandrone. Its warm and distinctive brushwork differs somewhat from her previous paintings, suggesting that, as she said, she has been trying her hand at all sorts of different styles during her travels.

121610.name: Oddly-Shaped Emblem
121610.desc: An emblem of peculiar design found by Nastya in a strange room. It seems capable of disabling traps...

121611.name: VIP Pass

121631.name: Champion's Trophy of the First Adventurers' Tournament
121631.desc:
A trophy awarded by the headquarters of the Adventurers' Guild in Snezhnaya. It stands as proof of the outstanding feats you and Paimon have achieved in the field of adventure.
As discussions at the Adventurers' Guild Development Conference failed to progress smoothly, the First Adventurers' Tournament, originally meant to promote friendly exchange between adventurers of different nations, became an arena for deciding who would have the final say...
As key figures in breaking the deadlock, you and Paimon joined the competition midway. Swiftly climbing the ranks, you claimed the championship, steered the conference's direction, and finalized several key resolutions...
Though these resolutions may not have an immediate impact, they are sure to help the Guild keep pace with the times and bring greater benefits to more adventurers...

121632.name: Rumbletwig

In such cases, they would leave a specific "scent trail" behind. Only by piecing together the incense trail can one track down the locations of these long-lost relics.

129001.name: Tears Among the Stars
129001.desc:
A drop of water obtained from within the colossal beast who coveted the primordial sea of life.

A philosopher in the faraway ancient world once posited that where there is life, there is death; naturally where there is death, there is life.
If not, then the fleeting light cannot resist the eternal darkness, and all withers into nothingness at the end of time.
The rules among the stars dictate that nature must be conserved, but the laws of the universe have never been conserved.
In a sealed box, destruction always overpowers new life. Millennia upon millennia of prosperity are but an instant in a span of billions of years. The greatest of achievements, the proudest accomplishments, in time all will tarnish, decay, dissipate, and ultimately fade into oblivion.
Thus there are things floating in among the stars, once adorned with countless prestigious titles from innumerable civilizations, shedding tears for their ordained demise.
Their tears stream down, out of desperation, out of hope, because all desperation and hope alike will be utterly extinguished along with the innumerable stars.
Their tears stream down out of sorrow, out of joy, because both will eventually scatter into the cold, dark endless void.
Every tiny yet beautiful silhouette and every moment worth remembering will fade with time, even stars.
And then there are these so-called "gods" that are determined to save everything worth saving, and devour everything that should be devoured.
Until the end of time, until the sea of stars recess into nothing but dying embers, until a newborn "world" moves for the first time in the stomach of the whale.
"There will be no more sins, no more sadness, and no more tears, because everything died with the ancient stars."

129002.name: Obsidian Ancient Name
129002.desc:
An Ancient Name, Tumaini, forged after many twists and turns, whose meaning is "hope."
You are its first bearer, and it shall record all your deeds and adventures in Natlan, to be passed down forevermore.
"Wisdom" is not the sole domain of living things, nor are all memories or emotions a "blessing." It is a nameless, shapeless existence, nor can common sense comprehend it. Just as we know naught about places that no light may touch, we cannot be sure that there are not countless pairs of eyes watching us from the deepest reaches of the dark. It is a condescending thing that lusts after the knowledge and information stored in the land. Even the horror and despair, which humans can never transcend, are mere emotions "simulated" for your benefit once it has understood all that Natlan is.
Lend your ear to Xumucul's roar. Hear the hatred that festered in the heart of the unrivaled warrior a thousand years ago. How he regrets lifting his weapon before the tombs of his companions in days bygone! For if this battle could never have been won, then he was no leader, but a cruel, lonesome king.
Look upon the tears of Cochanina — witness her thousand-year-old despair. Resolute she was to the end, but fire, sword, and death never ceased to ravage her homeland. At the last, she would kneel before the icy coffins, and reflect upon the image the rain-puddles painted of her: If it cannot be rejected, why not embrace it?
Feel Ndenge's fury, and know his thousand-year madness. He fought for Natlan all his life, shed and spent his fiery blood, only to learn the truth of war from the Sacred Flame once he had attained the throne. He was not a hero, beloved by all — he was but a blind, ignorant clown, for humanity can never hope to conquer the true master.
Fathom the words of Xbalanque, perceive his thousand-year-old lie. The utmost wisdom births the utmost paranoia, and as he held time and death in his hands, he doomed Natlan to an endgame without any solution. Humans need not light lamps before the destined darkness to come, lest it be to attract still larger monsters.
Think upon Mavuika's plan... No.
It can warp history and memory, but it cannot twist your personal experiences. This is the meaning of this name you hold, and the light that Ancient Names mean to pass down.
"Our forebears carved 'miracles' into obsidian rock, yet future bearers looked upon them and saw 'strength.'"

129003.name: Moon-Prayer Blossom From Columbina
129003.desc: A Moon-Prayer Blossom gifted to you by Columbina, exuding a fragrance both pure and ethereal, much like those you once saw in the Silvermoon Hall.\nIt stirs the memory of a story, and heralds the opening of a new chapter. This time, it will never lose its colors again.
