200240.desc: A sizable piece of an Irminsul Fruit. You can feel its broken edges brim over with restless power.

200241.name: Duelist's Dance
200241.desc: When a character hits opponents, a shockwave will be unleashed that deals AoE True DMG. When characters are at full HP, the DMG dealt will be increased further. This effect can be triggered once every 5s per player's party.

200242.name: Blade Dance
200242.desc: Characters possess 5 stacks of the Blade Dance effect, and each stack increases the Normal Attack DMG dealt by the character by 15%. Possessing 5 stacks will increase Normal ATK SPD by 15%. When a character takes DMG, they will lose 1 stack of Blade Dance. A maximum of 1 stack can be lost every second in this way. A character will gain one stack of Blade Dance for every 10s they are on the field, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each character's CDs, stack counts, and their effects are counted independently.

200243.name: Starcrystal Dance
200243.desc: When a character obtains an Elemental Shard created by a Geo Elemental Reaction, a small shockwave will be unleashed that will deal 500% of that character's ATK as DMG to nearby opponents. Additionally, all characters in the party gain a 40% Geo DMG Bonus for 10s after this effect is triggered. These effects can be triggered once every 5s and this CD is shared between all party members.

200244.name: Intertwined Steps
200244.desc: When any party member uses an Elemental Burst, the Elemental Roundabout effect is generated, which increases all party members' Elemental Mastery by 100 for 20s, stacking up to 3 times. If this effect is triggered again at 3 stacks, a shockwave that deals AoE True DMG will be unleashed.

200245.name: Endless Waltz
200245.desc: After using an Elemental Burst, all party members on the field will unleash one shockwave that scales on 600% of the ATK of the character that unleashed that shockwave, and which deals DMG to nearby opponents. This effect can occur once every 2s and its CD is shared between all characters in the party.

200246.name: Refraction Crystals
200246.desc: When a character obtains an Elemental Shard created by a Crystallize Reaction, they gain a 30% Elemental DMG Bonus for 10s.

200247.name: Emboldened
200247.desc: For 20s after an Elemental Burst hits an opponent, the character who unleashed that Elemental Burst has their Normal Attack DMG increased by 40%.

200248.name: Courageous
200248.desc: After a character protected by a shield hits an opponent with a Normal Attack, their ATK is increased by 8%. This effect can stack up to 5 times and lasts for 8s. This effect, its stacks, and its duration are independently calculated for every character.

200249.name: Whirlpool
200249.desc: Defeating opponents with a character's Charged Attack will create a Vacuum Field that pulls nearby opponents in and deals DMG based on 500% of the character's ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 2s, and this effect's CD is shared between all characters in the party.

200250.name: Challenger
200250.desc: When there are no more than 2 opponents near a character, ATK is increased by 20% and DEF is increased by 20%.

200251.name: Execution
200251.desc: When a character's Charged Attacks hit an opponent that is under 50% HP, an executioner's blade will descend and deal True DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 10s and this CD is shared between all party members.

200252.name: Focusing Crystals
200252.desc: When a character obtains an Elemental Shard created by a Crystallize Reaction, they will regenerate 2 Energy for all members of the party. This effect can be triggered once every 2s and this CD is shared between all party members.

200253.name: Refined Burst
200253.desc: Increases the Elemental Burst Level of all party members by 1.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

200254.name: Judgment
200254.desc: When an opponent is defeated, it will release a shockwave that deals AoE True DMG to other opponents.

200255.name: Keen Edge
200255.desc: All party members gain a 30% Physical DMG Bonus.

200256.name: Burst Damage
200256.desc: Elemental Burst DMG dealt by all party members increased by 30%.

200257.name: Overmastered
200257.desc: All characters in the party have their Elemental Mastery increased by 100.

200258.name: Iron Wall
200258.desc: All party members' Shield Strength increased by 40%.

200259.name: Song of Steel
200259.desc: All party members' Normal Attack DMG increased by 30%.

200260.name: Fierce Strike
200260.desc: All party members' Charged Attack DMG increased by 30%.

200261.name: Dance of Abundance
200261.desc: After using an Elemental Burst, the Elemental Profusion effect will occur, increasing all party members' Elemental Burst DMG by 12% for 15s. Max 5 stacks. When 5 stacks are possessed, Normal ATK SPD is increased by 15%.

200262.name: Conductivity
200262.desc: When an active character triggers Electro-Charged, all of that player's party members' Elemental Burst CDs are decreased by 1s. This can occur once every 1.5s.

200900.name: Wilderness Rod
200900.desc: A rather pedestrian-looking wooden fishing rod. Apart from being quite sturdy, even to the point where you could use it for self-defense, it lacks any sort of special features. But the old adage holds true — "the novice's rod shall be the tent-pole of their veterancy." Even the greatest of anglers must surely have started with this simple implement.

200901.name: Windtangler
200901.desc: If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, this rod will shorten the time in which fish will struggle by a stable amount and increase your chances of success. This effect only works in Mondstadt.\n\nA long, bright, transparent rod created by a poet from Mondstadt. To help borrow the power of Anemo to help raise the rod, the poet rather ingeniously designed a fishing reel made from the leaves of Windwheel Asters, which also imparts a certain romanticism of "lingering in the wind" to this device. But perhaps there were issues in the handiwork or in the design itself, for the finalized product could not spin as freely as expected. Perhaps this is what they call "the chasm between professions?"
source_list: Exchange at the Mondstadt Fishing Association

200902.name: Wishmaker
200902.desc: If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, this rod will shorten the time in which fish will struggle by a stable amount and increase your chances of success. This effect only works in Liyue.\n\nA long rod that stands like elegant bamboo. It is said to have been constructed and kept by a skilled hermit from Liyue, and it was first discovered on a stone tablet with the following words carved upon it: "O you who aspire, take up this rod," like a legendary sword waiting for a hero to pull it out. Of course, you only ever hear this glorious origin story from the mouths of merchants, so it may just be some rhetoric used to increase the item's value... But those who know this and still use this rod can only be those who are ready and willing to accept this pact.
source_list: Exchange at the Liyue Fishing Association

200903.name: Narukawa Ukai
200903.desc: If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, this rod will shorten the time in which fish will struggle by a stable amount and increase your chances of success. This effect only works in Inazuma.\n\nA rod created to commemorate the ancient Ukai, or Cormorant, fishing method. The ruby-red gem at the tip of the rod represents the tinder used by the cormorant fishers, and the bird ornaments along the rod's shaft represent the cormorants themselves, who helped the hard-working Inazumans pass through those cataclysmic years. This low-efficiency fishing method has long become obsolete, but the persevering, pioneering spirit has been passed down together with this rod.
source_list: Exchange at the Inazuma Fishing Association

200904.name: Moonstringer
200904.desc: If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, this rod will shorten the time in which fish will struggle at an accelerating rate and increase your chances of success. If you leave the Ideal Tension Zone, the acceleration will reset.\nA special fishing rod created for the sake of the Lunar Leviathan. To tackle this legendary fish, the creator of this rod specially added some material with rare functions onto the rod itself and the fishing line, giving it both great malleability and tensile strength. Of course, such a treasure could easily catch ordinary fish, but that seems like overkill to the point where even the rod might feel ashamed to be used thus.

200905.name: Serendipity
200905.desc: If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, this rod will shorten the time in which fish will struggle by a stable amount and increase your chances of success. This effect only works in Sumeru.\n\nThis archaic Sumeru fishing rod is carved like white jade, decorated with dark gold patterns, and embellished with green gems. Under its pure aesthetics, it seems to have some meaning related to "life" — it is said that the oldest fishing rod of Sumeru was a branch wrapped with vines, and many master anglers achieved miraculous catches with such rods. Today's fishermen also believe that such fishing rods with long histories will bring them good luck.
source_list: Exchange at the Sumeru Fishing Association

200906.name: Wavepiercer
200906.desc:
If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, this rod will shorten the time in which fish will struggle by a stable amount and increase your chances of success. This effect only works in Fontaine.

A slender fishing rod with a beautiful metallic glamor. Made of innovative metal materials designed by the Fontaine Research Institute, it combines light weight and resistance. Thanks to the solid metal loops reinforcing the connections between each section, the rod is capable of bearing fish of astonishing weight. Moreover, the reel seat is modeled after the handguards on weapon handles, protecting the angler from being damaged by fierce and "tough" fish. 
According to experienced fishers, this rod is the perfect weapon against "Iron Fish," the specialty of Fontaine, and is comparable to a trusty lance.
source_list: Exchange at the Fontaine Fishing Association

200907.name: Flowhorn Flounderfinder
200907.desc:
If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, this rod will shorten the time in which fish will struggle by a stable amount and increase your chances of success. This effect only works in Natlan.

A specialty rod of the Natlan Fishing Association. Crafted from weapons-grade metal, it has also been carved with a fine design that features Long-Necked Rhinos and Flowcurrent Birds, ensuring both durability and style.
Anglers often speculate that, if only it felt inclined to harness the potential of its exceedingly long neck, the Long-Necked Rhino might become the most gifted fisher in the entire natural world. Meanwhile, the seemingly clumsy Flowcurrent Bird actually has to rely upon catching fish to survive. Together, therefore, they would make the perfect fishing partners — thus, having them both on the same rod is believed to bring anglers exceptional luck!
source_list: Exchange at the Natlan Fishing Association

200908.name: Moongleam Sapling
200908.desc: If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, this rod will shorten the time in which fish will struggle by a stable amount and increase your chances of success. This effect only works in Nod-Krai.\n\nA fishing rod that shimmers with a pure, silvery glow, like moonlight caught in its frame. It's a masterpiece reserved for true masters among Nod-Krai's anglers, those who have reached the highest levels of the craft. It is said that the last wielder of this rod treated every catch as a quiet exchange rather than a contest. Some fish were released right away, while others were invited home for a short visit in the aquarium — before being gently returned to the waters they came from. This thoughtful, respectful way of fishing gave rise to a unique tradition among local anglers — one that values connection and care over mere skill.
source_list: Exchange at the Nod-Krai Fishing Association

200909.name: Scepter of the Snow Angler King
200909.desc: If you can stay within the Ideal Tension Zone while fishing, using this rod will steadily shorten the time fish struggle and increase your chances of success. Only effective in Snezhnaya.\n\nA fishing rod made from Prime Ice by an unknown artisan, acclaimed as "the scepter of the king of anglers in the land of snow." It is currently entrusted to the Snezhnaya Fishing Association. It is said that only anglers of supreme skill, fully tempered by the howling wind and snow, are worthy of wielding this rod...
source_list: Exchange at the Snezhnaya Fishing Association

210002.name: Travel Notes: Catch the Wind
210002.desc: Namecard style.\nThe most difficult part of writing a travel journal is coming up with the beginning.
210002.special: "Travel Notes: Catch the Wind" namecard style.

210003.name: Amber: Bunny
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Amber

210004.name: Klee: Explosive
210004.desc: Namecard style.\nKlee's lucky explosive — can you tell if it's Jumpy Dumpty or Dodoco? (Hint: Look carefully at the tail...)
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Klee

210005.name: Diluc: Flames
210005.desc: Namecard style.\nMaster Crepus painted many eagles during his lifetime, but he never could've foreseen creating an eagle with such fire.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Diluc

210006.name: Razor: Wolvensprint
210006.desc: Namecard style.\nIt's quite a sight to behold Razor and the wolves prepare their dinner, but they won't let Klee or the Traveler see the slightly gruesome affair.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Razor

210007.name: Venti: Azure Sky
210007.desc: Namecard style.\nThe bright blue of a cloudless sky and the melodious tone of Der Frühling complement each other perfectly.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Venti

210008.name: Jean: The Winds' Course
210008.desc: Namecard style.\nThe dandelion, also called "lion's fang" by some, is the flower most sensitive to the direction of the wind.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Jean

210009.name: Barbara: Flow
210009.desc: Namecard style.\nWhen Barbara sings, her melodic voice flows like the tender healing of a clear spring.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Barbara

210010.name: Kaeya: Pavo Ocellus
210010.desc: Namecard style.\nThe pattern of peacock feathers resembles eyes that never shut. Can we really say that this Pavo Ocellus is missing an eye...?
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Kaeya

210011.name: Lisa: Tempus Fugit
210011.desc: Namecard style.\nAn hourglass marks the end of the work day for Lisa. Its sand moves fast.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Lisa

210012.name: Sucrose: Bio-Alchemy
210012.desc: Namecard style.\nIf you closely examine an Anemo Hypostasis before it disappears, you will discover that they are actually quite square.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Sucrose

210013.name: Fischl: Night Raven
210013.desc: Namecard style.\nA raven dark as midnight with wings that can block out the sun. "I permit thee to conceive his likeness upon such decoration!"
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Fischl

210014.name: Noelle: Protector
210014.desc: Namecard style.\nNoelle is quite special. Noelle won't let any harm come to you.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Noelle

210015.name: Mona: Starry Sky
210015.desc: Namecard style.\nA girl gazes down at the stars' reflection on the water, pondering the joys and sorrows of life.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Mona

210016.name: Bennett: Recognition
210016.desc: Namecard style.\nA sign of recognition from Benny's Adventure Team.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Bennett

210017.name: Xiangling: Fresh from the Pan
210017.desc: Namecard style.\nTry saying this three times fast: "Guoba sears sea snails by Liyue's sea shore."
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Xiangling

210018.name: Xingqiu: Rainbow
210018.desc: Namecard style.\nCome watch the night rain that brings no rainbow.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Xingqiu

210019.name: Qiqi: Cold Storage
210019.desc: Namecard style.\nWhat should be kept in the fridge? Dr. Baizhu's herbs, coconut milk... and Hu Tao.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Qiqi

210020.name: Keqing: Lightning Stiletto
210020.desc: Namecard style.\nIt was originally invented to just test out one's surroundings and climb to high places, really...
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Keqing

210021.name: Achievement: Explorer
210021.desc: Namecard style.\nAfter all your wanderings throughout the world, do not forget the reason why you first set out.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Mortal Travails: Series I"

210022.name: Achievement: Virtuoso
210022.desc: Namecard style.\nAfter mastering these skills, you may just find that you can get by just fine without engaging in battle. If you are without any commission to complete, that is.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "The Art of Adventure"

210023.name: Achievement: Hero
210023.desc: Namecard style.\nYour hero's journey began before you knew it, but it's the experiences that really made it special.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "The Hero's Journey"

210024.name: Mondstadt: Whistling Wind
210024.desc: Namecard style.\nListen to the singing of Mondstadt's birds and winds.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Mondstadt: The City of Wind and Song"

210025.name: Liyue: Stillness of Stone
210025.desc: Namecard style.\nWitness the lonely, cloud-covered peaks of Liyue.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Liyue: The Harbor of Stone and Contracts"

210026.name: Achievement: Colors of the Rainbow
210026.desc: Namecard style.\nLight can refract into countless colors, but people stop at seven because they're lazy to count. Perhaps the elements are like that, too.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Elemental Specialist: Series I"

210027.name: Achievement: Bowmaster
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Marksmanship"

210028.name: Achievement: Challenger
210028.desc: Namecard style.\nEven if you're just going out to get a single dandelion, there will be obstacles in your path. But you love a challenge, don't you?
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger: Series I"

210029.name: Achievement: Deep & Dark
210029.desc: Namecard style.\nThe deeper you delve, the more secrets you shall uncover.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Domains and Spiral Abyss: Series I"

210030.name: Achievement: Hill Dwellers
210030.desc: Namecard style.\nThe hilichurls were dubbed the "hill devils." But a certain young girl named Musk insists on calling them the "hill dwellers."
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Olah!: Series I"

210031.name: Achievement: Snowy Land
210031.desc: Namecard style.\nYou've heard many stories about Snezhnaya. What does it look like in your mind's eye?
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Snezhnaya Does Not Believe in Tears: Series I"

210032.name: Achievement: Cliffhanger
210032.desc: Namecard style.\nThey say that storytellers love their cliffhangers — but you? You've heard it all before.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Stone Harbor's Nostalgia: Series I"

210033.name: Achievement: Reunion
210033.desc: Namecard style.\nWe shall meet again someday.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Meetings in Outrealm: Series I"

210038.name: Ningguang: Phoenix
210038.desc: Namecard style.\nThey say that "more's the pity that phoenixes are few." But seriously, one Ningguang is more than enough...
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Ningguang

210039.name: Beidou: Weighing Anchor
210039.desc: Namecard style.\n"Weighing anchor out to sea, one is wont to waver. But look to the skies, and the stars shall light the way."
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Beidou

210040.name: Chongyun: Spirit Blade
210040.desc: Namecard style.\nThis was originally a peachwood sword made of ice. But a big enough ice block makes a better exorcist's tool than peachwood.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Chongyun

210041.name: Achievement: Challenger II
210041.desc: Namecard style.\nThat which awaits at the end of the challenges is...
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger: Series II"

210042.name: Travel Notes: Fading Star
210042.desc: Namecard style.\nSo long as there is still desire left in your heart, when you hold your head high you will see that which glitters but is not light.
210042.special: "Travel Notes: A New Star" namecard style.

210043.name: Diona: Meow!
210043.desc: Namecard style.\nAll who have Kätzlein blood will have such feline features. An ancient prank played by a certain someone, perhaps?
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Diona

210044.name: Zhongli: Planet Befall
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Zhongli

210045.name: Xinyan: Song's End
210045.desc: Namecard style.\nXinyan only has time to examine her instrument carefully after the performance is over. Even in silence, it is a beauty.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Xinyan

210046.name: Childe: Foul Legacy
210046.desc: Namecard style.\nThis bears all the marks of that fellow who gallivants as he pleases across the continent with his ever-changing combat styles. Yet, his "Foul Legacy" was not originally his. Rather, it was taught to him by that solitary girl who dwelt in the darkest corners of the universe.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Tartaglia

210047.name: Mondstadt: Hero's Fame
210047.desc: Namecard style.\nThe name of the Honorary Knight has spread far and wide among the citizenry.

210048.name: Mondstadt: Blessing
210048.desc: Namecard style.\nThey who have it in their hearts to bless others shall themselves be blessed.

210049.name: Liyue: A Thousand Ships
210049.desc: Namecard style.\nMany boats have been numbered by day and night.

210050.name: Liyue: In the Clouds
210050.desc: Namecard style.\nThe peaks adorn the clouded moon.

210051.name: Achievement: Challenger III
210051.desc: Namecard style.\nFinally, a worthy opponent! Our battle will be legendary!
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger - Series III"

210052.name: Achievement: Snowy Summit
210052.desc: Namecard style.\nA draconian peak must be scaled.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Visitors on the Icy Mountain"

210053.name: Ganyu: Qilin
210053.desc: Namecard style.\nDo no harm to plant nor insect.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Ganyu

210054.name: Albedo: Sun Blossom
210054.desc: Namecard style.\nAllow me to bear witness to this miracle.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Albedo

210055.name: Travel Notes: Chalk
210055.desc: Namecard style.\nRemember to keep warm when setting foot on the mountain.

210056.name: Frostbearing: Ancient Tree
210056.desc: Namecard style.\nWe shall rise again — the tree of old has sprouted anew.
source_list: Reward for reaching Frostbearing Tree Offering Lv. 9

210057.name: Celebration: Hypostasis
210057.desc: Namecard style.\nMy opponent for today seems to have an artistic temperament.
source_list: Obtained from the Hypostatic Symphony event

210058.name: Xiao: Mask
210058.desc: Namecard style.\nHe longs for a day to come when he will wear the mask and dance — not to conquer demons, but to the tune of that flute amid a sea of flowers.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Xiao

210059.name: Hu Tao: Spirit Soother
210059.desc: Namecard style.\nDirector Hu Tao isn't scary at all. Probably.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Hu Tao

210060.name: Travel Notes: Mingxiao
210060.desc: Namecard style.\nWhen everyone's wishes are gathered together, they can light up the long night.

210061.name: Celebration: Lantern-Light
210061.desc: Namecard style.\nEvery year on this day, the lanterns light up the night. May the fire never die, and may humanity endure.
source_list: Purchased from Lantern Rite Event Shop

210062.name: Celebration: Mechanicus
210062.desc: Namecard style.\nYou claim to have seen all mechanisms, but have you ever considered playing yourself as a pawn?
source_list: Obtained from the Theater Mechanicus event

210063.name: Rosaria: Indenture
210063.desc: Namecard style.\nThe unselfish warmth and goodwill of the people is, to her, a kindness that she must repay, and so it is an indenture that follows her forever.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Rosaria

210064.name: Travel Notes: Windblume
210064.desc: Namecard style.\nWho has seen the wind? Neither you nor I. Nor has anyone ever seen love, till a bouquet comes flying by.

210065.name: Celebration: Feast
source_list: Obtained from the "Gifts of an Outworld Encounter" event.

210066.name: Celebration: Shining Scale
210066.desc: Namecard style.\nThe universe does play host to just such a snake, whose scales glitter with precisely these colors.

210067.name: Celebration: Fruit of Wisdom
210067.desc: Namecard style.\nWhat knowledge might the fruit of wisdom bring, were it to descend upon the land? Either way, it'll taste good as a drink if left in Diona's hands.
source_list: Obtained from the Energy Amplifier event

210068.name: Celebration: Peekaboo!
210068.desc: Namecard style.\nYou can't see me. You can't see me.

210069.name: Yanfei: Impartial
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Yanfei

210070.name: Eula: Ice-Sealed
210070.desc: Namecard style.\nA cold heart is but a shell to protect oneself.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Eula

210071.name: Travel Notes: Sub-Space Recreation
210071.desc: Namecard style.\nHow many nights have you spent with a stone for your pillow?

210072.name: Achievement: Tea Time
210072.desc: Namecard style.\nThe days and months pass within the teapot.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "A Realm Beyond: Series I"

210073.name: Kaedehara Kazuha: Autumn Maple-Viewing
210073.desc: Namecard style.\n"The pine-song ripples as red leaves billow."
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Kaedehara Kazuha

210075.name: Achievement: Vacation Home
210075.desc: Namecard style.\nThe world is wide under the eaves.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "A Realm Beyond: Series II"

210076.name: Celebration: Vastness
210076.desc: Namecard style.\nImagine the vast expanse of a sea of stars. Imagine a one followed by a hundred zeros.

210077.name: Celebration: Kaboomball
210077.desc: Namecard style.\n"In a land far, far away, there was a kingdom known as the Grand Alliance, and the people living there could throw ever-changing, quick, and powerful Kaboomballs."
source_list: Obtained from the Kaboomball Kombat event

210078.name: Celebration: Battlesong
210078.desc: Namecard style.\nGood omens must appear thrice for good fortune to come. One bows thrice at curtain call. The opponents to defeat number three.
source_list: Obtained from the Legend of the Vagabond Sword event

210079.name: Inazuma: Sacred Sakura
210079.desc: Namecard style.\nWherever the sakura petals fall, there the protection of the sacred tree rests.

210080.name: Travel Notes: Grand Narukami Shrine
210080.desc: Namecard style.\nThe sakura of Mt. Yougou symbolizes the Grand Narukami Shrine.
210080.special: "Travel Notes: Grand Narukami Shrine" namecard style.

210081.name: Kamisato Ayaka: Folding Fan
210081.desc: Namecard style.\nAyaka does constantly change out the fans she carries with her, of course. If you're buying her some as gifts, remember not to send summer fans or throwing fans. Dancing fans or tea fans are good choices, though.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Ayaka

210082.name: Yoimiya: Auratus Spark
210082.desc: Namecard style.\nEven momentary sparks can leave beautiful, unquenchable flames in the hearts of those who watch the night sky.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Yoimiya

210083.name: Sayu: Muji-Muji Daruma
210083.desc: Namecard style.\nIt is even smaller than Sayu, sure, but it can help her do the things she doesn't want to do.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Sayu

210084.name: Inazuma: Raiden Emblem
210084.desc: Namecard style.\nThis is the emblem of the Ogosho Shogun, and is the banner of her troops, the Electro Mitsudomoe.

210085.name: Inazuma: Kamisato Crest
210085.desc: Namecard style.\nThis Tri-Commission house-crest represents the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan.

210086.name: Achievement: Gate
210086.desc: Namecard style.\nWhat encounters lie on the other side of this door?
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Meetings in Outrealm: Series II"

210087.name: Achievement: Traversal
210087.desc: Namecard style.\nA traveler shall experience ten thousand tales, and each shall form a part of the traveler's soul.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Mortal Travails: Series II"

210088.name: Achievement: Stone Dragon
210088.desc: Namecard style.\nOur journey among the precipices.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger: Series IV"

210089.name: Achievement: Full Bloom
210089.desc: Namecard style.\nGather ye then soil from all corners of the universe, and from it may countless flowers grow.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "A Realm Beyond: Series III"

210090.name: Inazuma: Kujou Insignia
210090.desc: Namecard style.\nThis Tri-Commission house-crest represents the Tenryou Commission's Kujou Clan.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Inazuma: The Islands of Thunder and Eternity"

210091.name: Celebration: Wondrous Calculation
210091.desc: Namecard style.\nA true grandmaster can see the board a thousand steps ahead.
source_list: Obtained by completing the Theater Mechanicus: Stage of Wonders event

210092.name: Raiden Shogun: Enlightenment
210092.desc: Namecard style.\nNot simply Ei, and not merely the Raiden Shogun. Observe yourself also with one stormy eye, and you will someday reach a breakthrough.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with the Raiden Shogun

210093.name: Sangonomiya Kokomi: The Deep
210093.desc: Namecard style.\nAll Watatsumi islanders know this tale: that deep beneath the waves lies their former home.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Sangonomiya Kokomi

210094.name: Kujou Sara: Tengu
210094.desc: Namecard style.\nKujou Sara may have forsaken the arrogant life of the tengu race, but she has never neglected their brilliance with the sword or their supernatural might.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Kujou Sara

210095.name: Aloy: Dawn
210095.desc: Namecard style.\n"Everything I do is in the service of life, not death."
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Aloy

210096.name: Travel Notes: Moonchaser
210096.desc: Namecard style.\nMay the moonlight wash over you, O pursuer!

210097.name: Inazuma: Sangonomiya Crest
210097.desc: Namecard style.\nThis is the emblem of the Sangonomiya Clan, the leaders of Watatsumi's people.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Inazuma: The Islands of Thunder and Eternity - Series II."

210098.name: Achievement: Nails
210098.desc: Namecard style.\n"Wait, if these fish can't be eaten, then why are we hammering these nails into fishhooks?" "Oh, you wouldn't understand."
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Teyvat Fishing Guide: Series I"

210099.name: Celebration: Tuneful Delight
210099.desc: Namecard style.\nO stars and mountains above, listen to my song!

210100.name: Celebration: Ikki
210100.desc: Namecard style.\n"I will ask you a question, and you shall answer me with your sword."
source_list: Obtained from the Hyakunin Ikki event

210101.name: Thoma: Blazing Guard
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Thoma

210102.name: Travel Notes: Heavenly General
210102.desc: Namecard style.\n"You were not created to punish evil. But as to what your purpose is... I fear that I, too, do not know."

210103.name: Inazuma: Eagleplume
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "The Chronicles of the Sea of Fog"

210104.name: Gorou: Leisurely Hound
210104.desc: Namecard style.\nAs long as you believe in the path you are walking, then everything you encounter on your journey will be a source of happiness.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Gorou

210105.name: Itto: Oni Face
210105.desc: Namecard style.\nA real man puts sorrow and anger behind him and smiles brightly for the world to see!
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Itto

210106.name: Travel Notes: Lyratum
210106.desc: Namecard.\nOnly this flower remains on the heights where all trees have withered.

210107.name: Shenhe: Comb
210107.desc: Namecard style.\nThe early onset of white hair is often correlated to one's sorrows. Since "comb" and "scatter" are similarly read in Liyue's language, they believe that combing one's hair is the same as scattering one's misfortunes.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Shenhe

210108.name: Yun Jin: Rhyme
210108.desc: Namecard style.\nMs. Yun has two sorts of teachers. The critics of her onstage performances are one, and the books on rhyme she references while writing are the other.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Yun Jin

210109.name: Inazuma: Tokoyo
210109.desc: Namecard style.\n"O Mighty Sun! What use are your heat and light if you cannot own all that they survey?"
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "The Light of Day"

210110.name: Travel Notes: Flowing Hues
210110.desc: Namecard style.\nThe luxurious colors flow past — all things are renewed.

210111.name: Celebration: Binge Vessel
210111.desc: Namecard.\nThere's a great many stories here, but no alcohol, so it's safe for Paimon to drink.
source_list: Obtained from the "Of Drink A-Dreaming" event

210112.name: Yae Miko: Kitsune Dreaming
210112.desc: Namecard style.\nWhere can Yae Miko's fox form be found? In your dreams, that's where.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Yae Miko

210113.name: Travel Notes: Awakening
210113.desc: Namecard style.\nThe three realms quake, heaven and earth awaken. The Sangacorexes, too, rise again from their eternal slumber.

210114.name: Kamisato Ayato: Ripple
210114.desc: Namecard style.\nThe camellia alights upon the mirrored pond, sending ripples throughout the water.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Kamisato Ayato

210115.name: Lumens: Stone of Light
210115.desc: Namecard style.\nWhat flows within this nameless, voiceless azure crystal? The secrets of the heavens? Or the whispers of the abyss?
source_list: Reward for enhancing the Lumenstone Adjuvant to Lv. 10

210116.name: Achievement: Thunderclap
210116.desc: Namecard style.\nListen to the sound that comes from the clouds. That is its resentful rage, and its tiny wish.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger: Series V"

210117.name: Achievement: Chasm
210117.desc: Namecard style.\nWhere once miners industriously delved and tunneled, now all is silent. Only the Glazed Sand Crystal and marrows of stone, both millennia-old, still give off any brilliance.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Chasmlighter"

210118.name: Travel Notes: Irodori
210118.desc: Namecard style.\nThose who share a hobby are known as a group as "fans." Best come up with those stories, everyone, before the kitsune editor-in-chief dreams up copyright law... Or perhaps she has already dreamed it up, but does not altogether mind?

210119.name: Yelan: Throw
210119.desc: Namecard style.\n"Dice are always quite hard to make 'fair.' That goes double for dice with shoddier workmanship. The weighting on each numbered side will almost certainly be unbalanced."
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Yelan

210120.name: Kuki Shinobu: Net
210120.desc: Namecard style.\n"You know those Naku Weed rings they have in Inazuma? You know, the kind that can drive out evil? Shinobu got the idea that since wicked things won't cross their boundaries willingly, we could make them into items that could be actively used. Ah, her talent for being a shrine maiden truly is frightening..."
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Kuki Shinobu

210121.name: Travel Notes: Divine Will
210121.desc: Namecard style.\n"Once upon a time, loyal souls did scatter east and west like swan geese." "Today I light my lantern, that they may not lose their way."

210122.name: Shikanoin Heizou: Temari
210122.desc: Namecard style.\nA Temari of entwining strings in various colors. It must have taken someone's great effort to make such an item, yet Heizou only sees it as a simple game to untangle each string.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Shikanoin Heizou

210123.name: Travel Notes: Azure Main
210123.desc: Namecard style.\nYears have gone by, and you wake from an old dream. Inside the keepsake shell, lingers the blue ocean of those summer days.

210124.name: Tighnari: Dew-Kissed
210124.desc: Namecard style.\nTighnari takes good care of his big, fluffy tail. The essential oil he uses was extracted from flowers and mixed together meticulously. It gives off a faint, calming scent.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Tighnari

210125.name: Collei: Good Virtue
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Collei

210126.name: Dori: Jinni
210126.desc: Namecard style.\nIf you wipe the lamp she gave you and then scrub the Mora you gave her, no wish is unattainable... right?
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Dori

210127.name: Travel Notes: Woodlands
210127.desc: Namecard style.\nBeneath the tranquil moon and inside the deep valley grows blooming roses. 'Tis a paradise with your presence.

210128.name: Achievement: Roaming
210128.desc: Namecard style.\nEvery journey and memory is a unique miracle that only belongs to the traveler.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Mortal Travails: Series III"

210129.name: Achievement: Fated Encounter
210129.desc: Namecard style.\nOne day, our encounter at this moment shall shine like a star of reminiscence in our hearts.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Meetings in Outrealm: Series III"

210130.name: Sumeru: Shimmering Woods
210130.desc: Namecard style.\nWhat dreams lie within the rich slumber of the stories deep in the woods?
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Sumeru: The Rainforest of Lore"

210131.name: Sumeru: Observance
210131.desc: Namecard style.\nBehold everything the world has to offer; see through all that the sky's light surveys.

210132.name: Sumeru: Unsullied
210132.desc: Namecard style.\nThe wise, graced with the thorough knowledge of the truth, will not be sullied by sin. They are like the Nilotpala Lotus, which remains clear and pure even after the rains and winds have passed.

210133.name: Travel Notes: Returning Winds
210133.desc: Namecard style.\nThe years come and go. Only remembrance and the winds that return do not change.

210134.name: Cyno: Silence
210134.desc: Namecard style.\nWhenever Cyno falls into a profound silence, he must be considering some weighty judgment... Or perhaps he is simply considering something amusing.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Cyno

210135.name: Candace: Gray Heron
210135.desc: Namecard style.\nThe burning winds of the past ruffle the heron's feathers, but the bird has eyes only for the morning star at first light.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Candace

210136.name: Nilou: Lotus Dance
210136.desc: Namecard style.\nThe lotus that blooms amidst the pure water is naught but a flash of light beneath her toes.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Nilou

210137.name: Achievement: Seven Lights
210137.desc: Namecard style.\nAnyone can play a tune that belongs just to them, and like the dew upon grass, can reflect the seven lights of heaven.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Elemental Specialist: Series II"

210138.name: Sumeru: Sandtreader
210138.desc: Namecard style.\nThe sands subsume the tracks of travelers, and they await the day when a gust of wind will reveal gilded memories once more.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Sumeru: The Gilded Desert - Series I"

210139.name: Achievement: Mirrored Dreams
210139.desc: Namecard style.\n"A millennium of obsession and tragic yearning has long been lost in the sandstorms of those blazing nights. But the eternal verdant oasis of her dreams is, in all likelihood, as tender as it was at the first..."
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger: Series VI"

210140.name: Nahida: Crescent
210140.desc: Namecard style.\nThe rising moon admires the sun, because her light can shine all over the earth. On the other hand, the setting sun is envious of the moon, for she can be accompanied by the sweetest of dreams.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Nahida

210141.name: Layla: Daydream
210141.desc: Namecard style.\n"The starry sky in your dreams will illuminate your way forward, on the premise that the crystal in your heart reflects clear lights."
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Layla

210142.name: Travel Notes: Fungus Land
210142.desc: Namecard style.\n"Traveler, there is no need to grieve, for the wind at dawn will blow the fungal spores carrying beautiful dreams to the fields that contain your hopes..."

210143.name: Wanderer: Drifter's Ballad
210143.desc: Namecard style.\nIn a world most transient does the past hide, and in the whims of flowing flowers does thin snow abide.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with the Wanderer

210144.name: Faruzan: Sealed Secret
210144.desc: Namecard style.\n"A—Anyway! Next time, remember to refer to me as Madam Faruzan before you ask a question! Seriously..."
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Faruzan

210145.name: Achievement: Invoker
210145.desc: Namecard style.\n"In this village, no one can defeat me!"
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Genius Invokation TCG"

210146.name: Travel Notes: Stellar Rivers
210146.desc: Namecard style.\nForgotten is the name of the ancient feast, scattered are the three rivers amongst a plumage of clouds, and across the curve of twilight does autumn yet linger.

210147.name: Alhaitham: Enlightenment
210147.desc: Namecard style.\n"The only things researchers should abide by are debates and dialectics. Only by questioning everything at all times can one avoid falling into prejudice."
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Alhaitham

210148.name: Yaoyao: Yuegui
210148.desc: Namecard style.\n"Can you guess which one here is Yuegui? That's right, all of them are!"
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Yaoyao

210149.name: Celebration: Lenticular Clouds
210149.desc: Namecard style.\nThe floating clouds dispersed to the thousand peaks at dawn.

210150.name: Travel Notes: Rhythm and Rhyme
210150.desc: Namecard style.\nWith magnificent sunglow sheds light on the night sky, chimes are orchestrated to celebrate the bygone year. The gilded palaces are adorned with beaded curtains, the railings painted silver by bright moonlight, and the feasts brimmed with jolly singing and dances. Is that flowers or fireworks? A wealth of instruments plays in unison, harmonious and pleasant.
210150.special: "Travel Notes: Rhythm and Rhyme" namecard style

210151.name: Sumeru: Sandstorm
210151.desc: Namecard style.\nThe endless sandstorm conceals ancient dreams...
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Sumeru: The Gilded Desert - Series II"

210152.name: Dehya: Purifying Flame
210152.desc: Namecard style.\nThose that should be burned will be reduced to fly ash, so that all the precious things that should be preserved can be revealed.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Dehya

210153.name: Mika: Index
210153.desc: Namecard style.\nEvery time he holds the map he illustrated in his hands, the boy feels like he is holding a small piece of rubbing of this world.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Mika

210154.name: Travel Notes: Artful Intent
210154.desc: Namecard style.\nIt is said that experiencing true love is like seeing a ghost. Most folks speak of both as hearsay, but true witnesses remain few and far between. That said, since even ghosts can manifest here, perhaps true love is also waiting right around the next corner.

210155.name: Baizhu: Relief
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Baizhu

210156.name: Kaveh: Domed Court
210156.desc: Namecard style.\n"When conceptualizing architecture, there is nothing wrong with imagining that the structure we build will surmount the firmament and outlast the stars."
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Kaveh

210157.name: Achievement: Infinitum
210157.desc: Namecard style.\n"Oh, Khvarena in your endless forms, protect this imperiled land. The blights and glories of the earthly realm are naught but the illusion of existing seeds."
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Blessed Hamada"

210158.name: Achievement: Transient Twilight
210158.desc: Namecard style.\n"I will forget the flowers of yesteryear, the daylight, the rain. I ask that you remember in my stead, in this nascent world, and hold to that lost dream."
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger: Series VII"

210159.name: Sumeru: The Great Dream
210159.desc: Namecard style.\n"The time to flourish has yet to come. Hide me with care between the blades of grass and beneath the tallness of trees. Let me linger in that place of dreams."
source_list: Reach Tree of Dreams's Favor Level 48

210160.name: Sumeru: Amrita
210160.desc: Namecard style.\nThe ancient Amrita Pool is suffused with recollections of times past. Perhaps it also contains the power that will create the future.
source_list: Make 6 offerings to the Amrita Pool

210161.name: Travel Notes: Crown of Glory
210161.desc: Namecard style.\n"Knowledge serves as the crown of time, and reminiscence is bound to the time we shared as one."
210161.special: "Travel Notes: Crown of Glory" namecard style.

210162.name: Kirara: Neko Box
210162.desc: Namecard style.\n"To Kirara, the smiles on her customers' faces are the best rewards possible."
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Kirara

210163.name: Travel Notes: Secrets
210163.desc: Namecard style.\nNever forget the time you once spent with games and good friends. Never forget what it feels like to have no worries about the future.

210164.name: Travel Notes: Vivid Illumination
210164.desc: Namecard style\nWho knows? Perhaps the phantasmal light that only exists on the other side of this transparent glass can ever so slightly brighten up the world on this one.

210165.name: Lyney: Pretense
210165.desc: Namecard style.\nOne major type of magic revolves around making things "vanish." Lyney has an arsenal of tricks up his sleeve. As his accomplice, as long as you are willing to turn a blind eye, all your problems may vanish as well.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Lyney

210166.name: Lynette: Earnestness
210166.desc: Namecard style.\nOne major type of magic revolves around "appearing suddenly." Lynette is usually conserving her energy, but her serious side can "appear" as abruptly as pigeons from a hat.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Lynette

210167.name: Freminet: Progress
210167.desc: Namecard style.\nAs the clockwork devices do naught but round and round in circles turn, the dolls march forward.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Freminet

210168.name: Fontaine: Judgment
210168.desc: Namecard style.\nThe insignia of the new Hydro Archon. Even without any legal notice, it is understood that none dare use it without permission.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Fontaine: Dance of the Dew-White Springs (I)"

210169.name: Achievement: Orbits
210169.desc: Namecard style.\n"O Almighty Sovereign, the Universitas Magistrorum has provided the predictions you requested: The two stars have been captured by the world's gravity... After a lengthy orbital period, today their paths shall intertwine once more."
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Meetings in Outrealm: Series IV"

210170.name: Achievement: Mariner
210170.desc: Namecard style.\nThe hands of travelers have touched ten thousand streams. They all flow from the same font of the world's waters, and all return to the same sea.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Mortal Travails: Series IV"

210171.name: Fontaine: Wondrous Machine
210171.desc: Namecard style.\nThe symbol of the energy blocks used by all of Fontaine's clockwork meka. There was once a great debate over whether it should be registered as a trademark, but in the end, the public was simply called upon not to use it too freely.

210172.name: Fontaine: Big News
210172.desc: Namecard style.\nThe trademarked logo of The Steambird. If you are discovered using it without first obtaining prior permission, we will uphold our rights and prosecute the offense to the fullest extent of the law!

210173.name: Travel Notes: Primordial Waters
210173.desc: Namecard style.\nTimepieces accompany the tranquil passing of the years, as fish accompany the swirling of the clear waters of the font. If all that is must one day wither, why is my yearning as clear as ever?

210174.name: Neuvillette: Surge
210174.desc: Namecard style.\nThe water's surface may seem placid as a pristine gem, but it may yet be lying in wait for an opportune moment to gush forth.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Neuvillette

210175.name: Wriothesley: Detention
210175.desc: Namecard style.\nMaintaining order at the Fortress of Meropide is no simple affair. As such, a deft and sometimes firm hand is needed — along with a small pinch of truly regrettable cruelty.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Wriothesley

210176.name: Travel Notes: Falling Star
210176.desc: Namecard style.\nMake a wish before you toss the arrow. If you manage to get it into the pot, who knows — your wish just might come true.

210177.name: Celebration: Euphonia
210177.desc: Namecard style.\nThe trees sing on the slopes of a thousand mountain valleys, accompanied by the music of the passing rain.
source_list: Obtained from the Genshin Concert event

210178.name: Achievement: Perpetual
210178.desc: Namecard style.\n"No one hears the dream that shattered between the conches and the gears. Only the tireless mechanical dancer still queries the echoes of the past day and night with its every elegant step."
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger: Series VIII"

210179.name: Fontaine: Redemption
210179.desc: Namecard style.\nThe official logo of the Fortress of Meropide. It is our dearest hope that all who wish to honor order and live out their lives in peace shall not ever be associated with the organization this insignia represents.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Fontaine: Dance of the Dew-White Springs (II)"

210180.name: Furina: Banquet
210180.desc: Namecard style.\nCan one person eat every cake? If they eat one per day, they should be able to enjoy cake for a week or so, right? But will the cakes stay fresh that long? Hmm... Well, don't worry, because there will be friends coming to eat the cakes together.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Furina

210181.name: Charlotte: Exclusive
210181.desc: Namecard style.\n"One, I've written an exclusive, and it's going to generate a lot of buzz for sure! Two, the newspaper said the situation is developing too slowly, so they're changing to a press release instead... Three, the person writing the press release will be in the Opera Epiclese as the defendant tomorrow, so they've decided to run my piece after all!"
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Charlotte

210182.name: Fontaine: Completeness
210182.desc: Namecard style.\n"The evening clouds scatter in the sky and the creek shines gold under the setting sun. My shadow wanders alone, akin to a lonely apparition at the bottom of a waterfall."
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Fontaine: Dance of the Dew-White Springs (III)"

210183.name: Travel Notes: Whirling Waltz
210183.desc: Namecard style.\nEven if the clockwork stops ticking, even if the puppets stop stepping forward. Though our memories be frozen eternally as coral, do not forget our adventures and the time we spent together.

210184.name: Navia: Rosula
210184.desc: Namecard style.\nRoses shall bloom, and thus does Ms. Navia's umbrella flower. Yet beware, for roses have thorns, and Navia's booming brolly packs a powerful punch.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Navia

210185.name: Chevreuse: Type II
210185.desc: Namecard style.\nThe standard issue weapon of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol is known as the "Special Security and Surveillance Patrol Type II Standard Musket." Yet, though there may be countless flowers in this world, the one you treasure is special, even if it should be known to the world as nothing at all special.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Chevreuse

210186.name: Travel Notes: Time Inscribed
210186.desc: Namecard style.\nWho knows how long it shall take before film in Teyvat will advance to the point of reinventing the art of "carving time"? Still, this scene has indeed frozen the sinful past.

210187.name: Xianyun: White Clouds
210187.desc: Namecard style.\nThose who the truth tell, commuted shall their sentence be. Be honest. When Cloud Retainer asked you, "Do you perceive one as merely some larger bird?", did you also append the thoughts, "Yes, and you talk, and fiddle with funny machines"?
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Xianyun.

210188.name: Gaming: Man Chai
210188.desc: Namecard style.\n"Don't stop believing, Man Chai. One day, we'll soar high, with nary a patched hole in our trousers."
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Gaming.

210189.name: Achievement: Adeptal Valley
210189.desc: Namecard style.\n...After that, the fish sank to the bottom of the lake, and the snake was split into several pieces. The remaining beasts waited on mountains, rivers, and moon, awaiting their silent answer.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Chenyu's Splendor."

210190.name: Chenyu: Rainjade Rite
210190.desc: Namecard style.\nStars flicker brightly above the tranquil sea and rivers. The mountain folk dance in harmony with birds and beasts.
source_list: Reward for reaching Rainjade Oblation Level 10.

210191.name: Travel Notes: Vibrant Harriers
210191.desc: Namecard style.\nHarriers and cranes come early in spring. Let the wind rise and the kites soar.

210192.name: Album: The Stellar Moments
210192.desc: Namecard style.\nWe parted in one melody and reunited in another.

210193.name: Chiori: Spectacular Sleeves
210193.desc: Namecard style.\nThe doll known as "Tamoto-chan" was one of Chiori's earliest works, and is also the model that requires the least fabric and tailoring.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Chiori

210194.name: Travel Notes: Arcane Amassing
210194.desc: Namecard style.\nAlchemy is a discipline that studies the conversion from one substance to another, but using alchemy to make potions reduces the quality by a drop. I don't know, perhaps that missing drop is converted into making everyone's mood a bit lighter.

210195.name: Arlecchino: Edict
210195.desc: Namecard style.\n"Father" laid down the harsh strictures of the House of the Hearth, and some of these seem almost unreasonable. Those familiar with her can use these rules to trace the outline of the ideals she so rarely speaks of.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Arlecchino

210196.name: Fontaine: Attunement
210196.desc: Namecard style.\nThe symphony known as "Phobos" has gone out of control, and a Harmost must bring it back in harmony. Yet Fortuna's wheels turn on noiselessly, for destiny knows that even the perfect melody must someday end.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Rhapsodia in the Ancient Sea"

210197.name: Achievement: Whalewrangler
210197.desc: Namecard style.\nThis time, Tartaglia fought this entity for a long time, though he remained unable to defeat it. Hunting the same whale thrice is considered unlucky, but he will not give up. That said, it will be a long while before the creature fully recovers.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger: Series IX"

210198.name: Fontaine: Lucine
210198.desc: Namecard style.\nDon't drink from the Fountain of Lucine. You never know whose tears you're swallowing.
source_list: Reach Fountain of Lucine Favor Level 48

210199.name: Travel Notes: The Realms Rocked
210199.desc: Namecard style.\n"The world does not love its children. If not, why chase them into the next one?" "What do you know? Maybe that one rocks even harder."
210199.special: "Travel Notes: The Realms Rocked" namecard style

210200.name: Clorinde: Roleplay
210200.desc: Namecard style.\nDedicated Game Masters at the Tabletop Troupe will sometimes switch hats to indicate their change in role. Hmm, in that case, does Clorinde—\nForget about it! She doesn't even take that hat off when swimming.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Clorinde

210201.name: Sigewinne: Treatment
210201.desc: Namecard style.\nSigewinne will take good care of her patients. Don't worry, her injections aren't that painful — and while the medicines aren't very tasty, you'd take them over the barren wasteland that special blend milkshakes represent.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Sigewinne

210202.name: Sethos: Ba Fragment
210202.desc: Namecard style.\nEach Ba Fragment has its unique symbol. While this one resembles an hourglass, it represents King Deshret's rule over both Upper and Lower Setekh. As for the light within, it stands for the wisdom of Hermanubis.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Sethos

210203.name: Achievement: Poetic Pages
210203.desc: Namecard style.\nThe dreams someone weaves into being are false, but they nonetheless point toward something real. There must be an eternity forged from "memory" at the end of this path.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Imaginarium Theater: The First Folio"

210204.name: Travel Notes: Simulnation
210204.desc: Namecard style.\n"Victory is but a mere trick of the player's imagination. Silence is the chessboard's true endgame. As such, the one virtuous deed is to play, and to forfeit is the sole sin." "Hey, why don't you play a few less wargames?"

210205.name: Emilie: Base Note
210205.desc: Namecard style.\n"The top note is sweet, the middle rich but not distracting, and the base — Ah! Such a faint fragrance! Such an exquisite perfume."\nOrders flow in and out in an endless stream, and to prevent any scents from disturbing her work, Emilie very seldom uses perfume herself. Alas. When will she have the chance to delight in those base notes?
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Emilie

210206.name: Travel Notes: Fanciful Fabrication
210206.desc: Namecard style.\nWood is processed into paper, and paper is folded into trees. All who are of folded paper shelter a true self within a falsehood.

210207.name: Celebration: Feast (II)
210207.desc: Namecard style.\nWhat makes a feast? Tomatoes, onions, and all other delicious things.

210208.name: Kinich: Ajaw
210208.desc: Namecard style.\nAt first glance, you might think that the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw had finally succeeded in turning the puny Kinich into a vessel of his will. Sadly, though, this is just the way namecards are named.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Kinich

210209.name: Mualani: Sharky
210209.desc: Namecard style.\nSharks that live in the sea don't actually like eating people — they prefer marine creatures. So as a shark that lives in freshwater hot springs, it's only natural that Mualani's Sharky Surfboard will only eat hot spring creatures. ...Just kidding, those Capybaras can sleep easy. Firstly, because their meat's too tough. And secondly, because... it's a surfboard?
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Mualani

210210.name: Kachina: Twirly
210210.desc: Namecard style.\nThe upper half of the Turbo Twirly is very stable, but if the lower half gets stuck, there's a high chance you'll end up with one very dizzy rider.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Kachina

210211.name: Natlan: Divine Army
210211.desc: Namecard style.\n"...Bathed by a hidden sun, Xbalanque's forces advance with unstoppable momentum. He brings all-out war to the world once more, but his goals don't stop there..."
source_list: Reward for reaching the highest Reputation Level with 1 tribe

210212.name: Natlan: Fiery Dragon
210212.desc: Namecard style.\n"...Sharer of light, heat, and wisdom, the dragon king awaits the coming visitor in silence beneath returning moonlight. His reawakening is not simply for..."
source_list: Reward for reaching the highest Reputation Level with 4 tribes

210213.name: Achievement: Endpoint
210213.desc: Namecard style.\nThe orbits of the true stars are traced in myriad rings across the night sky. A sea of blossom awaits the return of a single flower, anticipating the day when both hearts and petals shall become soft and tender.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Meetings in Outrealm: Series V"

210214.name: Achievement: Feline Fortune
210214.desc: Namecard style.\nYou want to know what the future holds? Then stay here and sit tight. Let this little kitty resist the urge to knock the crystal ball onto the ground, and steal the secrets of fate for you.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Imaginarium Theater: The Second Folio"

210215.name: Natlan: Return of the Flame
210215.desc: Namecard style.\nGive yourself over to the joy of the contest — for victor and vanquished shall earn honor in equal measure, with both belonging to the flames of the night.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Natlan: The Land of Fire and Competition (I)"

210216.name: Achievement: Lord of the Night
210216.desc: Namecard style.\nHow can restless thoughts be calmed? In this land, the only way is battle!
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Duelist: Series I"

210217.name: Travel Notes: Primal Fire
210217.desc: Namecard style.\nBut why green, brown, and purple? Shouldn't the first companions we meet be red, green, and blue, or... yellow?

210218.name: Celebration: Crispy and Sweet
210218.desc: Namecard style.\nThis golden array of food is the perfect balance of salty and sweet.

210219.name: Xilonen: Cue Point
210219.desc: Namecard style.\nRight on cue, the mountains echo with the rhythm of Xilonen's forge-hammer. When the final echo fades, she has already long ceased her toil and found a sunlit spot for her afternoon nap.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Xilonen

210220.name: Travel Notes: Sabzeruz
210220.desc: Namecard style.\n"Twelve moons and twelve more, new memories will grow."

210221.name: Chasca: Fully Loaded
210221.desc: Namecard style.\nFear not, she's here to make peace, not to fight. The only question is whether to save a few bullets... Y'know, the type that get fired into the sky as warning shots.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Chasca

210222.name: Ororon: Nightshade
210222.desc: Namecard style.\nJust as starlight cannot overpower the darkness of night, so too do shadows linger beneath the candle's light. Likewise, the heart's emptiness cannot easily be filled.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Ororon

210223.name: Natlan: Fleeting Dreams
210223.desc: Namecard style.\nBefore one could become a sage among dragons, or a king among men, the ploys of one's ambition would have long since turned to naught but dreams. Yet to be incomplete is good; superior, in fact, to perfection.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Natlan: The Land of Fire and Competition (II)"

210224.name: Achievement: Fighting Spirit
210224.desc: Namecard style.\nEven if one was to lose their physical form and find themselves trapped in the cold depths of some ghostly spring, the will to fight on shall never fade away.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Duelist: Series II"

210225.name: Travel Notes: Spiritweaver
210225.desc: Namecard style.\nThe reason that the Masters of the Night-Wind are able to record stories in their scrolls is very simple — that everything in this world has its warp and weft. All that has been is no less than the very fabric of existence.

210226.name: Mavuika: Sun-Crowned
210226.desc: Namecard style.\nNo Pyro Archon has ever intended to contest the sun. But as ordinary people see it, this "solar ring" is the crown of leaders as radiant as the sun.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Mavuika

210227.name: Citlali: Opalstar
210227.desc: Namecard style.\nThe black one is akin to obsidian, and is thus called "Itzpapa." The white one is white as a star, and has thus been named "Citlalin."
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Citlali

210228.name: Lan Yan: Silver Swallow
210228.desc: Namecard style.\nThe swallow's arrival shall bring forth cleansing rains, washing the worries of wizened winter away.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Lan Yan

210229.name: Achievement: All-Seeing
210229.desc: Namecard style.\nThe gaze of a traveler looks upon all like a light, and your impression of things will someday resurface in your mind in vivid, intense color.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Mortal Travails: Series V"

210230.name: Achievement: Blaze
210230.desc: Namecard style.\nAfter the flame that once represented light, heat, and wisdom became corroded by the tenebrous dark, the only thing that yet belonged to the imprisoned titan was its inextinguishable will to fight.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Challenger: Series X"

210231.name: Achievement: Repertoire
210231.desc: Namecard style.\nPerhaps a melody may exist that collects and contains all the wondrous music in the world. Surging heartbeats mark the musical phrase, anxious thoughts form brief rests, and within the notes lie all things — laughter, tears, forgotten dreams, and dancing raindrops...
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Repertoire of Myriad Melodies"

210232.name: Travel Notes: The Flame Renewed
210232.desc: Namecard style.\nThe spring comes on sure, and old peach wood charms must be burned. Raise your cups of herbal wine in toast, then exchange those old talismans for new ones.
210232.special: "Travel Notes: The Flame Renewed" namecard style

210233.name: Yumemizuki Mizuki: Nightmare Devourer
210233.desc: Namecard style.\nThe yumekui-baku consume nightmares and leave only pleasant dreams. But what if dreams are to be understood in reverse? Faced with such conjecture, her warm-natured response: A truly beautiful dream, even if turned upside down through reality's lens, would still remain beautiful.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Yumemizuki Mizuki

210234.name: Celebration: Scorch
210234.desc: Namecard style.\nThe secret to unleashing a powerful attack is to pull back your fist and then strike out with unwavering conviction.
source_list: Obtained from the "Realm of Tempered Valor" event

210235.name: Travel Notes: Wondrous Reverie
210235.desc: Namecard style.\nAs flowers bloom and distant songs fade, faint traces of dreams remain.

210236.name: Varesa: Powerhouse
210236.desc: Namecard style.\nWhat could possibly be the secret to her immense strength? D'you think it's got something to do with her nigh-on insatiable appetite...?
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Varesa

210237.name: Iansan: Unyielding
210237.desc: Namecard style.\n"If you really need to, and you push yourself hard enough, you can even train in your dreams!" Sounds great, but... Is it actually possible?
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Iansan

210238.name: Natlan: Draconic Gaze
210238.desc: Namecard style.\nHaving once beheld the old world in all its glory, these draconic eyes now shine with fresh vigor, heralding the dawn of a new one.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Sacred Mountain's Fading Glow."

210239.name: Achievement: Tranquil Peace
210239.desc: Namecard style.\nIf ever the day comes when all worldly conflicts can finally be put to rest, then even the gods of night themselves may drift off into peaceful slumber.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Duelist: Series III"

210240.name: Travel Notes: Blooming Glory
210240.desc: Namecard style.\nWe learn to fight through play and pursuit, to stand firm through wounds and hardship, and with that strength, set forth for the very limits of the world.

210241.name: Escoffier: Charm
210241.desc: Namecard style.\nFor Escoffier, a certain relationship exists between rhythm and flavor. Why, then, does she not fuel her compositions with delicious food? The answer is quite simple — consistent flavors are reliable and comforting, but no one wants to hear the same song over and over.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Escoffier

210242.name: Ifa: Bro
210242.desc: Namecard style.\n"'Is there any point in getting close to Ifa?' Of course there is, bro, absolutely." "Of course there is, bro, of course there is."
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Ifa

210243.name: Travel Notes: Balletica
210243.desc: Namecard style.\nScript supervisors perform a vital role. They record every detail of each scene to ensure continuity. Thinking about it, you're the best script supervisor there is — you already remember everything.

210244.name: Skirk: Lone Shadow
210244.desc: Namecard style.\nHer solitude is not some show meant to maintain an air of mystery. She was once the last rabbit left standing in the wildfire's wake — now, she's a lion in disguise, unable to speak her truth to the sheep.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Skirk

210245.name: Dahlia: Sacred Duty
210245.desc: Namecard style.\nIf the essence of being an "idol" is simply "being loved," then Dahlia might've found his sacred calling. Barbara still strives to perfect her image, while Dahlia need only guard his privacy — lest someone spot him sharing drinks with a certain bard...\n...Though that may not be as easy as it seems.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Dahlia

210246.name: Celebration: Lavish Gala
210246.desc: Namecard style.\nAmid the ticking countdown, the gala commences on schedule. After their masked waltz, the two set their separate schemes into motion...\nPerhaps this unspoken understanding is the true "treasure" to be cherished.

210247.name: Travel Notes: Speculation
210247.desc: Namecard style.\nShould chess pieces ever grow minds of their own, could they too force their players into awkward zugzwang?

210248.name: Ineffa: Command
210248.desc: Namecard style.\nThe household robot awaits your command, but Birgitta will keep her aim on you, silently urging you to choose your next words carefully. She does come equipped with a laser module, after all.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Ineffa

210249.name: Natlan: Wheel of Flame
210249.desc: Namecard style.\nThe stone wheel of the totem turns. Not just with the passage of time, but with the blazing of all souls.

210250.name: Natlan: Chasing the Wind
210250.desc: Namecard style.\nEven when the winds no longer sweep these broken plains, those who chase the breeze through the ashes will still remain.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "A Summer of Ash and Prickly Pears"

210251.name: Travel Notes: Easy Breezy
210251.desc: Namecard style.\nTime floats easy, light and free. You sway so breezy, just let it be. No rush to go, no need to know — just pick a poem and go with the flow.

210252.name: Celebration: Tuna On Rice
210252.desc: Namecard style.\nThe rotation is meant to display all the delicious food before you. The deliciousness, on the other hand, is meant to fill your heart with happiness.
source_list: Reward from the "Genshin Impact × Sushiro" collaboration

210253.name: Lauma: Branched Antlers
210253.desc: Namecard style.\nIn a distant land, there are legends of those who bear antlers. Antlers are said to be the outgrowth of wisdom too vast for the mind to contain, branching upward like the limbs of a tree. One can't help but wonder if Lauma's antlers were once soft and covered in velvet.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Lauma

210254.name: Flins: Oathkeeper's Lantern
210254.desc: Namecard style.\nAs the saying goes, "Will-o'-the-wisps are like love — most visible in the barren swamp, and just as likely to lead you into danger." Of course, the saying only relates to the natural phenomenon.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Flins

210255.name: Aino: Whoopsie Ducksie
210255.desc: Namecard style.\nWhen a "Cool Your Jets Ducky" is overheating, does Aino throw out another Ducky to cool its jets, or does she just say "Whoopsie Ducksie" and leave it at that?
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Aino

210256.name: Nod-Krai: Moonlight
210256.desc: Namecard style.\nOf the thousand nights before, none held a new moon as beautiful as the one we saw.
source_list: Obtained from completing all quests under "Selenic Chronicles: Part II"

210257.name: Nod-Krai: Sacred Realm
210257.desc: Namecard style.\nUnder the moonlight, people chase the tides, for they are the traces left behind by the rising new moon.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Nod-Krai: An Elysium of Moonlight and Wanderings (I)"

210258.name: Achievement: Time Apart
210258.desc: Namecard style.\nAfter ten thousand winters come ten thousand springs anew. After ten thousand partings, ten thousand reunions, too. The past has slipped away. Yet tomorrow holds the promise of you.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Meetings in Outrealm: Series VI"

210259.name: Travel Notes: Glacial Moon
210259.desc: Namecard style.\nThe moon's shadow stretches like a sea of ice, across which we journey. Amid shattered isles, the lost once longed deeply for a... new savior.

210260.name: Celebration: Sublime Flavors
210260.desc: Namecard style.\nSome say cooking a dish is a duel between a chef and a customer, and that the reward for the former's victory is the latter's satisfied smile.

210261.name: Nefer: Secrets
210261.desc: Namecard style.\nEven the ugliest victory is preferable to noble defeat. Unbesmirched innocence has no place amid the blood and sand. This is simply how the desert folk survive.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Nefer

210262.name: Travel Notes: Bygone Ruins
210262.desc: Namecard style.\nHidden beyond time and veiled in eternal shadow, the one who embraces the silent spring of dreams with riddles awaits the world's answer in the wake of a falling star.

210263.name: Durin: Radiant Heart
210263.desc: Namecard style.\nThe ceaseless drumming in his chest reminds him thus: "You carry the hopes of a distant past. Your soul is resplendent and nascent, and within you burns a fervor no winter blizzard can quench."
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Durin

210264.name: Jahoda: Helping Hand
210264.desc: Namecard style.\n"Whenever things get too busy, I wish I could borrow Jahoda's hand!" — Surely that means the owner of said "lendable hand" is both agile and reliable, right?
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Jahoda

210265.name: Travel Notes: Blazing Snow
210265.desc: Namecard style.\nWhen braving wind, snow, and rain, what truly matters isn't sheer bravery alone, but the careful discernment to find the right path forward.

210266.name: Celebration: Dream Reader
210266.desc: Namecard style.\nThey say that one's dreams at night reflect one's thoughts by day. Perhaps the same goes for the books one reads... Though that probably doesn't count as a nightmare. Probably.

210267.name: Columbina: Someday
210267.desc: Namecard style.\nShe dances in the shallows of clear streams and drifts with the current, falling asleep beneath the pale shadows of the mountains. She wanders through the ripples of time, playing hide-and-seek with the kuuhenki.\nShe rests in the garden of all things, humming softly to every living creature. In the quiet hours before dawn, she waits for the day of their reunion.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Columbina

210268.name: Zibai: Veiled Vista
210268.desc: Namecard style.\nHeaven and earth are but a wayfarer's lodge, and time a wanderer passing through the ages.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Zibai

210269.name: Illuga: Nightmare Songbird
210269.desc: Namecard style.\nHaving braved the darkness of night, the nightingale pours its ardor into the bright world of day, and sears the nightmares with fierce fury.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Illuga

210270.name: Achievement: Far-Sighted
210270.desc: Namecard style.\nThe traveler once stood atop the town, gazing toward the distant horizon, confident that the far-off sights within view would one day become milestones in the journey ahead.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Mortal Travails: Series VI"

210271.name: Nod-Krai: Lantern of Longest Night
210271.desc: Namecard style.\nIn the blackest of nights, a lamp shall rise, tonight, and for a thousand nights beyond.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Nod-Krai: An Elysium of Moonlight and Wanderings (II)"

210272.name: Travel Notes: Lanternlit Ode
210272.desc: Namecard style.\nPray for me a bright moon, wish me a fair day. Clad in my spring cloak, I follow moonbeams' sway.

210273.name: Varka: Lead Wolf
210273.desc: Namecard style.\nThe pack of wolves chased the northern wind, but only the leader knew that the wind had already begun swirling at their paws the moment they started running.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Varka.

210274.name: Travel Notes: Northerly Winds
210274.desc: Namecard style.\nIt was something the wind could bring from the north: a hint of cold, the last faint scent of the flowers before they would fall from their perches, and the news that a traveler from afar would soon return.

210275.name: Linnea: Rattling Resonance
