210275.desc: Namecard style.\nLinnea had long assumed the rhythmic clatter coming from Lumi was merely the compression of frozen snow. But then came the day Lumi reached behind her back and produced — a pair of maracas.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Linnea

210276.name: Mondstadt: Watchtower
210276.desc: Namecard style.\nAfter being stuffed with all sorts of oddities, Segment-Domain Tau looked less like a vault than ever. Ever since her departure, it had been transformed from a temple into a watchtower, yearning for its mistress to come home.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Demon Mountain's Breath."

210277.name: Empty Temple: Overflowing Memories
210277.desc: Namecard style.\nMemory Factors are the building blocks of civilization. Even so, an archive brimming with them cannot replicate the high price of an antique — simply because it lacks the "weathering."

210278.name: Travel Notes: Homecoming
210278.desc: Namecard style.\nEverything in this world holds its own past and its own secrets. Tell me, can you see the lingering gaze of those who once cherished these artifacts?

210279.name: Nicole: Heavenly Stairway
210279.desc: Namecard style.\nOnce, Nicole still bore a form close to that of a human, making her way down the stairway step by step. Whatever else it was, it seemed far more dignified than falling or being cast down. Silent all the while, she passed beneath the sky and into a city that no longer belonged to angels.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Nicole

210280.name: Lohen: Benevolence
210280.desc: Namecard style.\n"Benevolence" may be the last word anyone would use to describe Lohen. Then again, even the sharpest thorns grow from gentle soil.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Lohen

210281.name: Prune: Judgment
210281.desc: Namecard style.\n"If I ever write my memoirs, the title will obviously be The Iron Hammer That Punished the Wicked Witch! It's only fitting for a life as grand and eventful as mine!" Though in fairness, that "grand and eventful life" has only spanned a few short years.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Prune

210283.name: Travel Notes: Gift of Splendor
210283.desc: Namecard style.\nA gift box is meant to stir up anticipation. But these little ones were never going to stop there — what's inside is nothing less than a beyond-expectations surprise!
210283.special: "Travel Notes: Gift of Splendor" namecard style

210284.name: Sandrone: Tea Break
210284.desc: Namecard style.\nSandrone may have learned to enjoy tea parties from Alain. In those days, even a tea break for two never felt dull. But later, when there were finally enough people for a proper tea party, they left one after another. And in their absence, she seemed to come a little closer to the loneliness Alain had known.
source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship Lv. 10 with Sandrone

210285.name: Nod-Krai: Moonbright
210285.desc: Namecard style.\nThe moon before my eyes is the moon above, and the figure upon it is the one I hold dear. I look up, as if to meet the moon, only to wonder whether my beloved sees me there.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Unfettered Crescent."

210286.name: Travel Notes: Sunny Summer
210286.desc: Namecard style.\nSometimes, it's okay to go with the flow. Let go of your exhaustion and worries, and allow things to unfold as they will. Like waking from a long dream, you may find the world there, ready to embrace you in our place.

source_list: Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Odette
Reward for reaching Friendship 10 with Alyosha

210289.name: Achievement: Resplendence
210289.desc: Namecard style.\nWhenever I recall that outstretched hand at the start of our journey, the lake becomes adrift with falling Inteyvats.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Meetings in Outrealm: Series VII"

210290.name: Snezhnaya: Long Night
210290.desc: Namecard style.\nWith our own hands, we raise fortresses against the frost — all to cross the endless night, to catch the chords of songs yet unsung, and to ensure that you and I might still watch the fresh snow fall, winter after winter.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Snezhnaya: Sacred city of ice and pale star (I)"

210291.name: Achievement: Treading Snow
210291.desc: Namecard style.\nSnowflakes alight in the Traveler's palm, only to melt away moments later. Whilst some stories have already concluded, their memories remain forever etched in the Traveler's heart.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Mortal Travails: Series VII"

210292.name: Snezhnaya: Fleeting Glimpses
210292.desc: Namecard style.\nCountless people wander through narratives without beginning or end. Surpass them, for your will to see the ending is stronger than that of anyone else.
source_list: Complete all Special Recruitment Plan: Cycle Training quests to obtain.

210293.name: Achievement: Enigmatic Core
210293.desc: Namecard style.\nOmens of suffering always appear like bubbles rising to the surface.
source_list: Reward for completing all achievements under "Land of Surging Shadows."

210294.name: Travel Notes: Frostfarer
210294.desc: Namecard style.\nOnce the long snowstorm has passed, the skies will clear.

215001.name: Echo: Dandelion Knight
215001.desc: Jean's Envisaged Echo flutters like dandelions in the wind, swirling about her, accompanying her on her resolute journey.

215002.name: Echo: Icy Resurrection
215002.desc: Qiqi's Envisaged Echo. The Heralds of Frost often come to visit and do calisthenic exercises together with her.

215003.name: Echo: Eclipsing Star
215003.desc: Ningguang's Envisaged Echo is shaped like gilded ginkgo leaves, noble and elegant.

215004.name: Echo: Cat Upon the Eaves
215004.desc: Kirara's Envisaged Echo. Wherever cat claws nimbly tread, blooming flowers there shall spread.

215005.name: Echo: Dark Side of Dawn
215005.desc: Diluc's Envisaged Echo. The night owl's pinions ignite, that a corner of the darkness may have light.

215006.name: Echo: Vago Mundo
215006.desc: Zhongli's Envisaged Echo. "Waste not the mountain spring, for no order governs wandering for leisure."

215007.name: Echo: Driving Thunder
215007.desc: Keqing's Envisaged Echo. "Swift thunder questioned new boughs last night, this morn the rainbow drove clouds to flight."

215008.name: Echo: Plenilune Gaze
215008.desc: Ganyu's Envisaged Echo. "Proceed with elegance, avoid certain peril."

215009.name: Echo: Scarlet Leaves Pursue Wild Waves
215009.desc: Kaedehara Kazuha's Envisaged Echo. "Flowers and birds are a dear pleasure to one winding under the moonlight."

215010.name: Echo: Windborne Bard
215010.desc: Venti's Envisaged Echo. "As free as the wind, I shall sing now the praises of things beauteous and true."

215011.name: Echo: Flame-Mane
215011.desc: Dehya's Envisaged Echo. "The eyes of a vulture, the spirit of a lion, an unbridled daughter of the desert."

215012.name: Echo: Plane of Euthymia
215012.desc: Raiden Shogun's Envisaged Echo. "The drawn bow is like the quartered moon, and studying the blade is like a circle of transparent jade. Now, the truth of jade lies beyond reach, my only companion the moonlit shades."

215013.name: Echo: Lonesome Transcendence
215013.desc: Shenhe's Envisaged Echo. "From the world she seems apart, but there are those who know her heart."

215014.name: Echo: Valley Orchid
215014.desc: Yelan's Envisaged Echo. "Stealthily she roams the night, stars shining upon her in the skies."

215015.name: Echo: Physic of Purity
215015.desc: Nahida's Envisaged Echo. "Share in my knowledge."

215016.name: Echo: Kreideprinz
215016.desc: Albedo's Envisaged Echo. "From blazing nigredo, the Solar Isotoma blossoms."

215017.name: Echo: Fleeing Sunlight
215017.desc: Klee's Envisaged Echo. "Da-da-da~ The Spark Knight's off on an adventure!"

215018.name: Echo: Frostflake Heron
215018.desc: Kamisato Ayaka's Envisaged Echo. "Do not speak of winter as void of color, the white snow falls and fills every corner."

215019.name: Echo: Pillar of Fortitude
215019.desc: Kamisato Ayato's Envisaged Echo. "Who says the autumn streams run cold, fallen blooms still drift and fold."

215020.name: Echo: Eons Adrift
215020.desc: Wanderer's Envisaged Echo. "Like the breeze, he lives in this world, and he walks its length and breadth."

215021.name: Echo: Helm of the Radiant Rose
215021.desc: Navia's Envisaged Echo. "Blind optimism isn't the answer — if you want a bright future, you have to go out and seize it with your own two hands!"

215022.name: Echo: Childe
215022.desc: Tartaglia's Envisaged Echo. "A flaw — here one moment, gone the next."

215023.name: Echo: Vigilant Yaksha
215023.desc: Xiao's Envisaged Echo. "Purge evil through battle — to this we dedicate our lives."

216001.name: Faint Glow
216001.desc: When stars first ascend from a corner of the sky, their colors are as subtle as a whisper of darkness.
source_list: Obtained by meeting specific requirements in "Valiant Chronicles"

216002.name: First Light
216002.desc: The first light is always faint, but the seed of its glow is already sown within, awaiting only the moment to flourish.
source_list: Obtained by meeting specific requirements in "Valiant Chronicles"

216003.name: Glimmering Glory
216003.desc: Rise in the dying night where no light remains, ignite hope in those who chase the dawn, and blaze through the darkness that the sun cannot reach.
source_list: Obtained by meeting specific requirements in "Valiant Chronicles"

216004.name: Brimming Spiritflow
216004.desc: It is light shining from above, and a gentle glow flowing from the heart. Lost children chase dreams of delicate moonlight. Amid the endless cycle of day and night, this place remains the only Elysium left in time.
source_list: Obtained by meeting specific requirements in "Valiant Chronicles"

216005.name: Keen Edge
216005.desc: Even after hundreds of hard-fought battles, it remains as keen as a freshly forged blade, its edge undiminished.
source_list: Obtained by meeting specific requirements in "Edge of Survival"

216006.name: Siege Breach
216006.desc: Like a heavy bullet, it punches through defenses and shatters the enemy's lines.
source_list: Obtained by meeting specific requirements in "Edge of Survival"

216007.name: Tempered Iron
216007.desc: Make adversity your crucible, forging the will to crush mighty foes and honing battle skills that none can withstand.
source_list: Obtained by meeting specific requirements in "Edge of Survival"

216008.name: First Snow
216008.desc: The endless snow falling with the light of dawn is nothing but drifting debris as the firmament breaks apart.
source_list: Obtained by meeting specific requirements in "Valiant Chronicles"

216009.name: Crystalline Frost
216009.desc: The north wind carries the breath of the first freeze, the eternal singing of the King of Winter Icelea's maidens. Let the world be held still in this moment forever! Only that wish was ever granted.
source_list: Obtained by meeting specific requirements in "Valiant Chronicles"

216010.name: Snowbound
216010.desc: Cold, silent streets and temples, layered corridors and palace halls, lie buried beneath a seal of ice that never melts. Under the reign of the King of Winter Icelea, the ever-frozen land quietly welcomes its end without end.
source_list: Obtained by meeting specific requirements in "Valiant Chronicles"

216011.name: Everwinter
216011.desc: The once grand and solemn ancient capital became a playground for the Jack Frost. All things lay sealed beneath the vast snow, as if for eternity. Only the sly Jack Frost knew that, when winter reaches its end, spring will return to the earth once more.
source_list: Obtained by meeting specific requirements in "Valiant Chronicles"

220001.name: Anemoculus Resonance Stone
220001.desc: A stone that can be used in Mondstadt to search for nearby Anemoculi.\nThis man-made stone plate possesses a certain characteristic similar to that of the Anemo Statues of The Seven, giving it the power to resonate with Anemoculi.\nOculus Resonance Stones are crude imitations of the Statues of The Seven constructed by the ancients. But it is precisely this crudeness that makes them crave the power of elemental oculi, thus providing devout worshippers and adventurers alike a prime opportunity to collect oculi.

220002.name: Geoculus Resonance Stone
220002.desc: A stone that can be used in Liyue to search for nearby Geoculi.\nThis exquisite stone plate imitates a certain mysterious quality of the Geo Statues of The Seven, causing it to lead people to the location of Geoculi.\nElemental Oculi represent the lost power of the Statues of The Seven — perhaps offering this power back to the statues also has significance for the lands that the gods watch over.

220003.name: Geo Treasure Compass
220003.desc: A compass that can be used in Liyue to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.\nThe land of Geo is rich with valuable resources, with treasures hidden throughout the mountains and wilderness just waiting to be found.

220004.name: Wind Catcher
220004.desc: A bottle that is able to hold Anemograna and use their energy to generate wind currents.\nThis item was designed by Knights of Favonius scholars to help the Knights on their scouting expeditions and travels by affording them the ability to better use the blessings of the Anemo God.\nIn order to take advantage of its wind currents with a wind glider, you technically need a gliding license — this has prevented it from becoming widely used, at least legally anyway.

220005.name: Portable Waypoint
220005.desc: Use this to create a temporary Teleport Waypoint at your current location. Only one can exist at a time.\nA pocket-sized item that creates a temporary Teleport Waypoint. It is capable of connecting with the ley lines, at least to the extent necessary to bring about teleportation.\nAlthough it offers an incredible convenience to Vision bearers, the actual principles behind Teleport Waypoints are not yet fully understood. We can only hope that using them does not cause any undesirable side effects...

220006.name: Adepti Seeker's Stove
220006.desc: A portable stove that can be quickly set up for cooking in the environment. If you enter into combat nearby, it will be destroyed.\nLiyue's terrain is vast, varied, and at times even inhospitable — and yet all its inhabitants share a love of good food. These two phenomena would not be able to coexist were it not for portable cooking equipment like this. Whether you are scaling the heights of Jueyun Karst or exploring the islets of Guyun Stone Forest, bringing a portable stove means that a delicious and freshly cooked hot meal is always available at a moment's notice.

220007.name: Condensed Resin
220007.desc:
You can hold no more than 5 at a time.
Condensed tree resin that can be used instead of Original Resin to revitalize Petrified Trees and Ley Line Blossoms to receive greater rewards.
Crystal filled with immense energy.
The silver-white Irminsul trees and blossoms are connected to ley lines that have become blocked over time. The energy contained in tree resin can purify the obstructing substance.

220008.name: NRE (Menu 30)
220008.desc: A handy meal-in-a-pouch that can transform most foods into instantly absorbable nutritional matter. Despite the fact that it can greatly increase the efficiency of nutritional intake, most knights aren't too keen to put their food in it...

220009.name: Anemo Treasure Compass
220009.desc: A compass that can be used in Mondstadt to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.\nThe needle of the Treasure Compass doesn't spin according to the world's magnetic field, but rather follows the energy of ley lines to lead the user to treasure.

220013.name: Treasure-Seeking Seelie
220013.desc: A small and special Seelie, particularly sensitive to the presence of Iron Coins.\nA companion entrusted to you by Ulman. Seelie are naturally inclined to guide people, though this Seelie seems weaker than usual, and possesses a remarkable obsession with Iron Coins...

220014.name: Mini Seelie: Dayflower
220014.desc: A memento from the Lost Riches event. Equip it to obtain a mini Seelie companion.\nA miniature sea-blue Seelie. Unlike other Seelie, it does not serve to guide others, but to follow them to see the world.

220015.name: Mini Seelie: Rosé
220015.desc: A memento from the Lost Riches event. Equip it to obtain a mini Seelie companion.\nA miniature powder-pink Seelie. Though it cannot say a word, it will silently follow a traveler that strikes its fancy around the world.

220016.name: Mini Seelie: Curcuma
220016.desc: A memento from the Lost Riches event. Equip it to obtain a mini Seelie companion.\nA miniature golden Seelie. It gives off a feeling very similar to that of Mora. They say that Seelie of this color represent good fortune.

220017.name: Warming Bottle
220017.desc: Upon use, emits heat for a short period over a small area, diminishing the effect of Sheer Cold.\nWarming Seelie have evolved in response to the extreme change in temperature to give the comfort of warmth to those who seek it. This convenient gadget was originally crafted by those who struggled to survive in the snowy mountains in imitation of such evolved Seelie.

220018.name: Kamera
220018.desc: A convenient tool that records and saves images upon use.\nA special item from Fontaine that can record images. People and places to remember must come aplenty for a Traveler roaming the world.

220019.name: Kurious Kamera
220019.desc: Use this during the "Five Flushes of Fortune" event to store images of objects with a specific color.\nJi Tong imported this new-fangled Kamera model from Fontaine, but it doesn't seem to work quite as he'd hoped...

220020.name: Special Kamera
220020.desc: When used, this useful gadget can save and store the scenery before it and add a special color tone to it.\nA strange device from Fontaine that will not only record sceneries but will also add special colors to the printed images. This design was made in response to "The Steambird"'s request for a Kamera that could not only reflect the environment, but also the emotions of the one taking the picture. Unfortunately, the final product could not quite match their specifications.

220021.name: Parametric Transformer
220021.desc:
A device that can transmute materials placed within and convert them into some other materials.
·During the transmutation process, you must use <color=#3399CCFF>Elemental Attacks</color> to generate enough energy for the transmutation to take place.
·After obtaining the transmuted materials, you must wait seven days to use the Parametric Transformer once again.

This mysterious device, discovered within the ruins, has the power to accelerate cycles and "transmute" material objects. Generally speaking, everything is undergoing a cycle. Memories and elements surge within the ley lines, rotten fallen fruits return to the soil, and the trees born from the soil will one day bear their crystalline fruit...

220022.name: Inquisitive Endora
220022.desc: A strange Lochfolk larva, filled with curiosity about the world at large.\nLochfolk specialize in shifting into watery shapes and can meld with other water bodies to synchronize emotions and knowledge alike. Endora is still small, and Endora is very curious. Endora can spit out bubbles to meld with other beings of water, through which she shall learn everything.

220023.name: Endora
220023.desc: Just a very curious Lochfolk who only wishes to see the world. Might actually get along very well with Mini Seelie: Dayflower, but please do not meld them together, thank you.

220024.name: Windblume Festival Commemorative Balloon
220024.desc: Use this to release a balloon that can be popped.\nBalloons have special significance in the land of the wind, for they represent the freedom to drift with the wind. Of course, air pressure will destroy balloons once they've reached a certain height.

220025.name: Windsong Lyre
220025.desc: Use this traditional instrument from Mondstadt to play songs.\nAn instrument of incredible workmanship, it will surely produce moving music when played by able hands.\nMondstadt has a long-standing tradition of poetry and song, and thus also boasts a long history of constructing instruments to that effect. Bards are most proud of their songs and poems, and perhaps the instruments, too, would be proud of their owners and their musical tradition.

220026.name: Serenitea Pot
220026.desc: A teapot obtained from Madame Ping. There seems to be a whole new realm within it...

220027.name: Wind-Blessed Harpastum
220027.desc: A harpastum made from pure bird feathers and strong fabric. Perhaps it contains some strange power...

220028.name: Waverider Repair Toolbox
220028.desc: A toolbox filled with all manner of items that can be used to repair the damage done to a Waverider.\n·Restores 50% of a Waverider's structural integrity.\n·Has a 90s cooldown.

220029.name: Straight Shooter
220029.desc: A Harpastum Bomb with a comfortable weight that makes it easy to control and throw accurately. It can deal a large amount of Pyro DMG to a single opponent.

220030.name: Floaty Splody
220030.desc: A Harpastum Bomb of cunning design that sends fragments flying every which way when it explodes, dealing a certain amount of Pyro DMG over a wide AoE.

220031.name: Hot Pod
220031.desc: A Harpastum Bomb brimming with Pyro energy. When unleashed, it will burst into violent flame, dealing a small amount of Pyro DMG over a small AoE. It is extraordinarily effective against Cryo shields.

220032.name: Electroculus Resonance Stone
220032.desc: A stone that can be used in Inazuma to search for nearby Electroculi.\nThis strange device can resonate with Electro Statues of The Seven. Due to this trait, it can detect the presence of Electroculi.\nAcross the span of endless years, even the most majestic cities and sculptures would be worn down by wind and rain, and even the power of Statues of The Seven would gradually dissipate. But this faded strength would coalesce once more into the Oculi, which call out wordlessly to their Statues.

220033.name: Seed Dispensary
220033.desc: A special container obtained from Madame Ping. According to her, this dispensary has the power to "generate seeds"... That is to say, it can create the seeds of various plants according to their special traits, which can then be planted within the appropriate fields within your Serenitea Pot.\nPlants available for planting: Silk Flower, Sweet Flower, Cecilia, Glaze Lily, Windwheel Aster, Qingxin, Violetgrass, Valberry, Small Lamp Grass, Jueyun Chili, Carrot, Radish, Mint, Mushroom, Naku Weed, Horsetail, Snapdragon, Lotus Head, Calla Lily, Seagrass, Sea Ganoderma, Harra Fruit, Zaytun Peach, Sumeru Rose, Pluie Lotus, Marcotte, Lumidouce Bell, Rainbow Rose, Grainfruit, Cacahuatl, Saurian Claw Succulent, Quenepa Berry, Brilliant Chrysanthemum, Sprayfeather Gill, Glowing Hornshroom, Skysplit Gembloom, Frostlamp Flower, Midsommar Berry, Lakkaberry, Pine Amber, Winter Icelea, Frostfairy Flower, Flockingweed, Golden Fern, Red Beet, Rimecurrant, Snowball Flower.

220034.name: Electro Treasure Compass
220034.desc: A handy tool used to locate nearby treasure in Inazuma and relevant clues.\nThe land of the thundering archipelago has suffered a great many past hurts. The many treasure chests that dot the islands are a symbol of its revival from these wounds.

220035.name: Red Feather Fan
220035.desc: Use this to increase Gliding Movement SPD by 30% for 30s.\n\nThis item possesses some sort of mysterious power. In the hands of the tengu warriors, it can have various effects, but in the hands of an ordinary person, it can still have enough power to "make one's body lighter" while in mid-air.

220036.name: Memento Lens
220036.desc: A mysterious lens. If you view small fox statues with this lens, you can find things that were not there before.\nThey say that in the distant past, the legendary Kitsune Saiguu left a catalyst for the then-Hiiragi Clan head, Hiroshi, as a tool to be used in exorcisms.\nThe Hiiragis would have a special Kamera made to order from overseas with that catalyst mounted on its lens assembly, before giving it back to the Grand Narukami Shrine as a symbol of their friendship.

220037.name: Treasure-Seeking Seelie
220037.desc: A small and special Seelie, particularly sensitive to the presence of Iron Coins.\nA companion entrusted to you by Ulman. Seelie are naturally inclined to guide people, though this Seelie seems weaker than usual, and possesses a remarkable obsession with Iron Coins...

220038.name: Mini Seelie: Viola
220038.desc: A memento from the Lost Riches event. Equip it to obtain a mini Seelie companion.\nA miniature purple Seelie. Its color is very similar to that of Electro-infused items. Who knows if you might get a little tingle from poking it...

220039.name: Peculiar Pinion
220039.desc:
A strange feather.
It may be able to trigger some wondrous effects if used on Tsurumi Island.
Take this feather with you into the world.

You did promise him that you would, after all.

220040.name: Peculiar Pinion
220040.desc: After defeating the monster that made the apex of Amakumo Peak its home, you discovered this strange feather.\nIt fell from the Thunderbird that once inhabited Tsurumi Island, and is the original form of the Maushiro.\nIt may have some special properties on Tsurumi Island.

220042.name: Ayesha's Chaos Prospector
220042.desc: A handy tool that the researcher Ayesha created on the side while researching ancient relics. It can be used to detect such ancient relics buried underground. Due to its hasty production, however, its accuracy could stand to be improved. Users should beware that some unexpected things may occur while using this gadget...

220043.name: Omni-Ubiquity Net
220043.desc: A net that has been modified once again by Wakamurasaki using onmyoudou. She claims that it can detain the essence of small creatures before using the net itself as a medium to recreate their forms.

220044.name: Floral Zither
220044.desc: A musical instrument that can be used in performances.\nIt is made of rather unique materials, and its craftsmanship is quite different from the designs that are currently in vogue. An unpredictable strength has been woven into the ethereal strings that can even allow it to cause the illusions within the heart of its player to surface.\nThere is an old adage in Liyue: "the longer one's eye of the flower drinks, the deeper one's heart into the mire sinks." It seems that only the strong-willed may use this instrument.

220045.name: Shiki Koshou
220045.desc: A gift from Shiki Taishou: a replica armed with spiritual power. Though Shiki Koshou is incapable of charm magic, it is in contact with Shiki Taishou at all times and can share all that it has seen and heard with him, so it's almost like you've still got Shiki Taishou with you on your journey.

220046.name: Ubiquity Net
220046.desc: A friend of Sango's used Kamuna Onmyoudou in a fit of inspiration to create this convenient little gadget. It is not powerful enough to capture criminals, but with a little aim, capturing little animals should be a cinch.

220047.name: Launch Tube
220047.desc: A special device created by the artisan Pengyi. It comes with functions that allow for the creation and automated launch of fireworks. In the hands of someone creative, it will surely see great use in the creation of unique and radiant fireworks shows.

220048.name: Lumenstone Adjuvant
220048.desc:
When equipped in The Chasm's Underground Mines, this precious crystal can provide illumination.

It has many similarities to the Glazed Sand Crystal that may only be found within The Chasm, but it stores even greater power within it.
May it be as a sun in your palm, lighting the way through the lightless tunnels and bringing comfort where all is dark.

220049.name: Bokuso Box
220049.desc: Use this to clear a certain area in Enkanomiya of the darkness' influence.\nThe name "Bokuso" is formed from "boku," meaning "to draw near to what is good," and "so," meaning "to shun that which is tainted."

220051.name: Arataki's Great and Glorious Drum
220051.desc:
A musical instrument that can be used in performances.
A small drum that Itto gave you. He bought it from an outlander merchant, and while it does look quite normal, it is said to be a relic left behind by an ancient and powerful onmyouji who used it to drive out calamity and pray for blessings.
It would cost an ordinary person a large sum if they were to wish to possess this, but the price may be negotiated if one has some connection to the drum.
And wouldn't you know it? An 8,000,000 Mora treasure was eventually purchased for 80,000. What a steal for Itto, eh?

220052.name: Material Collector
220052.desc: A collection device created by Bertrand, a manufacturer of machines. It can sequentially collect materials required for creating other products. When hooked up to the Great Machine, it will pour the source materials into the latter and start the process of creating robotic furnishings.

220053.name: "Kusava"
220053.desc: Equip it to utilize the power of Aranara.\n"Fatty fruit, bitter fruit."\nA temporary home for Aranara memories. Kusava makes Aranara strong.

220055.name: Aranyaka
220055.desc: Arama handed this book over to you.\nIt seems to have witnessed the passage of many years. By the look of things, someone used to keep records in it, but none of that can be retrieved now.\nUse it to document your shared adventure with Arama.

220056.name: Casket of Tomes
220056.desc: A box for cards released by the Genius Invokation TCG Society. Only beginners who have learned the basic rules and are verified as players can collect one.\nThey say that these boxes were made by researchers from the Sumeru Akademiya, and that they feature a special mechanism that can be used to detect nearby people who also possess Caskets of Tomes.\nUse this function to engage in more matches against nearby players!

220057.name: Dendroculus Resonance Stone
220057.desc: A stone that can be used in Sumeru to search for nearby Dendroculi.\nA curious amulet of a similar nature to the Dendro Statues of The Seven. By the same token, it is drawn to Dendroculi.\nIn the world, there are grass and trees, vines and flowers — living beings of Dendro Element that abound in diverse shapes and forms. Though differing in appearance and various other aspects, they were born from the same land and will return to the same land.

220058.name: Dendro Treasure Compass
220058.desc: A compass that can be used in Sumeru to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.\nFor some people, the significance of life lies in exploration and discovery. Upon reaching each destination, there is always bountiful treasure awaiting.

220059.name: "The Boon of the Elder Tree"
220059.desc: A talisman that can help collect wood.\nTalismans of this kind are often seen in the forests in Sumeru. They possess the ability to gather the power of grass and trees.\nTo prevent the erosion of the forest and, in darker times, to resist the invasion of vicious monsters, trees and vines would form impregnable shelters together. Those who held "the Boon of the Elder Tree" were recognized by the forest as its friends and thus gained unfettered access to walk amidst the forest under the guidance of streams and moonlight. But that is archaic lore from a long, long time ago.
source_list: Purchase from the blacksmith in Mondstadt or Liyue

220060.name: Ultra-Hot Burner Lamp Test Model
220060.desc: A gadget that improves the efficiency of food processing by consuming minerals.\nYoung Akademiya researchers are accustomed to cooking with their experimental instruments. Someone invented an "Ultra-Hot Burner Lamp" that utilizes the energy of minerals to juice up the heat, all the better to save time and increase cooking efficiency.\nThe one you have is a test model for civilian use with power constraints and a dimmer flame, which should reduce its fire hazard rating. Even so, this convenient gadget is still perfectly capable of cooking jam and drying sausages with ease.

220061.name: Treasure-Seeking Seelie
220061.desc: The "Treasure-Seeking Seelie" you got from Ulman. It doesn't look that energetic...

220062.name: Mini Seelie: Moss
220062.desc: A memento from the Lost Riches event. Equip it to obtain a mini Seelie companion.\nA miniature green Seelie. It becomes most happy indeed when it gets close to a tree.

220063.name: Exquisite Kamera
220063.desc: A Kamera that Razi borrowed from Lord Sangemah Bay. It will come in handy when you take photos of beautiful scenery, look for inspiration in the wilderness, or wish to keep festive memories!\nThis Kamera is adorned with metal decorations and thus looks a lot more expensive than regular Kameras. Be careful with it!\nAccording to the leasing agreement, it can only be used within Sumeru's borders.

220064.name: Banu's Wisdom
220064.desc: In some cosmological settings, this is a staff filled with mystical power. It can resonate with the Future Stars and show the way to them.\nOf course, in some other settings, it might be an object kept in storage by an organization known as the Akademiya, and perhaps its recorded name might even be Ayesha's Chaos Prospector. There is a thin layer of dust over this object due to a long period of disuse.

220065.name: Fishing Line Stabilizer
220065.desc:
A self-adaptive tension stabilizer that can be installed on a fishing rod to facilitate fishing. The device can automatically detect and record how hard different fish struggle. The more data it collects, the better the stabilizer works.

The device's prototype was the pointless invention of a Fontaine inventor that drew little interest for the longest time until the Fontaine Fishing Association discovered it and modified the product into the fishing line stabilizer used today. When the device first came out, it was most warmly received by the Association members, and now it has gradually been promoted in other regions.
It is an exceptionally hot commodity in the Snezhnayan market. Word has it that one of the Lord Harbingers is particularly fond of the product, which explains the hype.

220066.name: Vintage Lyre
220066.desc: Use this traditional instrument from Mondstadt to play songs. It may work wonders when played in the forests of Sumeru.\nA vintage lyre borrowed from Amadhiah in Vimara Village.\nMondstadt has a long-standing tradition of poetry and song. Bards from there tend to address their instruments as "Friend" or "Partner." Thus, one of them trusting Amadhiah with the instrument was nothing less than a gesture of intimacy and trust.

220067.name: Jumpy Dumpty Party Popper
220067.desc: A party popper that, when used, unleashes streamers and confetti.\n"Jumpy Dumpty is Klee's good friend and fish blasting companion! But if Klee brings Jumpy Dumpty to the festival, Master Jean will be angry... Don't you worry, though! Jumpy Dumpty has gained a new ability with Albedo's help! Just pull on its tail, and beautiful colored strips will come flying out!"

220069.name: Scarlet Sand Slate
220069.desc: This object has long been the subject of Akademiya Researcher Tirzad's research. Its etchings and craftsmanship indicate that it is a relic of King Deshret's civilization. It seems to have the power to command devices within ruins associated with King Deshret...

220070.name: "Bubbly Kamera"
220070.desc: When used, this useful gadget can save and store the scenery before it and add a special color tone to it.\nA strange device of unknown origin. The photos it takes have a peculiar effect. Who would've thought that a machine with no water inside could produce photos with jovial bubbles in them that lend them a sense of fantasy?\nA certain Cavalry Captain once described this machine as being able to "capture people's desire for cool and refreshing days."

220071.name: "Kusava"
220071.desc:
Equip it to utilize the power of Aranara.
"Fatty fruit, bitter fruit."
A temporary home for Aranara memories. Kusava makes Aranara strong.
Now inside it are stored the cherished memories of Aranakin, Aragaru, and Aranaga. The power within is ready to be unleashed at any minute for the sake of beloved friends.

220072.name: Jinni in the Magic Bottle — Liloupar
220072.desc:
Born from water lilies, Liloupar, the great Jinni, whose soul had been shattered due to an ancient punishment, was sealed in a transparent magic bottle.
Now, it seems that she has found a new master...

Although she only possesses a-hundred-millionth of her previous great power, she will use what is left of her to help her master pass through the hot sand and ancient ruins of the Desert of Hadramaveth.

220073.name: Wisdom Orb
220073.desc: A crucial item provided by the organizer of the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament. Use it to capture, accommodate, and command intelligent Fungi. Word has it that it was invented by a researcher named Kautilya. Only those who can wield this item skillfully are qualified to participate in the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament. That said, you cannot help but feel that some of this item's functions create a strong sense of déjà vu...

220074.name: Cloud Retainer's Damasked Device
220074.desc: Made from stacked paper, this lightweight device has the appearance of a bird, and fittingly, was given to you by Cloud Retainer.\nWhile it may be called a "device," you cannot see any traditional mechanical components here — well, not from the outside, anyway.\nIt seems that this adeptus' skills as a mechanist have improved even further...

220075.name: Wilderness Compass
220075.desc: A special compass obtained from the Adventurers' Guild. According to certain rumors, it might just offer you a sprinkle of extra luck...

220076.name: Sorush
220076.desc: As one of the Pari, the defenders of the land, Sorush aspires to become a Bloomguard who shall quell calamity.\nHaving formed a connection with one whom she trusts, Sorush now traverses the defiled land alongside her Yasnapati...

220077.name: Windblume Kamera
220077.desc: The Kamera you borrowed from Fassben. Be careful when using it. You don't want to break it, now...

220078.name: Festive Drum
220078.desc: A musical instrument that can be used in performances.\nA drum with a clear sound and unique design. It has an exquisite exterior and features intricate craftsmanship. High-quality materials have been used in its construction, with a view toward sound quality during performances, intonation and long-term wear and tear.\nIt is said that this small drum combines an Inazuman traditional instrument with some quirks of drums from other nations. When it plays certain tunes, it can even bring people good luck...

220079.name: Sorush
220079.desc: A Pari born in the Vourukasha Oasis, Sorush is a Bloomguard acknowledged by the Khvarena.\nHaving formed a connection with one whom she trusts, Sorush now traverses the land blessed by Khvarena alongside her Yasnapati...

220080.name: Search Compass
220080.desc: A "Search Compass" made to find relic replicas. As this device was adapted from one used to survey elemental energies, the localized elements present might disrupt its attempts to scan for those replicas...

220082.name: Flowing Joyspar
220082.desc: A marvelous crystal with spots of radiance that seems to be able to sense joyous emotions in a certain radius around it and lead people in the corresponding direction.\nUse this to find Joyeux Vouchers in a set AoE.

220083.name: Felicitous Joyspar
220083.desc: A marvelous crystal within which radiance flows like a river. It seems to be able to sense joyous emotions in a vast area and lead people in the corresponding direction.\nUse this to find all Joyeux Vouchers within the Veluriyam Mirage.

220084.name: Itty Bitty Octobaby
220084.desc: A type of tiny octopus that normally lives in the depths of the ocean.\nPerhaps out of an overabundance of curiosity, or a desire to travel, it begins to cruise throughout the seas while still extremely young. If it sees a creature it likes, it will follow it everywhere.\nBut who knows what it will be like when it grows up...

220085.name: Inscribed Mirror
220085.desc: A mirror-type gadget made by the Amurta researcher Lamiya. It can be linked to the animals' devices, which will reflect the animals' points of view in the mirror.

220086.name: Hydroculus Resonance Stone
220086.desc: A talisman that can be used in Fontaine to search for nearby Hydroculi.\nA curious talisman that possesses similar properties to the Hydro Statues of The Seven. It seems to be able to detect the Elemental Flow of Hydroculi.\nOculi are by nature scattered pieces of power belonging to the Statues of The Seven. Returning them to the Statues is therefore the reasonable, right, and lawful thing to do.

220087.name: Hydro Treasure Compass
220087.desc: A compass that can be used in Fontaine to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.\nThese chests scattered across Fontaine are not the lawful property of any individual or organization. In most circumstances, it is legal to claim the contents found within.

220088.name: Crystalfly Trap
220088.desc:
A Crystalfly Trap, developed by a senior researcher named Fawitzki from Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering.
After being properly deployed and inserting the required materials, this device will start working and lure Crystalflies inside.
Fawitzki once led research on "Low-Temperature Lighting Devices," which required a large amount of Crystal Cores as research materials, which led to the development of the Crystalfly Trap.
However, the project was suspended for various reasons.
"We are here to commemorate the diligent Mr. Fawitzki. We sincerely hope that there are those who will carry on his research. The Institute will provide maximum support in any areas deemed appropriate."
source_list: Purchase from the blacksmith in Mondstadt or Liyue

220089.name: Wind-Powered Wind Generator
220089.desc:
A wind generating device developed by Refait, senior researcher from Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering.
After being activated, this device can provide a strong lifting force for the Wind Glider user.
However, due to design limitations, the device requires utilizing significant wind power to activate. The wind energy required is approximately equal to that produced by the working Wind Glider.
"Umm... So you mean I can only activate this device when I'm already using the Wind Glider."
"But the only reason I even want to activate it is to give my Wind Glider a push!"

220090.name: Bresson's Special Kamera
220090.desc: A Kamera specially modified by Bresson. It was manufactured with the best materials available, and has excellent performance.

220091.name: Portable Aerodynamic Gelatinous Bubble Generator
220091.desc:
A mechanism that can be used to create large amounts of colloid bubbles.

Givalois, a researcher from the Fontaine Research Institute, developed this prototype.
The original purpose was to create a large generator of gelatinous bubbles. Just as the project aimed to do, the bubbles so produced could carry some amount of water within them, and move or hover stably in the air, potentially achieving the aim of being able to quickly transport water resources.
However, as they were never able to find a material to make gelatinous bubbles of this type, the project stalled at the prototype stage.
But it is said the researcher Givalois's children loved this prototype bubble machine, so perhaps it would be possible to sell it as a toy?

"This machine is a product of Daddy's research, and it's called the Portable Aerodynamic Gelatinous Bubble Generator..."
"Bubbles! So pretty! Daddy, you're amazing!"

220093.name: "Special Analysis Zoom Lens"
220093.desc: A new type of Kamera accessory developed to enhance image recognition capabilities.\nAfter equipping this accessory, a normal Kamera can quickly adjust its focus, allowing it to capture images of your travels so you can record precious memories at a moment's notice.

220094.name: Image Sampling Kamera
220094.desc: A Kamera specially modified by Lepine-Pauline for the profound discipline of "Graph Adversarial Technology." It is unknown just what kind of complex and expensive components are installed inside, but it seems to be able to capture the photograph subject's particular structure, profile, and coloration...

220095.name: Treasure-Seeking Seelie
220095.desc: A Treasure-Seeking Seelie obtained from Ulman. It is said that it can move freely underwater, even though it doesn't look very energetic right now...

220096.name: Mini Seelie: Brilliance
220096.desc: A memento from Lost Riches. Equip the Seelie to gain its company.\nA mini Seelie with brilliant colors, it can move freely underwater.

220097.name: Nightwind Horn
220097.desc: This exquisite horn is a Fontainian instrument that can be used in performances, and was a gift from Dvorak to you.\nThey say the tones of the horn are both rich and mellow as well as gentle, like a gentle evening breeze blowing among a thicket of trees. So, Fontainian composers often use horns to vividly bring the imagery of hunters and forests to life. Without a doubt, this instrument is eminently suited to a musical gala celebrating "life."

220098.name: "Fateometer"
220098.desc: A deceptively grandiose-looking card box that is actually quite simple. The number drawn seems to indicate a certain direction of fate, or perhaps the success or failure of a certain choice...\n"As long as you believe in your bond with the cards, the numbers shown will show your fate." — Since Lyney said that, let's just tentatively take his word with a shaker of salt.

220099.name: Jocund Letters
220099.desc: Letter paper emanating a faint magical glow, and a finely crafted quill. With this in hand, elegant, ebullient words shall flow across the page of their own accord, writing detailed descriptions of certain objects' locations, and seemingly hinting at the location of treasure...\nAfter using this item, you can detect "Excerpts of Bliss" within a certain AoE inside Simulanka.

220100.name: Joyous Letters
220100.desc: Letter paper that radiates a magical glow, and a masterfully crafted quill. With this in hand, elegant, ebullient words shall flow across the page of their own accord, writing detailed descriptions of certain objects' locations, and seemingly hinting at the location of treasure...\nAfter using this item, you can detect all "Excerpts of Bliss" within Simulanka.

220101.name: "Yelena"
220101.desc: A sample of the perfume Emilie made herself. It is based on the legendary "Auguste" fragrance chronicled in Fontaine's histories.\nTilt the bottle toward the sunlight and you will see this flowing line of graceful text: "Forget the past, and keep on living."

220102.name: Asagiri's Dedicated Fontaine Kamera
220102.desc: A Kamera you obtained from Asagiri. Use it to help her complete her work of gathering inspiration on her trip to Fontaine.\nThe Kamera is well-maintained, clearly showing that this artist paid as much attention to this key tool as she does her paints and brushes...

220103.name: Pyroculus Resonance Stone
220103.desc: A stone that can be used in Natlan to search for nearby Pyroculi.\nDuring its crafting, adjustments were made to imbue it with characteristics resembling those of the Pyro Statues of The Seven, allowing one to sense the blazing power of the Pyroculi through it.\nBy sacrificing oneself, the Pyroculi can be returned to the statue, reuniting the scattered flames. Perhaps the Resonance Stone deems this sacrifice to be worth it.

220104.name: Pyro Treasure Compass
220104.desc: A compass that can be used in Natlan to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.\nAmidst the turmoil and strife that wrack the land, many treasures throughout the vast Nation of Pyro have gone unaccounted for, all trace of their whereabouts lost.

220105.name: Firstborn Firesprite
220105.desc: A tiny lifeform that emerged from a flame within a shell.\nThere is something quite endearing about its over-reliance on the shell it found protecting it at the moment it gained its sentience — perhaps it feels secure in this closed-up world. After all, when its eggshell is completely enclosed, it reigns supreme in its own little universe.\nIt is said that in ancient times, the Primal Fire burned with a similar life force.

220106.name: Kaboom Box
220106.desc: A mechanism that continually absorbs the force it receives.\nApparently, when the power within reaches bursting point, it will explode in a dazzling display of fireworks. But the amount of force needed to trigger this explosion seems to vary each time... So why not take turns attacking it with your friends? They say that whoever makes it go "kaboom" will have extraordinarily good luck for the rest of the day.

220107.name: Graffiti Kamera
220107.desc: A "Graffiti Alliance" Kamera provided by "Dopey Dazzler." Functionally, it isn't much different from a standard Kamera. However, it's said that it can capture and record specific scenes and objects, serving as a repository for inspiration and source material for graffiti artists...

220108.name: Paimon's Kamera
220108.desc: A convenient gadget that records and saves images when used, this one belongs to Paimon. Back when you bought it, you haggled with the seller for ages before finally scoring a bargain on this custom Kamera, which Paimon keeps with great care. You recall that the seller included a thick photo album along with the Kamera too, but you've barely seen her take it out. Just what kind of photos has she taken with that Kamera of hers?

220109.name: Artifact Transmuter
220109.desc:
·Consume Sanctifying Elixir to generate Artifacts through the process of Definition, or consume Artifacts to obtain Sanctifying Elixir through the process of Extraction.
·During each cycle, there is a limit on both the amount of Sanctifying Elixir that can be extracted and the number of times that Artifacts of each Set can be defined.

Artifacts draw their power from stories. This explains how it is possible to attempt to create Artifacts through sacred writings. Legend tells of an instance where seventy sages independently produced identical translations of the same source text; and thus, the original text was considered to be sacred. A person has only to place their hand on this machine and the story behind the Artifact will naturally flow out of it.

220110.name: Repertoire of Myriad Melodies
220110.desc: A collection of sheet music given to you by Sansa the bard. It contains musical scores and performance insights gathered from various nations, penned in such detail as to rival a musical encyclopedia.\nWith such a collection at their disposal, a musician could play many enchanting melodies indeed...

220111.name: Djem Djem Drum
220111.desc: A traditional instrument from Natlan that can be used in performances.\nA percussion instrument with a skin drumhead that can be played with one's bare hands. Tuned using ropes, it has a unique sound that, in skilled hands, can add a rich rhythm to any song.

220112.name: Ukulele
220112.desc: A traditional instrument from Natlan that can be used in performances.\nA small, four-stringed lute shaped similarly to — and which plays like — a guitar, though its fret count and tuning differ. Thanks to the material the strings are made of, it sounds clear and bright, yet soft, soothing the hearts of those who hear it.

220113.name: Inscribed Mirror
220113.desc: A mirror-type gadget made by the Amurta researcher Lamiya. It can be linked to the adopted animals' devices, which will reflect the animals' points of view in the mirror.

220114.name: Forensic Imaging Device
220114.desc: A special Kamera that can be used to compare past and present data to investigate anomalies in an area and gather important clues.\nAt the same time, thanks to its various optical channels, this device can allow you to pick up on traces that may be difficult to observe with the naked eye. If you make good use of this function, you'll be able to gather information with ease.

220115.name: Neo Terminal: Floating Leaf Model
220115.desc: A Neo Akasha Terminal mechanism based on an unknown creature, created by a deity who commands all wisdom.\nIts creator ingeniously programmed an auto-follow protocol, intending for it to provide aid to its master anywhere, anytime.\nIn addition, it also comes with the latest timekeeping function, as if to remind its master of their daily agenda.

220116.name: "Lingering Euphonia"
220116.desc: A guitar that Skirk made based on the instruments of her homeland.\nThe guitar has a unique charm when played. Its ancient melody seems to hum of a history that nobody recalls.

220117.name: Leaping Spirit Piano
220117.desc: Use to play a Natlanese-style instrument.\nA uniquely curved mechanical piano, its black and white keys resemble a traditional model, but the sound it produces is unconventional indeed. On certain lively occasions, musicians play it such that its rhythm becomes the fuel for a fiery atmosphere.

220118.name: Paimon's Kamera
220118.desc: A convenient gadget that can record and store pictures of scenery. This one belongs to Paimon. Aside from food and spending time with you, Paimon has many other hobbies, and photography is one of them. According to her, the pictures she has taken are enough for an exhibition. Perhaps one day, you can hold a photography exhibition for Paimon!

220120.name: Ujola Cat
220120.desc: A mysterious mechanical being, much like a cat.\nIt is a gift from the Voynich Guild that was unearthed from an ancient ruin dating back to the pioneering age. According to an anonymous informant, the inscription at the excavation site once bore the word "Ujola," but it weathered away shortly after being uncovered. To this day, the meaning of the name remains uncertain.\nPerhaps it was simply a cat named "Ujola," or it once belonged to someone by that name. Records from the Akademiya show that this name once belonged to a student from Nod-Krai many years ago. The truth is probably simple — after all, it's just a name paired with a cat. What more profound meaning could there possibly be?

220121.name: Rotor Hovering Daybed
220121.desc:
The Voynich Guild developed this hovering daybed using artifacts unearthed from the pioneering age.
Once activated, it hovers slightly above ground, allowing you to rest on it anywhere in the wild. A remarkable creation indeed!
Despite the Voynich Guild's best efforts at reverse-engineering, the daybed remains somewhat unstable — the technology of the pioneering age remains unfathomable to this day.
It is said that when the earliest hovering daybed was discovered, it was buried alongside a mechanical cat, leading some to call it the "King Size Cat Bed."
"No! It couldn't possibly be a cat bed. Everyone knows cats don't sleep in their own beds!"

220122.name: Memento Kamera
220122.desc: An antique Kamera with an elegant design. It once belonged to a legendary Fontainian photographer and witnessed countless historic moments.\nNow, it serves the purpose of capturing the fleeting beauty along its journey and preserving it forever.\nEvery press of the shutter is a gentle act of capturing a memory.

220123.name: Luna Treasure Compass
220123.desc: A compass that can be used in Nod-Krai and the Frost Moon to search for nearby treasures and relevant clues.\nThis sublunary sphere holds countless unknown treasures, waiting to be discovered by adventurers with courage or wit.

220124.name: Travel Accounts
220124.desc: A notebook filled with various anecdotes and amusing tales.\nOpen it to browse the stories recorded within. With the fortune slip tucked inside, you can also make a simple wish via Destiny Drawn.

220125.name: Lunar Arcana Case
220125.desc: A card box given to you by a certain witch proficient in divination. It can be used to store the Lunar Arcana you find during your performances, cards which may also be exchanged with friends in Co-Op Mode.\nEach world defines divination differently, but one thing remains constant — the use of "here" and "now" as anchors to unravel the unknown. Thus, the more Arcana one hoards within this box, the brighter the lantern of understanding burns...

220126.name: The Little Witch's Dictionary
220126.desc: Received from Alice, this dictionary was created by the witches. Though it claims to explain a storybook of fables titled The Little Witch and the Undying Fire, it is actually filled with homework tailored by the Hexenzirkel for each reader.\nAs they say, "To defy the current is to learn." Embark on your journey with your companions and seek the crown of elevation!

220127.name: Jadelight Canopy
220127.desc: Bathed in the energy of the Ley Lines, the Jadelight Canopy has been replenished with spiritual power. It can now summon a jade carriage, helping its user travel quickly to distant locations.

220128.name: Spotter Kamera
220128.desc: The Kamera that Paimon carries with her. Use it to record the noteworthy differences you find this time!

220129.name: Harmonic Keys
220129.desc: A delicate instrument that can be used in performances.\nIn the eyes of the ancient philosopher-debaters, the melodies of the mortal world are but a rough imitation of the universe's symphony. However, the King of the Immortals captured the unusual motifs within the musician's performance, then instructed the harmonist to fix the eternal music onto every key, allowing anyone who plays it to join in the grandest of symphonies.

220130.name: Segment-Domain Treasure Compass
220130.desc: When used within the Temple of Space, this device detects nearby treasures and the related clues.\n Even within the hidden vaults where the thousand winds cannot reach, there are still invisible threads that guide the way toward the most precious of collections — as well as the hidden meanings behind them.

220131.name: Linnea's Naturalist Archive
220131.desc: A naturalist archive crafted by Linnea herself. It records her observations and discoveries.

220132.name: Sandrone's Portable Tea Table
220132.desc: A portable tea table gifted to you by Sandrone. Easy to carry and store, and even fitted with a levitation device. With this, you can enjoy a leisurely tea party almost anywhere.

220133.name: Eye of Graeae
220133.desc: A strange mechanism you encountered in an abandoned station. It often appears in the form of a monocle.\nIt seems to have many convenient functions...

220134.name: Witch's Revelation Case
220134.desc: The case Barbeloth once carried has found its way into your possession. Within it sleep all the oracles, both those already revealed and those yet to open their eyes. Whether their words may one day steer the course of fate... Barbeloth would only say this: "Hehehe... The true colors of fate are never meant to be revealed lightly. Besides, a future with secrets yet to unfold is far more delightful, would you not agree?"

220135.name: MAAN-Kamera
220135.desc: A specialized Kamera provided by Chichikova, serving as a special equipment for the Mutual Aid Advancement Network. Once a designated target is captured in accordance with the exploration plan, the captured image is processed into vital intelligence, lighting the way for the rookies who follow in their footsteps...

220136.name: Cryo Treasure Compass
220136.desc: A compass that can be used in Snezhnaya to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.\nMany treasures lie frozen in hidden places across the land of snow. Those who can undo the seals may claim the gifts left within the ice.

221001.name: Instructions: Anemoculus Resonance Stone
221001.desc: Detailed step-by-step instructions for making an Anemoculus Resonance Stone. Master them and you will be able to create a tool to guide you to Anemoculi.

221002.name: Instructions: Geoculus Resonance Stone
221002.desc: Detailed step-by-step instructions for making a Geoculus Resonance Stone. Master them and you will be able to create a tool to guide you to Geoculi.

221003.name: Diagram: Geo Treasure Compass
221003.desc: A detailed step-by-step diagram for making a Geo Treasure Compass. Use it to easily locate treasure all over Liyue.

221004.name: Diagram: Wind Catcher
221004.desc: A detailed step-by-step diagram for making a Wind Catcher. A Wind Catcher can absorb the energy of Anemograna and release it when needed to create a wind current.

221005.name: Instructions: Portable Waypoint
221005.desc: Detailed step-by-step instructions for making a Portable Waypoint. With a Portable Waypoint, you can create a teleport waypoint wherever in the world you want.

221006.name: Diagram: Adepti Seeker's Stove
221006.desc: A detailed step-by-step diagram for making an Adepti Seeker's Stove. Learn it and you can create a portable stove to bring with you on your travels.

221007.name: Instructions: Condensed Resin
221007.desc: Detailed step-by-step instructions for making Condensed Resin. Using resin in this condensed form to activate certain Ley Line Blossoms and Petrified Trees will increase your efficiency. You can hold no more than 5 Condensed Resin at a time.
source_list: Purchase from the blacksmith in Mondstadt or Liyue

221008.name: Diagram: NRE (Menu 30)
221008.desc: A detailed step-by-step diagram for making a Nutrition, Ready-to-Eat (NRE) meal-in-a-pouch. Learn it and you can create a tool that makes ingesting food much quicker.
source_list: Purchase from the blacksmith in Mondstadt or Liyue

221010.desc: Through this memory, you can master the method to make a Snow-Tombed Starsilver (Claymore).

221011.name: Memory of the Frostbearing Tree
221011.desc: Through this memory, you can master the method to make a Frostbearer (Catalyst).

221012.name: Diagram: Dragonspine Spear
221012.desc: A detailed step-by-step diagram for making a Dragonspine Spear (Polearm).

221013.name: Saimon Heirloom Blade Diagram
221013.desc: The Saimon Clan possessed this diagram of how to make the Amenoma Kageuchi (Sword). You can use it to master the art of making this weapon.

221014.name: Diagram: Katsuragikiri Nagamasa
221014.desc: Someone from Tatarasuna left this diagram of Katsuragikiri Nagamasa behind. You can use it to master the art of making this Claymore.

221015.name: Diagram: Kitain Cross Spear
221015.desc: A detailed step-by-step diagram for making a Kitain Cross Spear (Polearm).

221016.name: Diagram: Hamayumi
221016.desc: A detailed step-by-step diagram for making a Hamayumi.

221017.name: Diagram: Warming Bottle
221017.desc: Detailed step-by-step instructions for making a Warming Bottle. Master them and you will be able to create a tool to resist Sheer Cold.

221018.name: Mask of Memories
221018.desc: Hanachirusato the shrine maiden used to wear this mask. It is deeply stained on the inside.\nSome memories are contained inside, through which one may learn the art of creating the Catalyst known as "Hakushin Ring."\nNow that Hanachirusato has been separated from this mask, Paimon doesn't get to call her the "Masked Maiden" anymore, right?

221019.name: Tale of the Forest King
221019.desc:
Through this tale, you can master the method to make the claymore "Forest Regalia."

This tale is about the Forest King.
"The forest used to be a giant maze many, many moons ago..."

221020.name: Tale of the Desert
221020.desc:
Through this tale, you can master the method to make the sword "Sapwood Blade."

This tale is about a friend lost in the desert.
"This is a story from Valuka..."

221021.name: Tale of the King's Squire
221021.desc:
Through this tale, you can master the method to make the bow "King's Squire."

This tale is about a girl lost in the forest maze.
"Once upon a time, there was a princess..."

221022.name: Tale of the Moonlight
221022.desc:
Through this tale, you can master the method to make the polearm "Moonpiercer."

This tale is about moonlight and magic.
"This story is about all the children who are fascinated by the moonlight..."

221023.name: Tale of the Portent
221023.desc:
Through this tale, you can master the method to make the catalyst "Fruit of Fulfillment."

This tale is about portents and disasters.
"In truth, the moon did not always look like a pearl..."

222001.name: Silken Print
222001.desc: A prayer plaque that displays lovely Inazuman scenery, carved upon exquisite Yumemiru Wood in full color.\nYou can use Sub-Space Creation to imprint this elegant scene upon your Serenitea Pot...

222002.name: Nature's True Fruit
222002.desc: This fruit, brought as a memento from Sumeru by the Teapot Traveling Salesman Chubby, gives off a truly marvelous fragrance.\nEven a whiff of this fruit brings certain images to mind, which you can manipulate via the power of Sub-Space Creation to recreate the wondrous sights of Sumeru in your Realm Within...

222003.name: "Swirling Scene in a Bottle"
222003.desc: This lovely terrarium filled with beautiful landscapes was brought from Fontaine by the Teapot Traveling Salesman Chubby.\nThe scenes contained within bring certain images to mind, which you can manipulate via the power of Sub-Space Creation to recreate the wondrous sights of Fontaine in your Realm Within...

222004.name: Scroll of the Fiery Firmament
222004.desc: This Natlan woven scroll, depicting unique landscapes and containing hidden powers, is a souvenir brought back from Natlan by the Teapot Traveling Salesman, Chubby.\nThe patterns on the scroll bring certain images to mind, which you can manipulate via the power of Sub-Space Creation to recreate the wondrous sights of Natlan in your Realm Within...

222005.name: Sphere of Fleeting Shadow
222005.desc: A Nod-Krai kuuvahki sphere mechanism, capable of playing music and producing dazzling light effects. It is a souvenir brought back from Nod-Krai by the Teapot Traveling Salesman, Chubby.\nEven a glimpse of the shifting lights cast by the sphere brings faint images to mind, which you can manipulate through the power of Sub-Space Creation to recreate the wondrous landscapes of Nod-Krai in your Realm Within...

223001.name: The Mountain Clouds Let Down Golden Rain
223001.desc: A classic "cloud blue" firework that will display its inner-and-outer-segmented design after exploding in mid-air like a profusely-blooming flower.

223002.name: The Silver Night Is Full of Stars
223002.desc: A classic "starry-night"-colored firework. Sure to be a magnificent, unforgettable sight.

223003.name: The Gloom Paints the Cold Blooms
223003.desc: A classic firework the color of the azure skies just after rain. Its flaming flower glows when released, displaying unique petal morphologies.

223004.name: Fireworks Dance Amidst a Snowy Sky
223004.desc: These gorgeous golden fireworks follow a particularly graceful trajectory after they ascend and are quite silent, though no less lovely for it.

223005.name: Golden Calendula Swirl
223005.desc: These calendula-colored classics will spin like windmills after being released and are most beauteous indeed.

223006.name: Kindled Trees by the Moonlit Window
223006.desc: After being released, these fireworks rain down flames like willow leaves and branches. It is said that the very edges of these flames can touch the window frames of the tallest buildings, granting a most unique viewing experience.

223007.name: Mischievous Villosas
223007.desc: An Anemo Slime-shaped creation. However, its creator considered calling it an "Anemo Slime-something" just a little odd, thus using the name of a similarly-colored local snack, "Villosa Balls," instead.

223008.name: Sparkly Shiny Dodoco!
223008.desc: After visiting a neighboring state, a certain firework artisan from Liyue met a friendly and hospitable Spark Knight, and thus created this firework based on her bestest friend, Dodoco.

223009.name: Fame and Fortune For a Season
223009.desc: A firework that explodes in the shape of Mora. Some say that if you view this from just the right angle, your fortunes for the year shall be assured.

223010.name: Unyielding Spirit
223010.desc: After visiting a neighboring state, a certain firework artisan from Liyue went on an unforgettable journey with a certain adventure team leader, thus basing this explosion's design off his favored gesture.

223011.name: Festival Spotlight
223011.desc: A firework that explodes in the shape of heart. Some say that if you view this from just the right angle, your love life for the year shall be blessed.

223012.name: Wanmin Feast
223012.desc: A firework based on the little helper for the Wanmin Restaurant's famous chef. When anyone from Liyue sees this little helper, their thoughts will immediately turn to good food. And where there's a festival, there must be good food!

223013.name: Between the Exquisite Throws of Her Enigmatic Dice
223013.desc: A dice-shaped firework that displays a different number each time it is set off. It is said to be a gift from a firework artisan intending to show their respect for the Yanshang Teahouse's new owner. Since she took over the place, almost all the problem gamblers have disappeared. The game of cards no longer has anything to do with Mora, instead returning to its original and purest form — ordinary leisure-time amusement.

223014.name: Inuzaka General's Friendly Helper
223014.desc: A traveling novelist was once warmly welcomed by a pointy-eared General during their stay in Watatsumi Island. The General's little canine companion left a deep impression on them, and so they commissioned an artisan to craft this firework.

223015.name: Cliffbreaker's Banner Flutters in Drum Rolls
223015.desc: A firework meticulously designed by an opera-loving firework artisan. It explodes in the shape of the banners often seen in opera performances. Watching operas is a favorite pastime among many Liyue locals, and when fireworks with this pattern bloom in the sky, an unforgettable melody sung by a certain famed performer is sure to come to mind...

223016.name: That Fairly Effectual "Advice" Against Wine
223016.desc: A firework commissioned by a merchant who often traveled between Liyue and Mondstadt. This firework is said to be a token of gratitude for a certain bartender, for it was after being deeply struck by her words that the merchant stopped their excessive drinking and made a great fortune.

223017.name: Rainforest-Born Fungi
223017.desc: A firework that explodes in the shape of a Floating Hydro Fungus.\nThey say that a Ministry of Civil Affairs clerk offered the inspiration for this rotund firework pattern after returning from a business trip in Sumeru, hoping that its adorable appearance would brighten everyone's heart.

223018.name: Obliging Little Yuegui
223018.desc: A firework inspired by a warmhearted little girl.\nMany people have received a helping hand from the girl, yet none know her name — all they know is that she called her companion "Yuegui." This firework was commissioned as an expression of their gratitude and well wishes.

223301.name: Construct Appearance: Jack Frost
223301.desc: An appearance variant for the "Prime Ice Construct: Cube."\nJack Frost appears utterly obsessed with fashioning bizarre icy creations in their own image. Even with a structure as simple as a cube, they have poured immense effort into incorporating their own distinct features.

223302.name: Construct Appearance: Polyarbear
223302.desc: Appearance of the "Prime Ice Construct: Storage Device."\nThere is an old saying among hunters that goes: "If a bear holds it close, you know it's a treasure."\nWhile the idea of wresting anything away from a real Polyarbear sounds terrifying, a mere storage unit modeled after one shouldn't pose much of a threat... right?

223303.name: Construct Appearance: The Ballerina
223303.desc: An appearance variant for the "Prime Ice Construct: Ambient Bollard."\nWhen watching a performance, one's emotions naturally ebb and flow with every graceful movement of the ballet dancer. Each viewing instills a profound sense of inner strength.\nPerhaps it was born from this very sentiment that this particular Prime Ice Construct appearance was designed.

223304.name: Construct Appearance: The Hound
223304.desc: An appearance variant for the "Prime Ice Construct: Ambient Bollard."\nContinuous buffs come not only from ambient bollards, but from the companions by our side. Sometimes, their mere presence provides a strength that far surpasses any magical enhancement... That being said, it would be wonderful if these bollards could follow us around just like a real companion.

223305.name: Construct Appearance: The Tides
223305.desc: An appearance variant for the "Prime Ice Construct: Ambient Bollard."\nThey say that if you stand near a bollard crafted in this likeness, you can sometimes hear the faint murmur of the tides. Yet, the structure itself makes no sound; the melody belongs entirely to your mind and imagination, just like a song that suddenly echoes in your heart on a quiet night.

339500.desc: A small table used as an arena in Genius Invokation TCG matches. It normally resembles an elevated box a bit more. Some players will place their Casket of Tomes inside to better carry both around, and once opened up, the various exquisitely built arenas of differing types and styles are then revealed as stages for the duels to come.

339901.name: Beginner Player Badge
339901.desc: They say that anyone who starts out with Genius Invokation TCG can obtain this particular Player Badge.\nEven the mightiest player starts from this point, building their personal legends as they go along.\nStay tuned, player — your saga begins here!

339902.name: Advanced Player Badge
339902.desc: Those who play Genius Invokation TCG often and complete the Advanced Player Trial match will obtain this Player Badge.\nMany are those who become players, but the vast majority treat the game as a sort of pastime, and so those who become Advanced Players are few and far between.\nEven games do provide the dedicated with unique rewards.

339903.name: Expert Player Badge
339903.desc: Those who study the art of playing Genius Invokation TCG and clear the Expert Player Trial match will obtain this Player Badge.\nPerhaps your attitude at this point is markedly different from when you first began, but you still find new joy in playing—\nIn willingly putting time into something you find interesting, and in enjoying all that comprises that which you love.

339904.name: Master Player Badge
339904.desc: Those who reach the level at which they may complete the Master player Trial shall receive this Player Badge.\nThey say that few are the players who can obtain this badge, and each of them has their own unique take on the game.\nVictory, it seems, may no longer be the sole object here.

339905.name: Legend Player Badge
339905.desc: Those who clear the Legend Player Trial will obtain this Player Badge.\nThis badge proves that you are well on your way to carving out your own unique mythos as a player.\nGo forth, go beyond, and reach new heights!

340000.name: Summertime Sparkle
340000.desc: Barbara's beach attire. This pretty skirt brims with summer vitality and carries with it a cool ocean breeze.

340001.name: Sea Breeze Dandelion
340001.desc: Jean's summer wear. Light and cool, but no less elegant for it. The perfect choice for a trip to the seaside.

340002.name: Orchid's Evening Gown
340002.desc: Ningguang's formal wear. The long cyan skirt traces her elegant curves, and the butterfly wings at her ankles lend the outfit a touch of light grace.

340003.name: Opulent Splendor
340003.desc: Keqing's formal wear. Amidst the beautiful dawn of the Lantern Rite, the threads weaved by days of hard work intertwine into a light yet magnificent appearance.

340004.name: Red Dead of Night
340004.desc: One of the outfits Diluc wears during covert actions, it resembles a flame dancing in the shadows. The crimson red traces it leaves behind at the edges of the enemy's vision will scar their nightmares forever.

340005.name: Ein Immernachtstraum
340005.desc: A ceremonial outfit for the Prinzessin. May she who is noble retain her courage, sincerity, and kindness forever, such that no evil shall ever overcome her.

340006.name: Gunnhildr's Legacy
340006.desc: Jean's outfit. This classic knight's ceremonial outfit is suited to all manner of occasions.

340007.name: 100% Outrider
340007.desc: Amber's outfit. This is a more formal — but no less cool — version of the Outrider's uniform!

340008.name: Pact of Stars and Moon
340008.desc: Mona's outfit. A costume made specifically to encompass the astrological concept of "the destined moment," thanks to the 30% discount ticket she got from the planetarium refund.

340009.name: To the Church's Free Spirit
340009.desc: Rosaria's outfit. This seems to have been custom-made for her by the Church.

340010.name: Springbloom Missive
340010.desc: Ayaka's travel outfit. Its design is based on the Fontaine dresses depicted in light novel illustrations and seems to reflect the lifestyle of proper ladies who live in that nation.

340011.name: A Sobriquet Under Shade
340011.desc: An outfit Lisa had someone commission for her when she revisited Sumeru. A perfect balance between practicality and elegance, the dress bears a resemblance to Lisa's old uniform from the Akademiya days.

340012.name: Blossoming Starlight
340012.desc: An exquisite outfit Klee wears only for the most important performances. The colors are brilliant, like a cake adorned with cream flowers and crowned with scarlet candles. With it comes happiness and smiles that will fill your adventures.

340013.name: Sailwind Shadow
340013.desc: Kaeya's outfit from his role as the "Dagger Bandit" in the play. Though flamboyant and designed to be as eye-catching as possible, it isn't difficult to put on, though it does take some time to get all the accessories and daggers sorted.

340014.name: Frostflower Dew
340014.desc: This Lantern Rite gift that Shenhe received is a set of elegant formal attire that her master, Cloud Retainer had commissioned for her. Red ropes still adorn her arms, but the bitter cold in Shenhe's heart has faded.

340015.name: Twilight Blossom
340015.desc: A light and graceful festive outfit accented mainly in black nightshade and cerulean blue. Its hair accessory is as radiant as the Qingxin — a pairing that Ganyu is most fond of.

340016.name: Bamboo Rain
340016.desc: Formal wear prepared by the Feiyun Commerce Guild for Xingqiu. The bamboo prints are refined and the cut is most flattering, but Xingqiu's favorite aspect of the outfit is its inner pockets, into which a thinner novel might be stuffed.

340017.name: Breeze of Sabaa
340017.desc: An elegant outfit for Nilou, this featherweight dress is seemingly woven of countless flowers, and with it drifts a light fragrance like the east wind at dawn, carrying beauteous blessings from a fairytale land.

340018.name: Phantom in Boots
340018.desc: Kirara's outfit. The swashbuckling feline of fairytale fame, the crafty courier of dearly-held dreams... is pleased to make your acquaintance!

340019.name: Cherries Snow-Laden
340019.desc: Hu Tao's outfit. Styled in a palette lighter than the dark ceremonial wear favored by the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, the dress is a special gift from her good friend Xiangling. The sunglasses, for their part, are from Hu Tao's personal collection.

340020.name: New Year's Cheer
340020.desc: Xiangling's outfit. The red coat glows like a stove amidst cold winds, topped with a hat that, at Hu Tao's suggestion, took inspiration from Guoba's appearance — a design that's right up Xiangling's alley.

340021.name: Tranquil Banquet
